```python
    # ------------------------------------------------ offline pack (v2.6.1) --
    def _load_pack_settings(self):
        from .download import offline_config
        path, only = offline_config()
        self.pack_path_edit.blockSignals(True)
        self.offline_only_check.blockSignals(True)
        self.pack_path_edit.setText(path)
        self.offline_only_check.setChecked(only)
        self.pack_path_edit.blockSignals(False)
        self.offline_only_check.blockSignals(False)
        self._show_pack_status()

    def _pack_changed(self, *args):
        from .download import set_offline_config
        try:
            set_offline_config(self.pack_path_edit.text().strip(),
                               self.offline_only_check.isChecked())
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("Offline settings not saved: {}".format(e))
        self._show_pack_status()

    def _show_pack_status(self):
        from .offline_pack import describe
        path = self.pack_path_edit.text().strip()
        text = describe(path)
        if self.offline_only_check.isChecked():
            text += "  Offline only: no internet requests."
        self.pack_status_label.setText(text)

    def _browse_pack(self, *args):
        start = self.pack_path_edit.text().strip() or os.path.expanduser("~")
        path, _f = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Offline data pack", start,
            "Offline data pack (*.zip *.sqlite);;All files (*)")
        if path:
            self.pack_path_edit.setText(path)
            self._pack_changed()

    def _clear_pack(self, *args):
        self.pack_path_edit.setText("")
        self._pack_changed()

    def _on_build_pack(self, *args):
        if self._busy:
            return
        start = self.pack_path_edit.text().strip()
        if not start.lower().endswith(".zip"):
            start = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "nd_offline_pack.zip")
        path, _f = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(self, "Build offline data pack", start,
                                               "Zip (*.zip)")
        if not path:
            return
        if not path.lower().endswith(".zip"):
            path += ".zip"
        if QMessageBox.question(
                self, "Build offline data pack",
                "Download every data set for all of North Dakota into\n{}\n\nThis needs "
                "internet access and takes a long time (an hour or more; a large file). "
                "QGIS stays usable. Start?".format(path)) != MB_YES:
            return
        from .build_nd_pack import build
        from .constants import sources_file_path

        def work(progress, log):
            src = sources_file_path()
            return build(path, progress=progress, log=log,
                         sources_file=src if os.path.isfile(src) else None)

        def done(outcome):
            if outcome.cancelled:
                self._update_status("Offline pack stopped - start it again with the same file "
                                    "to go on", False)
                return
            if outcome.error is not None:
                self._log(outcome.traceback)
                self._update_status("Offline pack FAILED: {}".format(outcome.error), False)
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Build offline data pack", str(outcome.error))
                return
            man = outcome.result or {}
            ds = man.get("datasets") or {}
            bad = sorted(k for k, v in ds.items()
                         if v.get("status") not in ("complete", "partial", "not available"))
            part = sorted(k for k, v in ds.items()
                          if v.get("status") == "partial" or v.get("gaps"))
            self._update_status("Offline pack written: {}{}{}".format(
                os.path.basename(path), " - missing: " + ", ".join(bad) if bad else "",
                " - incomplete: " + ", ".join(part) if part else ""), not (bad or part))
            if QMessageBox.question(self, "Build offline data pack",
                                    "Use this pack on this computer too?") == MB_YES:
                self.pack_path_edit.setText(path)
                self._pack_changed()
        self._start_background("Building the offline data pack...", work, done,
                               project_bound=False)

    def _data_area_changed(self, *args):
        from .datafetch import AREA_FLOOD
        self.flood_buffer_spin.setEnabled(self.data_area_combo.currentData() == AREA_FLOOD)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ config --
    def _data_cfg(self):
        """The download choices as pipeline cfg keys (shared by the
        classification and Download data now)."""
        from .classify_tab import _AUTO, _DOWNLOAD, _ROAD_RE, _RAIL_RE
        from .compat import GEOM_LINE
        road_choice = self.road_combo.currentData()
        road = self._resolve_layer(self.road_combo, _ROAD_RE, (GEOM_LINE,), exclude=_RAIL_RE)
        return {
            "download_nsi": self.nsi_download_check.isChecked(),
            "download_address": self.addr_download_check.isChecked(),
            "download_usa_structures": self.usa_download_check.isChecked(),
            "download_camps": self.camps_download_check.isChecked(),
            "download_roads": road is None and road_choice in (_AUTO, _DOWNLOAD),
            "download_rail": self.rail_combo.currentData() == _DOWNLOAD,
            "download_crossings": self.crossing_combo.currentData() == _DOWNLOAD,
            "download_crossings_structures": self.crossings_download_check.isChecked(),
            "download_dams": self.dams_download_check.isChecked(),
            "download_lifelines": self.lifelines_download_check.isChecked(),
            "download_flowlines": self.flowlines_download_check.isChecked(),
            "download_places": self.flowlines_download_check.isChecked(),
            "data_area": self.data_area_combo.currentData(),
            "flood_buffer_ft": float(self.flood_buffer_spin.value()),
            "add_to_project": True,
            "local_data": self._local_data_for_run(),      # v2.9: data folder picks
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ actions --
    def _open_data_folder(self, *args):
        path = os.path.join(self.config_output_folder or "", SUBDIR_DATA)
        if not self.config_output_folder:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Data", "Pick the dam folder on the Setup tab "
                                                  "first.")
            return
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
        self._open_path(path)

    def _download_job(self):
        """Main-thread preparation of Download data now: the depth raster,
        the study area and the choices. Raises when there is no study area."""
        from .extent import make_extent_clip
        # only the depth raster is needed here (study area / flooded area);
        # a missing velocity raster is the classification's business
        path = self._raster_paths().get("depth") or ""
        depth = QgsRasterLayer(path, "Depth")
        if not depth.isValid():
            raise RuntimeError("The Depth raster failed to load: " + path)
        ctx = QgsProject.instance().transformContext()
        clip = make_extent_clip(depth, self.extent_spin.value(), ctx)
        if clip is None or clip.bbox_4326() is None:
            raise RuntimeError("No study area - the Depth raster has no usable extent / "
                               "coordinate system.")
        cfg = self._data_cfg()
        cfg["add_to_project"] = False           # the saved files are added by the caller
        if hasattr(self, "_cache_cfg"):
            cfg.update(self._cache_cfg())       # v2.8: per-tile download cache
        return {"cfg": cfg, "clip": clip, "depth": depth, "out": self.config_output_folder,
                "dam": self.config_dam_folder}

    def _add_downloaded(self, saved):
        """Add the data sets a background run saved (path, base) to the
        project's 'Downloaded data' group and refresh the layer lists."""
        from .constants import GRP_DATA
        from .helpers import add_layer_to_project
        from qgis.core import QgsVectorLayer
        for path, base in saved:
            lyr = QgsVectorLayer(path, base, "ogr")
            if lyr.isValid():
                add_layer_to_project(lyr, base, visibility=False, group=self._group(GRP_DATA))
        self._refresh_layer_combos()

    def _download_data_sync(self):
        """Download and save the data sets on the calling thread (scripts,
        tests). Returns the rows of datafetch.download_data."""
        from .datafetch import download_data
        job = self._download_job()
        job["cfg"]["add_to_project"] = True
        self._progress = self._make_progress("Downloading data...")
        rows = download_data(job["cfg"], job["clip"], job["depth"], job["out"], job["dam"],
                             progress=self._progress_tick, log=self._log)
        self._refresh_layer_combos()
        return rows

    def _on_download_data(self, *args):
        if self._busy:
            return
        if not self.config_output_folder:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Download data", "Pick the dam folder on the Setup tab "
                                                       "first.")
            return
        depth = self._raster_paths().get("depth")
        if not depth or not os.path.isfile(depth):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Download data", "The study area comes from the Depth "
                                                       "raster - select it on the Setup tab.")
            return
        try:
            job = self._download_job()
        except Exception as e:
            self._update_status("Download FAILED: {}".format(e), False)
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Download data", str(e) or repr(e))
            return
        from .datafetch import download_data
        from .runner import release_outputs
        # the saved data sets are rewritten: a loaded layer would keep the
        # files locked (Windows) - taken out of the project, added again after
        n = release_outputs(self.config_output_folder, data_sets=True)
        if n:
            self._log(">>> {} layer(s) of outputs/{} taken out of the project (they are "
                      "written again)".format(n, SUBDIR_DATA))
        sink = []

        def work(progress, log):
            return download_data(job["cfg"], job["clip"], job["depth"], job["out"], job["dam"],
                                 progress=progress, log=log,
                                 add_layer=lambda path, base: sink.append((path, base)))

        def done(outcome):
            if outcome.cancelled:
                self._update_status("Download cancelled", False)
                self._log(">>> Download cancelled by user")
                return
            if outcome.error is not None:
                self._log(outcome.traceback)
                log_message(outcome.traceback, MSG_CRITICAL)
                self._update_status("Download FAILED: {}".format(outcome.error), False)
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Download data",
                                     str(outcome.error) or repr(outcome.error))
                return
            self._add_downloaded(sink)
            self._report_downloads(outcome.result)
        self._start_background("Downloading data...", work, done)

    def _report_downloads(self, rows):
        saved = [r for r in rows if r[1]]
        failed = [r[0] for r in rows if r[1] is None and r[4] != "study area"
                  and r[4] != "flooded area"]
        self._update_status("Data: {} data set(s) saved to outputs/{}{}".format(
            len(saved), SUBDIR_DATA, " - {} failed".format(len(failed)) if failed else ""),
            not failed)
```

## `datafetch.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.5.1: 'Download data' - every data set the plugin can fetch from the
internet (or from a work server whose address is set in the data-source
file) saved as a GeoPackage in <outputs>/Data and added to the project.

Area of each data set:
  "study" - the study area (depth raster extent + the study-area buffer)
  "flood" - structures, facilities and other point / area data only where
            the flood is (wet depth cells + the flood buffer); lines (roads,
            rail, NHD flowlines) keep the whole study area because the road
            network beyond the flood decides sole access and the travel-time
            trace

The downloads go through download.py, so the dated caches in
outputs/_downloads are shared with Main Consolidation and the Hazard
Classification of the same day (nothing is fetched twice), and the
stale-cache fallback applies.
"""

import math
import os

import numpy as np
from osgeo import gdal

from qgis.core import (
    QgsCoordinateTransform, QgsFeatureRequest, QgsProject, QgsVectorLayer,
)

from .constants import (
    NARN_URL, CROSSINGS_URL, ND_ROADS_URL, HPMS_ND_URLS, ND_COUNTY_ROADS_URL, NDDOT_AADT_URL,
    NDDOT_AADT_LAYERS, NHD_FLOWLINE_URL, lifeline_downloads, RAIL_CROSSING_SEARCH_MI,
    GRP_DATA, SUBDIR_DATA,
)
from .compat import MSG_WARNING
from .download import (
    fetch_nsi, fetch_nd_address_points, fetch_usa_structures, fetch_osm_camps,
    fetch_arcgis_layer, fetch_dams, fetch_osm_lifelines, fetch_nbi, fetch_osm_crossings,
    fetch_osm_places, try_download, STALE_USED, PACK_USED,
    configure_tile_cache_from_cfg, tile_cache_report_lines,
)
from .extent import distance_xy_in_crs
from .helpers import (
    log_message, export_layer_to_formats, add_layer_to_project, plugin_group,
    dam_display_name, get_layer_path, gdal_exceptions, CancelledByUser, is_null,
)

AREA_STUDY, AREA_FLOOD = "study", "flood"
AREA_CHOICES = [("Study area - depth raster extent + study-area buffer", AREA_STUDY),
                ("Flooded area - wet depth cells + flood buffer (lines keep the study "
                 "area)", AREA_FLOOD)]
DEFAULT_FLOOD_BUFFER_FT = 300.0
MASK_MAX_CELLS = 4000            # flood mask side, cells (coarser grid for huge rasters)

# (key, file name, label, config flag, may be limited to the flood)
# the flag names are the pipeline's cfg keys, so one set of choices drives
# the downloads here, in Main Consolidation and in the classification
DATASETS = [
    ("nsi", "NSI_Structures", "USACE National Structure Inventory", "download_nsi", True),
    ("address", "ND_Site_Addresses", "ND GIS Hub site / structure address points",
     "download_address", True),
    ("usa", "FEMA_USA_Structures", "FEMA USA Structures outlines", "download_usa_structures",
     True),
    ("camps", "Campgrounds", "OpenStreetMap campgrounds / RV parks", "download_camps", True),
    ("roads", "ND_Roads", "ND GIS Hub NG9-1-1 road centerlines", "download_roads", False),
    ("traffic", "Traffic_Counts", "Traffic counts (HPMS / NDDOT / county AADT)",
     "download_roads", False),
    ("rail", "Rail_Lines", "FRA/BTS rail network", "download_rail", False),
    ("xing", "Rail_Grade_Crossings", "FRA grade crossings", "download_crossings", True),
    ("bridges", "Bridges_Culverts", "National Bridge Inventory + OpenStreetMap crossings",
     "download_crossings_structures", True),
    ("dams", "NID_Dams", "National Inventory of Dams", "download_dams", True),
    ("lifelines", "Lifeline_Facilities", "Lifeline facilities (ND GIS Hub, EIA, OSM)",
     "download_lifelines", True),
    ("flowlines", "NHD_Flowlines", "USGS NHD flowlines", "download_flowlines", False),
    ("places", "Towns", "OpenStreetMap cities / towns / villages", "download_places", True),
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------ flood mask --
def _dilate(mask, r):
    """Square dilation of a boolean grid by r cells (two 1D passes with
    cumulative sums - no scipy)."""
    if r <= 0:
        return mask
    out = mask
    for axis in (0, 1):
        a = np.moveaxis(out, axis, 0).astype(np.int32)
        n = a.shape[0]
        c = np.zeros((n + 1,) + a.shape[1:], dtype=np.int32)
        np.cumsum(a, axis=0, out=c[1:])
        lo = np.clip(np.arange(n) - r, 0, n)
        hi = np.clip(np.arange(n) + r + 1, 0, n)
        out = np.moveaxis((c[hi] - c[lo]) > 0, 0, axis)
    return out


class FloodMask(object):
    """Where the depth raster is wet (> 0), grown by `buffer_ft`, on a grid
    of at most MASK_MAX_CELLS per side (a coarse cell is wet when any of its
    cells is - never smaller than the flood)."""

    def __init__(self, depth_layer, buffer_ft, transform_ctx, lat=None):
        self.ok = False
        self.crs = depth_layer.crs() if depth_layer is not None else None
        self.ctx = transform_ctx
        self._xf = {}
        path = get_layer_path(depth_layer)
        if not path:
            return
        with gdal_exceptions():
            try:
                self._read(path, buffer_ft, lat)
                self.ok = True
            except Exception as e:
                log_message("Flood mask not made ({}) - the study area is used".format(e),
                            MSG_WARNING)

    def _read(self, path, buffer_ft, lat):
        ds = gdal.Open(path)
        if ds is None:
            raise RuntimeError("cannot open " + path)
        w, h = ds.RasterXSize, ds.RasterYSize
        scale = max(1.0, float(max(w, h)) / MASK_MAX_CELLS)
        if scale > 1.0:
            # coarse grid over the same extent; "max" keeps a coarse cell wet
            # when any of its cells is wet (never smaller than the flood)
            cw, ch = max(1, int(math.ceil(w / scale))), max(1, int(math.ceil(h / scale)))
            g0 = ds.GetGeoTransform()
            bounds = (g0[0], g0[3] + h * g0[5], g0[0] + w * g0[1], g0[3])
            ds = gdal.Warp("", ds, format="MEM", width=cw, height=ch, outputBounds=bounds,
                           resampleAlg="max")
        band = ds.GetRasterBand(1)
        a = band.ReadAsArray().astype(np.float64)
        nod = band.GetNoDataValue()
        s, o = band.GetScale(), band.GetOffset()
        if nod is not None:
            a[a == nod] = np.nan
        a = a * (s if s not in (None, 0) else 1.0) + (o or 0.0)
        wet = np.isfinite(a) & (a > 0)
        gt = ds.GetGeoTransform()
        self.gt = gt
        self.shape = wet.shape
        dx, dy = distance_xy_in_crs(float(buffer_ft), self.crs, lat) if self.crs is not None \
            else (0.0, 0.0)
        r = int(math.ceil(max(dx / abs(gt[1]), dy / abs(gt[5])))) if buffer_ft > 0 else 0
        r = min(r, max(self.shape))
        if r:
            # pad the grid by the buffer so a feature just outside the raster
            # edge but within the buffer of a wet edge cell is kept
            wet = np.pad(wet, r, mode="constant", constant_values=False)
            gt = (gt[0] - r * gt[1], gt[1], gt[2], gt[3] - r * gt[5], gt[4], gt[5])
            self.gt = gt
            self.shape = wet.shape
        self.mask = _dilate(wet, r)
        self.n_wet = int(wet.sum())

    def _to_mask(self, src_crs):
        key = src_crs.authid() or src_crs.toWkt() if src_crs is not None else ""
        if key not in self._xf:
            xf = None
            try:
                if src_crs is not None and src_crs.isValid() and self.crs.isValid():
                    t = QgsCoordinateTransform(src_crs, self.crs, self.ctx)
                    xf = None if t.isShortCircuited() else t
            except Exception:
                xf = None
            self._xf[key] = xf
        return self._xf[key]

    def touches(self, geom, src_crs):
        """True when the feature's box reaches a wet (buffered) cell. A
        feature that cannot be located is kept."""
        if not self.ok:
            return True
        try:
            bb = geom.boundingBox()
            xf = self._to_mask(src_crs)
            if xf is not None:
                bb = xf.transformBoundingBox(bb)
            gt = self.gt
            c0 = (bb.xMinimum() - gt[0]) / gt[1]
            c1 = (bb.xMaximum() - gt[0]) / gt[1]
            r0 = (bb.yMaximum() - gt[3]) / gt[5]
            r1 = (bb.yMinimum() - gt[3]) / gt[5]
            c0, c1 = sorted((c0, c1))
            r0, r1 = sorted((r0, r1))
            h, w = self.shape
            c0, c1 = max(0, int(math.floor(c0))), min(w - 1, int(math.floor(c1)))
            r0, r1 = max(0, int(math.floor(r0))), min(h - 1, int(math.floor(r1)))
            if c0 > c1 or r0 > r1:
                return False                  # outside the raster
            return bool(self.mask[r0:r1 + 1, c0:c1 + 1].any())
        except Exception:
            return True


# ------------------------------------------------------------ downloads --
def data_folder(output_folder):
    from .processing import DATA_MARKER_FILE
    path = os.path.join(output_folder, SUBDIR_DATA)
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    marker = os.path.join(path, DATA_MARKER_FILE)
    if not os.path.isfile(marker):
        try:
            with open(marker, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                fh.write("Layers in this folder were saved by the ND Dam Hazard "
                         "Classification Helper (Data & Output tab).\n")
        except OSError:
            pass
    return path


def _kept_ids(layer, clip, mask, use_flood, progress=None):
    ids = []
    xf = clip.transform_from(layer.crs()) if clip is not None else None
    for f in layer.getFeatures(QgsFeatureRequest().setNoAttributes()):
        g = f.geometry()
        if g is None or g.isNull() or g.isEmpty():
            continue
        if clip is not None and not clip.intersects_geometry(g, xform=xf):
            continue
        if use_flood and mask is not None and not mask.touches(g, layer.crs()):
            continue
        ids.append(f.id())
    return ids


def _save(layer, name, dam, out, clip, mask, use_flood, ctx, add_layer):
    """Write the features of `layer` inside the area to Data/<dam>_<name>.gpkg
    and hand the file to add_layer(path, base) (None: not shown).
    Returns (path or None, kept, total)."""
    total = layer.featureCount()
    ids = _kept_ids(layer, clip, mask, use_flood)
    base = "{}_{}".format(dam, name)
    sub = layer.materialize(QgsFeatureRequest().setFilterFids(ids)) if ids else None
    if sub is None:
        return None, 0, total
    _ok, _r, paths = export_layer_to_formats(sub, data_folder(out), base, ctx,
                                             formats=("gpkg",))
    path = paths.get("gpkg")
    if path and add_layer is not None:
        add_layer(path, base)
    return path, len(ids), total


def _merge(layers):
    """One memory layer of several layers of the same kind (lifelines from
    several agencies): geometry, source and name / category."""
    from qgis.core import QgsFeature, QgsField
    from .compat import FT_STRING, WKB_POINT, GEOM_POINT
    from .helpers import create_memory_layer
    layers = [(label, lyr) for label, lyr in layers if lyr is not None and lyr.featureCount()]
    if not layers:
        return None
    from qgis.core import QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem
    crs = QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem("EPSG:4326")
    out = create_memory_layer("merged", WKB_POINT, crs,
                              [QgsField("Source", FT_STRING), QgsField("Name", FT_STRING),
                               QgsField("Type", FT_STRING)])
    feats = []
    for label, lyr in layers:
        names = [f.name() for f in lyr.fields()]
        low = [n.lower() for n in names]
        pick = lambda cands: next((names[low.index(c)] for c in cands if c in low), None)
        nm = pick(("name", "facility", "fac_name", "plant_name", "station_name", "label"))
        tp = pick(("category", "type", "amenity", "facility_type", "naics_desc"))
        xf = QgsCoordinateTransform(lyr.crs(), crs, QgsProject.instance().transformContext())
        for f in lyr.getFeatures():
            g = f.geometry()
            if g is None or g.isNull():
                continue
            try:
                p = g if g.type() == GEOM_POINT else g.pointOnSurface()
                p.transform(xf)
            except Exception:
                continue
            q = QgsFeature(out.fields())
            q.setGeometry(p)
            q.setAttributes([label, "" if not nm or is_null(f[nm]) else str(f[nm]),
                             "" if not tp or is_null(f[tp]) else str(f[tp])])
            feats.append(q)
    out.dataProvider().addFeatures(feats)
    out.updateExtents()
    return out


def _fetch(key, ext, xing, big, out, progress):
    """(layer, label) for one data set - several services are merged."""
    if key == "nsi":
        return try_download("NSI", fetch_nsi, ext, out, progress_cb=progress)[0]
    if key == "address":
        return try_download("ND GIS Hub address points", fetch_nd_address_points, ext, out,
                            progress_cb=progress)[0]
    if key == "usa":
        return try_download("FEMA USA Structures", fetch_usa_structures, ext, out,
                            progress_cb=progress)[0]
    if key == "camps":
        return try_download("OpenStreetMap campgrounds", fetch_osm_camps, ext, out)[0]
    if key == "roads":
        return try_download("ND GIS Hub roads", fetch_arcgis_layer, ND_ROADS_URL, ext, out,
                            "ND_roads_NG911", progress_cb=progress)[0]
    if key == "traffic":
        for url in HPMS_ND_URLS:
            year = "".join(ch for ch in url.split("HPMS_FULL_ND_")[-1][:4] if ch.isdigit())
            lyr = try_download("HPMS {}".format(year), fetch_arcgis_layer, url, ext, out,
                               "HPMS_ND_{}".format(year))[0]
            if lyr is not None:
                return lyr
        if NDDOT_AADT_URL:
            url = "{}/{}".format(NDDOT_AADT_URL.rstrip("/"), NDDOT_AADT_LAYERS.get("aadt", 0))
            lyr = try_download("NDDOT traffic counts", fetch_arcgis_layer, url, ext, out,
                               "NDDOT_traffic_counts")[0]
            if lyr is not None and lyr.featureCount():
                return lyr
        return try_download("ND county roads (AADT)", fetch_arcgis_layer, ND_COUNTY_ROADS_URL,
                            ext, out, "ND_county_roads")[0]
    if key == "rail":
        return try_download("Rail lines", fetch_arcgis_layer, NARN_URL, ext, out,
                            "NARN_rail_lines", progress_cb=progress)[0]
    if key == "xing":
        return try_download("Grade crossings", fetch_arcgis_layer, CROSSINGS_URL, xing, out,
                            "FRA_grade_crossings", progress_cb=progress)[0]
    if key == "bridges":
        return _merge([("National Bridge Inventory",
                        try_download("National Bridge Inventory", fetch_nbi, ext, out)[0]),
                       ("OpenStreetMap", try_download("OpenStreetMap crossings",
                                                      fetch_osm_crossings, ext, out)[0])])
    if key == "dams":
        got = try_download("National Inventory of Dams", fetch_dams, ext, out)
        return got[0]
    if key == "lifelines":
        parts = []
        for k, label, url, _cat in lifeline_downloads():
            parts.append((label, try_download(label, fetch_arcgis_layer, url, ext, out,
                                              "lifeline_" + k)[0]))
        parts.append(("OpenStreetMap", try_download("OpenStreetMap lifelines",
                                                    fetch_osm_lifelines, ext, out)[0]))
        return _merge(parts)
    if key == "flowlines":
        return try_download("USGS NHD flowlines", fetch_arcgis_layer, NHD_FLOWLINE_URL, ext,
                            out, "NHD_flowlines")[0]
    if key == "places":
        return try_download("OpenStreetMap places", fetch_osm_places, big, out)[0]
    return None


# the Data & Output data sets that the data-folder search can supply (datafolder role)
LOCAL_ROLE_OF_DATASET = {"nsi": "nsi", "address": "address", "usa": "usa", "camps": "camps",
                         "roads": "roads", "traffic": "aadt", "rail": "rail",
                         "xing": "crossings", "bridges": "bridges", "dams": "dams",
                         "flowlines": "centerline"}


def download_data(cfg, clip, depth_layer, output_folder, dam_folder="", progress=None,
                  log=None, add_layer=None):
    """Fetch the data sets switched on in `cfg` (pipeline cfg keys) for the
    study area and save them to <outputs>/Data. cfg also holds "data_area"
    (study / flood), "flood_buffer_ft" and "add_to_project". add_layer(path,
    base): how a saved file reaches the project (v2.6: a background run
    collects them for the main thread); None with add_to_project adds them
    here. Returns [(label, path or None, kept, total, note)]."""
    log = log or (lambda m: None)
    ext = clip.bbox_4326() if clip is not None else None
    if ext is None:
        raise RuntimeError("The depth raster has no usable coordinate system / extent - the "
                           "study area for the downloads is unknown.")
    xing = clip.bbox_4326(extra_ft=RAIL_CROSSING_SEARCH_MI * 5280.0)
    big = clip.bbox_4326(extra_ft=2.0 * 5280.0)
    ctx = QgsProject.instance().transformContext()
    use_flood = cfg.get("data_area") == AREA_FLOOD
    mask = None
    if use_flood:
        mask = FloodMask(depth_layer, float(cfg.get("flood_buffer_ft") or 0.0), ctx,
                         lat=clip.lat)
        if mask.ok:
            log(">>> Download area: flooded cells + {:g} ft (lines: study area)".format(
                float(cfg.get("flood_buffer_ft") or 0.0)))
        else:
            use_flood = False
    if not use_flood:
        log(">>> Download area: {}".format(clip.describe()))
    dam = dam_display_name(dam_folder or output_folder).replace(" ", "_")
    if add_layer is None and cfg.get("add_to_project", True):
        group = plugin_group(dam_display_name(dam_folder or output_folder), GRP_DATA)

        def add_layer(path, base):
            saved = QgsVectorLayer(path, base, "ogr")
            if saved.isValid():
                add_layer_to_project(saved, base, visibility=False, group=group)
    del STALE_USED[:]
    del PACK_USED[:]
    # v2.8.0: per-tile download cache from cfg (data_cache_folder, data_max_age_days,
    # refresh_data, data_cache_max_mb); off when data_cache_folder is absent / empty
    configure_tile_cache_from_cfg(cfg)
    todo = [d for d in DATASETS if cfg.get(d[3], True)]
    # v2.9: a data set the data folder supplies is not downloaded again
    local = cfg.get("local_data") or {}
    if local:
        from .datafolder import existing_roles
        usable = existing_roles(local)          # a pick whose file is gone is downloaded
        have = [d for d in todo if LOCAL_ROLE_OF_DATASET.get(d[0]) in usable]
        if have:
            log(">>> Found in the data folder, not downloaded: {}".format(
                ", ".join(d[2] for d in have)))
        todo = [d for d in todo if d not in have]
    rows = []
    n = max(1, len(todo))
    # v2.6: every data set is fetched side by side, then saved one by one
    from .download import parallel_map

    def fetch(key, label, progress_cb=None):
        return _fetch(key, ext, xing, big, output_folder, progress_cb or (lambda p, m="": None))
    got = parallel_map([(key, fetch, (key, label), {}) for key, _n, label, _f, _fl in todo],
                       progress_cb=lambda p, m: progress(0.7 * p, m) if progress else None,
                       label="Downloading data sets")
    for i, (key, name, label, _flag, floodable) in enumerate(todo):
        lo, hi = 70.0 + 30.0 * i / n, 70.0 + 30.0 * (i + 1) / n

        def sub(p, m="", lo=lo, hi=hi, label=label):
            if progress:
                progress(lo + (hi - lo) * max(0.0, min(100.0, p)) / 100.0,
                         "{}: {}".format(label, m) if m else label)
        ok, lyr = got.get(key, (False, None))
        if not ok:
            if lyr is not None:
                log_message("{}: {}".format(label, lyr), MSG_WARNING)
            lyr = None
        if lyr is None:
            rows.append((label, None, 0, 0, "download failed / service unavailable"))
            log(">>> {}: download failed (service unavailable or offline)".format(label))
            continue
        sub(90, "saving")
        try:
            path, kept, total = _save(lyr, name, dam, output_folder, clip, mask,
                                      use_flood and floodable, ctx, add_layer)
        except CancelledByUser:
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("{}: not saved: {}".format(label, e), MSG_WARNING)
            rows.append((label, None, 0, 0, "save failed: {}".format(e)))
            log(">>> {}: could not be saved ({})".format(label, e))
            continue
        note = "flooded area" if (use_flood and floodable) else "study area"
        rows.append((label, path, kept, total, note))
        log(">>> {}: {} of {} feature(s) in the {}{}".format(
            label, kept, total, note, " -> {}".format(os.path.relpath(
                path, output_folder)) if path else " - nothing saved"))
    for name, day, fname in STALE_USED:
        log(">>> WARNING: {}: the service did not answer - the download of {} was used "
            "({})".format(name, day, fname))
    for line in tile_cache_report_lines():
        log(line)
    from .pipeline import pack_report_lines
    for line in pack_report_lines():
        log(line)
    _write_index(rows, output_folder, use_flood, cfg)
    if progress:
        progress(100.0, "Downloads saved")
    return rows


def _write_index(rows, output_folder, use_flood, cfg):
    """Data/Downloaded_Data.csv: what was downloaded, when and for which area."""
    import csv
    import time
    from .helpers import prepare_output_path
    from .processing import DATA_INDEX_FILE
    path = prepare_output_path(os.path.join(data_folder(output_folder), DATA_INDEX_FILE))
    try:
        with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
            w = csv.writer(fh)
            w.writerow(["Data set", "File", "Features kept", "Features downloaded", "Area",
                        "Date"])
            day = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            for label, p, kept, total, note in rows:
                w.writerow([label, os.path.basename(p) if p else "", kept, total, note, day])
            if use_flood:
                w.writerow(["(flood buffer {:g} ft)".format(
                    float(cfg.get("flood_buffer_ft") or 0.0)), "", "", "", "", ""])
    except OSError as e:
        log_message("Downloaded_Data.csv not written: {}".format(e), MSG_WARNING)
```

## `datafolder.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.9.0: find the data sets of the Data & Output tab groups 3 - 6
(structures; roads, rail and crossings; dams, lifelines and other layers;
channel) in a folder on the computer.

scan_folder(folder) walks the folder - bounded by max_depth, max_files and a
cancel callback - and opens every candidate file ONCE with OGR, read-only,
to list its layers: name, geometry kind, field names, the feature count only
when the driver has it cheaply, CRS and the file time. At most one feature
is read, and only for a layer whose declared geometry type is "unknown"
(KML, mixed GeoJSON). NOTHING is written into the scanned folder: the scan
results are cached in memory only, per file (path + size + modification
time), so a second scan re-opens only new or changed files.

Formats:
  GeoPackage (every layer), Shapefile, GeoJSON (.geojson; a .json only when
  its start looks like GeoJSON / Esri JSON), KML / KMZ, File geodatabase
  folders (*.gdb, when this GDAL's OpenFileGDB / FileGDB driver opens them),
  GeoParquet (.parquet, only when this GDAL has the Parquet driver - skipped
  silently otherwise), ZIP archives (their vector files through /vsizip/ -
  HIFLD layers are often downloaded zipped) and CSV tables with longitude /
  latitude (or x / y) columns.
  A CSV is NOT opened with OGR - its CSV driver makes no points without open
  options. The header and first row are read with the csv module (the same
  column aliases and delimiter rule as the review exchange) and the data set
  gets a QGIS "delimitedtext" URI (DataSet.provider == "delimitedtext");
  open_uri() / open_layer() pick the provider from the URI. x / y columns
  whose first row is not longitude / latitude have no known CRS: the data set
  says so and ranks lower.

Skipped: hidden folders, __pycache__, _downloads, _reprojected, tile_cache,
backup / old / archive folders (autodetect's list and any folder name with
one of those words), and inside an 'outputs' folder the plugin's own result
folders (Classification, EAP, QA, Consolidation, Submittal) - NOT
outputs/Data: the data sets the Data & Output tab saved there are valid
sources, recognised by their own names (datafetch.DATASETS, plus
Downloaded_Data.csv, which also tells whether a set was limited to the
flooded area - such a set ranks a little lower and says so). The plugin's
own result layers (processing.is_plugin_output_name, <dam>_POI, "inundated")
are never candidates. One unreadable file is skipped with a note; the scan
never raises for it.

Geometry (ROLE_GEOMETRY): NSI / address points; FEMA and other outlines,
campgrounds (structures.campground_records takes footprints), model boundary
and parcels polygons; roads, rail and centerline lines; AADT lines or points;
grade crossings and bridges points; dams and lifelines points or polygons.
Tables and empty layers are never candidates.

match_roles(datasets) gives every role its candidates, best first, each
with a score and a human reason, and assigns a layer to at most one role
(best score first); "lifelines" takes many layers, each with the plugin's
category. The rules are the plugin's own wherever it has one:
  the saved / downloaded data-set names (datafetch.DATASETS,
  build_nd_pack.datasets(), download._CACHE_RE, constants.LIFELINE_SOURCES,
  STRUCTURES_TAG), structures._NSI_FIELDS / _NENA_MARKERS / _FEMA_FIELDS,
  processing._GROUP_PATTERNS, osm_processing's FEMA / OSM names,
  classify_tab's _ROAD_RE / _RAIL_RE / _CROSS_RE / _PARCEL_RE /
  _CENTERLINE_RE and their exclusions, linear's AADT and rail fields and
  trains_per_day(), facilities.canonical_category() (lifeline categories,
  e.g. "Fire_Stations.shp" -> "Fire station"), OSM_CAMP_TAGS /
  OSM_LIFELINE_TAGS. Rules the plugin did not have (model boundary, other
  building outlines, bridges by name, NID / NBI field markers that are
  inline in facilities.py) are marked as such below.

Scores rank candidates for picking a layer; they are not engineering
parameters, and nothing here changes a hazard classification: the picks are
inputs the engineer sees (describe()) and can change.
"""

import copy
import csv
import functools
import os
import re
import threading
import time
import zipfile
from collections import deque
from urllib.parse import quote

from osgeo import gdal, ogr
from qgis.core import QgsVectorLayer

from . import constants as C
from .constants import (
    OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME, OUTPUT_SUBDIRS, DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_NAME, STRUCTURES_TAG,
    LEGACY_STRUCTURES_TAG, OSM_CAMP_TAGS, OSM_LIFELINE_TAGS,
)
from .helpers import gdal_exceptions, CancelledByUser
from .processing import (
    _GROUP_PATTERNS, _layer_name_key, is_plugin_output_name, is_downloaded_data_layer,
    DATA_INDEX_FILE,
)
from .structures import _NSI_FIELDS, _NENA_MARKERS, _FEMA_FIELDS
from .osm_processing import _is_fema_structures_name, _is_osm_name
from .facilities import canonical_category, SCHOOLS
from .linear import (
    _AADT_NAMES, _AADT_YEAR_NAMES, _RE_YEAR_COL, _NAME_NAMES, _OWNER_NAMES, _PASS_NAMES,
    trains_per_day,
)
from .autodetect import _SKIP_DIRS as _AUTODETECT_SKIP_DIRS
from .review_exchange import _ALIASES as _XY_ALIASES, _delimiter
from .datafetch import DATASETS
from .download import _CACHE_RE

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ roles --
ROLES = ("nsi", "address", "usa", "outlines", "camps", "roads", "aadt", "rail", "crossings",
         "bridges", "dams", "lifelines", "boundary", "parcels", "centerline")
MULTI_ROLES = ("lifelines",)
ROLE_LABELS = {
    "nsi": "NSI structure points", "address": "ND GIS Hub site / structure address points",
    "usa": "FEMA USA Structures outlines", "outlines": "other building outlines",
    "camps": "campgrounds / RV parks", "roads": "road lines", "aadt": "AADT (traffic) layer",
    "rail": "rail lines", "crossings": "rail grade crossings",
    "bridges": "bridges / culverts / low-water crossings", "dams": "dams (NID)",
    "lifelines": "lifeline facilities", "boundary": "model boundary polygon",
    "parcels": "parcels", "centerline": "channel centerline / NHD flowlines"}
ROLE_GROUP = {"nsi": 3, "address": 3, "usa": 3, "outlines": 3, "camps": 3, "roads": 4,
              "aadt": 4, "rail": 4, "crossings": 4, "bridges": 4, "dams": 5, "lifelines": 5,
              "boundary": 5, "parcels": 5, "centerline": 6}

POINT, LINE, POLYGON, NONE, UNKNOWN = "point", "line", "polygon", "none", "unknown"
ROLE_GEOMETRY = {
    "nsi": (POINT,), "address": (POINT,), "usa": (POLYGON,), "outlines": (POLYGON,),
    "camps": (POLYGON,), "roads": (LINE,), "aadt": (LINE, POINT), "rail": (LINE,),
    "crossings": (POINT,), "bridges": (POINT,), "dams": (POINT, POLYGON),
    "lifelines": (POINT, POLYGON), "boundary": (POLYGON,), "parcels": (POLYGON,),
    "centerline": (LINE,)}
# camps: polygons only - structures.campground_records() takes every feature as a
# footprint (the OSM download already turns campground points into circles)

# ranking of the candidates (0 - 100); not engineering parameters
S_PLUGIN = 95            # the plugin's own saved / downloaded data-set name
S_FIELDS = 80            # the data set's own field signature (NSI, NENA, FEMA, NBI, NID)
S_NAME_STRONG = 70       # an unambiguous name (lifeline category, parcels)
S_NAME = 55              # the name rule the plugin uses for project layers
S_WEAK = 35              # a generic word only
S_SUPPORT = 8            # each further piece of evidence
MIN_SCORE = 30           # below this a layer is not a candidate
FLOOD_ONLY_PENALTY = 10  # saved by the Data & Output tab for the flooded area only
NO_CRS_PENALTY = 15      # CSV x / y columns without a known coordinate system

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- scan --
DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH = 4
DEFAULT_MAX_FILES = 1000
MAX_WALK_ENTRIES = 200000        # directory entries looked at (bounds a scan of a whole drive)
ZIP_MAX_MEMBERS = 100            # vector files opened per ZIP archive
CSV_COUNT_MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024   # rows are counted only in smaller CSV files
JSON_SNIFF_BYTES = 65536

VECTOR_EXT = (".gpkg", ".shp", ".geojson", ".json", ".kml", ".kmz", ".csv", ".parquet")
ZIP_MEMBER_EXT = (".gpkg", ".shp", ".geojson", ".kml", ".parquet")
_CONTAINER_DRIVERS = ("GPKG", "OpenFileGDB", "FileGDB", "KML", "LIBKML", "SQLite")
# autodetect's list (the hydraulic-raster search) without 'outputs': outputs/Data
# and the FEMA_Structures file in outputs are data sets
_SKIP_DIR_NAMES = (({d.lower() for d in _AUTODETECT_SKIP_DIRS} - {OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME.lower()})
                   | {DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_NAME.lower(), "_reprojected", "__pycache__", "tile_cache",
                      "__macosx", "system volume information"})
_SKIP_DIR_WORDS = ("backup", "backups", "old", "archive", "archives", "archived")
_SKIP_DIR_PREFIXES = ("ACER_", "EAP_")          # autodetect: old result folders
_JSON_SNIFF = re.compile(r'"type"\s*:\s*"(?:FeatureCollection|Feature)"|"geometryType"\s*:')
_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN = 0x2
_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM = 0x4
_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT = 0x400    # Windows junctions: never followed (loops)

_CACHE = {}                      # (source, signature) -> (tuple of DataSet, tuple of notes)
_CACHE_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_CACHE_MAX = 5000


class DataSet(object):
    """One vector layer found by scan_folder().

    uri       what QgsVectorLayer(uri, name, provider) opens ("path|layername=x"
              for GeoPackage / FileGDB / KML layers, "/vsizip/..." for a ZIP
              member, a "file:///...?type=csv&xField=..." URI for a CSV)
    provider  "ogr" or "delimitedtext"
    path      the file (or .gdb folder) on disk; for a ZIP member the .zip
    source    what OGR opened (path, or /vsizip/<zip>/<member>)
    member    the file inside the ZIP ("" otherwise)
    layer     layer name; format: OGR driver ("GPKG", "ESRI Shapefile" ...)
    geometry  "point" / "line" / "polygon" / "none" / "unknown"
    fields, fields_lower   field names; count: features (None when not cheap)
    crs       "EPSG:xxxx" (or a CRS name, "" when unknown); mtime, size: file
    layer_count            layers in the same source
    plugin_data            True in the plugin's own outputs/Data folder
    data_label, data_area  its Downloaded_Data.csv row ("Data set", "Area")
    hints     names used for matching (layer name, file / archive stem)
    notes     remarks (CSV without CRS, geometry from the first feature ...)
    """

    def __init__(self, **kw):
        self.uri = kw.get("uri", "")
        self.provider = kw.get("provider", "ogr")
        self.path = kw.get("path", "")
        self.source = kw.get("source", self.path)
        self.member = kw.get("member", "")
        self.layer = kw.get("layer", "")
        self.format = kw.get("format", "")
        self.geometry = kw.get("geometry", UNKNOWN)
        self.fields = list(kw.get("fields") or [])
        self.fields_lower = [f.lower() for f in self.fields]
        self.count = kw.get("count")
        self.crs = kw.get("crs", "")
        self.mtime = kw.get("mtime", 0.0)
        self.size = kw.get("size", 0)
        self.layer_count = kw.get("layer_count", 1)
        self.plugin_data = False
        self.data_label = ""
        self.data_area = ""
        self.hints = list(kw.get("hints") or [self.layer])
        self.notes = list(kw.get("notes") or [])

    @property
    def name(self):
        return self.layer or os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.source))[0]

    def as_dict(self):
        return {k: getattr(self, k) for k in (
            "uri", "provider", "path", "source", "member", "layer", "format", "geometry",
            "fields", "fields_lower", "count", "crs", "mtime", "size", "layer_count",
            "plugin_data", "data_label", "data_area", "hints", "notes")}

    def __repr__(self):
        return "DataSet({!r}, {}, {} field(s))".format(self.uri, self.geometry, len(self.fields))


class ScanResult(list):
    """The DataSets of a scan (a list) plus what the scan met: notes (files
    skipped and why), files_seen / files_read, truncated (max_files or the
    walk limit reached), cancelled, skipped_parquet (no Parquet driver)."""

    def __init__(self, folder=""):
        list.__init__(self)
        self.folder = folder
        self.notes = []
        self.files_seen = 0
        self.files_read = 0
        self.truncated = False
        self.cancelled = False
        self.skipped_parquet = 0
        self.elapsed_s = 0.0


def clear_cache():
    """Forget the in-memory scan cache (e.g. after the user asks to re-scan)."""
    with _CACHE_LOCK:
        _CACHE.clear()


# ----------------------------------------------------------- small helpers --
def _stem(path):
    return os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path.rstrip("/\\")))[0]


def _short(e):
    t = str(e).strip().splitlines()[0] if str(e).strip() else type(e).__name__
    return t[:200]


def _last_gdal_error():
    for mod in (gdal, ogr):
        try:
            msg = mod.GetLastErrorMsg()
            if msg:
                return msg
        except Exception:
            continue
    return ""


def _has_driver(name):
    try:
        return ogr.GetDriverByName(name) is not None
    except Exception:
        return False


def geometry_kind(code):
    """"point" / "line" / "polygon" / "none" / "unknown" of an OGR geometry
    type code (2.5D, Z / M / ZM and curve types included)."""
    try:
        t = int(code)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return UNKNOWN
    if t == 100:                         # wkbNone
        return NONE
    t = (t & 0x7fffffff) % 1000          # drop the 2.5D flag and ISO Z / M / ZM
    return {1: POINT, 4: POINT, 2: LINE, 5: LINE, 8: LINE, 9: LINE, 11: LINE, 13: LINE,
            3: POLYGON, 6: POLYGON, 10: POLYGON, 12: POLYGON, 14: POLYGON, 15: POLYGON,
            16: POLYGON, 17: POLYGON}.get(t, UNKNOWN)


def _crs_of(srs):
    if srs is None:
        return ""
    try:
        srs.AutoIdentifyEPSG()
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        auth, code = srs.GetAuthorityName(None), srs.GetAuthorityCode(None)
        if auth and code:
            return "{}:{}".format(auth, code)
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        return srs.GetName() or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _file_url(path):
    """file:/// URL of a local path (Windows drive letters and UNC paths)."""
    return _url_of_abs(os.path.abspath(path))


def _url_of_abs(path):
    p = path.replace("\\", "/")
    if p.startswith("//"):
        return "file:" + quote(p, safe="/:")
    if not p.startswith("/"):
        p = "/" + p
    return "file://" + quote(p, safe="/:")


def _uri_path(path):
    return path.replace("\\", "/")


def _skip_dir(entry, in_outputs):
    name = entry.name
    low = name.lower()
    if low.startswith((".", "$")) or low in _SKIP_DIR_NAMES:
        return True
    if name.upper().startswith(_SKIP_DIR_PREFIXES):
        return True
    if any(w in _SKIP_DIR_WORDS for w in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", low)):
        return True
    if in_outputs and low in _result_dirs():
        return True
    try:
        if getattr(entry, "is_junction", lambda: False)():
            return True
        attrs = getattr(entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False), "st_file_attributes", 0) or 0
        if attrs & (_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN | _FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM
                    | _FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT):
            return True
    except OSError:
        return True
    return False


def _result_dirs():
    """The plugin's result folders inside outputs (never data sets)."""
    names = {d.lower() for d in OUTPUT_SUBDIRS}
    try:
        from .submittal import SUBMITTAL_DIR
        names.add(SUBMITTAL_DIR.lower())
    except Exception:                  # pragma: no cover - submittal.py always ships
        names.add("submittal")
    return names


def _looks_like_geojson(path):
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            head = fh.read(JSON_SNIFF_BYTES)
    except OSError:
        return False
    return bool(_JSON_SNIFF.search(head))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- walk --
def _walk(root, max_depth, max_files, include_zip, stopped, report):
    """Candidate files [(kind, path, stat)] breadth first (shallow files
    first), plus (truncated, cancelled, notes)."""
    out, notes = [], []
    todo = deque([(root, 0)])
    seen = 0
    truncated = cancelled = False
    while todo:
        folder, depth = todo.popleft()
        try:
            with os.scandir(folder) as it:
                entries = sorted(it, key=lambda e: e.name.lower())
        except OSError as e:
            notes.append("folder not readable: {} ({})".format(folder, e.strerror or _short(e)))
            continue
        in_outputs = os.path.basename(folder.rstrip("/\\")).lower() == OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME.lower()
        for e in entries:
            seen += 1
            if seen % 500 == 0:
                if stopped():
                    return out, truncated, True, notes
                report(min(9.0, 1.0 + seen / 20000.0),
                       "Looking for data sets: {} file(s) found".format(len(out)))
            if seen > MAX_WALK_ENTRIES:
                truncated = True
                notes.append("stopped looking after {:,} folder entries - choose a smaller "
                              "folder".format(MAX_WALK_ENTRIES))
                return out, truncated, cancelled, notes
            try:
                is_dir = e.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False)
            except OSError:
                continue
            kind = None
            if is_dir:
                if e.name.lower().endswith(".gdb"):
                    kind = "gdb"               # a File geodatabase: one data source
                elif not _skip_dir(e, in_outputs) and depth < max_depth:
                    todo.append((e.path, depth + 1))
                    continue
                else:
                    continue
            else:
                ext = os.path.splitext(e.name)[1].lower()
                if ext in VECTOR_EXT:
                    kind = ext[1:]
                elif ext == ".zip" and include_zip:
                    kind = "zip"
                else:
                    continue
            if len(out) >= max_files:
                notes.append("stopped after {} data file(s) (the limit) - choose a smaller "
                             "folder or raise the limit".format(max_files))
                return out, True, cancelled, notes
            try:
                st = e.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
            except OSError as err:
                notes.append("skipped {}: {}".format(e.path, err.strerror or _short(err)))
                continue
            out.append((kind, e.path, st))
    return out, truncated, cancelled, notes


def _signature(kind, path, st):
    if kind != "gdb":
        return (st.st_size, getattr(st, "st_mtime_ns", int(st.st_mtime * 1e9)))
    n = size = newest = 0
    try:
        with os.scandir(path) as it:
            for e in it:
                try:
                    s = e.stat()
                except OSError:
                    continue
                n += 1
                size += s.st_size
                newest = max(newest, getattr(s, "st_mtime_ns", int(s.st_mtime * 1e9)))
    except OSError:
        pass
    return (n, size, newest)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- read --
def _dataset_from_layer(lyr, source, path, driver, n_layers, st, member, hints):
    name = lyr.GetName()
    notes = []
    geom = geometry_kind(lyr.GetGeomType())
    if geom == UNKNOWN:
        # KML / mixed GeoJSON declare no type: the first feature tells
        try:
            lyr.ResetReading()
            f = lyr.GetNextFeature()
            g = f.GetGeometryRef() if f is not None else None
            if g is not None:
                geom = geometry_kind(g.GetGeometryType())
                if geom != UNKNOWN:
                    notes.append("geometry type from the first feature")
            lyr.ResetReading()
        except Exception:
            pass
    defn = lyr.GetLayerDefn()
    fields = [defn.GetFieldDefn(i).GetName() for i in range(defn.GetFieldCount())]
    try:
        count = lyr.GetFeatureCount(0)        # force=0: only when the driver knows it
        count = int(count) if count is not None and int(count) >= 0 else None
    except Exception:
        count = None
    try:
        crs = _crs_of(lyr.GetSpatialRef())
    except Exception:
        crs = ""
    uri = _uri_path(source)
    if driver in _CONTAINER_DRIVERS or n_layers > 1:
        uri = "{}|layername={}".format(uri, name)
    h = [name] + ([x for x in hints if x] if n_layers == 1 else [])
    return DataSet(uri=uri, provider="ogr", path=path, source=source, member=member,
                   layer=name, format=driver, geometry=geom, fields=fields, count=count,
                   crs=crs, mtime=st.st_mtime, size=st.st_size, layer_count=n_layers,
                   hints=list(dict.fromkeys(h)), notes=notes)


def _read_ogr(source, path, st, member="", hints=()):
    """DataSets of every layer OGR finds in `source` (opened once), notes."""
    out, notes = [], []
    shown = member and "{} ({})".format(path, member) or path
    try:
        with gdal_exceptions():
            ds = ogr.Open(source, 0)
            if ds is None:
                raise RuntimeError(_last_gdal_error() or "not recognised by OGR")
            try:
                driver = ds.GetDriver().GetName()
            except Exception:
                driver = ""
            n = ds.GetLayerCount()
            if not n:
                notes.append("skipped {}: no layers".format(shown))
            for i in range(n):
                lyr = ds.GetLayer(i)
                if lyr is None:
                    continue
                try:
                    out.append(_dataset_from_layer(lyr, source, path, driver, n, st, member,
                                                   [_stem(source)] + list(hints)))
                except Exception as e:
                    notes.append("skipped {} layer {}: {}".format(shown, i, _short(e)))
            ds = None
    except CancelledByUser:
        raise
    except Exception as e:          # one bad file never stops the scan
        notes.append("skipped {}: could not be opened ({})".format(shown, _short(e)))
    return out, notes


def _read_csv(path, st):
    """A point DataSet for a CSV with lon / lat (or x / y) columns; a CSV
    without them is a table, not a data set (skipped silently)."""
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace", newline="") as fh:
            first = fh.readline()
            second = fh.readline()
    except OSError as e:
        return [], ["skipped {}: {}".format(path, e.strerror or _short(e))]
    if not first.strip():
        return [], []
    delim = _delimiter(first)
    try:
        header = next(csv.reader([first], delimiter=delim))
        row = next(csv.reader([second], delimiter=delim), []) if second.strip() else []
    except (csv.Error, StopIteration):
        return [], []
    tags = [_XY_ALIASES.get(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", h.lower()), "") for h in header]

    def column(tag):
        return tags.index(tag) if tag in tags else None
    notes = []
    ix, iy, crs = column("Lon"), column("Lat"), "EPSG:4326"
    if ix is None or iy is None:
        ix, iy, crs = column("X"), column("Y"), ""
        if ix is None or iy is None:
            return [], []
        try:
            x, y = float(row[ix]), float(row[iy])
            if -180.0 <= x <= 180.0 and -90.0 <= y <= 90.0:
                crs = "EPSG:4326"
                notes.append("x / y read as longitude / latitude (first row)")
        except (IndexError, ValueError):
            pass
        if not crs:
            notes.append("x / y columns without a known coordinate system - set the CRS")
    count = None
    if st.st_size <= CSV_COUNT_MAX_BYTES:
        try:
            with open(path, "rb") as fh:
                count = max(0, sum(1 for line in fh if line.strip()) - 1)
        except OSError:
            count = None
    xname, yname = header[ix].strip(), header[iy].strip()
    query = [("type", "csv"), ("delimiter", delim), ("xField", xname), ("yField", yname),
             ("detectTypes", "yes"), ("geomType", "point"), ("spatialIndex", "no"),
             ("subsetIndex", "no"), ("watchFile", "no")]
    if crs:
        query.append(("crs", crs))
    uri = _file_url(path) + "?" + "&".join("{}={}".format(k, quote(v, safe=":"))
                                           for k, v in query)
    ds = DataSet(uri=uri, provider="delimitedtext", path=path, source=path, layer=_stem(path),
                 format="CSV", geometry=POINT, fields=[h.strip() for h in header], count=count,
                 crs=crs, mtime=st.st_mtime, size=st.st_size, layer_count=1,
                 hints=[_stem(path)], notes=notes)
    return [ds], []


def _read_zip(path, st, parquet_ok, stopped):
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
            names = zf.namelist()
    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile, RuntimeError, ValueError) as e:
        return [], ["skipped {}: not a readable ZIP archive ({})".format(path, _short(e))], True
    gdbs, files = [], []
    for n in names:
        parts = [p for p in n.replace("\\", "/").split("/") if p]
        if not parts or parts[-1].startswith(".") or any(
                p.startswith(".") or p.lower() in _SKIP_DIR_NAMES for p in parts[:-1]):
            continue
        gdb = next((i for i, p in enumerate(parts[:-1]) if p.lower().endswith(".gdb")), None)
        if gdb is not None:
            key = "/".join(parts[:gdb + 1])
            if key not in gdbs:
                gdbs.append(key)
            continue
        ext = os.path.splitext(parts[-1])[1].lower()
        if ext in ZIP_MEMBER_EXT and (ext != ".parquet" or parquet_ok):
            files.append("/".join(parts))
    members = gdbs + sorted(files)
    notes = []
    if len(members) > ZIP_MAX_MEMBERS:
        notes.append("{}: only the first {} of {} vector files read".format(
            path, ZIP_MAX_MEMBERS, len(members)))
        members = members[:ZIP_MAX_MEMBERS]
    out = []
    zroot = "/vsizip/" + _uri_path(os.path.abspath(path))
    hints = [_stem(path)] if len(members) == 1 else []
    for m in members:
        if stopped():
            return out, notes, False          # partial: never cached
        sets, n2 = _read_ogr("{}/{}".format(zroot, m), path, st, member=m, hints=hints)
        out.extend(sets)
        notes.extend(n2)
    return out, notes, True


def _read_candidate(kind, path, st, parquet_ok, stopped):
    source = os.path.abspath(path)
    key = (os.path.normcase(source), kind, parquet_ok, _signature(kind, path, st))
    with _CACHE_LOCK:
        hit = _CACHE.get(key)
    if hit is not None:
        return [_copy(ds) for ds in hit[0]], list(hit[1]), True       # (sets, notes, complete)
    complete = True
    if kind == "zip":
        sets, notes, complete = _read_zip(path, st, parquet_ok, stopped)
    elif kind == "csv":
        sets, notes = _read_csv(path, st)
    else:
        sets, notes = _read_ogr(path, path, st)
    if not complete:
        return sets, notes, False
    with _CACHE_LOCK:
        if len(_CACHE) >= _CACHE_MAX:
            _CACHE.clear()
        _CACHE[key] = (tuple(_copy(ds) for ds in sets), tuple(notes))
    return sets, notes, True


def _copy(ds):
    c = copy.copy(ds)
    for k in ("fields", "fields_lower", "hints", "notes"):
        setattr(c, k, list(getattr(ds, k)))
    return c


class _PathLayer(object):
    """Just enough of a layer for processing.is_downloaded_data_layer()."""

    def __init__(self, path):
        self._p = path

    def source(self):
        return self._p


def _annotate_plugin_data(sets):
    """Mark the layers of the plugin's own outputs/Data folder and attach
    their Downloaded_Data.csv row (data-set label and area)."""
    index = {}
    for ds in sets:
        ds.plugin_data, ds.data_label, ds.data_area = False, "", ""
        if ds.member or not is_downloaded_data_layer(_PathLayer(ds.path)):
            continue
        ds.plugin_data = True
        folder = os.path.dirname(ds.path)
        if folder not in index:
            index[folder] = {}
            p = os.path.join(folder, DATA_INDEX_FILE)
            try:
                with open(p, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
                    for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
                        f = (row.get("File") or "").strip()
                        if f:
                            index[folder][f.lower()] = ((row.get("Data set") or "").strip(),
                                                        (row.get("Area") or "").strip())
            except (OSError, csv.Error):
                pass
        label, area = index[folder].get(os.path.basename(ds.path).lower(), ("", ""))
        ds.data_label, ds.data_area = label, area


def scan_folder(folder, max_depth=DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH, progress=None, cancel=None,
                max_files=DEFAULT_MAX_FILES, include_zip=True):
    """Every vector layer in `folder` (and its sub-folders up to max_depth
    levels) as a ScanResult (a list of DataSet with .notes, .truncated,
    .cancelled ...). progress(pct, message) is called along the way; the
    scan stops (keeping what it found) when cancel() returns True or
    progress raises CancelledByUser. Never raises for a bad file."""
    t0 = time.time()
    res = ScanResult(folder or "")

    def stopped():
        try:
            return bool(cancel and cancel())
        except Exception:
            return False

    def report(pct, msg):
        if progress is None:
            return
        try:
            progress(pct, msg)
        except CancelledByUser:
            raise
        except Exception:
            pass

    if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
        res.notes.append("not a folder: {}".format(folder))
        return res
    root = os.path.abspath(folder)
    res.folder = root
    try:
        report(0.0, "Looking for data sets in {}".format(root))
        cands, res.truncated, res.cancelled, notes = _walk(
            root, max(0, int(max_depth)), max(1, int(max_files)), include_zip, stopped, report)
        res.notes.extend(notes)
        res.files_seen = len(cands)
        parquet_ok = _has_driver("Parquet")
        n = max(1, len(cands))
        for i, (kind, path, st) in enumerate(cands):
            if res.cancelled or stopped():
                res.cancelled = True
                break
            if kind == "parquet" and not parquet_ok:
                res.skipped_parquet += 1        # no Parquet driver in this GDAL
                continue
            if kind == "json" and not _looks_like_geojson(path):
                continue                        # settings, manifests ...: not data sets
            report(10.0 + 90.0 * i / n, "Reading {} of {}: {}".format(
                i + 1, len(cands), os.path.basename(path)))
            sets, notes, complete = _read_candidate(kind, path, st, parquet_ok, stopped)
            res.extend(sets)
            res.notes.extend(notes)
            res.files_read += 1
            if not complete:                    # cancelled inside a ZIP archive
                res.cancelled = True
                break
    except CancelledByUser:
        res.cancelled = True
    if res.cancelled:
        res.notes.append("scan cancelled - {} layer(s) found so far".format(len(res)))
    _annotate_plugin_data(res)
    res.elapsed_s = time.time() - t0
    try:
        report(100.0, "{} layer(s) in {} file(s)".format(len(res), res.files_read))
    except CancelledByUser:
        pass
    return res


# --------------------------------------------------------------- matching --
_TRAFFIC_WORDS = ("aadt", "traffic", "hpms")     # the traffic words of classify_tab._ROAD_RE
# new rules (the plugin had none): bridges by name, dams by name, building
# outlines, model boundary, generic lifeline layers; field markers that are
# inline in facilities.read_dams / read_crossings
_BRIDGE_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])(?:bridges?|culverts?|fords?|nbi)(?![a-z])|low ?water")
_NBI_MARKER = "structure_number_008"             # facilities.read_crossings: NBI record
_OSM_CROSSING_FIELDS = ("waterway", "railway")   # facilities.read_crossings: OSM crossing
_NID_ID_FIELDS = ("nidid",)                      # facilities.read_dams (compact form)
_DAM_DETAIL_FIELDS = ("hazardpotential", "nidheight", "nidstorage")
_DAM_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])(?:nid|dams|national inventory of dams|"
                          r"dam (?:points?|locations?|inventory))(?![a-z])")
_OUTLINE_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])(?:buildings?|footprints?|outlines?|bldgs?)(?![a-z])")
_BOUNDARY_STRONG_RE = re.compile(
    r"2d ?flow ?areas?|(?<![a-z])flow ?areas?(?![a-z])|model ?(?:boundary|boundaries|extent|"
    r"domain|limits?|perimeter)|mesh ?(?:boundary|perimeter)|computational ?domain")
_BOUNDARY_WEAK_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])(?:boundary|boundaries|perimeter|domain)(?![a-z])")
_BOUNDARY_ADMIN_RE = re.compile(
    r"county|city|state|township|district|parcel|zip|census|tribal|reservation|municipal|"
    r"corporate|precinct|ward|school|watershed|huc|basin|fire")
_LIFELINE_GENERIC_RE = re.compile(r"lifelines?|critical ?facilit|essential ?facilit|"
                                  r"critical ?infrastructure")
_LIFELINE_EXCLUDE_RE = re.compile(
    r"district|boundar|jurisdiction|coverage|territor|precinct|hydrant|manhole|valve|"
    r"risk|hazard|incident|danger|perimeter|response|history|"
    r"(?<![a-z])(?:zones?|areas?|pipes?|mains?|lines?|beats?|burn(?:ed)?)(?![a-z])")
# data-set keys of datafetch.DATASETS -> role (None: not a group 3-6 input)
_DATASET_ROLES = {"nsi": "nsi", "address": "address", "usa": "usa", "camps": "camps",
                  "roads": "roads", "traffic": "aadt", "rail": "rail", "xing": "crossings",
                  "bridges": "bridges", "dams": "dams", "lifelines": "lifelines",
                  "flowlines": "centerline", "places": None}
# groups of build_nd_pack.datasets() -> role ("rail" holds lines and crossings)
_PACK_GROUP_ROLES = {"nsi": ("nsi",), "address": ("address",), "usa": ("usa",),
                     "nid": ("dams",), "roads": ("roads",), "traffic": ("aadt",),
                     "rail": ("rail", "crossings"), "lifelines": ("lifelines",),
                     "bridges": ("bridges",), "nhd": ("centerline",)}


def _tab_rules():
    """classify_tab's layer-name rules (imported late: a UI module)."""
    from . import classify_tab as T
    return T


def _singular(key):
    def one(w):
        if len(w) > 4 and w.endswith("ies"):
            return w[:-3] + "y"
        if len(w) > 3 and w.endswith("s") and not w.endswith(("ss", "us", "is")):
            return w[:-1]
        return w
    return " ".join(one(w) for w in key.split())


def _keyword_re(words):
    alts = sorted({re.escape(w).replace(r"\ ", " ").replace(" ", " ?") for w in words},
                  key=len, reverse=True)
    return re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])(?:{})(?![a-z])".format("|".join(alts)))


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _school_rules():
    """[(regex, category)] for the plugin's school / child-care categories
    (facilities.SCHOOLS, OSM_LIFELINE_TAGS)."""
    words = {}
    for tag in OSM_LIFELINE_TAGS:
        cat = tag[-1]
        if cat in SCHOOLS:
            words.setdefault(cat, set()).add(tag[1].replace("_", " "))
    for cat in SCHOOLS:
        words.setdefault(cat, set()).add(cat.lower())
    return tuple((_keyword_re(w), cat) for cat, w in sorted(words.items()))


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _camp_re():
    words = set()
    for tag in OSM_CAMP_TAGS:
        words.add(tag[1].replace("_", " "))
        words.add(tag[-1].lower())
    return _keyword_re(words)


def lifeline_category(text):
    """The plugin's facility category for a lifeline layer / file name
    ("Fire_Stations" -> "Fire station", "Emergency_Operations_Centers" ->
    "Emergency operations center", "Public_Schools" -> "School"), or None.
    facilities.canonical_category() decides, on the name and on its
    singular form; districts, zones, hydrants and the like are not
    facilities."""
    key = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", (text or "").lower()).strip()
    if not key or _LIFELINE_EXCLUDE_RE.search(key):
        return None
    sing = _singular(key)
    for k in (key, sing):
        cat = canonical_category(k)
        if cat:
            return cat
    for rx, cat in _school_rules():
        if rx.search(sing):
            return cat
    return None


def _plugin_names():
    """[(name key, roles, category, reason)] of the plugin's own data-set
    names: the Data & Output tab's saved files, the download / offline-pack
    names and the building-outline file."""
    out = []
    for d in DATASETS:
        role = _DATASET_ROLES.get(d[0])
        if role:
            out.append((_layer_name_key(d[1]), (role,), None,
                        "plugin data set name '{}'".format(d[1])))
    for tag in (STRUCTURES_TAG, LEGACY_STRUCTURES_TAG):
        out.append((_layer_name_key(tag), ("usa",), None,
                    "plugin building-outline file name '{}'".format(tag)))
    lifeline_cats = {"lifeline_" + t[0]: t[-1] for t in C.LIFELINE_SOURCES}
    try:
        from . import build_nd_pack as B
        from . import osm_parse as O
        osm_roles = {O.overpass_to_features: ("lifelines",), O.crossing_features: ("bridges",),
                     O.camp_features: ("camps",)}
        for entry in B.datasets():
            name, group, spec = entry[0], entry[2], entry[-1] if isinstance(entry[-1], dict) \
                else {}
            roles = _PACK_GROUP_ROLES.get(group)
            if group == "osm":
                roles = osm_roles.get(spec.get("parse"))
            if not roles:
                continue
            names = [name] + [c[0] for c in spec.get("choices") or []]
            for n in names:
                out.append((_layer_name_key(n), roles, lifeline_cats.get(n),
                            "plugin download name '{}'".format(n)))
    except Exception:                    # the pack builder is optional here
        pass
    for key, cat in lifeline_cats.items():
        out.append((_layer_name_key(key), ("lifelines",), cat,
                    "plugin download name '{}'".format(key)))
    return out


def _nhd_fields():
    """NHD flowline fields (the pack builder's field list), lower case."""
    try:
        from . import build_nd_pack as B
        for entry in B.datasets():
            spec = entry[-1] if isinstance(entry[-1], dict) else {}
            if entry[2] == "nhd" and spec.get("fields"):
                return tuple(f.strip().lower() for f in spec["fields"].split(",") if f.strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    return ()


class Candidate(object):
    """A data set proposed for a role: score (0-100), reasons (text) and,
    for lifelines, the plugin category (None: per feature from its category
    / type field, as facilities.read_lifelines does)."""

    def __init__(self, role, dataset, score, reasons, category=None):
        self.role, self.dataset, self.score = role, dataset, int(round(score))
        self.reasons = list(reasons)
        self.category = category

    @property
    def reason(self):
        return "; ".join(self.reasons)

    def __repr__(self):
        return "Candidate({}, {!r}, {}, {!r})".format(self.role, self.dataset.uri, self.score,
                                                      self.category)


class MatchResult(object):
    """candidates: role -> [Candidate] best first (every layer that fits);
    chosen: role -> Candidate or None (one layer per role); lifelines: the
    chosen lifeline layers; unmatched: DataSets given no role."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.candidates = {r: [] for r in ROLES}
        self.chosen = {r: None for r in ROLES if r not in MULTI_ROLES}
        self.lifelines = []
        self.datasets = []
        self.unmatched = []
        self.notes = []
        self.folder = ""

    def best(self, role):
        return list(self.lifelines) if role in MULTI_ROLES else self.chosen.get(role)

    @property
    def found(self):
        return [r for r in ROLES if self.best(r)]

    @property
    def missing(self):
        return [r for r in ROLES if not self.best(r)]


class _Evidence(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.primary, self.support = [], []

    def add(self, score, reason):
        if score > 0:
            self.primary.append((score, reason))

    def also(self, reason):
        self.support.append(reason)

    def total(self):
        if not self.primary:
            return 0, []
        parts = sorted(self.primary, key=lambda p: -p[0])
        extra = len(parts) - 1 + len(self.support)
        cap = 99 if parts[0][0] >= S_PLUGIN else S_PLUGIN - 1
        return min(cap, parts[0][0] + S_SUPPORT * extra), [r for _s, r in parts] + self.support


def _is_own_output(names):
    T = _tab_rules()
    for n in names:
        if is_plugin_output_name(n) or T._PLUGIN_POI_RE.search(n) or "inundated" in n.lower():
            return True
    return False


def _pattern_hit(names, pattern, exclude=None):
    """First name (raw or as a key: '_' '-' '.' as spaces) the pattern finds,
    unless the exclusion finds it too."""
    for n in names:
        forms = (n, _layer_name_key(n))
        if any(pattern.search(f) for f in forms) and \
                not (exclude is not None and any(exclude.search(f) for f in forms)):
            return n
    return None


def _family(names):
    """processing's point-layer family of the first name one of its rules
    matches (NSI / NDGISHUB; None for FEMA points)."""
    for n in names:
        key = _layer_name_key(n)
        for fam, pattern in _GROUP_PATTERNS:
            if pattern.search(key):
                return fam, n
    return None, None


class _Probe(object):
    """Just enough of linear.AttrReader for trains_per_day(): does the layer
    have a train-count field?"""

    def __init__(self, low):
        self.low = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(low)}

    def get(self, attrs, name):
        return 1.0 if name in self.low else None


def _plugin_hit(ds, table):
    """(roles, category, reason) when the data set carries one of the
    plugin's own data-set names."""
    if ds.data_label:
        for d in DATASETS:
            if d[2] == ds.data_label and _DATASET_ROLES.get(d[0]):
                return ((_DATASET_ROLES[d[0]],), None,
                        "plugin data set '{}' (Downloaded_Data.csv)".format(d[1]))
    names = list(ds.hints)
    m = _CACHE_RE.match(os.path.basename(ds.source))
    if m:
        names.append(m.group(1))           # a download-cache file: <name>_<date>_<hash>
    for n in names:
        key = _layer_name_key(n).strip()
        for pk, roles, cat, reason in table:
            if key == pk:
                return roles, cat, reason
            # <dam>_<name> in the plugin's Data folder / outputs (outline file)
            if key.endswith(" " + pk) and (ds.plugin_data or "usa" in roles):
                return roles, cat, reason
    return None


def _score(ds, table, nhd_fields):
    """{role: (score, reasons, category)} for one data set."""
    T = _tab_rules()
    names = [n for n in ds.hints if n]
    low = ds.fields_lower
    compact = [re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", f) for f in low]
    ev = {r: _Evidence() for r in ROLES}
    cats = {}
    geom = ds.geometry

    hit = _plugin_hit(ds, table)
    if hit is not None:
        roles, cat, reason = hit
        role = next((r for r in roles if geom in ROLE_GEOMETRY[r]), None)
        if role is not None:
            ev[role].add(S_PLUGIN, reason)
            if role in MULTI_ROLES:
                cats[role] = cat

    # --- structures (group 3) ---------------------------------------------
    fam, fam_name = _family(names)
    nsi = [f for f in _NSI_FIELDS if f in low]
    if len(nsi) >= 3:
        ev["nsi"].add(S_FIELDS, "fields {} -> NSI".format(", ".join(nsi[:4])))
    elif len(nsi) == 2:
        ev["nsi"].add(60, "fields {} -> NSI".format(", ".join(nsi)))
    elif nsi and nsi[0] in ("fd_id", "occtype"):
        ev["nsi"].add(40, "field {} -> NSI".format(nsi[0]))
    if fam == "NSI":
        ev["nsi"].add(S_NAME, "name '{}' -> NSI".format(fam_name))
    nena = [f for f in _NENA_MARKERS if f in low]
    if len(nena) >= 3:
        ev["address"].add(S_FIELDS, "NENA fields {} -> site / structure address points".format(
            ", ".join(nena[:4])))
        ev["roads"].add(70, "NENA NG9-1-1 fields {} -> road centerlines".format(
            ", ".join(nena[:3])))
    elif len(nena) == 2:
        ev["address"].add(60, "NENA fields {} -> address points".format(", ".join(nena)))
        ev["roads"].add(50, "NENA street fields {}".format(", ".join(nena)))
    if fam == "NDGISHUB":
        ev["address"].add(S_NAME, "name '{}' -> ND GIS Hub address points".format(fam_name))
    fema = [f for f in _FEMA_FIELDS if f in low]
    if len(fema) == len(_FEMA_FIELDS):
        ev["usa"].add(S_FIELDS, "fields {} -> FEMA USA Structures".format(", ".join(fema)))
    elif fema:
```
