```python
        ev["usa"].add(50, "field {} -> FEMA USA Structures".format(fema[0]))
    n = next((x for x in names if _is_fema_structures_name(x)
              or "usa structures" in _layer_name_key(x)), None)
    if n:
        ev["usa"].add(60, "name '{}' -> FEMA USA Structures".format(n))
    n = _pattern_hit(names, _OUTLINE_RE)
    if n:
        ev["outlines"].add(50, "name '{}' -> building outlines".format(n))
    elif next((x for x in names if _is_osm_name(x)), None) and "building" in low:
        ev["outlines"].add(45, "OpenStreetMap buildings")
    if "building" in low and ev["outlines"].primary:
        ev["outlines"].also("field building")
    n = next((x for x in names if _camp_re().search(_singular(_layer_name_key(x)))), None)
    if n:
        ev["camps"].add(65, "name '{}' -> campgrounds / RV parks".format(n))

    # --- roads, rail and crossings (group 4) ------------------------------
    rail_names = [x for x in names
                  if T._RAIL_RE.search(re.sub(r"trails?", " ", _layer_name_key(x)))]
    road_words, road_name_hit = set(), None
    for x in names:
        if not T._RAIL_RE.search(x):
            words = {m.group(0).lower() for m in T._ROAD_RE.finditer(_layer_name_key(x))}
            if words and road_name_hit is None:
                road_name_hit = x
            road_words.update(words)
    if road_words - set(_TRAFFIC_WORDS):
        ev["roads"].add(S_NAME, "name '{}' -> roads".format(road_name_hit))
    elif road_words:
        ev["roads"].add(40, "name '{}' -> traffic".format(road_name_hit))
    road_name = next((f for f in _NAME_NAMES if f in low), None)
    aadt = [f for f in low if f in _AADT_NAMES or _RE_YEAR_COL.match(f)]
    if road_name and ev["roads"].primary:
        ev["roads"].also("road-name field {}".format(road_name))
    if aadt and ev["roads"].primary:
        ev["roads"].also("AADT field {}".format(aadt[0]))
    if not rail_names:
        if aadt:
            ev["aadt"].add(60, "fields {} -> AADT".format(", ".join(aadt[:3])))
        if road_words & set(_TRAFFIC_WORDS):
            ev["aadt"].add(S_NAME, "name '{}' -> traffic ({})".format(
                road_name_hit, ", ".join(sorted(road_words & set(_TRAFFIC_WORDS)))))
        year = next((f for f in _AADT_YEAR_NAMES if f in low), None)
        if year and ev["aadt"].primary:
            ev["aadt"].also("year field {}".format(year))
    if rail_names:
        ev["rail"].add(S_NAME, "name '{}' -> rail".format(rail_names[0]))
    narn = [f for f in _OWNER_NAMES + _PASS_NAMES if f in low and f not in ("owner", "operator")]
    if len(narn) >= 2:
        ev["rail"].add(75, "rail fields {} -> rail lines".format(", ".join(narn[:3])))
    elif narn and ev["rail"].primary:
        ev["rail"].also("rail field {}".format(narn[0]))
    bridge_name = _pattern_hit(names, _BRIDGE_NAME_RE)
    if trains_per_day(_Probe(low), None) is not None:
        ev["crossings"].add(75, "train-count fields -> FRA grade crossings")
    xname = _pattern_hit(names, T._CROSS_RE)
    if xname and not bridge_name:
        rail_like = rail_names or any(w in _layer_name_key(xname).split()
                                      for w in ("grade", "fra"))
        ev["crossings"].add(60 if rail_like else 40, "name '{}' -> {}crossings".format(
            xname, "rail grade " if rail_like else ""))
    if _NBI_MARKER in low:
        ev["bridges"].add(85, "field {} -> National Bridge Inventory".format(_NBI_MARKER))
    if "category" in low and any(f in low for f in _OSM_CROSSING_FIELDS):
        ev["bridges"].add(50, "fields category, {} -> OpenStreetMap crossings".format(
            next(f for f in _OSM_CROSSING_FIELDS if f in low)))
    if bridge_name:
        ev["bridges"].add(60, "name '{}' -> bridges / culverts".format(bridge_name))

    # --- dams, lifelines and other layers (group 5) -----------------------
    if any(f in compact for f in _NID_ID_FIELDS):
        ev["dams"].add(85, "NID ID field -> National Inventory of Dams")
    elif "damname" in compact and any(f in compact for f in _DAM_DETAIL_FIELDS):
        ev["dams"].add(60, "dam name / hazard fields -> dams")
    n = _pattern_hit(names, _DAM_NAME_RE)
    if n:
        ev["dams"].add(60, "name '{}' -> dams".format(n))
    for x in names:
        cat = lifeline_category(x)
        if cat:
            ev["lifelines"].add(S_NAME_STRONG, "name '{}' -> {}".format(x, cat))
            cats.setdefault("lifelines", cat)
            break
    else:
        n = _pattern_hit(names, _LIFELINE_GENERIC_RE)
        if n:
            ev["lifelines"].add(S_NAME, "name '{}' -> lifeline facilities (category per "
                                        "feature)".format(n))
            cats.setdefault("lifelines", None)
            typ = next((f for f in ("category", "type", "fac_type", "facility_type")
                        if f in low), None)
            if typ:
                ev["lifelines"].also("field {}".format(typ))
    n = _pattern_hit(names, _BOUNDARY_STRONG_RE)
    if n:
        ev["boundary"].add(65, "name '{}' -> model boundary / 2D flow area".format(n))
    else:
        n = _pattern_hit(names, _BOUNDARY_WEAK_RE, _BOUNDARY_ADMIN_RE)
        if n:
            ev["boundary"].add(S_WEAK, "name '{}' -> boundary".format(n))
    n = _pattern_hit(names, T._PARCEL_RE, T._PARCEL_EXCLUDE)
    if n:
        ev["parcels"].add(S_NAME_STRONG, "name '{}' -> parcels".format(n))

    # --- channel (group 6) ------------------------------------------------
    nhd = [f for f in nhd_fields if f in low]
    if len(nhd) >= 3:
        ev["centerline"].add(75, "NHD fields {} -> flowlines".format(", ".join(nhd[:4])))
    n = _pattern_hit(names, T._CENTERLINE_RE, T._CENTER_EXCLUDE)
    if n:
        ev["centerline"].add(S_NAME, "name '{}' -> channel centerline".format(n))

    out = {}
    for role in ROLES:
        if geom not in ROLE_GEOMETRY[role]:
            continue
        score, reasons = ev[role].total()
        if not score:
            continue
        if ds.data_area and "flood" in ds.data_area.lower() and geom != LINE:
            score -= FLOOD_ONLY_PENALTY
            reasons.append("saved for the flooded area only")
        if ds.provider == "delimitedtext" and not ds.crs:
            score -= NO_CRS_PENALTY
            reasons.append("no coordinate system")
        if score >= MIN_SCORE:
            out[role] = (score, reasons, cats.get(role))
    return out


def match_roles(datasets):
    """MatchResult for the DataSets of scan_folder(): candidates per role,
    best first; every layer assigned to at most one role, the highest score
    first (ties: role order, then path); lifelines may take many layers."""
    res = MatchResult()
    res.datasets = list(datasets or [])
    res.folder = getattr(datasets, "folder", "")
    res.notes = list(getattr(datasets, "notes", []) or [])
    table = _plugin_names()
    nhd_fields = _nhd_fields()
    pairs = []
    for i, ds in enumerate(res.datasets):
        if ds.geometry in (NONE, UNKNOWN):
            continue
        if ds.count == 0:
            continue
        if _is_own_output(ds.hints):
            continue
        for role, (score, reasons, cat) in _score(ds, table, nhd_fields).items():
            c = Candidate(role, ds, score, reasons, cat)
            res.candidates[role].append(c)
            pairs.append((-c.score, ROLES.index(role), ds.uri.lower(), i, c))
    for role in ROLES:
        res.candidates[role].sort(key=lambda c: (-c.score, c.dataset.uri.lower()))
    taken = set()
    for _s, _r, _u, i, c in sorted(pairs, key=lambda p: p[:4]):
        if i in taken:
            continue
        if c.role in MULTI_ROLES:
            res.lifelines.append(c)
        elif res.chosen[c.role] is None:
            res.chosen[c.role] = c
        else:
            continue
        taken.add(i)
    res.unmatched = [ds for i, ds in enumerate(res.datasets) if i not in taken]
    return res


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- output --
def describe(result):
    """Text lines for the run log: the pick for every role with its reason,
    the other candidates, what was not found and what the scan skipped."""
    lines = []
    if result.folder:
        lines.append("Data folder {}: {} layer(s)".format(_uri_path(result.folder),
                                                           len(result.datasets)))
    taken = {id(c.dataset) for c in result.lifelines}
    taken.update(id(c.dataset) for c in result.chosen.values() if c is not None)
    for role in ROLES:
        if role in MULTI_ROLES:
            for c in result.lifelines:
                lines.append("{} [{}]: {} ({})".format(
                    role, c.category or "category per feature", c.dataset.uri, c.reason))
            continue
        c = result.chosen.get(role)
        if c is None:
            continue
        lines.append("{}: {} ({})".format(role, c.dataset.uri, c.reason))
        others = [o for o in result.candidates[role]
                  if o is not c and id(o.dataset) not in taken]
        if others:
            lines.append("    {} other candidate(s) for {}, e.g. {} (score {})".format(
                len(others), role, others[0].dataset.uri, others[0].score))
    for ds in result.datasets:
        for note in ds.notes:
            if id(ds) in taken:
                lines.append("note: {}: {}".format(ds.uri, note))
    if result.missing:
        lines.append("not found: {}".format(", ".join(result.missing)))
    for note in result.notes:
        lines.append("scan note: {}".format(note))
    return lines


def to_config(result):
    """{role: uri} of the picks; "lifelines": [(uri, category or None)] -
    what the lead stores in the settings and passes as cfg["local_data"]."""
    out = {}
    for role in ROLES:
        if role in MULTI_ROLES:
            if result.lifelines:
                out[role] = [(c.dataset.uri, c.category) for c in result.lifelines]
        elif result.chosen.get(role) is not None:
            out[role] = result.chosen[role].dataset.uri
    return out


def provider_for_uri(uri):
    """"delimitedtext" for a CSV URI made here, else "ogr"."""
    u = (uri or "").strip()
    return "delimitedtext" if u.lower().startswith("file:") and "?" in u else "ogr"


def _name_from_uri(uri):
    u = uri or ""
    if "|layername=" in u:
        return u.split("|layername=", 1)[1].split("|")[0]
    return _stem(u.split("?")[0].split("|")[0])


def open_uri(uri, name=None, provider=None):
    """QgsVectorLayer for a URI of to_config() / DataSet.uri, or None when it
    cannot be opened (missing file, invalid layer). Never raises."""
    if not uri:
        return None
    try:
        lyr = QgsVectorLayer(uri, name or _name_from_uri(uri), provider or provider_for_uri(uri))
        return lyr if lyr.isValid() else None
    except Exception:
        return None


def open_layer(dataset, name=None):
    """QgsVectorLayer of a DataSet (or Candidate), or None."""
    ds = getattr(dataset, "dataset", dataset)
    if ds is None:
        return None
    return open_uri(ds.uri, name or ds.name, ds.provider)


def _file_of_uri(uri):
    if provider_for_uri(uri) == "delimitedtext":
        try:
            from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse
            u = urlparse(uri.split("?")[0])
            p = unquote(u.path)
            if u.netloc:                       # UNC: file://server/share/...
                return "//" + u.netloc + p
            if re.match(r"^/[A-Za-z]:", p):
                p = p[1:]
            return p
        except Exception:
            return ""
    p = uri.split("|")[0]
    if p.startswith("/vsizip/"):
        m = re.match(r"^/vsizip/(.+?\.zip)(?:/|$)", p, re.I)
        return m.group(1) if m else ""
    return p


def open_config(local_data):
    """Open the layers of a to_config() dict (also after a JSON round trip):
    ({role: layer, "lifelines": [(layer, category)]}, notes). A file that no
    longer exists or does not open is left out with a note."""
    layers, notes = {}, []
    for role, value in (local_data or {}).items():
        if role not in ROLES:
            continue
        if role in MULTI_ROLES and not isinstance(value, str):
            items = value
        else:
            items = [(value, None)] if isinstance(value, str) else [value]
        opened = []
        for item in items or []:
            try:
                uri, cat = (item[0], item[1]) if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)) else (item, None)
            except (IndexError, TypeError):
                continue
            path = _file_of_uri(uri)
            if path and not os.path.exists(path):
                notes.append("{}: {} no longer exists".format(role, path))
                continue
            lyr = open_uri(uri)
            if lyr is None:
                notes.append("{}: {} could not be opened".format(role, uri))
                continue
            opened.append((lyr, cat))
        if role in MULTI_ROLES:
            if opened:
                layers[role] = opened
        elif opened:
            layers[role] = opened[0][0]
    return layers, notes


def find_data(folder, max_depth=DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH, progress=None, cancel=None,
              max_files=DEFAULT_MAX_FILES):
    """scan_folder() + match_roles() in one call."""
    return match_roles(scan_folder(folder, max_depth=max_depth, progress=progress,
                                   cancel=cancel, max_files=max_files))


def existing_roles(local_data):
    """The roles of a to_config() dict whose file (at least one, for the
    lifelines) still exists - what a run will take from the folder instead of
    downloading. A missing file is left to the download."""
    if not isinstance(local_data, dict) or not local_data:
        return set()
    out = set()
    for role, v in local_data.items():
        uris = [x[0] for x in v if isinstance(x, (list, tuple)) and x] \
            if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) else [v]
        for uri in uris:
            try:
                f = _file_of_uri(uri) if isinstance(uri, str) else ""
            except Exception:                        # noqa
                f = ""
            if f and os.path.exists(f):
                out.add(role)
                break
    return out
```

## `datafolder_tab.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.9: "Search a folder for data sets" on the Data & Output tab.

The engineer points at a folder on this computer (or a work server) that holds the
data sets of groups 3-6 (structures, roads / rail / crossings, dams / lifelines /
other layers, channel). The folder is searched in the background (datafolder.py):
every layer is read and matched to what the plugin needs by its name and its fields.
The pick for each data set is shown and can be changed. Order of use in a run:

    1. the layer found in this folder,
    2. the layer in the QGIS layer tree (auto-detect / the list of the group),
    3. the download from the internet.

A layer that the engineer picks by hand in one of the lists of groups 3-6 is never
replaced by the folder. Nothing is written into the folder.

HIFLD: the plugin can no longer download HIFLD (the HIFLD Open service was closed and
its copy at NASA NCCS does not answer). Download the layers from the Homeland Security
Digital Library, https://www.hsdl.org/hifld/, put them in a folder and search it here.
"""

import json
import os

from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import (
    QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QLabel, QGroupBox, QCheckBox, QComboBox,
    QLineEdit, QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QWidget, QMessageBox, QFileDialog,
)

from .helpers import log_message
from . import datafolder as DF

# data-folder role -> (list on the Data & Output tab, is "(none)" a decision?)
# a list that holds a layer of the project overrides the folder for that role
_ROLE_COMBOS = {
    "roads": ("road_combo", True), "aadt": ("aadt_combo", False),
    "rail": ("rail_combo", True), "crossings": ("crossing_combo", True),
    "outlines": ("outline_combo", False), "dams": ("dam_layer_combo", False),
    "boundary": ("boundary_combo", False), "parcels": ("parcel_combo", False),
    "centerline": ("centerline_combo", False),
}
COLUMNS = ("Group", "Data set", "Layer / file found", "Why")
NOT_USED = "(not used - QGIS layer or download)"


class DataFolderTabMixin(object):
    """Needs the dialog's _start_background, _log, _update_status, _busy and the layer
    lists of the data tab."""

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- widgets --
    def _build_datafolder_group(self):
        grp = QGroupBox("Data folder - search this computer for the data sets of groups 3-6")
        lay = QVBoxLayout()
        intro = QLabel(
            "Pick a folder that holds your data sets (sub-folders to 4 levels; GeoPackage, "
            "Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, CSV and ZIP files). The plugin reads each layer, "
            "matches it to a data set below by its name and fields, and uses it <b>first</b>; "
            "then the layers in the QGIS layer tree; then the internet. A layer you pick by "
            "hand in a list of groups 3-6 is never replaced. Nothing is written into the "
            "folder. <b>HIFLD</b> can no longer be downloaded by the plugin: get the layers "
            "from <a href=\"https://www.hsdl.org/hifld/\">hsdl.org/hifld</a> (Homeland "
            "Security Digital Library), save them in a folder and search it here.")
        intro.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(intro)
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.datafolder_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.datafolder_edit.setPlaceholderText("Folder with data sets (optional)")
        self.datafolder_edit.setToolTip(
            "Search this folder (sub-folders to 4 levels) for the data sets of groups 3-6. "
            "Order of use: this folder, then the QGIS layer tree, then the internet.")
        self.datafolder_browse_btn = QPushButton("Browse...")
        self.datafolder_browse_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_browse_data_folder)
        self.datafolder_search_btn = QPushButton("Search folder")
        self.datafolder_search_btn.setToolTip(
            "Reads the layers of the folder in the background and shows what was found for "
            "each data set. QGIS stays usable.")
        self.datafolder_search_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_search_data_folder)
        self.datafolder_hifld_btn = QPushButton("Get HIFLD (hsdl.org)")
        self.datafolder_hifld_btn.setToolTip(
            "Opens the Homeland Security Digital Library HIFLD page in your web browser. "
            "Download the layers you need (fire stations, EMS, EOC, law enforcement, "
            "wastewater, ... for North Dakota), save them in a folder and search it here.")
        self.datafolder_hifld_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_open_hifld_page)
        row.addWidget(self.datafolder_edit, 3)
        row.addWidget(self.datafolder_browse_btn)
        row.addWidget(self.datafolder_search_btn)
        row.addWidget(self.datafolder_hifld_btn)
        lay.addLayout(row)
        self.datafolder_use_check = QCheckBox(
            "Use the data sets found in this folder first (before QGIS layers and downloads)")
        self.datafolder_use_check.setChecked(True)
        self.datafolder_use_check.toggled.connect(lambda *_a: self._df_parcels_changed())
        lay.addWidget(self.datafolder_use_check)
        self.datafolder_table = QTableWidget()
        self.datafolder_table.setColumnCount(len(COLUMNS))
        self.datafolder_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(list(COLUMNS))
        lay.addWidget(self.datafolder_table)
        self.datafolder_status = QLabel("No folder searched yet.")
        self.datafolder_status.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(self.datafolder_status)
        # the picks travel with the project settings (a hidden text box)
        self.datafolder_picks_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.datafolder_picks_edit.setVisible(False)
        self.datafolder_picks_edit.textChanged.connect(self._df_picks_text_changed)
        lay.addWidget(self.datafolder_picks_edit)
        grp.setLayout(lay)
        self._df_rows = []                  # one dict per table row
        self._df_updating = False
        self._df_match = None
        return grp

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- actions --
    def _on_browse_data_folder(self, *args):
        if self._busy:
            return
        start = self.datafolder_edit.text().strip() or self.config_dam_folder or \
            os.path.expanduser("~")
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Folder with data sets", start)
        if folder:
            self.datafolder_edit.setText(folder)
            self._on_search_data_folder()

    def _on_open_hifld_page(self, *args):
        from .constants import HIFLD_PORTAL_URL
        try:
            from qgis.PyQt.QtCore import QUrl
            from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QDesktopServices
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(HIFLD_PORTAL_URL))
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("HIFLD page not opened: {}".format(e))
        self._log(">>> HIFLD: download the layers from {} , save them in a folder and search "
                  "it here".format(HIFLD_PORTAL_URL))

    def _on_search_data_folder(self, *args):
        if self._busy:
            return
        folder = self.datafolder_edit.text().strip()
        if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Data folder",
                                "Pick an existing folder to search first.")
            return

        def work(progress, log):
            found = DF.scan_folder(folder, progress=progress)
            return found, DF.match_roles(found)

        def done(outcome):
            if outcome.cancelled:
                self._update_status("Data folder search cancelled", False)
                self._log(">>> Data folder search cancelled")
                return
            if outcome.error is not None:
                self._log(outcome.traceback)
                self._update_status("Data folder search FAILED: {}".format(outcome.error), False)
                QMessageBox.critical(self, "Data folder", str(outcome.error))
                return
            scan, match = outcome.result
            self._df_match = match
            self._df_show_match(match)
            for line in DF.describe(match):
                self._log(">>> " + line)
            n = len([r for r in DF.ROLES if match.best(r)])
            self._update_status("Data folder: {} layer(s) read, {} of {} data sets found".format(
                len(scan), n, len(DF.ROLES)), n > 0)
        self._start_background("Searching the data folder...", work, done, project_bound=False)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- table --
    def _df_show_match(self, match):
        rows = []
        for role in DF.ROLES:
            if role in DF.MULTI_ROLES:
                for c in match.lifelines:
                    label = "Lifeline facilities" + (" - " + c.category if c.category else "")
                    rows.append({"role": role, "category": c.category, "label": label,
                                 "options": [(c.dataset.name, c.dataset.uri, c.reason)],
                                 "selected": c.dataset.uri, "multi": True,
                                 "why": c.reason})
                continue
            cands = match.candidates.get(role) or []
            chosen = match.chosen.get(role)
            if not cands:
                continue
            rows.append({"role": role, "category": None,
                         "label": DF.ROLE_LABELS.get(role, role),
                         "options": [(c.dataset.name + "  (score {})".format(c.score),
                                      c.dataset.uri, c.reason) for c in cands],
                         "selected": chosen.dataset.uri if chosen else "",
                         "multi": False,
                         "why": chosen.reason if chosen else ""})
        self._df_fill_table(rows)
        self._df_store_picks()
        missing = [DF.ROLE_LABELS[r] for r in match.missing if r not in DF.MULTI_ROLES]
        self.datafolder_status.setText(
            "{} data set(s) chosen. Not found here (QGIS layers or downloads are used): {}".format(
                len([r for r in rows if r["selected"]]),
                ", ".join(missing) if missing else "none"))

    def _df_fill_table(self, rows):
        self._df_updating = True
        try:
            t = self.datafolder_table
            t.setRowCount(0)
            t.setRowCount(len(rows))
            self._df_rows = rows
            for i, r in enumerate(rows):
                group = DF.ROLE_GROUP.get(r["role"], "")
                t.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(group)))
                t.setItem(i, 1, QTableWidgetItem(r["label"]))
                combo = QComboBox()
                combo.addItem(NOT_USED if not r["multi"] else "(not used)", "")
                for text, uri, _why in r["options"]:
                    combo.addItem(text, uri)
                for k in range(combo.count()):
                    if combo.itemData(k) == r["selected"]:
                        combo.setCurrentIndex(k)
                        break
                combo.setToolTip(r["selected"] or "")
                combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(lambda _i, row=i: self._df_combo_changed(row))
                r["combo"] = combo
                t.setCellWidget(i, 2, combo)
                t.setItem(i, 3, QTableWidgetItem(r.get("why", "")))
            try:
                t.resizeColumnsToContents()
            except Exception:
                pass
        finally:
            self._df_updating = False

    def _df_combo_changed(self, row):
        if self._df_updating or row >= len(self._df_rows):
            return
        r = self._df_rows[row]
        uri = r["combo"].currentData() or ""
        r["selected"] = uri
        why = ""
        for _text, u, w in r["options"]:
            if u == uri:
                why = w
        r["why"] = why
        it = self.datafolder_table.item(row, 3)
        if it is not None:
            try:
                it.setText(why)
            except Exception:
                self.datafolder_table.setItem(row, 3, QTableWidgetItem(why))
        r["combo"].setToolTip(uri)
        self._df_store_picks()

    # --------------------------------------------------------------- picks --
    def _df_picks(self):
        """{role: uri, "lifelines": [[uri, category]]} of the table."""
        out = {}
        for r in self._df_rows:
            uri = r.get("selected") or ""
            if not uri:
                continue
            if r["role"] in DF.MULTI_ROLES:
                out.setdefault(r["role"], []).append([uri, r.get("category")])
            else:
                out[r["role"]] = uri
        return out

    def _df_store_picks(self):
        self._df_updating = True
        try:
            self.datafolder_picks_edit.setText(json.dumps(self._df_picks(), sort_keys=True))
        finally:
            self._df_updating = False
        self._df_parcels_changed()

    def _df_parcels_changed(self):
        """v2.9: the parcel hints' field pickers follow the folder's parcel layer."""
        refresh = getattr(self, "_refresh_parcel_fields290", None)
        if refresh is not None:
            try:
                refresh()
            except Exception as e:                               # noqa
                self._log(">>> Parcel fields not refreshed: {}".format(e))

    def _df_picks_text_changed(self, text):
        """The project's settings were restored: show the saved picks (no new search)."""
        if self._df_updating:
            return
        try:
            picks = json.loads(text) if text else {}
        except ValueError:
            picks = {}
        rows = []
        for role in DF.ROLES:
            v = picks.get(role) if isinstance(picks, dict) else None
            if not v:
                continue
            if role in DF.MULTI_ROLES:
                for item in v:
                    try:
                        uri, cat = item[0], item[1]
                    except (IndexError, TypeError):
                        continue
                    rows.append({"role": role, "category": cat,
                                 "label": "Lifeline facilities" + (" - " + cat if cat else ""),
                                 "options": [(DF._name_from_uri(uri), uri, "saved pick")],
                                 "selected": uri, "multi": True, "why": "saved pick"})
            else:
                rows.append({"role": role, "category": None,
                             "label": DF.ROLE_LABELS.get(role, role),
                             "options": [(DF._name_from_uri(v), v, "saved pick")],
                             "selected": v, "multi": False, "why": "saved pick"})
        self._df_fill_table(rows)
        self._df_parcels_changed()
        if rows:
            self.datafolder_status.setText(
                "{} saved pick(s) - search the folder again to refresh the list.".format(
                    len(rows)))

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- cfg (run) --
    def _local_data_for_run(self):
        """cfg["local_data"]: the table's picks, without the roles whose list holds a
        layer the engineer picked by hand. {} when the folder is not to be used."""
        if not getattr(self, "datafolder_use_check", None) or \
                not self.datafolder_use_check.isChecked():
            return {}
        picks = self._df_picks()
        if not picks:
            return {}
        from .classify_tab import _AUTO, _NONE, _DOWNLOAD
        for role, (attr, none_is_decision) in _ROLE_COMBOS.items():
            combo = getattr(self, attr, None)
            if role not in picks or combo is None:
                continue
            data = combo.currentData()
            explicit = data not in (None, _NONE, _AUTO, _DOWNLOAD) or \
                (data == _NONE and none_is_decision)
            if explicit:
                picks.pop(role, None)
        return picks
```

## `devscreen.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.5: future-development screening (ND REG_05.2026 5.3(b)).

Vacant parcels (no habitable or unverified structure on them) up to a size
limit that lie in the ACER danger zone that would make the dam HIGH if a
house were built there: the high-danger zone, or the judgment zone when
judgment-zone structures are counted as probable loss of life (depth > 2 ft
for a 1D model). Each parcel is evaluated like a building outline (cell by
cell over the parcel and its 5-ft edge ring) with the house-on-foundation
curve. The list is a judgment aid - zoning, platting and access decide
whether development is imminent; it never changes the class.
"""

from qgis.core import QgsCoordinateTransform, QgsDistanceArea, QgsFeature, QgsField

from .compat import AREA_SQFT, WKB_MULTIPOLYGON, FT_DOUBLE, FT_STRING, FT_INT, NULL
from .constants import ZONE_LABELS
from .helpers import (
    create_memory_layer, transform_geometry, log_message, is_null, add_features_batched,
)

SQFT_PER_ACRE = 43560.0
_REF_FIELDS = ("parcel_id", "parcelid", "parcel", "parcelnum", "parcel_num", "pin", "apn",
               "pid", "tax_id", "taxid", "parcel_no", "parcelno")
_USE_HINTS = ("landuse", "land_use", "zoning", "zone", "use_desc", "usedesc", "propclass",
              "prop_class", "class_desc", "lu_desc")
FIELDS = [("Parcel_Ref", FT_STRING), ("Land_Use", FT_STRING), ("Acres", FT_DOUBLE),
          ("Max_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("Max_Vel_fps", FT_DOUBLE), ("ACER_Zone", FT_INT),
          ("ACER_Zone_Label", FT_STRING), ("If_Built", FT_STRING)]


def _field(names_low, wanted, contains=False):
    for w in wanted:
        if w in names_low:
            return names_low.index(w)
    if contains:
        for i, n in enumerate(names_low):
            if any(w in n for w in wanted):
                return i
    return -1


def screen(parcel_layer, structs, samplers, analysis_crs, transform_ctx, clip=None, lat=None,
           max_acres=5.0, judgment_as_probable=True, one_d=False, progress_cb=None):
    """(layer or None, summary dict). `samplers`: the governing scenario's
    open samplers (as for evaluate_structures)."""
    from .structures import (
        evaluate_structures, TYPE_HOUSE, OUT_PROBABLE, OUT_JUDGMENT, _Grid, _ft_units,
        _request_for,
    )
    summary = {"checked": 0, "too_large": 0, "built": 0, "hits": 0, "acres": 0.0}
    if parcel_layer is None or not parcel_layer.isValid():
        return None, summary
    da = QgsDistanceArea()
    da.setSourceCrs(analysis_crs, transform_ctx)
    try:
        da.setEllipsoid(analysis_crs.ellipsoidAcronym() or "EPSG:7019")
    except Exception:
        pass
    names = [f.name() for f in parcel_layer.fields()]
    low = [n.lower() for n in names]
    i_ref = _field(low, _REF_FIELDS)
    i_use = _field(low, _USE_HINTS, contains=True)
    # structures that make a parcel "built": habitable or unverified ones
    grid = _Grid(_ft_units(200.0, analysis_crs, lat))
    for s in structs:
        # a campground area is not a building on the parcel
        if s.get("habitable") in ("Yes", "Unverified") and s.get("geom") is not None \
                and not s.get("camp"):
            grid.insert_rect(s, s["geom"].boundingBox())
    xf = QgsCoordinateTransform(parcel_layer.crs(), analysis_crs, transform_ctx)
    a_to_clip = clip.transform_from(analysis_crs) if clip is not None else None
    cands = []
    for feat in parcel_layer.getFeatures(_request_for(parcel_layer, clip)):
        g = transform_geometry(feat.geometry(), xf)
        if g is None or g.isNull() or g.isEmpty():
            continue
        if clip is not None and not clip.intersects_geometry(g, xform=a_to_clip):
            continue
        summary["checked"] += 1
        try:
            if not g.isGeosValid():
                g = g.makeValid()
            acres = da.convertAreaMeasurement(da.measureArea(g), AREA_SQFT) / SQFT_PER_ACRE
        except Exception:
            continue
        if acres > max_acres:
            summary["too_large"] += 1
            continue
        bb = g.boundingBox()
        built = False
        k0 = grid._key(bb.xMinimum(), bb.yMinimum())
        k1 = grid._key(bb.xMaximum(), bb.yMaximum())
        seen = set()
        for i in range(k0[0], k1[0] + 1):
            for j in range(k0[1], k1[1] + 1):
                for s in grid.cells.get((i, j), ()):
                    if id(s) in seen:
                        continue
                    seen.add(id(s))
                    try:
                        if s["geom"].boundingBox().intersects(bb) and s["geom"].intersects(g):
                            built = True
                            break
                    except Exception:
                        continue
                if built:
                    break
            if built:
                break
        if built:
            summary["built"] += 1
            continue
        a = feat.attributes()
        ref = "" if i_ref < 0 or is_null(a[i_ref]) else str(a[i_ref])
        use = "" if i_use < 0 or is_null(a[i_use]) else str(a[i_use])
        cands.append({"id": len(cands) + 1, "geom": g, "footprint": True, "sqft": None,
                      "acer_type": TYPE_HOUSE, "ref": ref or "fid {}".format(feat.id()),
                      "use": use, "acres": acres})
    if not cands:
        return None, summary
    evaluate_structures(cands, samplers, analysis_crs, transform_ctx, one_d=one_d,
                        progress_cb=progress_cb, lat=lat, near_ft=0.0)
    trigger = {OUT_PROBABLE} | ({OUT_JUDGMENT} if judgment_as_probable and not one_d else set())
    hits = [c for c in cands if c.get("outcome") in trigger]
    summary["hits"] = len(hits)
    summary["acres"] = sum(c["acres"] for c in hits)
    summary["examples"] = [c["ref"] for c in hits[:6]]
    if not hits:
        return None, summary
    lyr = create_memory_layer("Future_Development_Parcels", WKB_MULTIPOLYGON, analysis_crs,
                              [QgsField(n, t) for n, t in FIELDS])
    feats = []
    for c in hits:
        g = c["geom"]
        try:
            if not g.isMultipart():
                from qgis.core import QgsGeometry
                g = QgsGeometry(g)
                g.convertToMultiType()
        except Exception:
            pass
        f = QgsFeature(lyr.fields())
        f.setGeometry(g)
        z = c.get("zone")
        f.setAttributes([c["ref"], c["use"] or NULL, round(c["acres"], 2),
                         NULL if c.get("max_depth") is None else round(c["max_depth"], 2),
                         NULL if c.get("max_vel") is None else round(c["max_vel"], 2),
                         NULL if z is None else int(z), ZONE_LABELS.get(z, "") or NULL,
                         "probable loss of life (dam HIGH)" if c.get("outcome") ==
                         OUT_PROBABLE else "judgment zone (HIGH when counted)"])
        feats.append(f)
    add_features_batched(lyr.dataProvider(), feats, 5000)
    lyr.updateExtents()
    log_message("Future development: {} vacant parcel(s) <= {:g} ac in the danger zone "
                "({:.1f} ac)".format(len(hits), max_acres, summary["acres"]))
    return lyr, summary


def summary_lines(summary, max_acres, layer_name="Future_Development_Parcels"):
    if not summary.get("checked"):
        return ["No parcels in the study area"]
    out = ["{} parcel(s) checked: {} larger than {:g} ac, {} with a habitable / unverified "
           "structure; {} vacant parcel(s) ({:.1f} ac) where a new house would be in the "
           "danger zone{}".format(summary["checked"], summary["too_large"], max_acres,
                                   summary["built"], summary["hits"], summary.get("acres", 0),
                                   ": " + ", ".join(summary.get("examples", [])) +
                                   (" ..." if summary["hits"] > 6 else "")
                                   if summary["hits"] else "")]
    if summary["hits"]:
        out.append("Layer {} - check zoning, platting and access: imminent development "
                   "there would make the dam HIGH (5.3(b))".format(layer_name))
    return out
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Dialog UI and orchestration for the ND Dam Hazard Helper."""

import os
import html
import time
import traceback

from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication, QProgressDialog, QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout,

    QFormLayout, QTabWidget, QTextEdit, QWidget, QComboBox,
)

from .compat import MSG_INFO, MSG_WARNING, MSG_CRITICAL, WINDOW_MODAL

from .constants import (
    PLUGIN_NAME, PLUGIN_VERSION, OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME,

)

from .settings import save_state, load_state, widget_value, set_widget_value

class NDDamHazardDialog(QDialog, DataTabMixin, DataFolderTabMixin, ClassificationTabMixin,
                        ExtrasTabMixin, Extras290TabMixin, SuiteTabMixin, ReviewTabMixin,
                        FacilityReviewTabMixin,
                        DssWiseTabMixin, RasImportTabMixin):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.config_dam_folder = ""
        self.config_output_folder = ""

        self._last_tick = 0.0
        self._last_pct = 0.0
        self._busy = False

        self._task = None               # v2.6: the background task while it runs
        self._finishing = False         # main-thread part of a background run
        self._project_gen = 0           # bumped when another project is opened
        self._restoring = False         # settings being restored: no raster search
        self.setup_ui()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ UI --

        self.tab_widget.addTab(self._build_review_tab(), "Review")
        self.tab_widget.addTab(self._build_facility_review_tab(), FT.TAB_TITLE)

        # --- Readme tab ---
        readme_tab = QWidget()

        selftest_row = QHBoxLayout()

                                     "temporary folder. Your project is not changed.")
        self.selftest_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_run_selftest)

        self.sources_btn = QPushButton("Edit data sources...")
        self.sources_btn.setToolTip("Opens the file with every download address (NSI, ND GIS "
                                    "Hub, NID, HIFLD, NBI ...). Change an address there when "
                                    "a service moves, then restart QGIS.")
        self.sources_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_edit_sources)
        selftest_row.addWidget(self.sources_btn)
        selftest_row.addStretch()
        readme_layout.addLayout(selftest_row)
        self.tab_widget.addTab(readme_tab, "Readme")

        main_layout.addWidget(self.tab_widget)

        self.status_label = QLabel("Ready")
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet("padding: 8px; background-color: #f5f5f5;")
        main_layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        self.log_text = QTextEdit()
        self.log_text.setMaximumHeight(150)
        self.log_text.setReadOnly(True)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.log_text)

    def _on_edit_sources(self, *args):
        from .constants import write_sources_file, SOURCE_OVERRIDES
        from qgis.PyQt.QtCore import QUrl
        from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QDesktopServices
        try:
            path = write_sources_file()
        except OSError as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Data sources", "Could not write the file: {}".format(e))
            return
        self._log(">>> Data-source file: {}{}".format(
            path, " (in use: {} change(s))".format(len(SOURCE_OVERRIDES))
            if SOURCE_OVERRIDES else ""))
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(path))

    def _on_tab_changed(self, index):
        if self.tab_widget.tabText(index) in ("Hazard Classification", "Data & Output"):
            self._refresh_layer_combos()

    def _inline_row(self, edit, btn):
        w = QWidget()
        h = QHBoxLayout(w)
        h.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        h.addWidget(edit, stretch=3)
        h.addWidget(btn)
        return w

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ inputs ----
    def _raster_paths(self):
        return {"depth": self.depth_edit.text().strip(),
                "vel": self.vel_edit.text().strip(),
                "arr": self.arr_edit.text().strip()}

    def _dv_path(self):
        p = self.dv_edit.text().strip()
        return p if p and os.path.isfile(p) else None

    def _one_d_selected(self):
        combo = getattr(self, "model_combo", None)
        return combo is not None and combo.currentData() == "1d"

    def _required_rasters(self):
        """Depth is always needed; velocity too (ACER zones from Dmax / Vmax)
        except for the 1D (depth-only) criterion. Arrival is optional
        (arrival fields and warning times are then left empty)."""
        keys = ["depth"]
        if not self._one_d_selected():
            keys.append("vel")
        return keys

    def _inputs_valid_for_main(self):
        paths = self._raster_paths()
        return (bool(self.config_dam_folder) and os.path.isdir(self.config_dam_folder)
                and all(paths[k] and os.path.isfile(paths[k]) for k in self._required_rasters())
                and (not paths["vel"] or os.path.isfile(paths["vel"])))

    def _update_button_states(self, *args):
        busy = self._busy
        ready = self._inputs_valid_for_main() and not busy
        if hasattr(self, "run_all_btn"):
            self.run_all_btn.setEnabled(ready)
            self.run_all_btn.setStyleSheet(BTN_ACTIVE_STYLE if ready else BTN_INACTIVE_STYLE)
            if ready:
                self.run_all_btn.setToolTip("All inputs selected - ready to run")
            elif busy:
                self.run_all_btn.setToolTip("A run is in progress")
            else:
                missing = []
                if not self.config_dam_folder or not os.path.isdir(self.config_dam_folder):
                    missing.append("Dam folder")
                labels = {"depth": "Depth raster", "vel": "Velocity raster",
                          "arr": "Arrival raster"}
                for key, path in self._raster_paths().items():
                    if key in self._required_rasters() and (not path or not os.path.isfile(path)):
                        missing.append(labels[key])
                self.run_all_btn.setToolTip("Missing: {}".format(", ".join(missing)))
        self._classification_button_state()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ BROWSERS --
    def browse_dam_folder(self):
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select Dam Project Folder",
                                                  self.config_dam_folder or "")
        if folder:
            self.dam_folder_edit.setText(folder)   # -> _on_dam_folder_changed
        self._update_button_states()

    def _on_dam_folder_changed(self, text):
        folder = (text or "").strip()
        self.config_dam_folder = folder
        self.config_output_folder = os.path.join(folder, OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME) if folder else ""
        self.output_folder_edit.setText(self.config_output_folder)
        if not self._restoring:
            self._auto_fill_rasters(force=False)
        self._update_button_states()
        self._refresh_dam_record()                     # v2.10: dam.json status line

    def _auto_fill_rasters(self, force=False):
        """Fill the raster boxes from the files found in the dam folder: all
        of them with force (the "Find rasters" button), otherwise only when
        every raster box is still empty. Returns the number filled."""
        folder = self.config_dam_folder
        if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
            return 0
        edits = [("depth", self.depth_edit), ("vel", self.vel_edit), ("arr", self.arr_edit),
                 ("dv", self.dv_edit)]
        base = []          # v2.5.1: no no-breach baseline / time steps in the dialog
        if not force and any(e.text().strip() for _k, e in edits):
            return 0
        from .autodetect import find_rasters, describe
        found = find_rasters(folder)
        n = 0
        for key, edit in edits + base:
            if edit is None or not found.get(key):
                continue
            if force or not edit.text().strip():
                edit.setText(found[key])
                n += 1
        self._log(">>> Rasters found in the dam folder: {}".format(describe(found, folder)))
        for note in found["notes"]:
            self._log("    " + note + " - change it on the Setup tab if needed")
        self._update_button_states()
        return n

    def _browse_raster(self, edit, title):
        start = os.path.dirname(edit.text().strip()) or self.config_dam_folder or ""
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, title, start,
            "Raster Files (*.tif *.tiff *.TIF *.TIFF *.img *.asc *.vrt *.flt *.bil);;"
            "All Files (*)")
        if path:
            edit.setText(path)
        self._update_button_states()

    def browse_depth(self):
        self._browse_raster(self.depth_edit, "Select Depth Raster")

    def browse_velocity(self):
        self._browse_raster(self.vel_edit, "Select Velocity Raster")

    def browse_arrival(self):
        self._browse_raster(self.arr_edit, "Select Arrival Raster")

    def browse_output(self):
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select Output Folder",
                                                  self.config_output_folder or "")
        if folder:
            self.config_output_folder = folder
            self.output_folder_edit.setText(folder)
        self._update_button_states()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ VALIDATION
    def validate_all_inputs(self):
        errors = []
        if not self.config_dam_folder or not os.path.isdir(self.config_dam_folder):
            errors.append("Dam folder not selected (or folder missing)")
        labels = {"depth": "Depth", "vel": "Velocity", "arr": "Arrival"}
        for key, path in self._raster_paths().items():
            if key in self._required_rasters() and (not path or not os.path.isfile(path)):
                errors.append("{} raster not selected (or file missing)".format(labels[key]))
            elif path and not os.path.isfile(path):
                errors.append("{} raster file missing".format(labels[key]))
        if hasattr(self, "scenario_table"):
            errors.extend(self._scenario_problems())     # v2.7: the scenario table
        if hasattr(self, "sens_check"):
            errors.extend(self._extras_problems())       # v2.8: the extra analyses
            errors.extend(self._extras290_problems())    # v2.9
        return len(errors) == 0, errors

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ STATUS/LOG
    def _update_status(self, message, is_success=True):
        color = "#2e7d32" if is_success else "#c62828"
        self.status_label.setText(message)
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet(
            "padding: 8px; background-color: #f5f5f5; color: {};".format(color))

    def _log(self, message):
        self.log_text.append(str(message))
        sb = self.log_text.verticalScrollBar()
        sb.setValue(sb.maximum())

    def _load_rasters(self):
        """(Re)load the three rasters from the current paths."""
        try:
            specs = [("depth", "Depth"), ("vel", "Velocity"), ("arr", "Arrival")]
            paths = self._raster_paths()
            rasters, bad = {}, []
            for key, name in specs:
                if not paths[key] and key not in self._required_rasters():
                    rasters[key] = None
                    self._log(">>> {} raster not given - {}".format(
                        name, "arrival times and warning times are left empty"
                        if key == "arr" else "depth-only (1D) criterion"))
                    continue
                lyr = QgsRasterLayer(paths[key], name)
                rasters[key] = lyr
                if not lyr.isValid():
                    bad.append(name)
                elif not lyr.crs().isValid():
                    self._log(">>> WARNING: {} raster has no CRS - coordinates are "
                              "assumed to match the point layers".format(name))
            self._rasters = rasters
            if bad:
                return False, "These rasters failed to load: {}".format(", ".join(bad))
            return True, "OK"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, str(e)

    def _study_area(self, ctx):
        """ExtentClip for the loaded depth raster (None: no clipping) and
        the keep-dry choice; logs both."""
        clip = make_extent_clip(self._rasters.get("depth"), self.extent_spin.value(), ctx)
        keep_dry = self.keep_dry_check.isChecked()
        if clip is not None:
            self._log(">>> Study area: {} (features without flood values {})".format(
                clip.describe(), "kept" if keep_dry else "dropped"))
        else:
            self._log(">>> WARNING: study area unavailable - features limited to raster "
                      "coverage")
        return clip, keep_dry

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- PROGRESS
    def _make_progress(self, title, modal=True):
        if self._chain is not None and self._progress is not None:
            self._progress.setLabelText(title)          # one bar for a chained step
            return self._progress
        prog = QProgressDialog(title, "Cancel", 0, 100, self)
        prog.setWindowTitle(PLUGIN_NAME)
        # Modal (synchronous steps): blocks the plugin dialog and QGIS while
        # the step pumps events. Background runs (v2.6) use a non-modal bar:
        # QGIS stays usable, the dialog's buttons are disabled meanwhile.
        if modal:
            prog.setWindowModality(WINDOW_MODAL)
        prog.setMinimumDuration(0)
        prog.setAutoClose(False)
        prog.setAutoReset(False)
        prog.setValue(0)
        prog.show()
        self._last_tick = 0.0
        self._last_pct = 0.0
        QApplication.processEvents()
        return prog

    def _progress_tick(self, pct, message):
        if self._progress is None:
            return
        pct = min(max(float(pct), 0.0), 100.0)
        if self._chain is not None:
            lo, hi = self._chain
            pct = lo + (hi - lo) * pct / 100.0
        pct = max(self._last_pct, pct)
        now = time.monotonic()
        # Refreshing the UI is comparatively expensive; do it at most every
        # PROGRESS_MIN_INTERVAL_S unless the run is finishing.
        if pct < 100.0 and now - self._last_tick < PROGRESS_MIN_INTERVAL_S:
            return
        self._last_tick = now
        self._last_pct = pct
        self._progress.setValue(int(pct))
        self._progress.setLabelText(message)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        # A click on Cancel after the last step has finished is ignored
        if pct < 100.0 and self._progress.wasCanceled():
            raise CancelledByUser()

    def _finish_progress(self, force=False):
        if self._chain is not None and not force:
            return
        if self._progress:
            self._progress.close()
            self._progress.deleteLater()
            self._progress = None
        QApplication.processEvents()

    # ------------------------------------------------------- BACKGROUND RUNS
    def _start_background(self, title, work, on_done, project_bound=True):
        """v2.6: run work(progress, log) in a QGIS task - QGIS stays usable,
        the dialog is busy. on_done(outcome) runs on the main thread when it
        has finished (outcome.result / .error / .cancelled). Without a task
        manager (tests, headless) the work runs at once, same callbacks.
        project_bound=False (v2.6.2): the work does not belong to the current
        project (offline pack build) - on_done runs even when another
        project was opened meanwhile."""
        from .runner import start_task
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._chain = None
        self._progress = self._make_progress(title, modal=False)
        try:                                     # the bar's Cancel stops the task
            self._progress.canceled.connect(self._cancel_task)
        except Exception:
            pass

        gen = self._project_gen

        def done(outcome):
            self._task = None
            try:
                if project_bound and outcome.ok and gen != self._project_gen:
                    self._log(">>> The project changed while the run was working - the "
                              "outputs are written in {} but not added to this project"
                              .format(self.config_output_folder))
                    self._update_status("Finished - project changed during the run; outputs "
                                        "in the outputs folder", False)
                    return
                on_done(outcome)
            finally:
                self._finishing = False
                self._finish_progress(force=True)
                self._set_busy(False)
        try:
            self._task = start_task(title, work, self._task_progress, self._log, done)
        except Exception as e:                   # the task could not even be started
            tb = traceback.format_exc()
            self._log(tb)
            log_message(tb, MSG_CRITICAL)
            self._finish_progress(force=True)
            self._set_busy(False)
            self._update_status("FAILED: {}".format(e), False)
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", str(e) or repr(e))

    def _cancel_task(self, *args):
        if self._task is not None:
            try:
                self._task.cancel()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _task_progress(self, pct, message):
        """Progress from the worker (main thread slot) - or from the work
        itself when it runs synchronously."""
        if self._progress is None or self._finishing:
            return                       # (a late worker signal: the finish bar is up)
        pct = min(max(float(pct), 0.0), 100.0)
        pct = max(self._last_pct, pct)
        now = time.monotonic()
        if pct < 100.0 and now - self._last_tick < PROGRESS_MIN_INTERVAL_S:
            return
        self._last_tick = now
        self._last_pct = pct
        self._progress.setValue(int(pct))
        self._progress.setLabelText(message)
        if self._task is None:
            QApplication.processEvents()         # synchronous fallback
        if pct < 100.0 and self._progress.wasCanceled():
            if self._task is not None:
                self._task.cancel()
            else:
                raise CancelledByUser()

    def _finish_deferred(self, res, title):
        """Main-thread part of a background run (layers, map book, report)
        behind a modal progress bar (modality cannot change on a shown bar,
        so a new one replaces the task's)."""
        from .pipeline import finish_run
        self._finishing = True
        self._finish_progress(force=True)
        self._chain = None
        self._progress = self._make_progress(title, modal=True)
        return finish_run(res, progress=self._progress_tick, log=self._log)

    def _set_busy(self, busy):
        self._busy = busy
        for name in ("check_btn", "run_all_btn", "find_rasters_btn", "dam_browse_btn",
                     "depth_browse_btn", "vel_browse_btn", "arr_browse_btn",
                     "output_browse_btn", "selftest_btn", "refresh_layers_btn",
                     "dv_browse_btn", "review_zoom_btn",
                     "review_save_btn", "review_rerun_btn", "sources_btn",
                     "review_export_btn", "review_merge_btn", "series_btn",
                     "dsw_scan_btn", "dsw_import_btn", "ras_scan_btn", "ras_import_btn",
                     "data_download_btn", "data_sources_btn", "open_data_btn",
                     # v2.9
                     "datafolder_edit", "datafolder_browse_btn", "datafolder_search_btn",
                     "datafolder_hifld_btn", "datafolder_use_check",
                     *Extras290TabMixin.BUSY_WIDGETS_290,
                     *SuiteTabMixin.BUSY_WIDGETS_2100,
                     "facrev_kind_combo", "facrev_scenario_combo", "facrev_show_all_check",
                     "facrev_zoom_btn", "facrev_save_btn", "facrev_rerun_btn",
                     # v2.6.1: the pack must not change under a running task
                     "pack_path_edit", "pack_browse_btn", "pack_clear_btn",
                     "offline_only_check", "pack_build_btn"):
            w = getattr(self, name, None)
            if w is not None:
                w.setEnabled(not busy)
        if not busy and hasattr(self, "dsw_import_btn"):
            self.dsw_import_btn.setEnabled(bool(getattr(self, "_dsw_items", None)))
        self._update_button_states()

    def _group(self, category):
        """Layer-tree group path of this dam for a category."""
        return plugin_group(dam_display_name(self.config_dam_folder), category)

    # -------------------------------------------------- CHECK / RUN EVERYTHING
    def _check_paths(self):
        paths = dict(self._raster_paths())
        paths["dv"] = self.dv_edit.text().strip() or None
        return paths

    def _check_cfg(self):
        cfg = dict(self._data_cfg())         # the Data & Output tab choices
        cfg["one_d"] = self._one_d_selected()
        return cfg

    def _run_checks(self, services):
        from .checks import check_all
        return check_all(self._check_paths(), self.config_output_folder,
                         self.config_dam_folder, self._check_cfg(), services=services,
                         progress=self._progress_tick if services else None)

    @staticmethod
    def _checks_html(results):
        colors = {"ERROR": "#c62828", "WARNING": "#e65100", "OK": "#2e7d32"}
        return "<br>".join("<span style='color:{}'><b>{}</b></span> {}".format(
            colors.get(lvl, "#000"), lvl, html.escape(t)) for lvl, t in results)

    def _on_check_inputs(self, *args):
        if self._busy:
            return
        from .checks import summary
        self._set_busy(True)
        try:
            self._progress = self._make_progress("Checking inputs and data services...")
            results = self._run_checks(services=True)
        except CancelledByUser:
            self._log(">>> Input check cancelled")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            tb = traceback.format_exc()
            self._log(tb)
            log_message(tb, MSG_CRITICAL)
            self._update_status("Input check FAILED: {}".format(e), False)
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Check Inputs Error",
                                 "{}\n\nFull details are in the log area below.".format(e))
            return
        finally:
            self._finish_progress()
            self._set_busy(False)
        for lvl, t in results:
            self._log(">>> CHECK {}: {}".format(lvl, t))
        n_err, n_warn = summary(results)
        self._update_status("Input check: {} error(s), {} warning(s)".format(n_err, n_warn),
                            n_err == 0)
        box = QMessageBox.warning if n_err else QMessageBox.information
        box(self, "Check inputs", self._checks_html(results))
        return results

    def _on_run_all(self, *args):
        """Check inputs, then (v2.6, one background task) save the data sets
        when asked and run the classification."""
        if self._busy:
            return
        valid, errors = self.validate_all_inputs()
        if not valid:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Input Errors",
                                "\n".join("- {}".format(e) for e in errors))
            return
        from .checks import summary, ERROR
        results = self._run_checks(services=False)
        for lvl, t in results:
            if lvl != "OK":
                self._log(">>> CHECK {}: {}".format(lvl, t))
        if summary(results)[0]:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Run everything - inputs need fixing",
                                self._checks_html([r for r in results if r[0] == ERROR]))
            return
        download_first = self.data_save_check.isChecked()
        if download_first:
            try:
                self._download_job()
            except Exception as e:
                # optional step: the classification downloads what it needs
                self._log(">>> WARNING: the data sets cannot be saved to outputs/Data ({}) - "
                          "continuing without".format(e))
                download_first = False
        self._launch_classification(download_first=download_first, everything=True)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ SELF-TEST
    def _on_run_selftest(self):
        if self._busy:
            return
        from .selftest import run_self_test
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._progress = self._make_progress("Running self-test...")
        try:
            ok, lines = run_self_test(progress_cb=self._progress_tick)
        except CancelledByUser:
            self._update_status("Self-test cancelled", False)
            return
        except Exception:
            ok, lines = False, ["Self-test crashed:"] + traceback.format_exc().splitlines()
        finally:
            self._finish_progress()
            self._set_busy(False)
        for line in lines:
            self._log(line)
            log_message(line, MSG_INFO if ok else MSG_WARNING)
        self._update_status("Self-test {}".format("PASSED" if ok else "FAILED"), ok)
        box = QMessageBox.information if ok else QMessageBox.warning
        box(self, "Self-Test", "<br>".join(html.escape(line) for line in lines))

    def _current_state(self):
        state = {}
        for name in self._SETTING_WIDGETS:
            w = getattr(self, name, None)
            if w is not None:
                v = widget_value(w)
                if v is not None:
                    state[name] = v
        if hasattr(self, "scenario_table"):
            state.update(self._scenario_state())            # v2.7: scenario table
        return state

    def _save_settings(self):
        state = self._current_state()
        # write only real changes (writing marks the project as modified)
        if state != load_state() and (state != self._defaults or load_state()):
            save_state(state)

    def _apply_state(self, state):
        self._restoring = True          # no raster search while settings are restored
        try:
            for name in self._SETTING_WIDGETS:
                if name in state and getattr(self, name, None) is not None:
                    set_widget_value(getattr(self, name), state[name])
            if hasattr(self, "scenario_table"):
                self._apply_scenario_state(state)
            if hasattr(self, "_restore_parcel_fields290"):
                self._restore_parcel_fields290(state)
        finally:
            self._restoring = False
        # an output folder chosen by the user (after the dam folder, which
        # resets it to <dam>/outputs); the review decisions live there
        out = (state.get("output_folder_edit") or "").strip()
        if out and self.config_dam_folder:
            self.config_output_folder = out
            self.output_folder_edit.setText(out)
            self._update_button_states()

    def _restore_settings(self):
        state = load_state()
        if not state:
            return
        self._apply_state(state)
        self._log(">>> Settings restored from the QGIS project")

    def _on_project_changed(self, *args):
        """Another project was opened (or the project was closed): show that
        project's settings instead of the previous project's."""
        self._project_gen += 1          # a running task must not finish into it
        if self._busy:
            return
        self._apply_state(dict(self._defaults))
        self._last_run = None
        # nothing from the previous project's run may be edited or opened
        if hasattr(self, "review_table"):
            self._review_rows = []
            self.review_table.setRowCount(0)
            self.review_status.setText("Run Hazard Classification first")
        if hasattr(self, "_facrev_clear"):
            self._facrev_clear()
        if hasattr(self, "open_report_btn"):
            self.open_report_btn.setEnabled(False)
        # the layer choices of the new project can only be restored once the
        # combos list the new project's layers
        if hasattr(self, "_refresh_layer_combos"):
            try:
                self._refresh_layer_combos()
            except Exception as e:
                log_message("Layer lists not refreshed: {}".format(e))
        self._restore_settings()
        self._update_button_states()

    def _on_write_project(self, *args):
        """Project > Save: store the dialog settings with it."""
        if self._busy:
            return
        try:
            self._save_settings()
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("Settings not saved in the project: {}".format(e))

    def hideEvent(self, event):
        # Esc / the window's close box hide the dialog: keep its settings
        if not self._busy:
            try:
                self._save_settings()
            except Exception:
                pass
        super().hideEvent(event)

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        if self._busy:
            event.ignore()
            return
        try:
            self._save_settings()
        except Exception:
            pass
        super().closeEvent(event)
```
