```python
    """[Item] for every recognisable file / ESRI grid in the package."""
    items = []
    for dirpath, dirs, files in os.walk(folder):
        # v2.4.1: never descend into __MACOSX / .Trashes (a folder package
        # copied from a Mac keeps them even when the zip step is skipped)
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not is_junk_path(d)]
        if "hdr.adf" in [f.lower() for f in files]:     # ESRI binary grid folder
            role = detect_role(os.path.basename(dirpath) + ".adf")
            units, basis = detect_units(os.path.basename(dirpath), role)
            items.append(Item(dirpath, role, units, basis))
            dirs[:] = []
            continue
        for f in sorted(files):
            # v2.4.0: skip macOS / Windows metadata files
            if is_junk_path(f):
                continue
            low = f.lower()
            if low.endswith((".aux.xml", ".ovr", ".prj", ".dbf", ".shx", ".cpg", ".sbn", ".sbx",
                             ".xml", ".tfw", ".zip", ".qpj")):
                continue
            role = detect_role(f)
            if role == T_IGNORE:
                continue
            units, basis = detect_units(f, role)
            items.append(Item(os.path.join(dirpath, f), role, units, basis))
    # one file per raster role: prefer names stating units, then UTM over geographic
    return items


_GEOGRAPHIC_WORDS = ("gcs", "wgs84", "wgs", "geographic", "latlon", "latlong", "geo")


def _rank(it):
    """Preference among several files of one role: units stated in the name,
    then UTM (projected) over geographic copies, then the shorter name."""
    toks = _tokens(it.name)
    geo = any(t in _GEOGRAPHIC_WORDS for t in toks)
    return (0 if it.basis == "file name" or it.basis == "set by user" else 1,
            0 if "utm" in toks else (2 if geo else 1), len(it.name), it.name)


def chosen(items, role):
    """The item used for a role: the preferred one when several files have
    the same role (the UI lets the user switch the others to (ignore))."""
    cands = [it for it in items if it.role == role]
    return min(cands, key=_rank) if cands else None


def duplicate_roles(items):
    """{role: [names]} of raster roles held by more than one file."""
    out = {}
    for it in items:
        if it.role in RASTER_ROLES:
            out.setdefault(it.role, []).append(it.name)
    return {r: n for r, n in out.items() if len(n) > 1}


def assumed_units(items):
    """Chosen raster items whose units were not stated anywhere."""
    out = []
    for role in RASTER_ROLES:
        it = chosen(items, role)
        if it is not None and it.basis.startswith("assumed"):
            out.append(it)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- converting --
def _convert_raster(src, dst, factor, progress=None):
    """Copy `src` to a float32 GeoTIFF multiplied by `factor` (NoData -9999)."""
    with gdal_exceptions():
        ds = gdal.Open(src, gdal.GA_ReadOnly)
        if ds is None:
            raise RuntimeError("cannot open {}".format(src))
        band = ds.GetRasterBand(1)
        nd = band.GetNoDataValue()
        scale, offset = band.GetScale(), band.GetOffset()
        scale = 1.0 if scale in (None, 0) else float(scale)
        offset = 0.0 if offset is None else float(offset)
        w, h = ds.RasterXSize, ds.RasterYSize
        dst = prepare_output_path(dst)
        out = gdal.GetDriverByName("GTiff").Create(
            dst, w, h, 1, gdal.GDT_Float32, options=["COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES",
                                                    "BIGTIFF=IF_SAFER"])
        out.SetGeoTransform(ds.GetGeoTransform())
        proj = ds.GetProjection()
        if proj:
            out.SetProjection(proj)
        ob = out.GetRasterBand(1)
        ob.SetNoDataValue(-9999.0)
        rows = max(1, min(h, 2000000 // max(1, w)))
        for y0 in range(0, h, rows):
            n = min(rows, h - y0)
            a = np.asarray(band.ReadAsArray(0, y0, w, n), dtype=np.float64)
            valid = np.isfinite(a) & (a > -9999)
            if nd is not None:
                valid &= a != nd
            a = (a * scale + offset) * factor
            ob.WriteArray(np.where(valid, a, -9999.0).astype(np.float32), 0, y0)
            if progress:
                progress(100.0 * (y0 + n) / h)
        ob.FlushCache()
        ob = None
        out = None
        ds = None
    return dst


def convert(items, out_folder, name="DSS-WISE Lite", progress=None):
    """Convert the chosen rasters, summarise tables. Returns a dict with the
    converted paths, a Scenario and summary lines."""
    os.makedirs(out_folder, exist_ok=True)
    res = {"paths": {}, "notes": [], "lines": [], "boundary": None, "report": None,
           "hazard_zones": [it.path for it in items if it.role == V_HAZARD],
           "hcom": [it.path for it in items if it.role == T_HCOM]}
    for role, names in duplicate_roles(items).items():
        res["notes"].append("{} files for '{}': {} - used {} (set the others to (ignore) to "
                            "choose another)".format(len(names), role, ", ".join(names),
                                                     chosen(items, role).name))
    for it in assumed_units(items):
        res["notes"].append("Units of {} were not stated in the file name - {} assumed; "
                            "confirm against the DSS-WISE report".format(it.name, it.units))
    roles = [r for r in RASTER_ROLES if chosen(items, r) is not None]
    for i, role in enumerate(roles):
        it = chosen(items, role)
        units = it.units or DEFAULT_UNITS[role]
        factor = TO_PLUGIN[units]
        dst = os.path.join(out_folder, OUT_NAMES[role])

        def sub(p, i=i, role=role):
            if progress:
                progress(100.0 * (i + p / 100.0) / max(1, len(roles) + 1),
                         "Converting {}".format(role))
        res["paths"][role] = _convert_raster(it.path, dst, factor, sub)
        res["lines"].append("{}: {} ({} -> plugin units, x{:g}; units {})".format(
            role, it.name, units, factor, it.basis or "set by user"))
    if R_DEPTH not in res["paths"]:
        raise RuntimeError("The package has no maximum-depth raster (or it was not "
                           "recognised - set its role in the table).")
    if R_VEL not in res["paths"] and R_DV in res["paths"]:
        # v2.5.1: ACER zones come from Dmax / Vmax only. DVmax / Dmax is NOT a
        # velocity (the maxima occur at different times), so without a
        # velocity raster the depth-only (1D) criterion is used; D x V is
        # kept for flood severity in the loss-of-life estimate
        res["notes"].append("No velocity raster: ACER zones need Dmax / Vmax - the depth-only "
                            "(1D) criterion is used; D x V is kept for flood severity")
    if R_VEL not in res["paths"] and R_DV not in res["paths"]:
        res["notes"].append("No velocity or DV raster: ACER depth-velocity zones cannot be "
                            "evaluated - use the depth-only (1D) criterion")
    if R_ARR not in res["paths"]:
        res["notes"].append("No arrival-time raster: warning times and arrival fields are "
                            "left empty")
    b = chosen(items, V_BOUNDARY)
    if b is not None:
        res["boundary"] = b.path
    rep = chosen(items, T_REPORT)
    if rep is not None:
        res["report"] = rep.path
    for it in items:
        if it.role == T_HCOM:
            res["lines"].extend(hcom_summary(it.path))
        elif it.role == T_DISCHARGE:
            res["lines"].extend(discharge_summary(it.path))
    p = res["paths"]
    res["scenario"] = Scenario(name, p[R_DEPTH], p.get(R_VEL), p.get(R_ARR), dv=p.get(R_DV),
                               source="DSS-WISE Lite")
    res["depth_only"] = R_VEL not in p          # v2.5.1: no Vmax -> 1D criterion
    with open(prepare_output_path(os.path.join(out_folder, "DSSWISE_Import_Summary.txt")),
              "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(["DSS-WISE Lite import: " + name, ""] + res["lines"] + [""] +
                           ["NOTE: " + n for n in res["notes"]]) + "\n")
    if progress:
        progress(100.0, "DSS-WISE import done")
    return res


# -------------------------------------------------------------------- tables --
def _read_table(path):
    """(header, rows) of the first sheet / CSV table."""
    if path.lower().endswith(".csv"):
        with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace") as fh:
            rows = list(csv.reader(fh))
        return (rows[0], rows[1:]) if rows else ([], [])
    from qgis.core import QgsVectorLayer
    lyr = QgsVectorLayer(path, "hcom", "ogr")
    if not lyr.isValid():
        return [], []
    header = [f.name() for f in lyr.fields()]
    rows = [[f[n] for n in header] for f in lyr.getFeatures()]
    return header, rows


def _col(header, *keys, exclude=()):
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        k = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", str(h).lower())
        if all(x in k for x in keys) and not any(x in k for x in exclude):
            return i
    return None


def _fnum(v):
    try:
        f = float(str(v).replace(",", ""))
        return f if np.isfinite(f) else None
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


_HCOM_FIELDS = (("pop_day", "population (day)", ("pop", "day"), ()),
                ("pop_night", "population (night)", ("pop", "night"), ()),
                ("pop", "population", ("pop",), ("day", "night")),
                ("par", "population at risk", ("par",), ("parcel",)),
                ("housing", "housing units", ("hous",), ()))


def hcom_totals(path):
    """Totals of a DSS-WISE HCOM (census block) table as a dict: file, rows,
    header, and - for each column found - pop_day, pop_night, pop (census
    population), par (population at risk), housing (housing units) and
    max_dv, with the column it came from in "columns". Column names are
    matched loosely (the table layout is not formally documented). {"error":
    text, "file": name} when the table cannot be read."""
    name = os.path.basename(path)
    try:
        header, rows = _read_table(path)
    except Exception as e:
        return {"file": name, "error": "not readable ({})".format(e)}
    if not header:
        return {"file": name, "error": "empty or not readable"}
    out = {"file": name, "rows": len(rows), "header": [str(h) for h in header],
           "columns": {}}
    for key, _label, keys, excl in _HCOM_FIELDS:
        i = _col(header, *keys, exclude=excl)
        if i is not None:
            out[key] = sum(_fnum(r[i]) or 0 for r in rows if i < len(r))
            out["columns"][key] = str(header[i])
    i = _col(header, "maxdv")
    if i is None:
        i = _col(header, "dv", exclude=("time", "arrival"))
    if i is not None:
        vals = [v for v in (_fnum(r[i]) for r in rows if i < len(r)) if v is not None]
        if vals:
            out["max_dv"] = max(vals)
            out["columns"]["max_dv"] = str(header[i])
    return out


def hcom_summary(path):
    """Totals of a DSS-WISE HCOM (census block) table: population at risk
    day / night, housing units, max DV. Column names are matched loosely."""
    t = hcom_totals(path)
    if t.get("error"):
        return ["HCOM table {}: {}".format(t["file"], t["error"])]
    out = ["HCOM table {} ({} rows):".format(t["file"], t["rows"])]
    for key, label, _k, _e in _HCOM_FIELDS:
        if key in t:
            out.append("  {}: {:,.0f} (column '{}')".format(label, t[key],
                                                           t["columns"][key]))
    if "max_dv" in t:
        out.append("  max DV: {:.1f} (column '{}', units as in the table)".format(
            t["max_dv"], t["columns"]["max_dv"]))
    if len(out) == 1:
        out.append("  columns: " + ", ".join(t["header"][:20]))
    return out


def discharge_summary(path):
    """Peak of each discharge column of a DSS-WISE observation-line CSV."""
    try:
        header, rows = _read_table(path)
    except Exception as e:
        return ["Discharge CSV {}: not readable ({})".format(os.path.basename(path), e)]
    if not header or not rows:
        return ["Discharge CSV {}: empty".format(os.path.basename(path))]
    tcol = _col(header, "time")
    out = ["Discharge hydrographs {} ({} rows):".format(os.path.basename(path), len(rows))]
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        if i == tcol:
            continue
        vals = [(_fnum(r[i]), r[tcol] if tcol is not None and tcol < len(r) else "")
                for r in rows if i < len(r)]
        vals = [v for v in vals if v[0] is not None]
        if not vals:
            continue
        peak, when = max(vals, key=lambda t: t[0])
        out.append("  {}: peak {:,.0f}{}".format(h, peak, " at {} {}".format(
            header[tcol], when) if tcol is not None else ""))
    return out


# v2.4.1: operating-system metadata that is never part of a DSS-WISE package
# (macOS resource forks / Finder files, Windows thumbnails). Only these exact
# names are skipped - an ordinary file starting with "__" or "." is kept.
_JUNK_DIRS = {"__macosx", ".trashes", ".spotlight-v100", ".fseventsd"}
_JUNK_FILES = {".ds_store", "thumbs.db", "desktop.ini", "ehthumbs.db"}


def is_junk_path(name):
    """True for macOS / Windows metadata: '._*' resource forks, .DS_Store,
    Thumbs.db, desktop.ini, or anything inside __MACOSX / .Trashes."""
    if not name:
        return False
    parts = [p for p in name.replace("\\", "/").split("/") if p and p not in (".", "..")]
    if not parts:
        return False
    if any(p.lower() in _JUNK_DIRS for p in parts[:-1]):
        return True
    last = parts[-1]
    return last.startswith("._") or last.lower() in _JUNK_FILES or last.lower() in _JUNK_DIRS
```

## `dsswise_tab.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""'DSS-WISE Lite' tab: import a DSS-WISE Lite Simulation Results Package
(zip or unzipped folder), confirm what each file is, convert the rasters to
the plugin's units and use them as the Setup tab rasters (or as an extra
breach scenario on the Hazard Classification tab)."""

import os
import re
import traceback

from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import (
    QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QLabel, QWidget, QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem,
    QComboBox, QLineEdit, QCheckBox, QTextEdit, QFileDialog, QMessageBox, QFormLayout,
    QGroupBox,
)
from qgis.core import QgsRasterLayer, QgsVectorLayer

from . import dsswise as DW
from .compat import MSG_CRITICAL
from .helpers import (
    log_message, add_layer_to_project, plugin_group, dam_display_name, CancelledByUser,
)
from .constants import GRP_DSSWISE
from .styles import style_depth

DSW_COLS = ["File", "Role", "Units", "How the units were found"]


class DssWiseTabMixin(object):
    def _build_dsswise_tab(self):
        tab = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(tab)
        info = QLabel(
            "<h3>DSS-WISE Lite results</h3>Import the <i>Simulation Results Package</i> "
            "downloaded from DSS-WISE Lite (NCCHE / FEMA). Each file is recognised by its "
            "name (e.g. <i>..._FloodDepth_in_Ft-..._UTM.tif</i>); check the roles and units "
            "below before importing. Rasters are converted to ft, ft/s, ft²/s and hours.")
        info.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(info)
        grp = QGroupBox("Package")
        form = QFormLayout()
        self.dsw_path_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.dsw_path_edit.setPlaceholderText("results package .zip or its unzipped folder")
        b1 = QPushButton("Zip...")
        b1.clicked.connect(self._dsw_browse_zip)
        b2 = QPushButton("Folder...")
        b2.clicked.connect(self._dsw_browse_folder)
        w = QWidget()
        h = QHBoxLayout(w)
        h.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        h.addWidget(self.dsw_path_edit, stretch=3)
        h.addWidget(b1)
        h.addWidget(b2)
        form.addRow("Package:", w)
        self.dsw_name_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.dsw_name_edit.setPlaceholderText("scenario name (default: package name)")
        form.addRow("Scenario name:", self.dsw_name_edit)
        self.dsw_scan_btn = QPushButton("Scan package")
        self.dsw_scan_btn.clicked.connect(self._dsw_scan)
        form.addRow("", self.dsw_scan_btn)
        grp.setLayout(form)
        lay.addWidget(grp)
        self.dsw_table = QTableWidget()
        self.dsw_table.setColumnCount(len(DSW_COLS))
        self.dsw_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(DSW_COLS)
        lay.addWidget(self.dsw_table)
        opts = QHBoxLayout()
        self.dsw_use_setup_check = QCheckBox("Use as the Setup tab rasters")
        self.dsw_use_setup_check.setChecked(True)
        self.dsw_load_check = QCheckBox("Load the converted layers")
        self.dsw_load_check.setChecked(True)
        self.dsw_add_scenario_check = QCheckBox("Add as a scenario in the Hazard "
                                                "Classification tab's table")
        self.dsw_add_scenario_check.setToolTip(
            "A further breach scenario (or, with a name like 'no breach', ... set its role "
            "there) next to the Setup tab rasters")
        for c in (self.dsw_use_setup_check, self.dsw_add_scenario_check, self.dsw_load_check):
            opts.addWidget(c)
        opts.addStretch()
        lay.addLayout(opts)
        self.dsw_import_btn = QPushButton("Import")
        self.dsw_import_btn.clicked.connect(self._dsw_import)
        self.dsw_import_btn.setEnabled(False)
        lay.addWidget(self.dsw_import_btn)
        self.dsw_result_text = QTextEdit()
        self.dsw_result_text.setReadOnly(True)
        lay.addWidget(self.dsw_result_text)
        self._dsw_items = []
        self._dsw_folder = None
        return tab

    def _dsw_browse_zip(self, *args):
        path, _f = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(self, "DSS-WISE Lite results package",
                                               getattr(self, "config_dam_folder", "") or "",
                                               "Zip (*.zip);;All Files (*)")
        if path:
            self.dsw_path_edit.setText(path)

    def _dsw_browse_folder(self, *args):
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Unzipped DSS-WISE Lite package",
                                                getattr(self, "config_dam_folder", "") or "")
        if path:
            self.dsw_path_edit.setText(path)

    def _dsw_name(self):
        name = self.dsw_name_edit.text().strip()
        if not name:
            base = os.path.basename(self.dsw_path_edit.text().strip().rstrip("/\\"))
            name = os.path.splitext(base)[0] or "DSS-WISE Lite"
        return name

    def _dsw_out(self):
        slug = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", self._dsw_name()).strip("_")[:40] or "package"
        root = getattr(self, "config_output_folder", "") or os.path.dirname(
            self.dsw_path_edit.text().strip())
        return os.path.join(root, "DSSWISE_" + slug)

    def _dsw_scan(self, *args):
        src = self.dsw_path_edit.text().strip()
        if not src or not os.path.exists(src):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "DSS-WISE Lite", "Select the results package first.")
            return
        try:
            out = self._dsw_out()
            os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
            self._dsw_folder = DW.open_package(src, out)
            self._dsw_items = DW.scan(self._dsw_folder)
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "DSS-WISE Lite", "Could not read the package: {}".format(e))
            return
        t = self.dsw_table
        t.setRowCount(len(self._dsw_items))
        for i, it in enumerate(self._dsw_items):
            t.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(os.path.relpath(it.path, self._dsw_folder)))
            role = QComboBox()
            for r in DW.ALL_ROLES:
                role.addItem(r, r)
            role.setCurrentIndex(DW.ALL_ROLES.index(it.role))
            t.setCellWidget(i, 1, role)
            units = QComboBox()
            for u in sorted({u for us in DW.UNIT_CHOICES.values() for u in us}):
                units.addItem(u, u)
            units.addItem("-", None)
            want = it.units if it.units else "-"
            for k in range(units.count()):
                if units.itemText(k) == want:
                    units.setCurrentIndex(k)
            t.setCellWidget(i, 2, units)
            t.setItem(i, 3, QTableWidgetItem(it.basis or ""))
        n = sum(1 for it in self._dsw_items if it.role in DW.RASTER_ROLES)
        msg = ["{} file(s) found, {} raster(s). Check the roles and units, then Import.".format(
            len(self._dsw_items), n)]
        for role, names in DW.duplicate_roles(self._dsw_items).items():
            msg.append("- {} files are recognised as '{}' ({}); {} will be used - set the "
                       "others to (ignore) to choose.".format(
                           len(names), role, ", ".join(names),
                           DW.chosen(self._dsw_items, role).name))
        for it in DW.assumed_units(self._dsw_items):
            msg.append("- Units of {} are not in its name: {} assumed - check the DSS-WISE "
                       "report and correct the Units column if needed.".format(it.name,
                                                                              it.units))
        self.dsw_result_text.setPlainText("\n".join(msg))
        self.dsw_import_btn.setEnabled(bool(self._dsw_items))

    def _dsw_table_items(self):
        """Items with the roles / units from the table, and a list of rows
        whose units do not fit their role (nothing is guessed for them)."""
        t = self.dsw_table
        bad = []
        for i, it in enumerate(self._dsw_items):
            it.role = t.cellWidget(i, 1).currentData()
            u = t.cellWidget(i, 2).currentData()
            if it.role in DW.UNIT_CHOICES:
                if u not in DW.UNIT_CHOICES[it.role]:
                    bad.append("{} ({}: '{}' - choose one of {})".format(
                        it.name, it.role, u or "-", ", ".join(DW.UNIT_CHOICES[it.role])))
                    continue
                if u != it.units:
                    it.basis = "set by user"
                it.units = u
        return self._dsw_items, bad

    def _dsw_import(self, *args):
        if not self._dsw_items:
            return
        items, bad = self._dsw_table_items()
        if bad:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "DSS-WISE Lite", "Units do not match the role for:\n" +
                                "\n".join(bad))
            return
        name = self._dsw_name()
        out = self._dsw_out()
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._progress = self._make_progress("Importing DSS-WISE Lite results...")
        try:
            res = DW.convert(items, out, name=name, progress=self._progress_tick)
        except CancelledByUser:
            self._finish_progress()
            self._set_busy(False)
            self._update_status("DSS-WISE import cancelled", False)
            self._log(">>> DSS-WISE Lite import cancelled")
            return
        except Exception as e:
            self._finish_progress()
            self._set_busy(False)
            log_message(traceback.format_exc(), MSG_CRITICAL)
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "DSS-WISE Lite", str(e) or repr(e))
            return
        self._finish_progress()
        self._set_busy(False)
        p = res["paths"]
        if self.dsw_use_setup_check.isChecked():
            # fields the package has no raster for are cleared on purpose: keeping
            # another model's velocity or arrival would mix two data sets
            self.depth_edit.setText(p[DW.R_DEPTH])
            self.vel_edit.setText(p.get(DW.R_VEL) or "")
            self.arr_edit.setText(p.get(DW.R_ARR) or "")
            self.dv_edit.setText(p.get(DW.R_DV) or "")
            # time steps of another model must not be mixed in, and the 1D /
            # 2D choice follows what the package contains
            want = "1d" if res["depth_only"] else "2d"
            i = self.model_combo.findData(want) if hasattr(self.model_combo, "findData") \
                else (1 if want == "1d" else 0)
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(i if i is not None and i >= 0 else
                                             (1 if want == "1d" else 0))
        if res.get("hcom") and hasattr(self, "hcom_edit"):
            # the classification compares its population at risk with DSS-WISE's own
            self.hcom_edit.setText(";".join(res["hcom"]))
        if self.dsw_add_scenario_check.isChecked() and hasattr(self, "_scn_add_row"):
            self._scn_add_row({"name": name, "depth": p[DW.R_DEPTH],
                               "velocity": p.get(DW.R_VEL), "arrival": p.get(DW.R_ARR),
                               "dv": p.get(DW.R_DV)})
            self._log(">>> DSS-WISE '{}' added to the scenario table (Hazard Classification "
                      "tab, advanced options)".format(name))
        if self.dsw_load_check.isChecked():
            grp = plugin_group(dam_display_name(self.config_dam_folder), GRP_DSSWISE)
            for role in DW.RASTER_ROLES:
                if role in p:
                    lyr = QgsRasterLayer(p[role], "{} - {}".format(name, role))
                    if lyr.isValid():
                        if role == DW.R_DEPTH:
                            style_depth(lyr)
                        add_layer_to_project(lyr, visibility=role == DW.R_DEPTH, group=grp)
            vecs = ([(res["boundary"], "inundation boundary")] if res.get("boundary") else []) \
                + [(p_, "hazard zones ({})".format(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p_))[0]))
                   for p_ in res.get("hazard_zones") or []]
            for path_, label in vecs:
                b = QgsVectorLayer(path_, "{} - {}".format(name, label), "ogr")
                if b.isValid():
                    add_layer_to_project(b, group=grp)
        text = ["Imported to {}".format(out), ""] + res["lines"] + [""] + \
            ["NOTE: " + n for n in res["notes"]]
        if res.get("report"):
            text.append("DSS-WISE report: {}".format(res["report"]))
        self.dsw_result_text.setPlainText("\n".join(text))
        self._log(">>> DSS-WISE Lite '{}' imported ({})".format(name, ", ".join(
            os.path.basename(v) for v in p.values())))
        self._update_button_states()
```

## `eap.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Emergency Action Plan (EAP) outputs for a breach scenario.

* EAP_Notification_List: every place to warn, in the order the flood gets
  there - flooded structures that are (or may be) occupied, dry ones whose
  road access is cut, flooded lifeline facilities, other dams (their owner /
  operator) and overtopped roads (closures). Address (ND GIS Hub NENA
  address first, then the FEMA_Structures PROP_ADDR ...), persons, arrival
  time, depth, ACER zone, latitude / longitude. GPKG + CSV + XLSX.
* EAP_Arrival_Bands.tif: the flooded area classed by arrival time
  (EAP_ARRIVAL_BREAKS_HR) for the inundation maps.
* EAP_Arrival_Contours.gpkg: arrival-time lines at the same breaks (GDAL
  contouring; skipped where the GDAL build has none).

Arrival is the scenario's arrival-time raster (hours after breach start).
Items without an arrival time are listed last.
"""

import os
import re

import numpy as np
from osgeo import gdal, ogr, osr
from qgis.core import (
    QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem, QgsCoordinateTransform, QgsFeature, QgsField, QgsGeometry,
    QgsPointXY,
)

from .compat import WKB_POINT, FT_DOUBLE, FT_INT, FT_STRING, NULL, GEOM_POINT
from .constants import (
    EAP_ARRIVAL_BREAKS_HR, ZONE_LABELS, CLASS_NODATA,
)
from .helpers import create_memory_layer, log_message, prepare_output_path, gdal_exceptions
from . import facilities as FAC

FIELDS = [("Order", FT_INT), ("Arrival_hr", FT_DOUBLE), ("Arrival_hhmm", FT_STRING),
          ("Type", FT_STRING), ("Priority", FT_STRING), ("Category", FT_STRING),
          ("Name", FT_STRING),
          ("Address", FT_STRING), ("City", FT_STRING), ("ZIP", FT_STRING),
          ("Persons", FT_INT), ("Max_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("ACER_Zone", FT_STRING),
          ("ND_Outcome", FT_STRING), ("Charged", FT_STRING), ("Ref_ID", FT_STRING),
          ("Lat", FT_DOUBLE), ("Lon", FT_DOUBLE)]


def hhmm(hours):
    if hours is None:
        return ""
    m = int(round(float(hours) * 60.0))
    return "{}:{:02d}".format(m // 60, m % 60)


def _point(geom):
    try:
        if geom.type() == GEOM_POINT:
            return geom.asPoint()
        return geom.pointOnSurface().asPoint()
    except Exception:
        try:
            return geom.centroid().asPoint()
        except Exception:
            return None


# v2.5: notification priority. 1 = people who cannot evacuate on their own
# (schools, child care, care homes, hospitals), 2 = emergency response and
# utility lifelines; the list itself stays sorted by arrival time.
PRIORITY_VULNERABLE = "1 - vulnerable occupants"
PRIORITY_LIFELINE = "2 - emergency response / lifeline"
_VULNERABLE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(school|schools|education|kindergarten|preschool|pre school|daycare|day care|child ?care|"
    r"nursery school|nursing|assisted living|basic care|care home|hospital|edu1|edu2|"
    r"res6|com6)\b", re.I)


def structure_priority(rec):
    """Priority of a structure from its sources' descriptions / NSI codes."""
    texts = " ; ".join(t for s in rec.get("sources", ()) for t in s.get("texts", ()))
    texts = re.sub(r"[_\-/]+", " ", "{} ; {}".format(texts, rec.get("occupancy") or ""))
    if _VULNERABLE_RE.search(texts):
        return PRIORITY_VULNERABLE
    if rec.get("lifeline"):
        return PRIORITY_LIFELINE
    return ""


def facility_priority(r):
    if r.get("kind") == FAC.KIND_LIFELINE:
        if r.get("category") in FAC.VULNERABLE:
            return PRIORITY_VULNERABLE
        if r.get("lifeline"):
            return PRIORITY_LIFELINE
    return ""


def notification_rows(structs, res):
    """Rows (dicts with a "pt" in the analysis CRS) for one breach scenario;
    `structs` must hold this scenario's results (restored snapshot)."""
    from .structures import address_of, OUT_DRY, CAT_NOT_HABITABLE
    rows = []
    for rec in structs:
        if rec.get("category") == CAT_NOT_HABITABLE or rec.get("habitable") == "No":
            continue
        depth = rec.get("max_depth")
        wet = depth is not None and depth > 0 and rec.get("outcome", OUT_DRY) != OUT_DRY
        if not wet and not rec.get("cut_off"):
            continue
        addr, city, zp = address_of(rec)
        inc = rec.get("incremental")
        rows.append({
            "type": "Structure" if wet else "Structure - road access cut",
            "priority": structure_priority(rec),
            # v2.5.1: FEMA occupancy for reference (not the habitability rule)
            "category": (rec.get("fema_category") or "")[:120],
            "name": (rec.get("occupancy") or "")[:120],
            "address": addr, "city": city, "zip": zp, "persons": int(rec.get("persons") or 0),
            "arrival": rec.get("arrival"), "depth": depth if wet else None,
            "zone": ZONE_LABELS.get(rec.get("zone"), "") if wet else "",
            "outcome": rec.get("outcome") or "",
            "charged": "" if inc is None else ("Yes" if inc else "No"),
            "ref": "Struct {}".format(rec["id"]), "pt": _point(rec["geom"])})
    recs = res.get("facility_records") or []
    ev = res.get("fac_eval") or {}
    charged = res.get("fac_charged") or {}
    for r in FAC.flooded(recs, ev, None):
        e = ev.get(r["id"]) or {}
        ch = charged.get(r["id"])
        dam = r["kind"] == FAC.KIND_DAM
        if r["kind"] == FAC.KIND_CROSSING:
            rows.append({
                "type": "Bridge / culvert / crossing - check, close if overtopped",
                "priority": "",
                "category": r["category"], "name": r["name"],
                "address": r.get("carried") or "", "city": "", "zip": "",
                "persons": 0, "arrival": e.get("arrival"), "depth": e.get("depth"),
                "zone": "", "outcome": ("ADT {:,.0f}".format(r["adt"]) if r.get("adt") else ""),
                "charged": "" if ch is None else ("Yes" if ch[0] else "No"),
                "ref": r.get("struct_no") or r["source"], "pt": _point(r["geom"])})
            continue
        rows.append({
            "type": "Dam - notify owner / operator" if dam else "Lifeline / critical facility",
            "priority": facility_priority(r),
            "category": ("{} hazard dam".format(r["hazard"]) if dam and r.get("hazard")
                         else r["category"]),
            "name": r["name"], "address": "", "city": "", "zip": "", "persons": 0,
            "arrival": e.get("arrival"), "depth": e.get("depth"), "zone": "", "outcome": "",
            "charged": "" if ch is None else ("Yes" if ch[0] else "No"),
            "ref": (r.get("nid") or "NID ?") if dam else r["source"],
            "pt": _point(r["geom"])})
    for rd in res.get("roads") or []:
        g = rd.get("geom")
        inc = rd.get("incremental")
        rows.append({
            "type": "Road - closure", "priority": "", "category": rd.get("road_class") or "",
            "name": rd.get("name") or "unnamed road", "address": "", "city": "", "zip": "",
            "persons": 0, "arrival": rd.get("arrival"), "depth": rd.get("max_depth"),
            "zone": ZONE_LABELS.get(rd.get("vehicle_zone"), "") if rd.get("vehicle_zone")
            else "", "outcome": rd.get("nd_class") or "",
            "charged": "" if inc is None else ("Yes" if inc else "No"),
            "ref": "{:.0f} ft overtopped".format(rd.get("length_ft") or 0),
            "pt": _point(g) if g is not None else None})
    rows = [r for r in rows if r["pt"] is not None]
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["arrival"] is None, r["arrival"] if r["arrival"] is not None
                             else 0.0, -(r["depth"] or 0.0)))
    return rows


def notification_layer(structs, res, crs, transform_ctx, name="EAP_Notification_List"):
    rows = notification_rows(structs, res)
    if not rows:
        return None
    lyr = create_memory_layer(name, WKB_POINT, crs, [QgsField(n, t) for n, t in FIELDS])
    to_ll = QgsCoordinateTransform(crs, QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem("EPSG:4326"),
                                   transform_ctx)

    def rnd(v, n=2):
        return NULL if v is None else round(float(v), n)
    feats = []
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        pt = r["pt"]
        try:
            ll = to_ll.transform(QgsPointXY(pt))
            lat, lon = round(ll.y(), 6), round(ll.x(), 6)
        except Exception:
            lat = lon = NULL
        f = QgsFeature(lyr.fields())
        f.setGeometry(QgsGeometry.fromPointXY(QgsPointXY(pt)))
        f.setAttributes([i + 1, rnd(r["arrival"]), hhmm(r["arrival"]) or NULL, r["type"],
                         r.get("priority") or NULL, r["category"] or NULL, r["name"] or NULL,
                         r["address"] or NULL,
                         r["city"] or NULL, r["zip"] or NULL, int(r["persons"]),
                         rnd(r["depth"]), r["zone"] or NULL, r["outcome"] or NULL,
                         r["charged"] or NULL, r["ref"] or NULL, lat, lon])
        feats.append(f)
    lyr.dataProvider().addFeatures(feats)
    lyr.updateExtents()
    return lyr


def summary_lines(rows_layer, bands_path, contours_path):
    out = []
    if rows_layer is not None:
        n = rows_layer.featureCount()
        first = next(iter(rows_layer.getFeatures()), None)
        t = ""
        if first is not None and first["Arrival_hhmm"] not in (None, NULL, ""):
            t = "; first arrival {} h:min after breach start ({})".format(
                first["Arrival_hhmm"], first["Type"].lower())
        out.append("Notification list: {} item(s) sorted by arrival time{} - "
                   "EAP/{}.csv / .xlsx".format(n, t, rows_layer.name()))
        try:
            pri = [f for f in rows_layer.getFeatures()
                   if str(f["Priority"] or "").startswith("1")]
        except Exception:
            pri = []
        if pri:
            out.append("{} priority notification(s) - vulnerable occupants (school, child "
                       "care, care home, hospital): {}".format(len(pri), "; ".join(
                           "#{} {}{}".format(f["Order"], f["Name"] or f["Category"] or "",
                                             " ({} h:min)".format(f["Arrival_hhmm"])
                                             if f["Arrival_hhmm"] not in (None, NULL, "")
                                             else "") for f in pri[:6]) +
                       ("" if len(pri) <= 6 else " and {} more".format(len(pri) - 6))))
    if bands_path:
        out.append("Arrival-time bands (h): {} - EAP/{}".format(
            band_labels_text(), os.path.basename(bands_path)))
    if contours_path:
        out.append("Arrival-time contours: EAP/{}".format(os.path.basename(contours_path)))
    return out


# ----------------------------------------------------------- arrival maps --
def band_labels():
    """[(class value, label)]: 1 = up to the first break ... last = beyond."""
    b = EAP_ARRIVAL_BREAKS_HR
    out = [(1, "0 - {:g} h".format(b[0]))]
    for i in range(1, len(b)):
        out.append((i + 1, "{:g} - {:g} h".format(b[i - 1], b[i])))
    out.append((len(b) + 1, "> {:g} h".format(b[-1])))
    return out


BAND_COLORS = ("#b2182b", "#e34a33", "#fc8d59", "#fdbb84", "#91bfdb", "#4575b4", "#313695")


def style_arrival_bands(lyr):
    from .helpers import apply_class_style
    items = [(v, BAND_COLORS[min(v - 1, len(BAND_COLORS) - 1)], "Arrival " + lbl)
             for v, lbl in band_labels()]
    return apply_class_style(lyr, items)


def band_labels_text():
    return ", ".join(lbl for _v, lbl in band_labels())


def write_arrival_bands(path, depth_path, arrival_path):
    """Int16 GeoTIFF on the depth grid: arrival class where depth > 0 and the
    arrival is known (NoData elsewhere). Returns the path or None."""
    from .hazard import _Grid
    from .processing import _create_class_raster, _finalize_class_raster, _rows_per_block
    if not depth_path or not arrival_path:
        return None
    ds_d = gdal.Open(depth_path, gdal.GA_ReadOnly)
    if ds_d is None:
        return None
    breaks = np.asarray(EAP_ARRIVAL_BREAKS_HR, dtype=np.float64)
    gd = ga = out = None
    path = prepare_output_path(path)
    try:
        gd, ga = _Grid(ds_d, depth_path), _Grid(ds_d, arrival_path)
        w, h = ds_d.RasterXSize, ds_d.RasterYSize
        out = _create_class_raster(gdal.GetDriverByName("GTiff"), path, w, h,
                                   ds_d.GetGeoTransform(), ds_d.GetProjection())
        band = out.GetRasterBand(1)
        rows = _rows_per_block(w, h)
        n = 0
        for y0 in range(0, h, rows):
            hh = min(rows, h - y0)
            d, dv = gd.read(y0, hh, w)
            a, av = ga.read(y0, hh, w)
            ok = dv & av & (d > 0) & (a >= 0)
            cls = np.full((hh, w), CLASS_NODATA, np.int16)
            cls[ok] = (np.searchsorted(breaks, a[ok], side="left") + 1).astype(np.int16)
            n += int(ok.sum())
            band.WriteArray(cls, 0, y0)
        _finalize_class_raster(out, w, h)
        band = None
        out = None
        if not n:
            log_message("EAP arrival bands: no flooded cell has an arrival time")
        return path
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("EAP arrival bands not written: {}".format(e))
        band = None                     # the band keeps the dataset open (GDAL >= 3.8)
        out = None
        try:
            if os.path.exists(path):
                os.remove(path)
        except OSError:
            pass
        return None
    finally:
        for g in (gd, ga):
            if g is not None:
                g.close()
        ds_d = None


def write_arrival_contours(path, arrival_path):
    """Arrival-time lines (GDAL ContourGenerateEx, fixed levels) to a
    GeoPackage. None when GDAL cannot contour here."""
    if not arrival_path or not hasattr(gdal, "ContourGenerateEx"):
        return None
    drv = ogr.GetDriverByName("GPKG")
    if drv is None:
        return None
    path = prepare_output_path(path)
    try:
        with gdal_exceptions():
            src = gdal.Open(arrival_path, gdal.GA_ReadOnly)
            band = src.GetRasterBand(1)
            if os.path.exists(path):
                drv.DeleteDataSource(path)
            ds = drv.CreateDataSource(path)
            srs = osr.SpatialReference()
            wkt = src.GetProjection()
            if wkt:
                srs.ImportFromWkt(wkt)
            lyr = ds.CreateLayer("arrival_contours", srs if wkt else None, ogr.wkbLineString)
            lyr.CreateField(ogr.FieldDefn("ID", ogr.OFTInteger))
            lyr.CreateField(ogr.FieldDefn("Arrival_hr", ogr.OFTReal))
            opts = ["FIXED_LEVELS=" + ",".join("{:g}".format(b) for b in EAP_ARRIVAL_BREAKS_HR),
                    "ID_FIELD=0", "ELEV_FIELD=1"]
            nd = band.GetNoDataValue()
            if nd is not None:
                opts.append("NODATA={}".format(nd))
            lyr.StartTransaction()
            gdal.ContourGenerateEx(band, lyr, options=opts)
            lyr.CommitTransaction()
            n = lyr.GetFeatureCount()
            ds = lyr = band = src = None
        if not n:
            os.remove(path)
            return None
        return path
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("EAP arrival contours not written: {}".format(e))
        return None
```

## `ensemble.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.10: hazard class probability from an ensemble of breach runs.

An ensemble is a folder of run folders, each with the rasters of one breach run: the
ND Dam Breach Runner's probabilistic study writes <dam>/Probabilistic/Runs/run_NNN/ with
"Depth (Max).tif" (ft), "Velocity (Max).tif" (ft/s), "Arrival Time.tif" (h after breach
start) and run.json (format "ndbreach/probabilistic_run": the sample, "weight", "status",
"baseline"); any folder of sub-folders whose rasters autodetect.find_rasters recognises
works too.

  which runs  "Runs" wins over the legacy "runs" when both exist. When Runs/index.json
             exists (the runner writes it when the study has finished) ONLY the run folders
             it lists are used; without it every run folder there now is used, with the
             runner's provisional weights, and the summary says "study not finished (no
             index.json)".
  baseline   run.json "baseline" {"depth", "velocity", "arrival"} (paths relative to the run
             folder) is the run's no-breach baseline, so the incremental (with minus without
             breach) classification applies per run; else Baseline rasters in the run
             folder; else the dam's own baseline scenario.
  no breach  a run with status "no breach" (the dam does not fail; all-NaN rasters) is NOT
             classified. It keeps its weight and is its own line "No breach" of the
             distribution: every probability is over ALL runs, so P(High) + P(Medium) +
             P(Low) + P(no breach) = 1 and nothing is silently conditioned on a failure;
             "given a breach" (P(class | the dam fails)) is shown beside it. The no-breach
             case alone is reported separately: the no-breach (baseline) flood classified on
             its own when a baseline exists, else "no breach - not classified".

run_ensemble() classifies EVERY run with this plugin's pipeline and the dam's own settings,
then counts how often each class comes out:

  settings   the dam's last run as recorded in <dam>/outputs/QA/Run_Settings.json (every
             setting, the layers it read, the data files it read), or a cfg handed in by
             the caller (base_cfg - e.g. the dialog's current settings); a CONFIG_JSON file
             (as ndhazard:classify) overrides settings. Without either: plugin defaults.
  data       downloads are NOT repeated per run: the data files the dam's own run read
             (Run_Settings.json "inputs": the NSI / address / FEMA / road / rail / NID /
             lifeline ... files in outputs/_downloads or the data folder) are handed to
             every run as its data folder (cfg["local_data"], as a reproduction does), and
             the dam's FEMA_Structures file is the outline layer. Downloads stay OFF unless
             allowed; when allowed (or when there is no record) they go through ONE shared
             tile cache (QA/Ensemble/_tile_cache) and the downloads of the first run are
             copied to the next ones (the runner's runs share the base run's grid, so the
             study areas - and the download file names - are the same).
  per run    outputs in <dam>/outputs/QA/Ensemble/<run id>/ (never in the dam folder or the
             runner's folder); PDF report, EAP, map book, zone rasters, comparison with the
             last run, sensitivity and other extras are off (quick_rerun on); the dam's
             engineer review decisions apply. The run's result is kept in
             Ensemble_Run_Result.json with a key of its rasters and settings: running the
             ensemble again (after a cancel, or with more runs) classifies only what is new.
  reference  the dam's OWN rasters are classified once the same way (QA/Ensemble/
             _reference) and compared with the class of the dam's last run: when they
             differ, the ensemble's settings / data do not reproduce the dam's own
             classification and the report says so first.
  gate       optional model gate (modelgate.py) per run; its status is in the run table.

Outputs in <dam>/outputs/QA: Class_Probability.csv (the class distribution - ND REG_05.2026
High / Medium / Low and ACER TM 11 High / Significant / Low with counts, weights,
probabilities and the run IDs of each class - and, per structure, the probability of the
probable loss of life zone), Class_Probability_Runs.csv (one row per run) and
Class_Probability.html. Weighted when EVERY classified run has a positive weight in its
run.json; otherwise every run counts once (and the report says why).

THE PROBABILITIES ARE ONLY AS GOOD AS THE ENSEMBLE'S PARAMETER DISTRIBUTIONS. They are the
share of runs (or of the weight) giving each class - nothing more. The ND Dam Breach
Runner's default distributions are adjustable placeholders, not published values. Nothing
here has been run in a real QGIS.
"""

import csv
import hashlib
import html
import json
import math
import os
import re
import shutil
import time

from .constants import (OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME, SUBDIR_QA, PLUGIN_NAME, PLUGIN_VERSION,
                        DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_NAME)

FOLDER = "Ensemble"
CSV_FILE = "Class_Probability.csv"
RUNS_CSV = "Class_Probability_Runs.csv"
HTML_FILE = "Class_Probability.html"
RESULT_FILE = "Ensemble_Run_Result.json"
RESULT_VERSION = 1
RUN_JSON = "run.json"
REFERENCE_ID = "_reference"
TILE_CACHE = "_tile_cache"
DEFAULT_MAX_RUNS = 200
MAX_RUNS_LIMIT = 1000
ND_CLASSES = ("High", "Medium", "Low")
TM11_CLASSES = ("High", "Significant", "Low")
OUT_PROBABLE = "Probable loss of life"
OUT_JUDGMENT = "Judgment zone"
MATCH_FT = 30.0                               # same structure in two runs (history.MATCH_FT)
# the runner's file names (nd_breach_runner core/workflow.FINAL_NAMES / BASELINE_NAMES)
RUNNER_NAMES = {"depth": "Depth (Max).tif", "vel": "Velocity (Max).tif",
                "arr": "Arrival Time.tif"}
CAVEAT = ("These probabilities are only as good as the ensemble's parameter distributions: "
          "each is the share of the runs (or of their weights) that gave that class, "
          "nothing more. The ND Dam Breach Runner's default distributions are adjustable "
          "placeholders, not published values - with them the numbers describe the "
          "placeholders, not the dam. The classification rules, the data and the engineer "
          "review decisions are the dam's own; the classes are this plugin's screening "
          "results until the engineer adopts them.")
# what every ensemble run does differently from a normal run (speed, no side effects)
ENSEMBLE_OVERRIDES = {
    "report_pdf": False, "eap": False, "eap_list": False, "eap_mapbook": False,
    "eap_travel": False, "compare_last_run": False, "add_to_project": False,
    "quick_rerun": True, "reuse_evaluation": False, "save_evaluation": False,
    "zone_rasters": False, "sampled_cells": False, "spreadsheets": False,
    "input_overviews": False, "zone_overviews": False, "report_imagery": False,
    "sensitivity": False, "termination": False, "evacuation": False, "evac_routes": False,
    "web_export": False, "temporal_animation": False, "conseq_sensitivity": False,
    "parcel_hints": False, "pop_source": None, "hcom_files": "", "peak_raster": None,
    "settings_profile": None, "ensemble_member": True,
}
# a data-folder role and the download it replaces
ROLE_DOWNLOADS = {"nsi": "download_nsi", "address": "download_address",
                  "usa": "download_usa_structures", "rail": "download_rail",
                  "crossings": "download_crossings", "roads": "download_roads",
                  "bridges": "download_crossings_structures", "dams": "download_dams",
                  "lifelines": "download_lifelines", "camps": "download_camps",
                  "centerline": "download_flowlines"}
_PATH_SETTINGS = ("output_folder", "dam_folder", "review_file", "facility_review_file",
                  "damage_curves_file", "hcom_files", "peak_raster", "local_data",
                  "scenarios", "dam_name", "settings_profile")
RUN_FIELDS = ["Run", "Status", "ND_Class", "TM11_Class", "Lives_In_Jeopardy", "Weight",
              "Governing_Reason", "Judgment_Items", "Gate", "Parameters", "Baseline",
              "Reused", "Seconds", "Message", "Output_Folder"]
CSV_FIELDS = ["Section", "Item", "Runs", "Weight", "Probability", "Run_IDs", "X", "Y", "CRS",
              "Detail"]


def _num(v, default=None):
    try:
        f = float(v)
        return f if math.isfinite(f) else default
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _natural(name):
    return [int(t) if t.isdigit() else t.lower() for t in re.split(r"(\d+)", name)]


# ============================================================== runs ==
RUNNER_RUN_FORMAT = "ndbreach/probabilistic_run"      # nd_breach_runner probabilistic.RUN_FORMAT
RUNNER_INDEX_FORMAT = "ndbreach/probabilistic_runs"   # ... RUNS_INDEX_FORMAT
RUNS_INDEX = "index.json"
STATUS_DONE = "done"
STATUS_NO_BREACH = "no breach"
UNFINISHED = "study not finished (no index.json)"


def _child(folder, name):
    """The sub-folder `name` of `folder`: the exact spelling first, then any case."""
    if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
        return None
    exact = os.path.join(folder, name)
    if os.path.isdir(exact) and name in os.listdir(folder):
        return exact
    hit = sorted(d for d in os.listdir(folder) if d.lower() == name.lower()
                 and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(folder, d)))
    return os.path.join(folder, hit[0]) if hit else None


def resolve_folder(path):
    """The folder holding the run folders: `path` itself, or its Probabilistic/Runs when
    `path` is a dam folder or a Probabilistic folder. "Runs" (the ND Dam Breach Runner from
    3.2.0) wins over the legacy "runs" when both exist."""
    cur = path
    for name in ("Probabilistic", "Runs"):
        hit = _child(cur, name)
        if hit:
            cur = hit
    return cur


def _runner_rasters(folder):
    out = {}
    for key, name in RUNNER_NAMES.items():
        p = os.path.join(folder, name)
        out[key] = p if os.path.isfile(p) else None
        b = os.path.join(folder, "Baseline " + name)
        out["base_" + key] = b if os.path.isfile(b) else None
    out["dv"] = None
    return out


def _runs_table(folder):
    """{run number: row} of Probabilistic_Runs.csv next to (or above) the run folders."""
    for f in (folder, os.path.dirname(folder)):
        p = os.path.join(f, "Probabilistic_Runs.csv")
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            try:
                with open(p, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
                    return {str(int(float(r.get("run")))): r for r in csv.DictReader(fh)
                            if _num(r.get("run")) is not None}
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                return {}
    return {}


_PARAM_SKIP = ("weight", "run", "status", "resumed", "u", "key", "seed", "n_runs")


def _read_json(path):
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
            data = json.load(fh)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
        return None, str(e)
    return (data, "") if isinstance(data, dict) else (None, "not a JSON object")


def read_run_meta(folder):
    """<run>/run.json as a dict ({} when there is none; {"_error": text} when unreadable)."""
    p = os.path.join(folder, RUN_JSON)
    if not os.path.isfile(p):
        return {}
    data, err = _read_json(p)
    return data if data is not None else {"_error": err}


def read_run_json(folder, meta=None):
    """(weight or None, params dict, note) of <run>/run.json. Parameters: the runner's
    "sample" and "parameters", else "params", else the scalar keys."""
    data = read_run_meta(folder) if meta is None else meta
    if not data:
        return None, {}, ""
    if data.get("_error"):
        return None, {}, "run.json not readable ({})".format(data["_error"])
    note = ""
    w = data.get("weight")
    weight = _num(w)
    if w is not None and (weight is None or weight <= 0):
        note = "weight {!r} is not a positive number - ignored".format(w)
        weight = None
    params = {}
    for key in ("params", "sample", "parameters"):
        if isinstance(data.get(key), dict):
            params.update(data[key])
    if not params:
        params = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if isinstance(v, (str, int, float, bool))}
    params = {k: v for k, v in params.items() if k not in _PARAM_SKIP and
              k not in ("format", "format_version", "tool", "created", "dam_id",
                        "weight_note", "baseline_note", "scenario", "arrival_depth_ft") and
              isinstance(v, (str, int, float, bool))}
    return weight, params, note


def _run_baseline(folder, meta):
    """({"base_depth", "base_vel", "base_arr"}, note) from run.json "baseline" (paths
    relative to the run folder); ({}, "") when it names none."""
    refs = meta.get("baseline") if isinstance(meta, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(refs, dict) or not refs:
        return {}, ""
    out, missing = {}, []
    for kind, key in (("depth", "base_depth"), ("velocity", "base_vel"),
                      ("arrival", "base_arr")):
        rel = refs.get(kind)
        if not rel:
            continue
        p = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(folder, str(rel)))
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            out[key] = p
        else:
            missing.append("{} ({})".format(kind, rel))
    if missing:
        note = "run.json baseline not found: {}".format(", ".join(missing))
        if not out.get("base_depth"):
            return {}, note + " - the dam's own baseline is used if it has one"
        return out, note
    return out, ""


def read_index(root):
    """(index dict or None, note) of <Runs>/index.json (the runner writes it when the study
    is finished)."""
    p = os.path.join(root, RUNS_INDEX)
    if not os.path.isfile(p):
        return None, ""
    data, err = _read_json(p)
    if data is None:
        return None, "index.json not readable ({}) - every run folder is used".format(err)
    if data.get("format") not in (None, RUNNER_INDEX_FORMAT) or \
            not isinstance(data.get("runs"), list):
        return None, "index.json is not an ND Dam Breach Runner run index - every run " \
                     "folder is used"
    return data, ""


def find_study(folder, max_runs=DEFAULT_MAX_RUNS):
    """The runs of an ensemble: {"root", "runs", "notes", "index" (path or None),
    "unfinished" (bool: a runner study without index.json)}.

    With Runs/index.json only the run folders it lists are used (in its order); without it
    every sub-folder with a depth raster (name order, run_2 before run_10). A run: {"id",
    "folder", "status" ("done" / "no breach"), "depth", "vel", "arr", "dv", "base_depth",
    "base_vel", "base_arr", "weight", "params", "note"}. A "no breach" run (all-NaN rasters)
    needs no raster. The baseline named in run.json (relative to the run folder) is the
    run's baseline; else Baseline rasters in the run folder."""
    from .autodetect import find_rasters
    notes = []
    root = resolve_folder(folder)
    if not root or not os.path.isdir(root):
        raise ValueError("Ensemble folder not found: {}".format(folder))
    index, inote = read_index(root)
    if inote:
        notes.append(inote)
    table = _runs_table(root)
    all_subs = sorted((d for d in os.listdir(root) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(root, d))
                       and not d.startswith(("_", ".")) and d.lower() != OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME),
                      key=_natural)
    if index is not None:
        listed = []
        for item in index["runs"]:
            name = item.get("folder") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
            if not name and isinstance(item, dict) and _num(item.get("run")) is not None:
                name = "run_{:03d}".format(int(item["run"]))
            if name and name not in listed:
                listed.append(str(name))
        gone = [d for d in listed if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(root, d))]
        extra = [d for d in all_subs if d not in listed]
        subs = [d for d in listed if d not in gone]
        if gone:
            notes.append("{} run folder(s) listed in index.json are missing: {}".format(
                len(gone), ", ".join(gone[:8])))
        if extra:
            notes.append("{} folder(s) not listed in index.json left out (not part of the "
                         "finished study): {}".format(len(extra), ", ".join(extra[:8]) +
                                                      (" ..." if len(extra) > 8 else "")))
        notes.append("Runs: the {} run(s) listed in {}".format(len(listed), RUNS_INDEX))
    else:
        subs = all_subs
    runs, empty = [], []
    runner = False
    for d in subs:
        f = os.path.join(root, d)
        meta = read_run_meta(f)
        if meta.get("format") == RUNNER_RUN_FORMAT:
            runner = True
        status = str(meta.get("status") or STATUS_DONE).strip().lower()
        if status not in (STATUS_DONE, STATUS_NO_BREACH):
            status = STATUS_DONE
        r = _runner_rasters(f)
        if not r.get("depth") and status != STATUS_NO_BREACH:
            try:
                found = find_rasters(f)
            except Exception:               # noqa: BLE001
                found = {}
            r = {k: found.get(k) for k in ("depth", "vel", "arr", "dv", "base_depth",
                                           "base_vel", "base_arr")}
        if not r.get("depth") and status != STATUS_NO_BREACH:
            empty.append(d)
            continue
        weight, params, note = read_run_json(f, meta)
        base, bnote = _run_baseline(f, meta)
        if base:
            for k in ("base_depth", "base_vel", "base_arr"):
                r[k] = base.get(k)
        if bnote:
            note = (note + "; " if note else "") + bnote
        if not params:
            m = re.search(r"(\d+)$", d)
            row = table.get(str(int(m.group(1)))) if m else None
            if row:
                params = {k: row[k] for k in ("width_factor", "time_factor", "n_factor",
                                              "method") if row.get(k) not in (None, "")}
                note = (note + "; " if note else "") + "parameters from Probabilistic_Runs.csv"
        runs.append(dict(r, id=d, folder=f, status=status, weight=weight, params=params,
                         note=note, baseline_from_run=bool(base)))
    if empty:
        notes.append("{} sub-folder(s) without a depth raster left out: {}".format(
            len(empty), ", ".join(empty[:8]) + (" ..." if len(empty) > 8 else "")))
    unfinished = index is None and (runner or os.path.basename(
        os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(root))).lower() == "probabilistic")
    if unfinished:
        notes.append("{}: the runner writes Runs/index.json when the study has finished; "
                     "these are the run folders there now, with provisional weights".format(
                         UNFINISHED[0].upper() + UNFINISHED[1:]))
    if max_runs and len(runs) > int(max_runs):
        notes.append("{} runs found; the first {} ({} order) are used (MAX_RUNS)".format(
            len(runs), int(max_runs), "index" if index is not None else "name"))
        runs = runs[:int(max_runs)]
    return {"root": root, "runs": runs, "notes": notes,
            "index": os.path.join(root, RUNS_INDEX) if index is not None else None,
            "unfinished": unfinished}


def find_runs(folder, max_runs=DEFAULT_MAX_RUNS):
    """(runs, notes) of find_study."""
    st = find_study(folder, max_runs)
    return st["runs"], st["notes"]


# ========================================================== settings ==
def _qa(dam_folder):
    return os.path.join(dam_folder, OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME, SUBDIR_QA)


def _reopen(rec):
    """A layer of a Run_Settings.json layer record, or None (not a file / gone)."""
    from . import reproduce as REP
    if not isinstance(rec, dict) or not rec.get("path") or not os.path.exists(rec["path"]):
        return None
    try:
        return REP._make_layer(rec.get("kind") or "vector", rec.get("source") or rec["path"],
                               rec.get("name"), rec.get("provider"))
    except Exception:                       # noqa: BLE001
        return None


def dam_settings(dam_folder, base_cfg=None, config_json=None, downloads=False):
    """(kw, info): the pipeline settings every ensemble run starts from, and
    {"record", "notes", "baseline" (dict or None), "dam_scenario" (dict or None),
    "local" (bool: the dam's data files are used), "downloads" (bool)}."""
    from . import pipeline as PL
    from . import reproduce as REP
    notes = []
    info = {"record": None, "notes": notes, "baseline": None, "dam_scenario": None,
            "local": False, "downloads": bool(downloads), "created": ""}
    rec = None
    rpath = os.path.join(_qa(dam_folder), REP.RUN_SETTINGS_FILE)
    if os.path.isfile(rpath):
        try:
            rec = REP.read_run_settings(rpath)
            info["record"] = rpath
            info["created"] = str(rec.get("created") or "")
        except ValueError as e:
            notes.append("QA/Run_Settings.json not used: {}".format(e))
    kw = {}
    if base_cfg is not None:
        kw = {k: v for k, v in dict(base_cfg).items() if k not in _PATH_SETTINGS}
        kw["local_data"] = dict((base_cfg or {}).get("local_data") or {})
        notes.append("Settings: handed in by the caller (the current settings)")
    elif rec is not None:
        for k, v in (rec.get("settings") or {}).items():
            if k in PL.DEFAULTS and k not in _PATH_SETTINGS:
                kw[k] = v
        for k, lrec in (rec.get("layers") or {}).items():
            if k not in PL.DEFAULTS:
                continue
            lyr = _reopen(lrec)
            kw[k] = lyr
            if lyr is None:
                notes.append("Layer {} ('{}') of the dam's run is not a file that still "
                             "exists - left out of the ensemble runs".format(
                                 k, lrec.get("name") if isinstance(lrec, dict) else ""))
        ps = rec.get("point_sources")
        if isinstance(ps, list):
            kw["point_sources"] = []
            for item in ps:
                lyr = _reopen((item or {}).get("layer"))
                if lyr is None:
                    notes.append("Point layer {} of the dam's run is not available - left "
                                 "out".format((item or {}).get("family")))
                else:
                    kw["point_sources"].append(((item or {}).get("family"), lyr))
        notes.append("Settings: the dam's last run (QA/Run_Settings.json of {})".format(
            rec.get("created") or "?"))
    else:
        notes.append("Settings: plugin defaults - the dam has no QA/Run_Settings.json (no run "
                     "with plugin 2.9 or later); classify the dam first for its own settings")
    if rec is not None:
        scen = rec.get("scenarios") or []
        br = next((s for s in scen if (s.get("role") or "breach") == "breach"), None)
        info["dam_scenario"] = br
        if br and br.get("baseline"):
            info["baseline"] = next((s for s in scen if s.get("name") == br.get("baseline")),
                                    None)
        # the data files the dam's run read, as a data folder for every run
        local = dict(kw.get("local_data") or {})
        multi = []
        for role, spec in (rec.get("inputs") or {}).items():
            if role in local:
                continue
            items = spec if isinstance(spec, list) else [spec]
            keep = []
            for it in items:
                pth = it[0] if isinstance(it, list) else it
                if pth and os.path.exists(REP.split_source(pth)[0]):
                    keep.append(it)
            if not keep:
                notes.append("Data '{}' the dam's run read is gone - not used".format(role))
                continue
            if role == "lifelines":
                local[role] = [it if isinstance(it, list) else [it, None] for it in keep]
            else:
                one = keep[0][0] if isinstance(keep[0], list) else keep[0]
                local[role] = one
                if len(keep) > 1:
                    multi.append("{} ({} files, the first used)".format(role, len(keep)))
        if multi:
            notes.append("Data read from several files by the dam's run and handed over as "
                         "one: {} - e.g. road traffic counts can differ from the dam's own "
                         "run (see the reference run)".format(", ".join(multi)))
        kw["local_data"] = local
        info["local"] = bool(local)
        if local:
            notes.append("Data: the {} data set(s) the dam's run read (run of {}) - not "
                         "downloaded again: {}".format(len(local), info["created"] or "?",
                                                      ", ".join(sorted(local))))
    # the dam's building-outline file
    osm = kw.get("osm_layer", "auto")
    if isinstance(osm, str) and osm == "auto":
        try:
            from .osm_processing import get_osm_candidates
            lyr = get_osm_candidates(os.path.join(dam_folder, OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME), dam_folder)
        except Exception:                   # noqa: BLE001
            lyr = None
        kw["osm_layer"] = lyr
        if lyr is not None:
            src = lyr.source().split("|")[0]
            notes.append("Building outlines: {}".format(os.path.basename(src) or lyr.name()))
            loc = kw.get("local_data") or {}
            if isinstance(loc.get("usa"), str) and os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(
                    REP.split_source(loc["usa"])[0])) == os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(src)):
                loc.pop("usa")                # the same file: not twice
    if config_json:
        from .processing_provider import _read_worker_file
        extra, ignored, _res = _read_worker_file(config_json)
        kw.update(extra)
        notes.append("Settings file {}: {} setting(s){}".format(
            os.path.basename(config_json), len(extra),
            "; ignored: " + ", ".join(ignored) if ignored else ""))
    # downloads
    local = kw.get("local_data") or {}
    if not downloads:
        for k in [k for k in PL.DEFAULTS if k.startswith("download_")]:
            kw[k] = False
        if not local and rec is None:
            notes.append("Downloads are OFF and the dam has no record of its data: only "
                         "project layers and the FEMA_Structures file are used - allow "
                         "downloads, or classify the dam first")
        else:
            notes.append("Downloads: off (every run reads the same data)")
    else:
        for role, key in ROLE_DOWNLOADS.items():
            if role in local:
                kw[key] = False
        notes.append("Downloads: allowed for what the dam's data files do not cover - one "
                     "shared tile cache, the first run's downloads copied to the others")
    kw.update(ENSEMBLE_OVERRIDES)
    return kw, info


def _review_files(dam_folder, kw):
    """The dam's engineer review decisions (structures, roads / facilities) for every run."""
    from . import review as RV
    from . import facility_review as FR
    out = os.path.join(dam_folder, OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME)
    got = {}
    for key, fn in (("review_file", RV.review_path), ("facility_review_file", FR.review_path)):
        p = fn(out)
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            got[key] = p
    return got


def run_config(base_kw, run, out_folder, dam_name, baseline=None, reviews=None):
    """Pipeline config keywords of one run (Scenario objects; the run's own baseline
    rasters, else the dam's baseline scenario)."""
    from .scenarios import Scenario, ROLE_BASELINE
    kw = dict(base_kw)
    kw["local_data"] = dict(base_kw.get("local_data") or {})
    kw["point_sources"] = list(base_kw["point_sources"]) \
        if isinstance(base_kw.get("point_sources"), list) else base_kw.get("point_sources",
                                                                            "auto")
    base_name = None
    scen = []
    if run.get("base_depth"):
        base_name = "No breach"
        scen.append(Scenario(base_name, run["base_depth"], run.get("base_vel"),
                             run.get("base_arr"), role=ROLE_BASELINE))
        base_note = "the run's own"
    elif baseline and baseline.get("depth") and os.path.isfile(baseline["depth"]):
        base_name = baseline.get("name") or "No breach"
        scen.append(Scenario(base_name, baseline["depth"], baseline.get("velocity"),
                             baseline.get("arrival"), dv=baseline.get("dv"),
                             role=ROLE_BASELINE))
        base_note = "the dam's ({})".format(os.path.basename(baseline["depth"]))
    else:
        base_note = ""
    scen.insert(0, Scenario("Breach", run["depth"], run.get("vel"), run.get("arr"),
                            dv=run.get("dv"), baseline=base_name))
    kw.update({"scenarios": scen, "output_folder": out_folder, "dam_folder": out_folder,
               "dam_name": "{} - {}".format(dam_name, run["id"])})
    if not run.get("vel") and not kw.get("one_d"):
        kw["one_d"] = True                      # as the batch: no velocity -> 1D criterion
    kw.update(reviews or {})
    return kw, base_note


# =========================================================== one run ==
def run_key(kw):
    """Key of a run's inputs: its rasters (path, size, time, content digest), the settings
    and the data, the plugin version."""
    from . import pipeline as PL
    from .processing_provider import worker_settings
    parts = {"plugin": PLUGIN_VERSION, "v": RESULT_VERSION,
             "scenarios": [[s.name, s.role, s.baseline] + [
                 PL._file_sig(p) for p in (s.depth, s.velocity, s.arrival, s.dv) if p]
                 for s in kw.get("scenarios") or []],
             "settings": sorted((k, repr(v)) for k, v in worker_settings(kw).items()
                                if k not in ("dam_name",)),
             "local": PL._local_data_sig(kw.get("local_data")),
             "layers": [[k, PL._layer_sig(kw.get(k))] for k in sorted(kw)
                        if k.endswith("_layer") and kw.get(k) is not None],
             "files": [[k, PL._file_sig(kw[k])] for k in ("review_file",
                                                        "facility_review_file")
                       if kw.get(k) and os.path.isfile(kw[k])]}
    try:
        blob = json.dumps(parts, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        blob = repr(parts)
    return hashlib.sha256(blob.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _rec_point(rec):
    from . import history as HIS
    return HIS._point(rec)


def extract_result(res):
    """JSON-ready result of a pipeline run: classes, lives in jeopardy, and the wet
    structures (not 'not habitable') of the governing scenario as classified (with a
    baseline: the incremental view)."""
    from .constants import ZONE_LABELS
    nd, tm = res.get("nd") or {}, res.get("tm11") or {}
    gov = (res.get("results") or {}).get(res.get("governing")) or {}
    views = gov.get("views")
    structs = views[0] if views else (res.get("structs") or [])
    crs = res.get("crs")
    out = []
    for s in structs:
        if s.get("habitable") == "No" or s.get("outcome") in (None, "Not inundated"):
            continue
        pt = _rec_point(s)
        if pt is None:
            continue
        out.append({"x": round(pt[0], 3), "y": round(pt[1], 3), "id": s.get("id"),
                    "outcome": s.get("outcome") or "", "habitable": s.get("habitable") or "",
                    "zone": ZONE_LABELS.get(s.get("zone"), "") if s.get("zone") else "",
                    "persons": _num(s.get("persons"), 0.0),
                    "depth": None if s.get("max_depth") is None else round(float(
                        s["max_depth"]), 2),
                    "category": s.get("fema_category") or s.get("category") or ""})
    try:
        lij = float(tm.get("lij") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        lij = 0.0
    return {"nd": nd.get("cls") or "", "tm11": tm.get("cls") or "", "lij": round(lij, 2),
            "reason": (list(nd.get("reasons") or []) or [""])[0][:250],
            "judgment_items": len(nd.get("judgment") or []),
            "crs": (crs.authid() or crs.toWkt()) if crs is not None else "",
            "structures": out}


def _result_path(out):
    return os.path.join(out, RESULT_FILE)


def load_result(out, key):
    try:
        with open(_result_path(out), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            data = json.load(fh)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("version") != RESULT_VERSION or \
            data.get("key") != key:
        return None
    return data


def save_result(out, key, data):
    data = dict(data, version=RESULT_VERSION, key=key,
                time=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = _result_path(out) + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(data, fh, indent=1)
    os.replace(tmp, _result_path(out))
    return data


def _seed_downloads(src_outs, dst_out):
    """Copy the downloaded data files of earlier runs (and of the dam's own run) into a
    run's outputs/_downloads: a file of the same study area and day is read, not fetched."""
    dst = os.path.join(dst_out, DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_NAME)
    today = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    n = 0
    for src_out in src_outs:
        src = os.path.join(src_out, DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_NAME)
        if not os.path.isdir(src):
            continue
        for f in os.listdir(src):
            if today not in f or not f.lower().endswith(".geojson"):
                continue
            target = os.path.join(dst, f)
            if os.path.exists(target):
                continue
            try:
                os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copy2(os.path.join(src, f), target)
                n += 1
            except OSError:
                continue
    return n


def classify_run(run, kw, resume=True, gate=False, dam_folder=None, progress=None,
                 log=None):
    """Classify one run (or re-use its saved result). Returns the saved result dict with
    "status" ("done" / "failed"), "reused", "seconds", "message", "gate"."""
    from . import pipeline as PL
    from .helpers import CancelledByUser
    out = kw["output_folder"]
    key = run_key(kw)
    if resume:
        old = load_result(out, key)
        if old is not None and old.get("status") == "done":
            old["reused"] = True
            return old
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    data = {"status": "failed", "reused": False, "message": "", "gate": ""}
    try:
        os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
        if gate:
            from . import modelgate as MG
            try:
                g = MG.gate({"depth": run["depth"], "vel": run.get("vel"),
                             "arr": run.get("arr"), "dv": run.get("dv"),
                             "base_depth": run.get("base_depth"), "dam_folder": dam_folder,
                             "output_folder": out}, write=True)
                data["gate"] = g["status"]
            except CancelledByUser:
                raise
            except Exception as e:          # noqa: BLE001 - the gate is an extra
                data["gate"] = "not run ({})".format(e)
        res = PL.run_classification(PL.config(**kw), progress=progress, log=log)
        data.update(extract_result(res))
        data["status"] = "done"
    except CancelledByUser:
        raise
    except Exception as e:                  # noqa: BLE001 - one run never stops the study
        data["message"] = str(e)[:300]
    finally:
        PL.forget_evaluation(out)           # the cache would keep every run's inventory
    data["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1)
    saved = save_result(out, key, data)
    saved["reused"] = False
    return saved


# ======================================================= aggregation ==
def _weights(runs_ok):
    """(weights list, weighted?, note)."""
    ws = [_num(r.get("weight")) for r in runs_ok]
    if runs_ok and all(w is not None and w > 0 for w in ws):
        return ws, True, "weighted by the runs' weights (run.json)"
    have = sum(1 for w in ws if w is not None and w > 0)
    note = "unweighted (every run counts once)"
    if have:
        note += " - only {} of {} runs have a weight; weights are used only when every " \
                "run has one".format(have, len(runs_ok))
    return [1.0] * len(runs_ok), False, note


NO_BREACH_ITEM = "No breach"
NOT_CLASSIFIED = "no breach - not classified"


def aggregate(items, match_units=MATCH_FT, no_breach_class=None):
    """Class distribution of an ensemble. items: [{"id", "weight", "status", "nd", "tm11",
    "lij", "structures": [...], ...}] - the classified runs (status "done") and the runs in
    which the dam did not fail (status "no breach"). Pure data.

    Presentation: every probability is over ALL these runs (their weight). The breach runs
    give P(High) / P(Medium) / P(Low); the no-breach runs are their own line "No breach"
    (P = the share of runs without a failure), so the class probabilities add up to 1 -
    P(no breach) and are never silently conditioned on a breach. Each class also carries
    "p_breach" = P(class | the dam fails). The class of the no-breach case (the no-breach
    flood classified on its own, when the dam has one: `no_breach_class` {"nd", "tm11",
    "basis"}) is reported beside that line, not added to a class.

    Returns {"n", "n_breach", "weighted", "weight_note", "total_weight", "breach_weight",
    "nd": {cls: {"runs", "weight", "p", "p_breach", "ids"}}, "tm11": ..., "no_breach":
    {"runs", "weight", "p", "ids", "nd", "tm11", "basis"}, "structures": [...],
    "lij": {"min", "mean", "max"}} (lives in jeopardy over the breach runs)."""
    ws, weighted, note = _weights(items)
    tot = sum(ws) or 1.0
    nb = [(it, w) for it, w in zip(items, ws) if it.get("status") == STATUS_NO_BREACH]
```
