```python
    @staticmethod
    def _spin290(lo, hi, step, key, suffix):
        s = QDoubleSpinBox()
        s.setRange(lo, hi)
        s.setSingleStep(step)
        s.setDecimals(2)
        s.setValue(float(_default(key)))
        s.setSuffix(suffix)
        return s

    def _update_enabled290(self, *args):
        """Options that depend on a tick box are greyed out without it (their
        values are still saved and read)."""
        def on(name):
            w = self.__dict__.get(name)
            return bool(w.isChecked()) if isinstance(w, QCheckBox) else None

        def group(flag, names):
            state = on(flag)
            if state is None:
                return
            for n in names:
                w = self.__dict__.get(n)
                if w is not None:
                    w.setEnabled(state)
        group("mobile_shape_check", ("mobile_max_width_spin", "mobile_min_ratio_spin",
                                     "mobile_min_length_spin", "mobile_max_length_spin"))
        group("conseq_sens_check", ("conseq_warning_edit", "conseq_ppd_edit",
                                    "conseq_pop_check", "conseq_severity_check"))
        group("temporal_check", ("temporal_start_edit", "temporal_step_spin"))
        group("parcel_hints_check", ("parcel_landuse_combo", "parcel_improvement_combo",
                                     "parcel_ref_combo", "parcel_vacant_kw_edit",
                                     "parcel_nonres_kw_edit", "parcel_res_kw_edit",
                                     "parcel_empty_zero_check"))

    # ------------------------------------------------------ parcel fields --
    def _widget290(self, name, cls):
        """The widget `name` when it is built (the host may be a QWidget whose
        unknown attributes answer with a no-op object)."""
        w = self.__dict__.get(name)
        return w if isinstance(w, cls) else None

    def _parcel_layer290(self):
        """The parcel layer chosen in the dialog (auto-detect: the first project
        polygon layer whose name has 'parcel'); None when none / downloaded."""
        combo = self._widget290("parcel_combo", QComboBox)
        if combo is None:
            return None
        from .classify_tab import _AUTO, _NONE, _DOWNLOAD, _PARCEL_RE, _PARCEL_EXCLUDE
        from .processing import is_plugin_output_name, is_downloaded_data_layer
        data = combo.currentData()
        folder_lyr = self._folder_parcels290(data)
        if folder_lyr is not None:
            return folder_lyr
        if data in (None, _NONE, _DOWNLOAD):
            return None
        project = QgsProject.instance()
        if data != _AUTO:
            lyr = project.mapLayer(data)
            return lyr if isinstance(lyr, QgsVectorLayer) else None
        for lyr in project.mapLayers().values():
            try:
                if (isinstance(lyr, QgsVectorLayer) and lyr.isValid()
                        and lyr.geometryType() == GEOM_POLYGON and _PARCEL_RE.search(lyr.name())
                        and not _PARCEL_EXCLUDE.search(lyr.name())
                        and not is_plugin_output_name(lyr.name())
                        and not is_downloaded_data_layer(lyr)):
                    return lyr
            except Exception:
                continue
        return None

    def _folder_parcels290(self, data):
        """The data folder's parcel layer when the run will use it (the parcel
        list holds no layer picked by hand) - the same rule as
        _local_data_for_run. Opened once per file (read-only)."""
        from .classify_tab import _AUTO, _NONE, _DOWNLOAD
        if data not in (None, _NONE, _AUTO, _DOWNLOAD):
            return None
        getter = getattr(self, "_local_data_for_run", None)
        if getter is None:
            return None
        try:
            uri = (getter() or {}).get("parcels")
        except Exception:                                    # noqa
            return None
        if not uri or not isinstance(uri, str):
            return None
        cached = self.__dict__.get("_folder_parcels_cache290")
        if cached and cached[0] == uri:
            return cached[1]
        from . import datafolder as DF
        lyr = DF.open_uri(uri)
        self._folder_parcels_cache290 = (uri, lyr)
        return lyr

    def _refresh_parcel_fields290(self, *args):
        """Refill the three parcel field pickers from the parcel layer chosen in
        the dialog. A choice stays when the field still exists; for a NEW layer
        the field names are only SUGGESTED (parcelhints.suggest_fields) - the
        engineer confirms. Safe to call before the widgets are built."""
        from . import parcelhints as PH
        specs = (("landuse", "parcel_landuse_combo"),
                 ("improvement", "parcel_improvement_combo"),
                 ("ref", "parcel_ref_combo"))
        combos = [(role, self._widget290(name, QComboBox)) for role, name in specs]
        if any(c is None for _r, c in combos):
            return
        try:
            lyr = self._parcel_layer290()
        except Exception as e:                               # noqa
            log_message("Parcel layer not read: {}".format(e), MSG_WARNING)
            lyr = None
        key = lyr.id() if lyr is not None else None
        try:
            names = [f.name() for f in lyr.fields()] if lyr is not None else []
        except Exception:
            names = []
        sug = PH.suggest_fields(lyr) if lyr is not None else {}
        new_layer = key != self.__dict__.get("_parcel_key290", "\0unset")
        for role, combo in combos:
            prev = combo.currentData() or ""
            combo.blockSignals(True)
            try:
                combo.clear()
                combo.addItem("(none)", "")
                for n in names:
                    combo.addItem(n, n)
                if prev in names:
                    pick = prev                               # the engineer's choice stays
                elif new_layer and sug.get(role):
                    pick = sug[role][0]                       # a new layer: suggest
                else:
                    pick = ""
                idx = combo.findData(pick)
                if idx >= 0:
                    combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            finally:
                combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._parcel_key290 = key

    def _restore_parcel_fields290(self, state):
        """After a settings state / profile was applied: refill the parcel field
        pickers and select the saved fields that exist in the layer."""
        self._refresh_parcel_fields290()
        for name in ("parcel_landuse_combo", "parcel_improvement_combo", "parcel_ref_combo"):
            combo = self._widget290(name, QComboBox)
            if combo is not None and name in (state or {}):
                idx = combo.findData(state[name] or "")
                if idx >= 0:
                    combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ cfg keys --
    def _extras290_config(self):
        """The v2.9 keys of the classification cfg (proper types)."""
        return {
            "mobile_shape": bool(self.mobile_shape_check.isChecked()),
            "mobile_max_width_ft": float(self.mobile_max_width_spin.value()),
            "mobile_min_ratio": float(self.mobile_min_ratio_spin.value()),
            "mobile_min_length_ft": float(self.mobile_min_length_spin.value()),
            "mobile_max_length_ft": float(self.mobile_max_length_spin.value()),
            "mobile_lot_units": bool(self.mobile_lot_check.isChecked()),
            "download_trailer_parks": bool(self.trailer_parks_check.isChecked()),
            "fast_sampling": bool(self.fast_sampling_check.isChecked()),
            "input_overviews": bool(self.input_overviews_check.isChecked()),
            "zone_overviews": bool(self.zone_overviews_check.isChecked()),
            "report_imagery": bool(self.report_imagery_check.isChecked()),
            "conseq_sensitivity": bool(self.conseq_sens_check.isChecked()),
            "conseq_sens_warning_hr": self.conseq_warning_edit.text().strip(),
            "conseq_sens_ppd": self.conseq_ppd_edit.text().strip(),
            "conseq_sens_population": bool(self.conseq_pop_check.isChecked()),
            "conseq_sens_severity": bool(self.conseq_severity_check.isChecked()),
            "evac_routes": bool(self.evac_routes_check.isChecked()),
            "temporal_animation": bool(self.temporal_check.isChecked()),
            "temporal_breach_start": self.temporal_start_edit.text().strip(),
            "temporal_step_min": int(self.temporal_step_spin.value()),
            "web_export": bool(self.web_export_check.isChecked()),
            "parcel_hints": bool(self.parcel_hints_check.isChecked()),
            "parcel_landuse_field": self.parcel_landuse_combo.currentData() or "",
            "parcel_improvement_field": self.parcel_improvement_combo.currentData() or "",
            "parcel_ref_field": self.parcel_ref_combo.currentData() or "",
            "parcel_hint_vacant_keywords": self.parcel_vacant_kw_edit.text().strip(),
            "parcel_hint_nonres_keywords": self.parcel_nonres_kw_edit.text().strip(),
            "parcel_hint_res_keywords": self.parcel_res_kw_edit.text().strip(),
            "parcel_hint_empty_is_zero": bool(self.parcel_empty_zero_check.isChecked()),
        }

    def _extras290_problems(self):
        """Problems with the v2.9 choices (for validate_all_inputs). Options are
        only checked while their tick box is on."""
        problems = []
        if self.mobile_shape_check.isChecked():
            if self.mobile_min_length_spin.value() > self.mobile_max_length_spin.value():
                problems.append("Mobile homes: the shortest length ({:g} ft) is longer than "
                                "the longest ({:g} ft)".format(
                                    self.mobile_min_length_spin.value(),
                                    self.mobile_max_length_spin.value()))
        if self.conseq_sens_check.isChecked():
            for label, edit, positive in (
                    ("warning time shifts", self.conseq_warning_edit, False),
                    ("persons per dwelling", self.conseq_ppd_edit, True)):
                good, bad = _number_tokens(edit.text())
                if bad:
                    problems.append("Consequence sensitivity: '{}' in the {} is not a "
                                    "number (use numbers separated by commas)".format(
                                        bad[0], label))
                elif positive and good and not any(v > 0 for v in good):
                    problems.append("Consequence sensitivity: the {} need at least one "
                                    "number above 0".format(label))
        if self.temporal_check.isChecked():
            txt = self.temporal_start_edit.text().strip()
            if txt and parse_start_time(txt) is None:
                problems.append("Animation clock start '{}' is not in the form YYYY-MM-DD "
                                "HH:MM (leave it empty for the nominal start)".format(txt))
        if self.parcel_hints_check.isChecked():
            if self._parcel_layer290() is None:
                problems.append("Parcel hints: choose a parcel layer (Data tab, parcels for "
                                "the future-development screening)")
            elif not (self.parcel_landuse_combo.currentData() or
                      self.parcel_improvement_combo.currentData()):
                problems.append("Parcel hints: choose a land-use field or an improvement "
                                "value field")
        return problems

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- utilities --
    def _say290(self, msg):
        try:
            self._log(msg)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _status290(self, msg, ok=True):
        try:
            self._update_status(msg, ok)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _text290(self, name):
        try:
            v = getattr(self, name)
        except Exception:
            return ""
        return v if isinstance(v, str) else ""

    def _start_dir290(self):
        return (self.__dict__.get("_tools_dir290") or self._text290("config_dam_folder") or
                self._text290("config_output_folder") or os.path.expanduser("~"))

    def _remember_dir290(self, path):
        try:
            folder = path if os.path.isdir(path) else os.path.dirname(path)
            if folder:
                self._tools_dir290 = folder
        except Exception:
            pass

    @staticmethod
    def _layer_ids290():
        try:
            return list(QgsProject.instance().mapLayers().keys())
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _open_file290(self, path):
        from qgis.PyQt.QtCore import QUrl
        from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QDesktopServices
        if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
            return False
        return bool(QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(path)))

    def _outputs_folder290(self, title):
        out = self._text290("config_output_folder")
        if not out or not os.path.isdir(out):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, title, "There is no outputs folder yet - run the "
                                "classification first (the values are read from its files).")
            return ""
        return out

    def _busy290(self):
        return bool(self.__dict__.get("_busy", False))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ estimate --
    @_guarded("Estimate run")
    def _on_estimate290(self):
        """Pre-run estimate (estimate.py): no downloads, about a second, so on
        the main thread."""
        if self._busy290():
            return
        from . import estimate as EST
        try:
            cfg = self._classification_config(QgsProject.instance().transformContext())
        except Exception as e:
            log_message(traceback.format_exc(), MSG_WARNING)
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Estimate run", "The settings are not complete enough "
                                "for an estimate yet:\n{}".format(e))
            return
        est = EST.estimate_for_cfg(cfg)
        lines = [str(x) for x in EST.estimate_lines(est)]
        for line in lines:
            self._say290(">>> " + line)
        show = QMessageBox.information if est.get("ok", True) else QMessageBox.warning
        text = "\n".join(lines[:30])
        if len(lines) > 30:
            text += "\n... (all {} lines are in the log)".format(len(lines))
        show(self, "Estimate run", text)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ profiles --
    @_guarded("Settings profile")
    def _on_profile_save290(self):
        if self._busy290():
            return
        from . import settings as ST
        start = os.path.join(self._start_dir290(), "settings" + ST.PROFILE_EXT)
        path, _f = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self, "Save settings profile", start, "Settings profile (*{})".format(ST.PROFILE_EXT))
        if not path:
            return
        if not path.lower().endswith(ST.PROFILE_EXT):
            if path.lower().endswith(".json"):
                path = path[:-5]
            path += ST.PROFILE_EXT
        default = os.path.basename(path)[:-len(ST.PROFILE_EXT)] or "settings"
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(self, "Settings profile", "Name of the profile:",
                                        text=default)
        if not ok or not str(name).strip():
            return
        note, ok2 = QInputDialog.getText(self, "Settings profile",
                                         "Note (optional - what these settings are for):")
        note = str(note).strip() if ok2 else ""
        try:
            meta = ST.save_profile(path, self._current_state(), str(name).strip(), note,
                                   layer_ids=self._layer_ids290())
        except (ST.ProfileError, OSError) as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Settings profile", "The profile was not saved:\n{}"
                                .format(e))
            return
        self._remember_dir290(path)
        self._say290(">>> Settings profile saved: '{}' ({} settings, sha256 {}) - {}".format(
            meta["name"], meta["keys"], meta["sha256"][:16], meta["path"]))
        if meta["excluded_keys"]:
            self._say290(">>> Left out of the profile (they belong to one dam or project): "
                         + ", ".join(meta["excluded_keys"]))
        self._status290("Settings profile saved: {}".format(os.path.basename(path)), True)

    @_guarded("Settings profile")
    def _on_profile_load290(self):
        if self._busy290():
            return
        from . import settings as ST
        path, _f = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Load settings profile", self._start_dir290(),
            "Settings profile (*{});;JSON (*.json)".format(ST.PROFILE_EXT))
        if not path:
            return
        known = list(self._SETTING_WIDGETS) + ["scenario_rows", "main_baseline"]
        ids = self._layer_ids290()
        try:
            state, meta = ST.load_profile(path, known_keys=known, layer_ids=ids)
        except ST.ProfileError as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Settings profile", str(e))
            return
        self._apply_state(state)
        self._restore_parcel_fields290(state)
        self._remember_dir290(path)
        self._profile_state290 = state
        self._profile_meta290 = meta
        try:
            self._profile_status = ST.profile_status(self._current_state(), state, meta, ids)
        except Exception as e:                               # noqa
            log_message("Profile status: {}".format(e), MSG_WARNING)
            self._profile_status = None
        self._say290(">>> Settings profile loaded: '{}' ({} settings, sha256 {})".format(
            meta["name"], meta["keys"], meta["sha256"][:16]))
        for w in meta.get("warnings") or []:
            self._say290(">>> Profile note: " + w)
        if meta.get("dropped_keys"):
            self._say290(">>> Profile entries left out: " + ", ".join(
                "{} ({})".format(k, v) for k, v in sorted(meta["dropped_keys"].items())))
        text = "Loaded '{}': {} setting(s) applied.".format(meta["name"] or "?", meta["keys"])
        if meta.get("note"):
            text += "\n\nNote of the profile: {}".format(meta["note"])
        if meta.get("warnings"):
            text += "\n\n" + "\n".join("- " + w for w in meta["warnings"])
        (QMessageBox.warning if meta.get("warnings") else QMessageBox.information)(
            self, "Settings profile", text)
        self._status290("Settings profile loaded: {}".format(meta["name"] or
                                                              os.path.basename(path)), True)

    def _settings_profile_for_cfg(self):
        """dict for cfg["settings_profile"] - the loaded profile (name, sha256,
        modified, changed_keys, path), re-checked against the dialog's settings
        NOW; None when no profile was loaded."""
        state = self.__dict__.get("_profile_state290")
        meta = self.__dict__.get("_profile_meta290")
        if state is None:
            return self.__dict__.get("_profile_status") or None
        try:
            from . import settings as ST
            self._profile_status = ST.profile_status(self._current_state(), state, meta,
                                                     self._layer_ids290())
        except Exception as e:                               # noqa
            log_message("Profile status: {}".format(e), MSG_WARNING)
        return self.__dict__.get("_profile_status") or None

    @_guarded("Compare profiles")
    def _on_profile_compare290(self):
        if self._busy290():
            return
        from . import settings as ST
        paths = []
        for n, what in enumerate(("first", "second")):
            p, _f = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
                self, "Compare profiles - choose the {} profile".format(what),
                self._start_dir290(), "Settings profile (*{});;JSON (*.json)".format(
                    ST.PROFILE_EXT))
            if not p:
                return
            paths.append(p)
        try:
            lines = ST.diff_lines(paths[0], paths[1])
        except ST.ProfileError as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Compare profiles", str(e))
            return
        self._remember_dir290(paths[1])
        head = "{}  <->  {}".format(os.path.basename(paths[0]), os.path.basename(paths[1]))
        self._say290(">>> Profile comparison: " + head)
        for line in lines:
            self._say290("    " + line)
        if not lines:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Compare profiles",
                                    head + "\n\nThe two profiles hold the same settings.")
        else:
            more = "\n... (all {} in the log)".format(len(lines)) if len(lines) > 40 else ""
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Compare profiles", "{}\n\n{} setting(s) differ (first -> second):\n{}{}"
                .format(head, len(lines), "\n".join(lines[:40]), more))

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- reproduce --
    @_guarded("Reproduce a package")
    def _on_reproduce290(self):
        if self._busy290():
            return
        from . import reproduce as REP
        title = "Reproduce a package"
        kind = QMessageBox.question(
            self, title, "Is the submittal package a .zip file?\n\nYes = choose the .zip file\n"
            "No = choose the package folder", MB_YES | MB_NO | MB_CANCEL)
        if kind == MB_CANCEL:
            return
        if kind == MB_YES:
            package, _f = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
                self, "Submittal package (.zip)", self._start_dir290(), "Zip (*.zip)")
        else:
            package = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Submittal package folder",
                                                       self._start_dir290())
        if not package:
            return
        work = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self, "EMPTY work folder for the reproduction", os.path.dirname(package.rstrip("/\\"))
            or self._start_dir290())
        if not work:
            return
        if os.path.isdir(work) and os.listdir(work) and not os.path.isfile(
                os.path.join(work, REP.WORK_MARKER)):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, title, "The work folder is not empty:\n{}\n\nChoose an "
                                "empty (or new) folder - the reproduction writes there and "
                                "must never touch a dam's real outputs.".format(work))
            return
        rasters = None
        if QMessageBox.question(
                self, title, "Read the scenario rasters from another folder?\n\nOnly needed "
                "when the package does not hold them (the folder is searched by file name).",
                MB_YES | MB_NO) == MB_YES:
            rasters = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Folder with the rasters",
                                                       self._start_dir290()) or None
        self._remember_dir290(package)
        self._say290(">>> Reproducing {} in {}".format(package, work))

        def job(progress, log):
            return REP.reproduce(package, work, progress=progress, log=log,
                                 rasters_folder=rasters)

        def done(outcome):
            if outcome.cancelled:
                self._status290("Reproduction cancelled", False)
                return
            if outcome.error is not None:
                self._say290(outcome.traceback)
                log_message(outcome.traceback, MSG_CRITICAL)
                self._status290("Reproduction FAILED: {}".format(outcome.error), False)
                QMessageBox.critical(self, title, str(outcome.error))
                return
            res = outcome.result or {}
            lines = [str(x) for x in (res.get("lines") or [])]
            status = res.get("status") or "?"
            for line in lines:
                self._say290(">>> " + line)
            self._status290("Reproduction: {}".format(status), bool(res.get("identical")))
            (QMessageBox.information if res.get("identical") else QMessageBox.warning)(
                self, title, "Result: {}\n\n{}".format(status, "\n".join(lines[:30])))
        self._start_background("Reproducing the package...", job, done, project_bound=False)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- portfolio --
    @_guarded("Portfolio dashboard")
    def _on_portfolio290(self):
        if self._busy290():
            return
        from . import portfolio as PF
        title = "Portfolio dashboard"
        dam = self._text290("config_dam_folder").rstrip("/\\")
        start = os.path.dirname(dam) if dam else self._start_dir290()
        parent = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Folder containing the dam folders",
                                                  start or "")
        if not parent:
            return
        self._remember_dir290(parent)
        self._say290(">>> Portfolio dashboard: {}".format(parent))

        def job(progress, log):
            return PF.build(parent)

        def done(outcome):
            if outcome.cancelled:
                self._status290("Portfolio dashboard cancelled", False)
                return
            if outcome.error is not None:
                self._say290(outcome.traceback)
                log_message(outcome.traceback, MSG_CRITICAL)
                self._status290("Portfolio dashboard FAILED: {}".format(outcome.error), False)
                QMessageBox.critical(self, title, str(outcome.error))
                return
            html_path, csv_path, rows = outcome.result
            self._say290(">>> Portfolio: {} dam(s) - {}".format(len(rows or []), html_path))
            self._say290(">>> Portfolio table: {}".format(csv_path))
            self._status290("Portfolio dashboard: {} dam(s)".format(len(rows or [])),
                            bool(rows))
            if not rows:
                QMessageBox.information(self, title, "No dam folders were found in\n{}"
                                        .format(parent))
            self._open_file290(html_path)
        self._start_background("Building the portfolio dashboard...", job, done,
                               project_bound=False)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- form fill --
    @_guarded("Fill form template")
    def _on_formfill290(self):
        if self._busy290():
            return
        from . import formfill as FF
        title = "Fill form template"
        out_folder = self._outputs_folder290(title)
        if not out_folder:
            return
        template, _f = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Form template with {{KEY}} placeholders", self._start_dir290(),
            "Templates (*.docx *.txt *.md *.html *.htm *.csv)")
        if not template:
            return
        ext = os.path.splitext(template)[1]
        suggested = os.path.join(out_folder, os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(template))[0]
                                 + "_filled" + ext)
        out, _f2 = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(self, "Save the filled form as", suggested,
                                               "*" + ext)
        if not out:
            return
        try:
            written, unknown, missing = FF.fill_template(
                template, FF.available_values(out_folder), out)
        except (ValueError, OSError) as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, title, "The form was not filled:\n{}".format(e))
            return
        self._remember_dir290(template)
        self._say290(">>> Form filled: {}".format(written))
        text = ["Filled form: {}".format(written)]
        if unknown:
            text.append("Placeholders the plugin has no such KEY for (left as they are): "
                        + ", ".join(unknown))
        if missing:
            text.append("Placeholders whose value this run did not record (left as they "
                        "are): " + ", ".join(missing))
        if not unknown and not missing:
            text.append("Every placeholder was filled.")
        text.append("Check every value before the form is signed - they are screening "
                    "results.")
        for line in text[1:-1]:
            self._say290(">>> " + line)
        self._status290("Form filled: {}".format(os.path.basename(written)),
                        not (unknown or missing))
        (QMessageBox.warning if (unknown or missing) else QMessageBox.information)(
            self, title, "\n\n".join(text))

    @_guarded("Save form key list")
    def _on_formfill_keys290(self):
        if self._busy290():
            return
        from . import formfill as FF
        title = "Save form key list"
        out_folder = self._outputs_folder290(title)
        if not out_folder:
            return
        path = FF.write_values_csv(out_folder)
        self._say290(">>> Form values written: {}".format(path))
        self._status290("Form key list saved: {}".format(os.path.basename(path)), True)
        QMessageBox.information(self, title, "Saved:\n{}\n\nKEY, value and description per "
                                "row; a KEY with no value was not recorded by the last run."
                                .format(path))
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

tab): the optional analyses after the classification (sensitivity table,
downstream termination point, second population source, evacuation timing),
the download cache and quick re-run options, the creep-watch worker count and
the dams-in-series screen. The analyses themselves are in pipeline_extras.py
and their own modules; this file only collects the choices.

Every screening value shown here is a parameter chosen by the engineer - the
defaults are starting values, not requirements."""

import os
import re
import traceback

from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import (
    QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QLabel, QGroupBox, QFormLayout,
    QSpinBox, QDoubleSpinBox, QCheckBox, QComboBox, QWidget, QMessageBox, QFileDialog,
    QLineEdit,
)

from .compat import GEOM_POLYGON, MSG_CRITICAL, MSG_WARNING, MB_YES, MB_NO
from .helpers import log_message

_NONE = "__none__"
_CACHE_AUTO = "auto"
# the plugin's own result layers are never offered as a population source
_OWN_RESULT_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(EAP_|Structure_|Habitable|Future_Development|Hazard_|Inventory_QA|Access_Cut|"
    r"Roads_Inundated|Rail_Inundated|Model_Boundary|Lifeline_Facilities|Dams_In_Series)", re.I)

    """Methods for the 'extra analyses and speed' group of the Hazard
    Classification tab and its buttons."""

        self.evac_passable_spin.setSingleStep(0.25)

        self.evac_include_combo.addItem("Flooded and nearly flooded", "near")
        self.evac_include_combo.addItem("All habitable structures", "all")
        form.addRow("  Structures included:", self.evac_include_combo)

        self.evac_safe_spin.setSingleStep(100.0)

        # -- speed and data cache
        self.cache_check = QCheckBox("Keep downloaded data tiles in the QGIS profile and "

        self.cache_check.setToolTip(

        form.addRow("", self.cache_check)

        self.cache_age_spin.setValue(int(D["data_max_age_days"]))

        self.cache_refresh_check = QCheckBox("Refresh every tile this run")

    # ------------------------------------------------- population layer combo --
    def _pop_candidates(self):
        """Polygon vector layers and raster layers that could hold a census /
        gridded population (never the plugin's own outputs)."""
        from .processing import is_plugin_output_name, is_downloaded_data_layer
        out = []
        for lyr in QgsProject.instance().mapLayers().values():
            try:
                if not lyr.isValid() or is_plugin_output_name(lyr.name()) or \
                        _OWN_RESULT_RE.search(lyr.name()) or is_downloaded_data_layer(lyr):
                    continue
            except Exception:
                continue
            if isinstance(lyr, QgsVectorLayer):
                if lyr.geometryType() == GEOM_POLYGON:
                    out.append(lyr)
            elif isinstance(lyr, QgsRasterLayer):
                out.append(lyr)
        return sorted(out, key=lambda x: x.name().lower())

    def _refresh_pop_combo(self):
        """Refill the layer list (keeping the choice) - called with the other
        layer combos."""
        combo = getattr(self, "pop_source_combo", None)
        if combo is None:
            return
        prev = combo.currentData()
        self._pop_updating = True
        combo.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            combo.clear()
            combo.addItem("(none)", _NONE)
            for lyr in self._pop_candidates():
                combo.addItem(lyr.name(), lyr.id())
            for i in range(combo.count()):
                if combo.itemData(i) == prev:
                    combo.setCurrentIndex(i)
                    break
        finally:
            combo.blockSignals(False)
            self._pop_updating = False
        self._fill_pop_fields(keep=True)

    def _pop_layer(self):
        d = self.pop_source_combo.currentData()
        if d in (None, _NONE):
            return None
        return QgsProject.instance().mapLayer(d)

    def _pop_source_changed(self, *args):
        if getattr(self, "_pop_updating", False):
            return                       # the list is being refilled: keep the field choices
        self._fill_pop_fields(keep=False)

    def _fill_pop_fields(self, keep=False):
        """Field pickers of the chosen polygon layer (suggested by name only -
        the engineer chooses); for a raster or no layer they are disabled."""
        from . import popsource as PS
        lyr = self._pop_layer()
        polygons = isinstance(lyr, QgsVectorLayer)
        raster = lyr is not None and not polygons
        want = {}
        if keep:
            want = {"pop": self.pop_field_combo.currentData(),
                    "day": self.pop_day_combo.currentData(),
                    "housing": self.pop_housing_combo.currentData()}
        names = PS.numeric_fields(lyr) if polygons else []
        sug = PS.suggest_fields(lyr) if polygons else {}
        for role, combo, optional in (("pop", self.pop_field_combo, False),
                                      ("day", self.pop_day_combo, True),
                                      ("housing", self.pop_housing_combo, True)):
            combo.blockSignals(True)
            try:
                combo.clear()
                combo.addItem("(choose a field)" if not optional else "(none)", "")
                for n in names:
                    combo.addItem(n, n)
                if want.get(role) in names:
                    pick = want.get(role)                  # the engineer's choice stays
                elif keep:
                    pick = None          # a refresh never puts a suggestion back over "(none)"
                else:
                    pick = sug.get(role) if role == "pop" else None   # a new layer: suggest
                idx = combo.findData(pick) if pick else -1
                if idx >= 0:
                    combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            finally:
                combo.blockSignals(False)
            combo.setEnabled(polygons)
        self.pop_units_combo.setEnabled(raster)
        self.pop_method_combo.setEnabled(raster)
        self.pop_mindepth_spin.setEnabled(lyr is not None)
        self.pop_period_combo.setEnabled(lyr is not None)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- data cache --
    def _cache_folder_for_info(self):
        try:
            from .download import default_cache_folder
            return default_cache_folder()
        except Exception:
            return ""

    def _update_cache_info(self):
        try:
            from .download import tile_cache_stats
            st = tile_cache_stats(self._cache_folder_for_info())
            mb = st["bytes"] / 1048576.0
            self.cache_info_label.setText("Cache: {} tile(s), {:.1f} MB".format(st["files"], mb))
        except Exception:
            self.cache_info_label.setText("")

    def _clear_tile_cache(self, *args):
        from .download import clear_tile_cache
        folder = self._cache_folder_for_info()
        ans = QMessageBox.question(
            self, "Tile cache", "Delete every downloaded data tile kept in\n{}\n?\n\nThe next "
            "run downloads what it needs again.".format(folder or "(not available)"),
            MB_YES | MB_NO)
        if ans != MB_YES:
            return
        n, freed = clear_tile_cache(folder) if folder else (0, 0)
        self._log(">>> Tile cache cleared: {} file(s), {:.1f} MB".format(n, freed / 1048576.0))
        self._update_cache_info()

    def _cache_cfg(self):
        """Cache and speed keys for the pipeline / download cfg."""
        return {
            "data_cache_folder": _CACHE_AUTO if self.cache_check.isChecked() else "",
            "data_max_age_days": int(self.cache_age_spin.value()),
            "refresh_data": bool(self.cache_refresh_check.isChecked()),
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ cfg keys --
    def _extras_config(self):
        """The v2.8 keys of the classification cfg."""
        cfg = {
            "sensitivity": self.sens_check.isChecked(),
            "sensitivity_factors": self.sens_factors_edit.text().strip(),
            "sensitivity_split": self.sens_split_check.isChecked(),
            "termination": self.term_check.isChecked(),
            "term_rise_ft": float(self.term_rise_spin.value()),
            "term_depth_ft": float(self.term_depth_spin.value()),
            "term_confirm": int(self.term_confirm_spin.value()),
            "pop_source": self._pop_layer(),
            "pop_field": self.pop_field_combo.currentData() or "",
            "pop_day_field": self.pop_day_combo.currentData() or "",
            "pop_housing_field": self.pop_housing_combo.currentData() or "",
            "pop_period": self.pop_period_combo.currentData() or "night",
            "pop_raster_units": self.pop_units_combo.currentData() or "per_cell",
            "pop_method": self.pop_method_combo.currentData() or "auto",
            "pop_min_depth_ft": float(self.pop_mindepth_spin.value()),
            "evacuation": self.evac_check.isChecked(),
            "evac_prep_min": float(self.evac_prep_spin.value()),
            "evac_passable_ft": float(self.evac_passable_spin.value()),
            "evac_include": self.evac_include_combo.currentData() or "flooded",
            "evac_dry_safe_ft": float(self.evac_safe_spin.value()),
            "quick_rerun": self.quick_check.isChecked(),
        }
        cfg.update(self._cache_cfg())
        return cfg

    def _extras_problems(self):
        """Problems with the extra choices (for validate_all_inputs)."""
        problems = []
        if self.sens_check.isChecked():
            from .pipeline_extras import parse_factors
            try:
                if not parse_factors(self.sens_factors_edit.text()):
                    problems.append("Sensitivity: no valid factor in the factors field")
            except Exception:
                problems.append("Sensitivity: the factors could not be read (use numbers "
                                "separated by commas)")
        lyr = self._pop_layer()
        if lyr is not None and isinstance(lyr, QgsVectorLayer) and \
                not self.pop_field_combo.currentData():
            problems.append("Second population source: choose the population field")
        if self.evac_check.isChecked():
            paths = getattr(self, "_raster_paths", lambda: {})() or {}
            if not paths.get("arr"):
                problems.append("Evacuation timing needs an arrival-time raster (Setup tab)")
        return problems

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- dams in series --
    def _run_series(self, *args):
        """v2.8: dams-in-series screen over a folder of studied dams
        (series.py) - a background task; writes Dams_In_Series_Screen.csv / .html
        into the folder and each dam's own QA folder."""
        if self._busy:
            return
        start = os.path.dirname(self.config_dam_folder.rstrip("/\\")) if getattr(
            self, "config_dam_folder", "") else ""
        parent = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self, "Folder containing the dam folders", start or "")
        if not parent:
            return
        from . import series as SER
        from .runner import detach_layers
        nid = None
        try:
            from .classify_tab import _NONE as _N
            d = self.dam_layer_combo.currentData()
            if d not in (None, _N):
                nid = detach_layers({"dam_layer": QgsProject.instance().mapLayer(d)}
                                    )["dam_layer"]
        except Exception:
            nid = None
        ctx = QgsProject.instance().transformContext()
        self._log(">>> Dams in series screen: {}".format(parent))

        def work(progress, log):
            res = SER.screen_folder(parent, nid_layer=nid, ctx=ctx,
                                    progress=lambda p, m: progress(p, m))
            paths = SER.write_reports(res, parent)
            try:
                SER.write_qa(res)
            except Exception as e:                     # optional per-dam copies
                log_message(traceback.format_exc(), MSG_WARNING)
                log(">>> WARNING: the per-dam files could not all be written ({})".format(e))
            return res, paths

        def done(outcome):
            if outcome.cancelled:
                self._update_status("Dams in series screen cancelled", False)
                return
            if outcome.error is not None:
                self._log(outcome.traceback)
                log_message(outcome.traceback, MSG_CRITICAL)
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Dams in series", str(outcome.error))
                self._update_status("Dams in series screen failed: {}".format(outcome.error),
                                    False)
                return
            res, paths = outcome.result
            lines = SER.summary_lines(res)
            for line in lines:
                self._log(">>> " + line)
            self._update_status("Dams in series: " + (lines[0] if lines else "done"), True)
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Dams in series", "\n".join(lines[:14]) + "\n\n" +
                                    paths.get("html", ""))
            self._open_path(paths.get("html"))
        self._start_background("Dams in series screen...", work, done, project_bound=False)
```

## `facilities.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Other dams (dams in series, ND REG_05.2026 5.3(c)) and lifeline /
critical facilities (5.2.2) in the inundated area.

Facilities come from downloads (National Inventory of Dams; ND GIS Hub,
EIA and OpenStreetMap for lifelines) and / or a
layer the engineer gives. Each one is tested against every scenario's
depth raster:
  * dam: depth > 0 within DAM_SEARCH_FT of the NID point (the point is often
    on the embankment or at the outlet, not in the channel);
  * lifeline point: depth > 0 within LIFELINE_POINT_RADIUS_FT; polygon:
    depth > 0 in the polygon or its 5-ft edge ring.
With a no-breach baseline a facility is charged to the breach when it is
dry without the breach or the breach adds at least the incremental depth.

Dams in series are an engineering-judgment item (the plugin cannot tell
whether the flood overtops or fails the other dam); flooded lifelines make
the dam at least ND Medium unless switched off.
"""

import math
import re

import numpy as np

from qgis.core import (
    QgsCoordinateTransform, QgsFeature, QgsField, QgsGeometry, QgsPointXY,
)

from .compat import WKB_POINT, FT_DOUBLE, FT_INT, FT_STRING, NULL, GEOM_POLYGON
from .constants import (
    DAM_SEARCH_FT, LIFELINE_POINT_RADIUS_FT, LIFELINE_CATEGORIES, FACILITY_DEDUP_FT,
    OSM_EDGE_BUFFER_FT, CROSSING_RADIUS_FT,
)
from .helpers import (
    log_message, create_memory_layer, transform_geometry, buffer_distance_in_layer_units,
    is_null, transform_xy,
)

KIND_DAM, KIND_LIFELINE, KIND_CROSSING = "dam", "lifeline", "crossing"

_NAME_FIELDS = ("name", "dam_name", "facname", "facility", "plant_name", "cwp_name",
                "business", "fac_name", "label")
_TYPE_FIELDS = ("category", "type", "fac_type", "facility_type", "hosp_type", "naicsdescr",
                "primsource", "sic_codes")


def _ft(distance_ft, crs, lat=None):
    """Feet in the CRS units (degrees scaled at `lat` for geographic CRSs)."""
    d = buffer_distance_in_layer_units(distance_ft, crs)
    try:
        if crs is not None and crs.isGeographic() and lat is not None:
            d = distance_ft / (364000.0 * max(0.2, math.cos(math.radians(lat))))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return d


def _field_index(names_low, wanted):
    for w in wanted:
        if w in names_low:
            return names_low.index(w)
    return -1


def _attr(attrs, idx):
    if idx < 0:
        return ""
    v = attrs[idx]
    return "" if is_null(v) else str(v).strip()


def _num(attrs, idx):
    if idx < 0:
        return None
    try:
        v = float(attrs[idx])
        return v if math.isfinite(v) else None
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


# free-text category / type -> canonical category (first match wins)
_CATEGORY_KEYWORDS = (
    ("nursing", "Nursing home"), ("skilled", "Nursing home"),
    ("assisted", "Basic care / assisted living"), ("basic care", "Basic care / assisted living"),
    ("hospital", "Hospital"), ("medical center", "Hospital"),
    ("emergency operation", "Emergency operations center"), ("eoc", "Emergency operations center"),
    ("fire", "Fire station"), ("ambulance", "EMS station"), ("ems", "EMS station"),
    ("police", "Law enforcement"), ("sheriff", "Law enforcement"),
    ("law enforcement", "Law enforcement"), ("substation", "Electric substation"),
    ("power plant", "Power plant"), ("generating", "Power plant"),
    ("wastewater", "Wastewater treatment"), ("sewage", "Wastewater treatment"),
    ("sewer", "Wastewater treatment"), ("lagoon", "Wastewater treatment"),
    ("water treatment", "Water treatment"), ("water works", "Water treatment"),
    ("water plant", "Water treatment"),
)
_CARE = {"Nursing home", "Basic care / assisted living"}
# v2.5: schools and child care (OSM) - vulnerable occupants, listed for review
# and as priority notifications; not lifelines (5.2.2) and never a class change
SCHOOLS = {"School", "Child care"}
VULNERABLE = _CARE | SCHOOLS | {"Hospital"}


def canonical_category(text):
    """Canonical facility category of a free-text value (case-insensitive),
    or None when nothing matches."""
    t = " {} ".format(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", (text or "").lower()))
    for canon in LIFELINE_CATEGORIES | _CARE | SCHOOLS:
        if t.strip() == canon.lower():
            return canon
    for kw, canon in _CATEGORY_KEYWORDS:
        if re.search(r"(?<![a-z]){}(?![a-z])".format(re.escape(kw)), t):
            return canon
    return None


def _norm_name(name):
    n = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 ]+", " ", (name or "").lower())
    n = re.sub(r"\b(dam|dams|the|no|number)\b", " ", n)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", n).strip()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- read --
def read_dams(layer, source_label, analysis_crs, transform_ctx, clip=None):
    """Dam records (points in `analysis_crs`) from an NID-like layer."""
    if layer is None or not layer.isValid():
        return []
    names = [f.name() for f in layer.fields()]
    low = [n.lower() for n in names]
    i_id = _field_index(low, ("nidid", "nid_id", "nid", "damid", "dam_id"))
    i_name = _field_index(low, ("name", "dam_name") + _NAME_FIELDS)
    i_haz = _field_index(low, ("hazard_potential", "hazard", "hazard_class", "haz_class",
                               "hazardclass"))
    i_h = _field_index(low, ("nid_height", "dam_height", "height", "structural_height"))
    i_s = _field_index(low, ("nid_storage", "max_storage", "storage", "normal_storage"))
    i_riv = _field_index(low, ("river_or_stream", "river", "stream"))
    i_eap = _field_index(low, ("eap_prepared", "eap"))
    xf = QgsCoordinateTransform(layer.crs(), analysis_crs, transform_ctx)
    a_to_clip = clip.transform_from(analysis_crs) if clip is not None else None
    out = []
    for feat in layer.getFeatures():
        g = transform_geometry(feat.geometry(), xf)
        if g is None or g.isNull() or g.isEmpty():
            continue
        try:
            pt = g.asPoint() if g.type() != GEOM_POLYGON else g.pointOnSurface().asPoint()
        except Exception:
            try:
                pt = g.centroid().asPoint()
            except Exception:
                continue
        if clip is not None and not clip.contains_point(pt, xform=a_to_clip):
            continue
        a = feat.attributes()
        out.append({"kind": KIND_DAM, "source": source_label,
                    "geom": QgsGeometry.fromPointXY(QgsPointXY(pt)),
                    "nid": _attr(a, i_id), "name": _attr(a, i_name) or "(unnamed dam)",
                    "hazard": _attr(a, i_haz), "height_ft": _num(a, i_h),
                    "storage_acft": _num(a, i_s), "river": _attr(a, i_riv),
                    "eap": _attr(a, i_eap), "category": "Dam"})
    return out


def read_lifelines(layer, source_label, category, analysis_crs, transform_ctx, clip=None):
    """Lifeline records from a point or polygon layer. `category` is the
    category of every feature (agency layers) or None to read it from a
    'category' field, else a 'type' field (OSM download, engineer's layer):
    matched case-insensitively to the plugin's categories; an engineer's
    feature whose type matches none of them is still a lifeline."""
    if layer is None or not layer.isValid():
        return []
    names = [f.name() for f in layer.fields()]
    low = [n.lower() for n in names]
    i_name = _field_index(low, _NAME_FIELDS)
    i_cat = _field_index(low, ("category",)) if category is None else -1
    i_type = _field_index(low, _TYPE_FIELDS)
    xf = QgsCoordinateTransform(layer.crs(), analysis_crs, transform_ctx)
    a_to_clip = clip.transform_from(analysis_crs) if clip is not None else None
    out = []
    for feat in layer.getFeatures():
        g = transform_geometry(feat.geometry(), xf)
        if g is None or g.isNull() or g.isEmpty():
            continue
        if clip is not None and not clip.intersects_geometry(g, xform=a_to_clip):
            continue
        a = feat.attributes()
        detail = _attr(a, i_type) if i_type != i_cat else ""
        if category:
            cat = category
        else:
            raw = _attr(a, i_cat)
            cat = canonical_category(raw) or canonical_category(detail) or \
                canonical_category(_attr(a, i_name)) or "Lifeline (user layer)"
        out.append({"kind": KIND_LIFELINE, "source": source_label, "geom": g,
                    "name": _attr(a, i_name) or "(unnamed)", "category": cat,
                    "detail": detail, "lifeline": cat not in (_CARE | SCHOOLS),
                    "polygon": g.type() == GEOM_POLYGON})
    return out


_NBI_OWNERS = {"01": "State highway agency", "02": "County highway agency",
               "03": "Town or township", "04": "City or municipal", "11": "State park / forest",
               "21": "Other state agency", "25": "Other local agency", "26": "Private",
               "27": "Railroad", "31": "State toll authority", "60": "Other federal",
               "62": "Bureau of Indian Affairs", "64": "U.S. Forest Service",
               "66": "National Park Service", "70": "Corps of Engineers"}


def read_crossings(layer, source_label, analysis_crs, transform_ctx, clip=None):
    """Bridges, culverts and stream crossings: National Bridge Inventory
    records (STRUCTURE_TYPE_043B = 19 is a culvert) or OpenStreetMap points
    with a 'category' field (culvert, ford / low-water crossing, railroad
    bridge)."""
    if layer is None or not layer.isValid():
        return []
    low = [f.name().lower() for f in layer.fields()]
    nbi = "structure_number_008" in low
    idx = {k: _field_index(low, names) for k, names in (
        ("no", ("structure_number_008",)), ("carried", ("facility_carried_007",)),
        ("crosses", ("features_desc_006a",)), ("adt", ("adt_029",)),
        ("adt_year", ("year_adt_030",)), ("type", ("structure_type_043b",)),
        ("owner", ("owner_022",)), ("built", ("year_built_027",)),
        ("scour", ("scour_critical_113",)), ("name", ("name",)),
        ("category", ("category",)), ("waterway", ("waterway",)),
        ("railway", ("railway",)), ("osm_id", ("osm_id",)), ("operator", ("operator",)))}
    xf = QgsCoordinateTransform(layer.crs(), analysis_crs, transform_ctx)
    a_to_clip = clip.transform_from(analysis_crs) if clip is not None else None
    out = []
    for feat in layer.getFeatures():
        g = transform_geometry(feat.geometry(), xf)
        if g is None or g.isNull() or g.isEmpty():
            continue
        try:
            pt = g.asPoint()
        except Exception:
            try:
                pt = g.centroid().asPoint()
            except Exception:
                continue
        if clip is not None and not clip.contains_point(pt, xform=a_to_clip):
            continue
        a = feat.attributes()
        if nbi:
            typ = _attr(a, idx["type"]).lstrip("0")
            cat = "Culvert" if typ == "19" else "Road bridge"
            carried = _attr(a, idx["carried"]).strip("' ")
            crosses = _attr(a, idx["crosses"]).strip("' ")
            owner = _attr(a, idx["owner"])
            adt = _num(a, idx["adt"])
            yr = _num(a, idx["adt_year"])
            rec = {"name": carried or "(bridge)", "category": cat,
                   "struct_no": _attr(a, idx["no"]).strip(), "carried": carried,
                   "crosses": crosses, "adt": adt, "adt_year": int(yr) if yr else None,
                   "owner": _NBI_OWNERS.get(owner.zfill(2), owner) if owner else "",
                   "built": int(_num(a, idx["built"]) or 0) or None,
                   "scour": _attr(a, idx["scour"])}
        else:
            cat = _attr(a, idx["category"]) or "Crossing"
            rec = {"name": _attr(a, idx["name"]) or "(unnamed)", "category": cat,
                   "struct_no": _attr(a, idx["osm_id"]), "carried": _attr(a, idx["railway"]),
                   "crosses": _attr(a, idx["waterway"]), "adt": None, "adt_year": None,
                   "owner": _attr(a, idx["operator"]), "built": None, "scour": ""}
        rec.update({"kind": KIND_CROSSING, "source": source_label,
                    "geom": QgsGeometry.fromPointXY(QgsPointXY(pt))})
        out.append(rec)
    return out


def crossing_priority(rec):
    """Sort key: busy roads first (ADT), then railroad bridges, then the rest."""
    adt = rec.get("adt") or 0
    rail = 1 if rec["category"] == "Railroad bridge" else 0
    return (-adt, -rail, rec["name"])


def dedupe(records, crs, lat=None):
    """Drop a lifeline record when an earlier one of the same category lies
    within FACILITY_DEDUP_FT (agency layers are read first, so they win over
    OSM); a dam when an earlier one has the same NID ID."""
    tol = _ft(FACILITY_DEDUP_FT, crs, lat)
    crossing_tol = _ft(100.0, crs, lat)
    kept = []
    for r in records:
        c = r["geom"].centroid().asPoint()
        dup = None
        for k in kept:
            if k["category"] != r["category"]:
                continue
            if r["kind"] == KIND_CROSSING:
                # the same structure from NBI and OSM; two records of one
                # source (twin bridges, neighbouring culverts) stay apart
                if r["source"] == k["source"]:
                    continue
                kc = k["geom"].centroid().asPoint()
                if math.hypot(kc.x() - c.x(), kc.y() - c.y()) <= crossing_tol:
                    dup = k
                    break
                continue
            if r["kind"] == KIND_DAM:
                # dams: the same NID ID (a dam in the download and in the
                # engineer's layer), or no ID and the same name close by -
                # separate dams of one project (main dam, dikes) are kept
                if r.get("nid") and k.get("nid"):
                    if r["nid"].upper() == k["nid"].upper():
                        dup = k
                        break
                    continue
                if _norm_name(r.get("name")) != _norm_name(k.get("name")):
                    continue
            kc = k["geom"].centroid().asPoint()
            if math.hypot(kc.x() - c.x(), kc.y() - c.y()) <= tol:
                dup = k
                break
        if dup is None:
            kept.append(r)
        else:
            if r["source"] not in dup.setdefault("also_in", []):
                dup["also_in"].append(r["source"])
            if dup.get("name") in ("", "(unnamed)") and r.get("name"):
                dup["name"] = r["name"]
    for i, r in enumerate(kept):
        r["id"] = i + 1
    return kept


def mark_subject_dam(dams, subject_nid="", dam_name=""):
    """Flag the dam being classified (by NID ID, else by name) so it is not
    counted as a dam in series. Returns the flagged record or None."""
    sid = (subject_nid or "").strip().upper()
    target = _norm_name(dam_name)
    hit = None
    for d in dams:
        d["subject"] = False
        if sid and d.get("nid", "").upper() == sid:
            hit = d
        elif not sid and target and _norm_name(d.get("name")) == target:
            hit = hit or d
    if hit is not None:
        hit["subject"] = True
        # saddle dams / dikes listed under the same name are part of it
        hn = _norm_name(hit.get("name"))
        for d in dams:
            if d is not hit and hn and _norm_name(d.get("name")) == hn:
                d["subject"] = True
    return hit


def mark_near_subject(records, crs, lat=None):
    """Lifelines within DAM_SEARCH_FT of the dam being classified (they may
    sit in the reservoir / at the dam itself): flagged for review."""
    subj = [r for r in records if r["kind"] == KIND_DAM and r.get("subject")]
    if not subj:
        return 0
    tol = _ft(DAM_SEARCH_FT, crs, lat)
    n = 0
    for r in records:
        if r["kind"] != KIND_LIFELINE:
            continue
        c = r["geom"].centroid().asPoint()
        for d in subj:
            p = d["geom"].asPoint()
            if math.hypot(p.x() - c.x(), p.y() - c.y()) <= tol:
                r["near_subject"] = True
                n += 1
                break
    return n


# --------------------------------------------------------------- evaluate --
def _search_geom(rec, crs, lat):
    if rec["kind"] == KIND_DAM:
        return rec["geom"].buffer(_ft(DAM_SEARCH_FT, crs, lat), 16), \
            "depth > 0 within {:g} ft of the NID point".format(DAM_SEARCH_FT)
    if rec.get("polygon"):
        return rec["geom"].buffer(_ft(OSM_EDGE_BUFFER_FT, crs, lat), 8), \
            "depth > 0 in the outline or its {:g}-ft edge ring".format(OSM_EDGE_BUFFER_FT)
    if rec["kind"] == KIND_CROSSING:
        return rec["geom"].buffer(_ft(CROSSING_RADIUS_FT, crs, lat), 16), \
            "depth > 0 within {:g} ft of the structure point (the channel under a " \
            "bridge is wet too - the deck / road may not be overtopped)".format(
                CROSSING_RADIUS_FT)
    return rec["geom"].buffer(_ft(LIFELINE_POINT_RADIUS_FT, crs, lat), 16), \
        "depth > 0 within {:g} ft of the point".format(LIFELINE_POINT_RADIUS_FT)


def evaluate(records, samplers, analysis_crs, transform_ctx, lat=None):
    """{id: {"depth": max depth ft or None, "arrival": earliest arrival h or
    None, "x", "y" (analysis CRS, where the max depth is)}} for one scenario.
    A facility with no wet cell gets depth None."""
    depth = samplers.get("depth")
    arr = samplers.get("arr")
    if depth is None or not depth.ok:
        return {}
    to_d = QgsCoordinateTransform(analysis_crs, depth.crs, transform_ctx) \
        if depth.crs is not None else None
    back = QgsCoordinateTransform(depth.crs, analysis_crs, transform_ctx) \
        if depth.crs is not None else None
    to_a = QgsCoordinateTransform(analysis_crs, arr.crs, transform_ctx) \
        if arr is not None and arr.ok and arr.crs is not None else None
    out = {}
    for rec in records:
        area, basis = _search_geom(rec, analysis_crs, lat)
        rec["basis"] = basis
        g = transform_geometry(area, to_d) if to_d is not None else area
        res = {"depth": None, "arrival": None, "x": None, "y": None}
        if g is not None:
            xs, ys, vals = depth.cells_in_geometry(g)
            if vals.size:
                wet = vals > 0
                if wet.any():
                    i = int(vals.argmax())
                    res["depth"] = float(vals[i])
                    p = QgsPointXY(float(xs[i]), float(ys[i]))
                    if back is not None:
                        try:
                            p = back.transform(p)
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    res["x"], res["y"] = p.x(), p.y()
                    if to_a is not None:
                        # v2.3.1: arrival at wet cells at facility, not buffer minimum
                        # xs/ys in depth.crs; back: depth.crs→analysis_crs; to_a: analysis_crs→arr.crs
                        awx, awy = transform_xy(xs[wet], ys[wet], back)
                        awx, awy = transform_xy(awx, awy, to_a)
                        av = arr.values_at(awx, awy)
                        av = av[np.isfinite(av) & (av >= 0)]
                        if av.size:
                            res["arrival"] = float(av.min())
        out[rec["id"]] = res
    return out


def mark_incremental(records, breach_eval, base_eval, min_depth_ft):
    """{id: (charged?, note)} of the flooded facilities against the
    baseline evaluation (None = no baseline: every flooded one is charged)."""
    out = {}
    for rec in records:
        d = (breach_eval.get(rec["id"]) or {}).get("depth")
        if d is None:
            continue
        if base_eval is None:
            out[rec["id"]] = (True, "")
            continue
        bd = (base_eval.get(rec["id"]) or {}).get("depth")
        if bd is None or bd <= 0:
            out[rec["id"]] = (True, "dry without breach")
        elif d - bd >= min_depth_ft:
            out[rec["id"]] = (True, "+{:.1f} ft with breach".format(d - bd))
        else:
            out[rec["id"]] = (False, "flooded without breach ({:.1f} ft)".format(bd))
    return out


def flooded(records, ev, charged=None, kind=None, charged_only=True):
    """Records of `kind` flooded in evaluation `ev` (and charged to the breach
    when `charged` is given and charged_only)."""
    out = []
    for rec in records:
        if kind is not None and rec["kind"] != kind:
            continue
        if rec.get("subject"):
            continue
        if (ev.get(rec["id"]) or {}).get("depth") is None:
            continue
        if charged is not None and charged_only and not charged.get(rec["id"], (True,))[0]:
            continue
        out.append(rec)
    return out


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- layers --
DAM_FIELDS = [("Dam_Name", FT_STRING), ("NID_ID", FT_STRING), ("Hazard_Potential", FT_STRING),
              ("Height_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("Storage_acft", FT_DOUBLE), ("River", FT_STRING),
              ("EAP", FT_STRING), ("Flooded", FT_STRING), ("Max_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE),
              ("Arrival_hr", FT_DOUBLE), ("Base_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("Charged", FT_STRING),
              ("Note", FT_STRING), ("Basis", FT_STRING), ("Source", FT_STRING)]
LIFELINE_FIELDS = [("Facility", FT_STRING), ("Category", FT_STRING), ("Lifeline", FT_STRING),
                   ("Detail", FT_STRING), ("Flooded", FT_STRING), ("Max_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE),
                   ("Arrival_hr", FT_DOUBLE), ("Base_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE),
                   ("Charged", FT_STRING), ("Note", FT_STRING), ("Basis", FT_STRING),
                   ("Source", FT_STRING)]


CROSSING_FIELDS = [("Structure", FT_STRING), ("Category", FT_STRING),
                   ("Structure_No", FT_STRING), ("Carries", FT_STRING), ("Crosses", FT_STRING),
                   ("ADT", FT_INT), ("ADT_Year", FT_INT), ("Owner", FT_STRING),
                   ("Year_Built", FT_INT), ("Scour_Critical", FT_STRING),
                   ("Flooded", FT_STRING), ("Max_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE),
                   ("Arrival_hr", FT_DOUBLE), ("Base_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE),
                   ("Charged", FT_STRING), ("Note", FT_STRING), ("Basis", FT_STRING),
                   ("Source", FT_STRING)]


def _round(v, n=2):
    return NULL if v is None else round(float(v), n)


def facilities_layer(records, kind, ev, base_ev, charged, crs, name):
    """Point layer of the facilities of `kind` (all of them in the study area,
    flooded or not). None when there are none."""
    recs = [r for r in records if r["kind"] == kind]
    if not recs:
        return None
    spec = {KIND_DAM: DAM_FIELDS, KIND_CROSSING: CROSSING_FIELDS}.get(kind, LIFELINE_FIELDS)
    if kind == KIND_CROSSING:
        recs = sorted(recs, key=crossing_priority)
    lyr = create_memory_layer(name, WKB_POINT, crs, [QgsField(n, t) for n, t in spec])
    feats = []
    for r in recs:
        e = ev.get(r["id"]) or {}
        b = (base_ev or {}).get(r["id"]) or {}
        wet = e.get("depth") is not None
        ch = (charged or {}).get(r["id"])
        note = ""
        if r.get("subject"):
            note = "the dam being classified - not counted"
        elif ch is not None:
            note = ch[1]
        if r.get("near_subject"):
            note = (note + "; " if note else "") + \
                "next to the dam being classified - may be in the reservoir; verify"
        if r.get("also_in"):
            note = (note + "; " if note else "") + "also in " + ", ".join(r["also_in"])
        charged_txt = NULL if not wet or r.get("subject") else (
            "Yes" if ch is None or ch[0] else "No")
        f = QgsFeature(lyr.fields())
        try:
            f.setGeometry(QgsGeometry.fromPointXY(r["geom"].centroid().asPoint()
                                                  if r.get("polygon") else r["geom"].asPoint()))
        except Exception:
            f.setGeometry(r["geom"].centroid())
        if kind == KIND_DAM:
            f.setAttributes([r["name"], r.get("nid") or NULL, r.get("hazard") or NULL,
                             _round(r.get("height_ft"), 1), _round(r.get("storage_acft"), 0),
                             r.get("river") or NULL, r.get("eap") or NULL,
                             "Yes" if wet else "No", _round(e.get("depth")),
                             _round(e.get("arrival")), _round(b.get("depth")), charged_txt,
                             note or NULL, r.get("basis") or NULL, r["source"]])
        elif kind == KIND_CROSSING:
            def _int(v):
                return NULL if v in (None, "") else int(v)
            f.setAttributes([r["name"], r["category"], r.get("struct_no") or NULL,
                             r.get("carried") or NULL, r.get("crosses") or NULL,
                             _int(r.get("adt")), _int(r.get("adt_year")),
                             r.get("owner") or NULL, _int(r.get("built")),
                             r.get("scour") or NULL, "Yes" if wet else "No",
                             _round(e.get("depth")), _round(e.get("arrival")),
                             _round(b.get("depth")), charged_txt, note or NULL,
                             r.get("basis") or NULL, r["source"]])
        else:
            f.setAttributes([r["name"], r["category"], "Yes" if r.get("lifeline") else "No",
                             r.get("detail") or NULL, "Yes" if wet else "No",
                             _round(e.get("depth")), _round(e.get("arrival")),
                             _round(b.get("depth")), charged_txt, note or NULL,
                             r.get("basis") or NULL, r["source"]])
        feats.append(f)
    lyr.dataProvider().addFeatures(feats)
    lyr.updateExtents()
    return lyr


def describe(recs, ev, n=4, dam=False):
    """Short list for the summary: 'Name (NID, High, 3.2 ft)'."""
    items = []
    for r in recs[:n]:
        d = (ev.get(r["id"]) or {}).get("depth")
        extra = [r.get("nid")] if dam and r.get("nid") else []
        if dam and r.get("hazard"):
            extra.append("{} hazard".format(r["hazard"]))
        if not dam:
            extra.append(r["category"])
            if r.get("near_subject"):
                extra.append("at the dam - may be in the reservoir")
            if r.get("kind") == KIND_CROSSING:
                if r.get("crosses"):
                    extra.append("over " + r["crosses"])
                if r.get("adt"):
                    extra.append("ADT {:,.0f}".format(r["adt"]))
        if d is not None:
            extra.append("{:.1f} ft".format(d))
        items.append("{} ({})".format(r["name"], ", ".join(extra)))
    more = "" if len(recs) <= n else " and {} more".format(len(recs) - n)
    return "; ".join(items) + more


def is_high_hazard(rec):
    return (rec.get("hazard") or "").strip().lower().startswith("h")


def log_counts(records):
    dams = sum(1 for r in records if r["kind"] == KIND_DAM)
    lif = sum(1 for r in records if r["kind"] == KIND_LIFELINE)
    cr = sum(1 for r in records if r["kind"] == KIND_CROSSING)
    log_message("Facilities in the study area: {} dam(s), {} lifeline / critical "
                "facilit(ies), {} bridge(s) / culvert(s) / crossing(s)".format(dams, lif, cr))
```

## `facility_review.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.9: the engineer's review of roads, railroads, bridges / culverts /
low-water crossings and lifeline facilities, kept across re-runs.

Decisions are kept in outputs/Facility_Review_Decisions.csv (UTF-8 with
BOM, one row per reviewed item: kind, name, decision, value, note,
reviewer, date and the item's location in WGS 84 and in the analysis CRS).
The file is read tolerantly (Excel copies in the ANSI code page, ";" as
the list separator, decimal commas, thousands separators, headers in
another case) and never overwritten when it cannot be read.

Matching (every run, to the new road / rail / facility records):
  * a road or rail STRETCH is keyed by its middle point (half-way along
    the flooded stretch) and its name. A saved decision matches a stretch
    of the same kind when the saved point lies within LINE_MATCH_FT of the
    stretch (so a stretch that grows or shrinks a little with a changed
    raster still matches) and the names do not clearly describe different
    roads (linear.names_conflict);
  * a FACILITY (bridge / culvert / crossing, lifeline) is keyed by its
    point (a point on the surface of an outline) within POINT_MATCH_FT.
Every decision matches at most one item and every item at most one
decision: the pairs are taken best first (same name, same automatic
category, then the shorter distance, then the later row of the file). A
re-run with the same data gives the same points, so every decision
matches again. Decisions that match nothing are kept in the file and
reported.

Effects (apply_facility_decisions, before the classification):
  * Excluded (any kind) / "Overtopped: no" (crossing): the item is left out
    of the lists the classification, the output layers and the EAP list
    use; it is kept in res["facility_review"]["excluded"];
  * Set AADT (road) / Set trains per day (railroad): the value replaces
    the automatic one and the ND class, basis, judgment flag and (roads)
    the TM 11 motorists are worked out again the way linear.py does; the
    automatic values are kept in *_auto keys;
  * Set category (lifeline): category and lifeline flag replaced;
  * Overtopped: yes (crossing): recorded on the item (and in its Basis);
  * Confirmed / Note: recorded, nothing changes.
The automatic records are never changed: an overridden item is a copy,
and the automatic lists are kept in res["facility_review_auto"] so that
the next run (which may re-use the cached evaluation) starts from them
again. Without saved decisions nothing is touched.
"""

import csv
import getpass
import io
import math
import os
import re
import time

import numpy as np

from qgis.core import (
    QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem, QgsCoordinateTransform, QgsPointXY, QgsGeometry, QgsFeature,
    QgsField,
)

from .compat import MSG_WARNING, WKB_POINT, FT_STRING
from .constants import (
    CLASS_HIGH, CLASS_JUDGMENT, DEFAULT_VEHICLE_OCCUPANCY, DEFAULT_VEHICLE_SPEED_MPH,
    LIFELINE_CATEGORIES, ND_AADT_LOW_BELOW, ND_HIGH, ND_MEDIUM, ZONE_LABELS,
    vehicle_curve_available,
)
from .helpers import log_message, buffer_distance_in_layer_units, create_memory_layer
from . import facilities as FAC
from . import linear as LN

REVIEW_FILE = "Facility_Review_Decisions.csv"
FIELDS = ["Kind", "Name", "Decision", "Value", "Auto_Value", "Note", "Reviewer", "Date",
          "Lon", "Lat", "X", "Y", "CRS", "Length_ft", "Item_ID", "Detail"]
# matching tolerances (software settings, not regulatory values)
POINT_MATCH_FT = 30.0
LINE_MATCH_FT = 50.0
_WGS = "EPSG:4326"

KIND_ROAD, KIND_RAIL, KIND_CROSSING, KIND_LIFELINE = "Road", "Railroad", "Crossing", "Lifeline"
KINDS = (KIND_ROAD, KIND_RAIL, KIND_CROSSING, KIND_LIFELINE)
LINE_KINDS = (KIND_ROAD, KIND_RAIL)
KIND_LABELS = {KIND_ROAD: "Roads", KIND_RAIL: "Railroads", KIND_CROSSING: "Bridges & crossings",
               KIND_LIFELINE: "Lifeline facilities"}
_ID_PREFIX = {KIND_ROAD: "R", KIND_RAIL: "RR", KIND_CROSSING: "C", KIND_LIFELINE: "L"}

DEC_CONFIRMED = "Confirmed"
DEC_EXCLUDED = "Excluded"
DEC_SET_AADT = "Set AADT"
DEC_SET_TRAINS = "Set trains per day"
DEC_OVERTOPPED_YES = "Overtopped: yes"
DEC_OVERTOPPED_NO = "Overtopped: no"
DEC_SET_CATEGORY = "Set category"
DEC_NOTE = "Note"
ALLOWED = {
    KIND_ROAD: (DEC_CONFIRMED, DEC_EXCLUDED, DEC_SET_AADT, DEC_NOTE),
    KIND_RAIL: (DEC_CONFIRMED, DEC_EXCLUDED, DEC_SET_TRAINS, DEC_NOTE),
    KIND_CROSSING: (DEC_CONFIRMED, DEC_EXCLUDED, DEC_OVERTOPPED_YES, DEC_OVERTOPPED_NO, DEC_NOTE),
    KIND_LIFELINE: (DEC_CONFIRMED, DEC_EXCLUDED, DEC_SET_CATEGORY, DEC_NOTE),
}
VALUE_DECISION = {KIND_ROAD: DEC_SET_AADT, KIND_RAIL: DEC_SET_TRAINS,
                  KIND_LIFELINE: DEC_SET_CATEGORY}

# the plugin's facility categories: lifelines (5.2.2) first, then the
# vulnerable-occupant categories that are listed for review only
_NON_LIFELINE = set(getattr(FAC, "_CARE", set())) | set(FAC.SCHOOLS)
CATEGORY_CHOICES = sorted(LIFELINE_CATEGORIES) + sorted(_NON_LIFELINE)

AUTO_KEY = "facility_review_auto"       # the automatic lists (restored on every run)
RESULT_KEY = "facility_review"          # what the decisions did in this run
_LIST_KEYS = ("roads", "rails", "facility_records")


def review_path(output_folder):
    return os.path.join(output_folder, REVIEW_FILE)


def reviewer_name():
    try:
        return getpass.getuser()
    except Exception:
        return ""


# ------------------------------------------------------------ parsing ----
def _num(v):
    """Number from a coordinate cell; a decimal comma is read as a point."""
    t = str(v).strip()
    if "," in t and "." not in t:
        t = t.replace(",", ".")
    return float(t)


_THOUSANDS = re.compile(r"^[+-]?\d{1,3}(?:[, '  ]\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?$")


def parse_value(text):
    """AADT / trains per day from a CSV cell (None when empty or not a
    number). '2,500' and '2 500' are thousands (Excel formatting); '12,5'
    is a decimal comma."""
    t = str(text if text is not None else "").strip().replace(" ", " ")
    if not t:
        return None
    try:
        if "," in t and "." in t:              # 1,234.5 (US) or 1.234,5 (European)
            t = t.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".") if t.rfind(",") > t.rfind(".") \
                else t.replace(",", "")
            v = float(t.replace(" ", ""))
        elif _THOUSANDS.match(t):
            v = float(re.sub(r"[, '  ]", "", t))
        else:
            v = _num(t.replace(" ", ""))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return v if math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 else None


_KIND_WORDS = {
    KIND_ROAD: ("road", "roads", "roadstretch", "street", "highway"),
    KIND_RAIL: ("railroad", "railroads", "rail", "rails", "railway", "railroadstretch"),
    KIND_CROSSING: ("crossing", "crossings", "bridge", "bridges", "culvert", "culverts",
                    "bridgecrossing", "bridgesandcrossings", "bridgesculvertscrossings",
                    "lowwatercrossing"),
    KIND_LIFELINE: ("lifeline", "lifelines", "lifelinefacility", "lifelinefacilities",
                    "facility", "facilities"),
}


def kind_of(text):
    t = re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", str(text or "").lower())
    for k, words in _KIND_WORDS.items():
        if t in words:
            return k
    return None


def decision_code(text):
    """Canonical decision of a CSV cell ('' for an empty cell, None when
    it is not understood - such a decision is never applied)."""
    t = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", str(text or "").lower()).strip()
    if not t:
        return ""
    # (the tab's longer labels, typed into the file by hand, are read too)
    if t.startswith("not overtopped") or t.startswith("overtopped no") or \
            t in ("overtopped n", "no overtopping"):
        return DEC_OVERTOPPED_NO
    if t.startswith("overtopped yes") or t in ("overtopped y", "overtopped"):
        return DEC_OVERTOPPED_YES
    if t.startswith("confirm") or t.startswith("automatic result is correct") or \
            t in ("correct", "ok"):
        return DEC_CONFIRMED
    if t.startswith("exclude") or t.startswith("not a lifeline"):
        return DEC_EXCLUDED
    if t.startswith("set aadt") or t == "aadt":
        return DEC_SET_AADT
    if t.startswith("set trains") or t in ("trains per day", "trains", "trains day"):
        return DEC_SET_TRAINS
    if t.startswith("set category") or t == "category":
        return DEC_SET_CATEGORY
    if t in ("note", "note only"):
        return DEC_NOTE
    return None


def canonical_category(text):
    """One of CATEGORY_CHOICES for a text (case-insensitive, or through the
    plugin's keyword rules), else None."""
    t = str(text or "").strip()
    for c in CATEGORY_CHOICES:
        if t.lower() == c.lower():
            return c
    c = FAC.canonical_category(t) if t else None
    return c if c in CATEGORY_CHOICES else None


def decision_of(row):
    """The decision of a file row as a dict (kind, decision, value, note,
    reviewer, date, name). decision None = not understood."""
    kind = kind_of(row.get("Kind"))
    code = decision_code(row.get("Decision"))
    note = (row.get("Note") or "").strip()
    raw_value = (row.get("Value") or "").strip()
    if code == "":
        code = DEC_NOTE if note else None
    value = None
    if code in (DEC_SET_AADT, DEC_SET_TRAINS):
        value = parse_value(raw_value)
    elif code == DEC_SET_CATEGORY:
        value = canonical_category(raw_value)
    return {"kind": kind, "decision": code, "value": value, "value_text": raw_value,
            "note": note, "reviewer": (row.get("Reviewer") or "").strip(),
            "date": (row.get("Date") or "").strip(), "name": (row.get("Name") or "").strip(),
```
