```python
def _cell(key, value, kind):
    v = "" if value is None else str(value)
    esc = html.escape(v, quote=True)
    if kind == "rank":
        rk = _rank(v)
        sort = ' data-sort="{}"'.format(rk if rk else "-")
        if rk:
            bg, fg = _CHIP[rk]
            return '<td{}><span class="chip" style="background:{};color:{}">{}</span></td>'.format(
                sort, bg, fg, esc.upper())
        return "<td{}>{}</td>".format(sort, esc)
    if kind == "action":
        if v in _ACTION:
            return ('<td data-sort="{}"><span class="chip" style="background:{};color:#fff">'
                    '{}</span></td>').format(ACTION_ORDER.index(v) + 1, _ACTION[v],
                                             esc.upper())
        return '<td data-sort="-">{}</td>'.format(esc)
    if key == "Creep_Alert" and v in _ALERT:
        return '<td><span class="chip" style="background:{}">{}</span></td>'.format(
            _ALERT[v], esc)
    cls = ' class="small"' if key in _SMALL else ""
    return "<td{}>{}</td>".format(cls, esc)


def _link(target, page_folder):
    """A link to a local file from a page in `page_folder` (relative when possible)."""
    try:
        rel = os.path.relpath(target, page_folder)
        return rel.replace(os.sep, "/")
    except ValueError:                           # another drive on Windows
        import pathlib
        return pathlib.Path(os.path.abspath(target)).as_uri()


def _with_small(cell, lines):
    lines = [str(x) for x in lines if x not in (None, "", MISSING)]
    if not lines:
        return cell
    return cell[:-5] + "".join('<div class="small">{}</div>'.format(html.escape(x, quote=True))
                               for x in lines) + "</td>"


def _screening_meta(sources, page_folder):
    """The page's line about the Screening results read (with links to its index.html)."""
    if not sources:
        return ("<p class='meta'>No ND Dam Breach Screening results were found (a folder in or "
                "directly inside this folder holding its summary.csv, e.g. '_screening'): "
                "the screening columns are '-'.</p>")
    bits = []
    for src in sources:
        folder = src if os.path.isdir(src) else os.path.dirname(src)
        idx = os.path.join(folder, SCREEN_INDEX)
        if os.path.isfile(idx):
            bits.append("<a href=\"{}\">{}</a>".format(
                html.escape(_link(idx, page_folder), quote=True), html.escape(idx)))
        else:
            bits.append(html.escape(src))
    return ("<p class='meta'>ND Dam Breach Screening results read from: {}. The screening "
            "and runner classes are the other plugins' screening previews; the ND class is "
            "this plugin's result.</p>").format("; ".join(bits))


def render_html(rows, parent_folder, when=None, screening=None, page_folder=None):
    """The dashboard page (text). `screening`: the Screening sources read (for the
    links on the page); `page_folder`: where the page is written (relative links)."""
    when = when or time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    page_folder = page_folder or parent_folder
    counts = {}
    for r in rows:
        k = str(r.get("ND_Class") or MISSING)
        counts[k] = counts.get(k, 0) + 1
    acts = {}
    for r in rows:
        k = str(r.get("Next_Action") or MISSING)
        acts[k] = acts.get(k, 0) + 1
    act_text = ", ".join("{} {}".format(acts[k], k) for k in ACTION_ORDER + (MISSING,)
                         if k in acts) or "none"
    title = "Dam portfolio - {}".format(os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(parent_folder)))
    out = ["<!DOCTYPE html>", "<html lang='en'><head><meta charset='utf-8'>",
           "<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>",
           "<title>{}</title>".format(html.escape(title)),
           "<style>{}</style></head><body>".format(_CSS),
           "<h1>{}</h1>".format(html.escape(title)),
           "<p class='meta'>Generated {} by {} v{} from the files of each dam's last run in "
           "{}. {} dam(s): {}.</p>".format(
               html.escape(when), html.escape(PLUGIN_NAME), html.escape(PLUGIN_VERSION),
               html.escape(parent_folder), len(rows),
               html.escape(", ".join("{} {}".format(v, k) for k, v in sorted(
                   counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -_rank(kv[0]))) or "none")),
           "<p class='meta'>The classes are the plugin's SCREENING results as last run - "
           "not hazard classifications until the engineer of record adopts them. '-' = not "
           "recorded or not run. Click a column heading to sort.</p>",
           "<p class='meta'>Next action (dams needing one are listed first): {}. It is "
           "worked out from dam.json and the files of the three plugins (screen, model, "
           "classify, review, refresh data older than a year, none) - a reminder, not a "
           "requirement.</p>".format(html.escape(act_text)),
           _screening_meta(screening, page_folder),
           "<table id='pf'><thead><tr>" + "".join(
               "<th>{}</th>".format(html.escape(label)) for _k, label, _t in _COLS)
           + "</tr></thead><tbody>"]
    for r in rows:
        cells = []
        for key, _label, kind in _COLS:
            val = r.get(key)
            if key == "Creep_Alert" and r.get("Creep_Message") not in (None, "", MISSING):
                cells.append(_cell(key, val, kind)[:-5] + '<div class="small">{}</div></td>'.format(
                    html.escape(str(r["Creep_Message"]), quote=True)))
                continue
            if key == "Oldest_Data_Date" and r.get("Oldest_Data_Source") not in (None, "",
                                                                                 MISSING):
                cells.append('<td title="{}">{}</td>'.format(
                    html.escape(str(r["Oldest_Data_Source"]), quote=True),
                    html.escape(str(val), quote=True)))
                continue
            if key == "Next_Action":
                cells.append(_with_small(_cell(key, val, kind), [r.get("Next_Action_Text")]))
                continue
            if key == "Screen_Class":
                extra = []
                if r.get("Screen_Border") not in (None, "", MISSING, "no"):
                    extra.append("borderline: {}".format(r["Screen_Border"]))
                if r.get("Screen_Gaps") not in (None, "", MISSING):
                    extra.append("data gaps: {}".format(r["Screen_Gaps"]))
                if r.get("Screen_Review") not in (None, "", MISSING):
                    extra.append("review: {}".format(r["Screen_Review"]))
                if r.get("Screen_Date") not in (None, "", MISSING):
                    extra.append("results of {}".format(r["Screen_Date"]))
                cells.append(_with_small(_cell(key, val, kind), extra))
                continue
            if key == "Runner_Class_Preview":
                extra = ["preview of {}".format(r["Runner_Preview_Date"])] if r.get(
                    "Runner_Preview_Date") not in (None, "", MISSING) else []
                cells.append(_with_small(_cell(key, val, kind), extra))
                continue
            if key == "Model_Date":
                cells.append(_with_small(_cell(key, val, kind), [
                    r.get("Model_Tool"), "manifest: {}".format(r["Model_Manifest"])
                    if r.get("Model_Manifest") not in (None, "", MISSING) else ""]))
                continue
            if key == "Dam":
                cells.append('<td title="{}"><b>{}</b></td>'.format(
                    html.escape(str(r.get("Folder") or ""), quote=True),
                    html.escape(str(val), quote=True)))
                continue
            cells.append(_cell(key, val, kind))
        out.append("<tr>" + "".join(cells) + "</tr>")
    out += ["</tbody></table>",
            "<p class='meta legend'><span class='chip' style='background:#c62828;color:#fff'>"
            "HIGH</span><span class='chip' style='background:#ef6c00;color:#fff'>SIGNIFICANT / "
            "MEDIUM</span><span class='chip' style='background:#2e7d32;color:#fff'>LOW</span>"
            "</p>",
            "<p class='meta legend'>" + "".join(
                "<span class='chip' style='background:{};color:#fff'>{}</span>".format(
                    _ACTION[k], k.upper()) for k in ACTION_ORDER) + "</p>",
            "<script>{}</script>".format(_JS), "</body></html>"]
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def build(parent_folder, out_path=None, screening=None, today=None):
    """Write the dashboard. Returns (html_path, csv_path, rows). `out_path`:
    the HTML file (default <parent>/Dam_Portfolio.html); the CSV is written
    next to it with the same name and .csv. `screening`: the ND Dam Breach
    Screening results (see screening_sources(); None = found automatically).
    Raises ValueError when `parent_folder` does not exist; a dam whose files
    are missing or unreadable is a row of "-"."""
    if not parent_folder or not os.path.isdir(parent_folder):
        raise ValueError("Folder not found: {}".format(parent_folder))
    sources = screening_sources(parent_folder, screening)
    rows = collect(parent_folder, sources if sources else False, today)
    hpath = out_path or os.path.join(parent_folder, HTML_FILE)
    if not hpath.lower().endswith((".html", ".htm")):
        hpath += ".html"
    folder = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(hpath))
    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
    cpath = _free_path(os.path.splitext(hpath)[0] + ".csv")
    hpath = _free_path(hpath)
    with open(cpath, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
        w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=PORTFOLIO_FIELDS)
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)
    with open(hpath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(render_html(rows, parent_folder, screening=sources, page_folder=folder))
    return hpath, cpath, rows
```

## `processing.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Project-layer discovery, raster samplers and the ACER TM 11 zone
rasters (Hazard_Foundations / Hazard_MobileHomes / Hazard_Vehicles)."""

import os
import re
import math

import numpy as np

from qgis.core import (
    QgsProject, QgsVectorLayer, QgsRasterLayer, QgsRectangle, QgsWkbTypes,
    QgsCoordinateTransform, QgsCsException,
)

from osgeo import gdal

from .compat import MSG_INFO, MSG_WARNING, GEOM_POINT, GEOM_LINE, GEOM_POLYGON
from .constants import (
    CLASS_NODATA, HAZARD_BLOCK_TARGET_CELLS, HAZARD_OVERVIEW_MIN_SIZE, vehicle_curve_available,
)
from .helpers import (
    log_message, get_layer_path, classify_values, curve_pair,
    log_threshold_verification, apply_acer11_style, add_layer_to_project,
    RasterSampler, buffer_distance_in_layer_units, gdal_exceptions,
    prepare_output_path, layer_file_path,
)

# NOTE: no module-level gdal.UseExceptions() - that silently changed GDAL
# behaviour for QGIS and every other plugin. See helpers.gdal_exceptions().

# Layer-name rules (matched on the lower-case name with "_", "-", "." read
# as spaces). "nsi"/"fema" must start a word ("Density", "Transit",
# "Female" do not match); "poi"/"pois" must be a whole word ("Points" does
# not match). Names containing "consolidated" are this plugin's outputs.
# FEMA point layers are recognised only so they are NOT taken as another
# group (v2.2: FEMA data enters through the FEMA_Structures outline file;
# FEMA point layers are no longer processed).
# The ND GIS Hub address points arrive under several names: the Hub item
# "NDGISHUB SiteStructure Address Points", the service layer
# "DBO_SiteStructureAddressPoints", or a user's "Address Points" export; a
# generic "address point(s)" name is only used when no NSI / FEMA rule
# matched first.
_GROUP_PATTERNS = (
    ("NSI", re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])nsi")),
    ("NDGISHUB", re.compile(r"gis ?hub|site ?structure")),
    (None, re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])fema(?!le)")),       # ignored (see above)
    ("NDGISHUB", re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])address ?points?(?![a-z])|(?<![a-z])addresspoints?")),
)


def _layer_name_key(name):
    return re.sub(r"[_\-.]+", " ", (name or "").lower())
_OUTPUT_NAME_MARKERS = ("consolidated", "poi_edited", "sample_points", "sample points")

RASTER_KEYS = ("depth", "vel", "arr")


def is_plugin_output_name(name):
    n = (name or "").lower()
    return any(m in n for m in _OUTPUT_NAME_MARKERS)


DATA_INDEX_FILE = "Downloaded_Data.csv"
# written when outputs/Data is created, so a download that stops part-way
# (cancel, error) still marks its layers as downloaded data
DATA_MARKER_FILE = ".nd_dam_downloaded_data"


def is_downloaded_data_layer(lyr):
    """v2.5.1: a layer saved by the Data & Output tab (outputs/Data, next to
    Downloaded_Data.csv). It is a record of the downloads - possibly limited
    to the flooded area - so auto-detection never takes it as an input (the
    runs read the same downloads from their cache). It can still be picked
    by name in a layer list."""
    try:
        from .constants import SUBDIR_DATA
        path = layer_file_path(lyr)
        folder = os.path.dirname(path)
        return bool(path) and os.path.basename(folder) == SUBDIR_DATA and (
            os.path.isfile(os.path.join(folder, DATA_INDEX_FILE))
            or os.path.isfile(os.path.join(folder, DATA_MARKER_FILE)))
    except Exception:
        return False


def discover_project_layers():
    """{"NSI": [...], "NDGISHUB": [...]}: the point layers of the project
    recognised by name. The plugin's own outputs and saved downloads are
    never inputs."""
    layer_dict = {"NSI": [], "NDGISHUB": []}
    for lyr in QgsProject.instance().mapLayers().values():
        if not isinstance(lyr, QgsVectorLayer) or not lyr.isValid():
            continue
        if is_plugin_output_name(lyr.name()) or is_downloaded_data_layer(lyr):
            continue
        if lyr.geometryType() != GEOM_POINT:
            continue
        name = _layer_name_key(lyr.name())
        for key, pattern in _GROUP_PATTERNS:
            if pattern.search(name):
                if key is not None:
                    layer_dict[key].append(lyr)
                break
    return layer_dict


def point_from_geometry(geom):
    """QgsPointXY of a (multi)point; a point on the surface for a line or
    polygon (e.g. a FEMA structure outline); None if not possible."""
    try:
        if geom is None or geom.isNull():
            return None
        gtype = geom.type()
        if gtype in (GEOM_LINE, GEOM_POLYGON):
            p = geom.pointOnSurface()
            return p.asPoint() if p is not None and not p.isNull() else None
        if QgsWkbTypes.isMultiType(geom.wkbType()):
            pts = geom.asMultiPoint()
            return pts[0] if pts else None
        return geom.asPoint()
    except Exception:
        return None


def safe_transform_point(xform, pt):
    """Transform a QgsPointXY; None if it lies outside the CRS's valid area."""
    if pt is None:
        return None
    if xform is None or xform.isShortCircuited():
        return pt
    try:
        return xform.transform(pt)
    except QgsCsException:
        return None


def raster_filter_rect(raster_layer, grow_ft, target_crs, transform_ctx):
    """Raster extent grown by `grow_ft` feet, expressed in `target_crs`
    (None means: do not filter). v1.1 transformed this rectangle in the
    wrong direction, which failed when point and raster CRSs differed."""
    try:
        rect = QgsRectangle(raster_layer.extent())
        rect.grow(buffer_distance_in_layer_units(grow_ft, raster_layer.crs()))
        xf = QgsCoordinateTransform(raster_layer.crs(), target_crs, transform_ctx)
        if xf.isShortCircuited():
            return rect
        out = xf.transformBoundingBox(rect)
        if out is None or out.isEmpty():
            return None
        if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (out.xMinimum(), out.yMinimum(),
                                                out.xMaximum(), out.yMaximum())):
            return None
        return out
    except QgsCsException:
        return None
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("Could not build spatial filter ({}); reading all features".format(e),
                    MSG_WARNING)
        return None


def make_samplers(depth_layer, velocity_layer, arrival_layer, buffer_ft):
    samplers = {}
    for key, lyr in zip(RASTER_KEYS, (depth_layer, velocity_layer, arrival_layer)):
        samplers[key] = RasterSampler(lyr, buffer_ft)
        if not samplers[key].ok:
            log_message("Raster '{}' could not be opened for sampling".format(
                lyr.name() if lyr else key), MSG_WARNING)
    return samplers


def close_samplers(samplers):
    for s in (samplers or {}).values():
        try:
            s.close()
        except Exception:
            pass


def _grids_aligned(ds_a, ds_b):
    gt_a, gt_b = ds_a.GetGeoTransform(), ds_b.GetGeoTransform()
    return (ds_a.RasterXSize == ds_b.RasterXSize
            and ds_a.RasterYSize == ds_b.RasterYSize
            and all(abs(a - b) < 1e-9 for a, b in zip(gt_a, gt_b))
            and ds_a.GetProjection() == ds_b.GetProjection())


def _aligned_velocity(ds_d, ds_v, v_nodata):
    """Velocity dataset on the depth grid. Uses a lazy in-memory VRT (reads
    and resamples only the rows being processed) instead of warping the whole
    raster into RAM."""
    if _grids_aligned(ds_d, ds_v):
        return ds_v
    width, height = ds_d.RasterXSize, ds_d.RasterYSize
    gt = ds_d.GetGeoTransform()
    proj = ds_d.GetProjection()
    kwargs = {"resampleAlg": "near"}
    if proj:
        kwargs["dstSRS"] = proj
    if v_nodata is not None:
        kwargs["srcNodata"] = v_nodata
    # cells outside the velocity raster must read as NoData, never as 0 ft/s
    # (the least severe velocity); callers treat <= -9999 as invalid
    dst_nd = v_nodata if v_nodata is not None else -9999.0
    kwargs["dstNodata"] = dst_nd
    north_up = gt[2] == 0 and gt[4] == 0 and gt[5] < 0
    if north_up:
        opts = gdal.WarpOptions(
            format="VRT", width=width, height=height,
            outputBounds=(gt[0], gt[3] + height * gt[5], gt[0] + width * gt[1], gt[3]),
            **kwargs)
        out = gdal.Warp("", ds_v, options=opts)
    else:
        # Rotated / south-up depth grid: warp into a dataset that carries the
        # exact depth geotransform so arrays line up cell for cell.
        out = gdal.GetDriverByName("MEM").Create("", width, height, 1, gdal.GDT_Float32)
        out.SetGeoTransform(gt)
        if proj:
            out.SetProjection(proj)
        band = out.GetRasterBand(1)
        band.SetNoDataValue(dst_nd)
        band.Fill(dst_nd)
        band = None
        gdal.Warp(out, ds_v, options=gdal.WarpOptions(**kwargs))
    if out is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Velocity raster alignment failed")
    return out


def _rows_per_block(width, height):
    rows = max(1, HAZARD_BLOCK_TARGET_CELLS // max(1, width))
    if rows >= 256:
        rows -= rows % 256          # whole output tiles per write
    return int(max(1, min(rows, height)))


def _create_class_raster(driver, path, width, height, gt, proj):
    ds = driver.Create(path, width, height, 1, gdal.GDT_Int16,
                       options=["COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES", "BIGTIFF=IF_SAFER"])
    if ds is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Could not create {}".format(path))
    ds.SetGeoTransform(gt)
    if proj:
        ds.SetProjection(proj)
    ds.GetRasterBand(1).SetNoDataValue(CLASS_NODATA)
    return ds


# v2.9: overview resampling of the class rasters (zone / band numbers: never
# averaged; "MODE" keeps the most common class but is slower)
ZONE_OVERVIEW_RESAMPLING = "NEAREST"


def _finalize_class_raster(ds, width, height, overviews=True):
    """Flush, (overviews=True) internal overviews on the open dataset -
    rasters larger than HAZARD_OVERVIEW_MIN_SIZE - and statistics.
    generate_hazard_rasters builds its overviews after closing the file
    instead (overviews.build_overviews)."""
    from .overviews import overview_levels
    band = ds.GetRasterBand(1)
    band.FlushCache()
    if overviews and max(width, height) > HAZARD_OVERVIEW_MIN_SIZE:
        levels = overview_levels(width, height)
        if levels:
            try:
                ds.BuildOverviews(ZONE_OVERVIEW_RESAMPLING, levels)
            except Exception as e:
                log_message("Overviews not built: {}".format(e), MSG_WARNING)
    try:
        band.ComputeStatistics(True)
    except Exception as e:
        # e.g. every cell is NoData - not a reason to fail the run
        log_message("Statistics not computed: {}".format(e), MSG_INFO)
    band = None
    ds.FlushCache()


def _scale_offset(band):
    scale, offset = band.GetScale(), band.GetOffset()
    scale = 1.0 if scale in (None, 0) else float(scale)
    offset = 0.0 if offset is None else float(offset)
    return scale, offset


def generate_hazard_rasters(output_folder, depth_layer, velocity_layer,
                            auto_style=True, progress_cb=None, add_to_project=True,
                            include_vehicle=True, group=None, overviews=True):
    """ACER TM 11 zone GeoTIFFs (1 High, 2 Judgment, 3 Low) on the depth
    grid from the maximum depth with the maximum velocity of each cell,
    processed in strips of rows (bounded memory). Returns {kind: path}.
    Hazard_Vehicles.tif (TM 11 Figure 4) is added when the vehicle curve is
    configured. Partial outputs are removed if cancelled or failed.
    add_to_project=False (worker threads): the caller loads the files.
    overviews: v2.9 - internal overviews (ZONE_OVERVIEW_RESAMPLING) in each
    file larger than HAZARD_OVERVIEW_MIN_SIZE px, built with
    overviews.build_overviews after the file is written (a failure is
    logged, never fails the run)."""
    from .hazard import ZONE_FILES
    d_path = get_layer_path(depth_layer)
    v_path = get_layer_path(velocity_layer) if velocity_layer is not None else None
    if not d_path:
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot determine the depth raster file path")
    if not v_path:
        raise RuntimeError("A velocity raster is needed for the ACER zone rasters "
                           "(max depth with max velocity)")

    def tick(pct, msg):
        if progress_cb:
            progress_cb(pct, msg)

    log_threshold_verification()
    os.makedirs(output_folder, exist_ok=True)
    kinds = ["found", "mobile"]
    if include_vehicle and vehicle_curve_available():
        kinds.append("vehicle")
    paths = {k: os.path.join(output_folder, ZONE_FILES[k]) for k in kinds}
    curves = {k: curve_pair(k) for k in kinds}
    _maxmax_rasters(d_path, v_path, paths, curves, kinds, tick, overviews=overviews)

    if add_to_project:
        tick(95, "Loading hazard layers...")
        for key in kinds:
            lyr = QgsRasterLayer(paths[key], "Hazard {}".format(key.capitalize()))
            if lyr.isValid():
                if auto_style:
                    apply_acer11_style(lyr)
                add_layer_to_project(lyr, group=group)
            else:
                log_message("Failed to load hazard raster: {}".format(paths[key]), MSG_WARNING)
    tick(100, "Hazard rasters done")
    return paths


def _zone_overviews(paths, kinds, width, height, tick):
    """v2.9: internal overviews in each written zone raster (large ones)."""
    if max(width, height) <= HAZARD_OVERVIEW_MIN_SIZE:
        return
    from .overviews import build_overviews
    for i, key in enumerate(kinds):
        tick(88 + 6.0 * i / max(1, len(kinds)), "Building overviews: {}...".format(
            os.path.basename(paths[key])))
        ok, text = build_overviews(paths[key], ZONE_OVERVIEW_RESAMPLING, external=False,
                                   compress="LZW")
        if not ok:
            log_message("Zone raster drawn without overviews - {}".format(text), MSG_WARNING)


def _maxmax_rasters(d_path, v_path, paths, curves, kinds, tick, overviews=True):
    with gdal_exceptions():
        ds_d = ds_v = ds_vw = band_d = band_v = None
        outs = {}
        created = []
        try:
            ds_d = gdal.Open(d_path, gdal.GA_ReadOnly)
            ds_v = gdal.Open(v_path, gdal.GA_ReadOnly)
            if ds_d is None or ds_v is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Could not open depth/velocity rasters with GDAL")

            tick(5, "Aligning velocity grid to depth grid...")
            width, height = ds_d.RasterXSize, ds_d.RasterYSize
            gt = ds_d.GetGeoTransform()
            proj = ds_d.GetProjection()
            v_nodata_src = ds_v.GetRasterBand(1).GetNoDataValue()
            ds_vw = _aligned_velocity(ds_d, ds_v, v_nodata_src)

            band_d = ds_d.GetRasterBand(1)
            band_v = ds_vw.GetRasterBand(1)
            d_nodata = band_d.GetNoDataValue()
            v_nodata = band_v.GetNoDataValue()
            if v_nodata is None:
                v_nodata = v_nodata_src
            d_scale, d_offset = _scale_offset(band_d)
            v_scale, v_offset = _scale_offset(ds_v.GetRasterBand(1))

            driver = gdal.GetDriverByName("GTiff")
            for key in kinds:
                paths[key] = prepare_output_path(paths[key])
                outs[key] = _create_class_raster(driver, paths[key], width, height, gt, proj)
                created.append(paths[key])

            rows = _rows_per_block(width, height)
            for y0 in range(0, height, rows):
                h = min(rows, height - y0)
                d = band_d.ReadAsArray(0, y0, width, h)
                v = band_v.ReadAsArray(0, y0, width, h)
                with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
                    # same validity rule as RasterSampler: > -9999 as well
                    # (ASCII grids may carry -9999 without a NoData tag)
                    valid = np.isfinite(d) & np.isfinite(v) & (d > -9999) & (v > -9999)
                if d_nodata is not None:
                    valid &= (d != d_nodata)
                if v_nodata is not None:
                    valid &= (v != v_nodata)
                # classify only the valid cells, in float64
                dv = d[valid].astype(np.float64)
                vv = v[valid].astype(np.float64)
                del d, v
                if d_scale != 1.0 or d_offset != 0.0:
                    dv = dv * d_scale + d_offset
                if v_scale != 1.0 or v_offset != 0.0:
                    vv = vv * v_scale + v_offset
                cls = np.empty((h, width), dtype=np.int16)
                for key in kinds:
                    cls.fill(CLASS_NODATA)
                    cls[valid] = classify_values(dv, vv, *curves[key])
                    outs[key].GetRasterBand(1).WriteArray(cls, 0, y0)
                del dv, vv, valid, cls
                tick(10 + 75.0 * (y0 + h) / height,
                     "Classifying hazard zones: row {} of {}".format(y0 + h, height))

            tick(86, "Finalising hazard GeoTIFFs (statistics)...")
            for key in list(outs):
                _finalize_class_raster(outs[key], width, height, overviews=False)
                outs[key] = None                 # closes the file
            outs.clear()
            if overviews:
                _zone_overviews(paths, kinds, width, height, tick)
        except Exception:
            outs.clear()                      # close before deleting
            for p in created:
                try:
                    if os.path.exists(p):
                        os.remove(p)
                except OSError:
                    pass
            raise
        finally:
            band_d = band_v = None
            ds_vw = None
            ds_v = None
            ds_d = None
```

## `processing_provider.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""QGIS Processing provider "ND Dam Hazard": the main steps as Processing
algorithms, so they can be run from the toolbox, in batch mode, in
graphical models and from the command line (qgis_process).

  ndhazard:acerzones   ACER TM 11 zone rasters (Dmax / Vmax) - runs in the
                       background
  ndhazard:classify    ND REG_05.2026 / TM 11 hazard classification (uses and
                       adds project layers, so it runs on the main thread)
  ndhazard:dsswise     import a DSS-WISE Lite results package
  ndhazard:batch       every dam folder of a folder (v2.9: WORKERS > 1 runs
                       that many dams at once as qgis_process children)
  ndhazard:creepwatch  hazard-creep watch over a folder of dams (watch.py)
  ndhazard:damsinseries, portfolio, reproduce, fillform (v2.8 / v2.9)
  v2.10 (the dam suite with ND Dam Breach Runner / ND Dam Breach Screening):
  ndhazard:ensemble        class probability over a model ensemble (ensemble.py)
  ndhazard:modelgate       checks of the flood model before the classification
  ndhazard:quickcreep      new structures in every dam's flood area, nothing re-run
  ndhazard:reviewpackage   reviewer's view of a submittal package; reviewsummary
  ndhazard:runnerculverts  culvert / bridge lines for the ND Dam Breach Runner
  ndhazard:suiteexport     data package for ND Dam Breach Screening (tool 0)
  ndhazard:chartsignoff    ACER TM 11 chart file for the other two plugins, sign-off
  ndhazard:rulecompare     this plugin's rules against the Runner / Screening rules
"""

import os
import traceback

from qgis.core import (
    Qgis, QgsProcessingProvider, QgsProcessingAlgorithm, QgsProcessingException,
    QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer, QgsProcessingParameterVectorLayer,
    QgsProcessingParameterFile, QgsProcessingParameterFolderDestination,
    QgsProcessingParameterBoolean, QgsProcessingParameterNumber, QgsProcessingParameterEnum,
    QgsProcessingParameterString,
    QgsProcessing, QgsProcessingOutputRasterLayer, QgsProcessingOutputString,
    QgsProcessingOutputFile, QgsProcessingOutputFolder,
)

from .compat import _first
from .constants import (
    PLUGIN_NAME, DEFAULT_EXTENT_BUFFER_FT, OUTPUT_FOLDER_NAME, MAPBOOK_SCALES,
    MAPBOOK_DEFAULT_SCALE,
)
from .helpers import CancelledByUser, get_layer_path

PROVIDER_ID = "ndhazard"
WT_TIMEOUT_MIN = 60             # watch worker processes: default limit per dam (minutes)


def _enum(*getters, default=None):
    return _first(*getters, default=default)


NUM_INTEGER = _enum(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingNumberParameterType.Integer,
                    lambda: QgsProcessingParameterNumber.Type.Integer,
                    lambda: QgsProcessingParameterNumber.Integer)
NUM_DOUBLE = _enum(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingNumberParameterType.Double,
                   lambda: QgsProcessingParameterNumber.Type.Double,
                   lambda: QgsProcessingParameterNumber.Double)
FILE_FOLDER = _enum(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingFileParameterBehavior.Folder,
                    lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Behavior.Folder,
                    lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Folder)
FILE_FILE = _enum(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingFileParameterBehavior.File,
                  lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Behavior.File,
                  lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.File)
NO_THREADING = _enum(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingAlgorithmFlag.NoThreading,
                     lambda: QgsProcessingAlgorithm.Flag.FlagNoThreading,
                     lambda: QgsProcessingAlgorithm.FlagNoThreading)
SRC_LINE = _enum(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingSourceType.VectorLine,
                 lambda: QgsProcessing.SourceType.TypeVectorLine,
                 lambda: QgsProcessing.TypeVectorLine)
SRC_POINT = _enum(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingSourceType.VectorPoint,
                  lambda: QgsProcessing.SourceType.TypeVectorPoint,
                  lambda: QgsProcessing.TypeVectorPoint)
SRC_POLYGON = _enum(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingSourceType.VectorPolygon,
                    lambda: QgsProcessing.SourceType.TypeVectorPolygon,
                    lambda: QgsProcessing.TypeVectorPolygon)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- worker mode --
# The hazard creep watch (watch.py) and, since v2.9, the batch classification
# can run every dam as its own `qgis_process
# run ndhazard:classify` child process. The classify algorithm's parameters do
# not cover every setting the watch needs (reuse_evaluation, save_evaluation,
# add_to_project, download_flowlines, ... - the pipeline's DEFAULTS), so the
# optional CONFIG_JSON parameter names a small JSON file {"<config key>": value}
# with pipeline settings. The file wins over the matching parameters. Only the
# JSON-safe scalar settings of pipeline.DEFAULTS are accepted (bool / number /
# text, of the same kind as the default); layers, "scenarios", "output_folder"
# and "dam_folder" are never taken from the file (the dam folder is the
# DAM_FOLDER parameter, its rasters are found in it). Unknown or wrongly typed
# keys are ignored and named in the log. Anything else a worker needs travels
# in the environment (offline data pack: ND_DAM_HAZARD_OFFLINE_PACK / _ONLY).
# v2.9: the file may also name, under RESULT_KEY, a file where the algorithm
# writes its result as JSON (classes, lives in jeopardy, governing reason,
# judgment items, report) - how the parent reads a worker's result without
# parsing its text output. Older plugin versions ignore the key (and say so).
_WORKER_RESERVED = ("output_folder", "dam_folder", "scenarios")
_SCALARS = (bool, int, float, str)
RESULT_KEY = "_result_file"
RESULT_VERSION = 1


def worker_setting_keys():
    """The config keys a CONFIG_JSON file may set."""
    from .pipeline import DEFAULTS
    return sorted(k for k, v in DEFAULTS.items()
                  if k not in _WORKER_RESERVED and not k.endswith("_layer")
                  and (v is None or isinstance(v, _SCALARS)))


def _setting_ok(default, value):
    if value is not None and not isinstance(value, _SCALARS):
        return False
    if default is None or value is None:
        return True
    if isinstance(default, bool):
        return isinstance(value, bool)
    if isinstance(default, (int, float)):
        return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
    return isinstance(value, str)


def worker_settings(cfg):
    """The part of a pipeline config a worker process can be given."""
    from .pipeline import DEFAULTS
    return {k: cfg[k] for k in worker_setting_keys() if k in cfg
            and _setting_ok(DEFAULTS.get(k), cfg[k])}


def write_worker_settings(path, settings):
    import json
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(settings, fh, indent=1, sort_keys=True)
    return path


def _read_worker_file(path):
    """(settings, ignored keys, result file path or "") of a CONFIG_JSON file."""
    import json
    from .pipeline import DEFAULTS
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        data = json.load(fh)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError("the settings file must hold a JSON object {\"setting\": value}")
    target = data.get(RESULT_KEY)
    target = target if isinstance(target, str) else ""
    ok = set(worker_setting_keys())
    good = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in ok and _setting_ok(DEFAULTS.get(k), v)}
    ignored = sorted(k for k in data if k not in good and not (k == RESULT_KEY and target))
    return good, ignored, target


def read_worker_settings(path):
    """(settings, ignored keys) of a CONFIG_JSON file. Raises ValueError /
    OSError when the file cannot be read or is not a JSON object."""
    good, ignored, _target = _read_worker_file(path)
    return good, ignored


def write_worker_result(path, cfg, res):
    """The result of a worker's classification as JSON (RESULT_KEY)."""
    import json
    import time
    nd, tm = res.get("nd") or {}, res.get("tm11") or {}
    try:
        lij = float(tm.get("lij") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        lij = 0.0
    data = {"version": RESULT_VERSION, "time": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
            "dam_folder": cfg.get("dam_folder") or "",
            "output_folder": cfg.get("output_folder") or "",
            "governing": str(res.get("governing") or ""),
            "nd": nd.get("cls") or "", "tm11": tm.get("cls") or "", "lij": lij,
            "reasons": [str(r) for r in (nd.get("reasons") or [])],
            "judgment_items": len(nd.get("judgment") or []),
            "report": str(res.get("report") or ""), "one_d": bool(cfg.get("one_d"))}
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(data, fh, indent=1)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    return path


def read_worker_result(path):
    """The dict written by write_worker_result, or None (missing, unreadable,
    another version)."""
    import json
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            data = json.load(fh)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("version") != RESULT_VERSION:
        return None
    return data


def _progress(feedback, lo=0.0, hi=100.0):
    def cb(pct, msg=""):
        if feedback is None:
            return
        if feedback.isCanceled():
            raise CancelledByUser()
        feedback.setProgress(lo + (hi - lo) * max(0.0, min(100.0, float(pct))) / 100.0)
        if msg:
            try:
                feedback.setProgressText(msg)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return cb


def _report_traceback(feedback):
    """Put the traceback of the exception being handled in the Processing log."""
    try:
        feedback.reportError(traceback.format_exc(), False)
    except Exception:
        pass


class _Base(QgsProcessingAlgorithm):
    def group(self):
        return "Dam hazard classification"

    def groupId(self):
        return "damhazard"

    def createInstance(self):
        return type(self)()

    def _raster_path(self, parameters, name, context):
        lyr = self.parameterAsRasterLayer(parameters, name, context)
        return get_layer_path(lyr) if lyr is not None else None

    def _int(self, parameters, name, context, default):
        try:
            return int(self.parameterAsInt(parameters, name, context))
        except AttributeError:
            pass
        try:
            return int(parameters.get(name, default))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return int(default)


class AcerZonesAlgorithm(_Base):
    def name(self):
        return "acerzones"

    def displayName(self):
        return "ACER TM 11 hazard zone rasters"

    def shortHelpString(self):
        return ("Houses on foundations, mobile homes and passenger vehicles (TM 11 Figs 2-4) "
                "from the maximum depth with the maximum velocity (Dmax / Vmax).")

    def initAlgorithm(self, config=None):
        self.addParameter(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("DEPTH", "Maximum depth (ft)"))
        self.addParameter(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer(
            "VELOCITY", "Maximum velocity (ft/s)"))
        self.addParameter(QgsProcessingParameterFolderDestination("OUTPUT", "Output folder"))
        for key, label in (("FOUNDATIONS", "ACER zones - houses on foundations"),
                           ("MOBILE", "ACER zones - mobile homes"),
                           ("VEHICLES", "ACER zones - passenger vehicles")):
            self.addOutput(QgsProcessingOutputRasterLayer(key, label))
        self.addOutput(QgsProcessingOutputString("METHOD_USED", "Method used"))

    def processAlgorithm(self, parameters, context, feedback):
        from .hazard import METHOD_MAXMAX
        from .processing import generate_hazard_rasters
        depth = self.parameterAsRasterLayer(parameters, "DEPTH", context)
        vel = self.parameterAsRasterLayer(parameters, "VELOCITY", context)
        if vel is None:
            raise QgsProcessingException("A maximum velocity raster is needed (Dmax / Vmax).")
        # parameterAsFileOutput resolves "Save to temporary folder"
        out = self.parameterAsFileOutput(parameters, "OUTPUT", context)
        os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            res = generate_hazard_rasters(out, depth, vel, progress_cb=_progress(feedback),
                                          add_to_project=False)
        except CancelledByUser as e:
            raise QgsProcessingException("Cancelled") from e
        except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError) as e:
            raise QgsProcessingException(str(e)) from e
        except Exception as e:                    # never an unhandled crash
            _report_traceback(feedback)
            raise QgsProcessingException("Unexpected error: {!r}".format(e)) from e
        feedback.pushInfo("Method: max depth with max velocity (Dmax / Vmax)")
        return {"OUTPUT": out, "FOUNDATIONS": res.get("found"), "MOBILE": res.get("mobile"),
                "VEHICLES": res.get("vehicle"), "METHOD_USED": METHOD_MAXMAX}


class ClassifyAlgorithm(_Base):
    def name(self):
        return "classify"

    def displayName(self):
        return "Dam hazard classification (ND REG_05.2026 / ACER TM 11)"

    def shortHelpString(self):
        return ("Runs the plugin's Hazard Classification for a dam folder: structures "
                "(project NSI / ND GIS Hub layers, FEMA_Structures outlines in the outputs "
                "folder, optional downloads), roads, rail, consequences, optional no-breach "
                "baseline for the incremental classification, summary and PDF report in "
                "<dam folder>/outputs.")

    def flags(self):
        return super().flags() | NO_THREADING

    def initAlgorithm(self, config=None):
        P = self.addParameter
        P(QgsProcessingParameterFile("DAM_FOLDER", "Dam project folder", behavior=FILE_FOLDER))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("DEPTH", "Breach: maximum depth (ft) - empty: "
                                            "found in the dam folder", optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("VELOCITY", "Breach: maximum velocity (ft/s)",
                                            optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("ARRIVAL", "Breach: arrival time (h)",
                                            optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("DXV", "Breach: max depth x velocity (ft2/s)",
                                            optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("BASE_DEPTH", "No-breach baseline: max depth",
                                            optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("BASE_VELOCITY", "No-breach baseline: max "
                                            "velocity", optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("BASE_ARRIVAL", "No-breach baseline: arrival",
                                            optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterVectorLayer("ROADS", "Road lines", [SRC_LINE], optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterVectorLayer("AADT", "AADT layer", optional=True))
```
