## `rasimport.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.5: HEC-RAS 6.x plan results (<project>.p##.hdf) to the plugin's
rasters, without the RAS Mapper export step.

Read from the plan HDF, for every 2D flow area:
  /Geometry/2D Flow Areas/<area>/Cells Center Coordinate, Cells Minimum
      Elevation, Cells Face and Orientation Info / Values
  /Results/Unsteady/Output/Output Blocks/Base Output/Summary Output/
      2D Flow Areas/<area>/Maximum Water Surface   (row 0 value, row 1 time
      in days), Maximum Face Velocity
  .../Unsteady Time Series/2D Flow Areas/<area>/Water Surface and
      .../Unsteady Time Series/Time (days)         (arrival time)
  root attributes "Projection" (WKT) and "Units System"

Written (GeoTIFF, Float32, NoData -9999; ft, ft/s, hours):
  WSE_ft.tif          maximum water surface of the cell containing the pixel
  Depth_ft.tif        with a terrain raster: max WSE - terrain on the
                      terrain grid (like RAS Mapper's "horizontal" WSE
                      rendering); without: max WSE - cell minimum elevation
                      (deepest point of each cell - conservative)
  Velocity_ftps.tif   largest |max face velocity| over the cell's faces
                      (face-normal speeds; RAS Mapper interpolates a full
                      velocity field - its rasters can differ at cell edges)
  Arrival_hr.tif      first output time the cell depth (WSE - minimum
                      elevation) exceeds the arrival depth, minus the breach
                      start time (0 = simulation start); needs time-series
                      output
  TimeOfPeak_hr.tif   time of the maximum water surface, minus breach start
Pixels are assigned to the nearest cell centre (RAS cells are Voronoi-type
polygons, so this is the cell that contains the pixel) within a search
radius; pixels beyond it are NoData.

The HDF is read with h5py when QGIS has it, else with GDAL's
multidimensional HDF5 driver (GDAL >= 3.1).

v2.9 - a plan HDF used DIRECTLY as a classification input (no Import step):
  is_plan_hdf(path)          cheap check (name *.p##.hdf + HDF5 signature;
                             deep=True: the 2D summary results group)
  plan_settings(settings)    the import options as a dict (defaults as the
                             HEC-RAS plan tab): dem, breach_hr, arrival_ft,
                             cell_ft
  plan_key(path, settings)   cache key: plan size / mtime / first + last MB,
                             the options, the terrain file, the import code
  plan_to_rasters_cached()   import_plan() into <cache_root>/<plan>_<key12>/,
                             re-used while the key matches (manifest.json;
                             written in a temporary folder and renamed, so a
                             crash never leaves a folder that looks complete)
  plan_cache_lookup()        the cached rasters without converting (or None)
The conversion never touches the project or widgets: it can run in a worker
thread (the one project call inside, prepare_output_path, is a no-op off the
main thread and finds nothing to release in a fresh folder anyway).
"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import time

import numpy as np

GEOM = "/Geometry/2D Flow Areas"
SUMMARY = "/Results/Unsteady/Output/Output Blocks/Base Output/Summary Output/2D Flow Areas"
TSERIES = "/Results/Unsteady/Output/Output Blocks/Base Output/Unsteady Time Series"
FT_PER_M = 3.28083989501312
NODATA = -9999.0
OUT_NAMES = {"wse": "WSE_ft.tif", "depth": "Depth_ft.tif", "vel": "Velocity_ftps.tif",
             "arr": "Arrival_hr.tif", "peak": "TimeOfPeak_hr.tif"}


class RasImportError(Exception):
    pass


def _txt(v):
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (bytes, bytearray)):
        return bytes(v).decode("utf-8", "replace").strip("\x00 ")
    if isinstance(v, np.ndarray):
        if v.size == 1:
            return _txt(v.ravel()[0])
        return v
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) and len(v) == 1:
        return _txt(v[0])
    return v


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- readers --
class _H5(object):
    name = "h5py"

    def __init__(self, path):
        import h5py
        self._h5 = h5py
        self.f = h5py.File(path, "r")

    def groups(self, path):
        g = self.f.get(path)
        if g is None:
            return []
        return [k for k, v in g.items() if isinstance(v, self._h5.Group)]

    def has(self, path):
        return path in self.f

    def shape(self, path):
        return tuple(self.f[path].shape)

    def read(self, path, cols=None):
        ds = self.f[path]
        if cols is None:
            return np.asarray(ds[()])
        return np.asarray(ds[:, cols[0]:cols[1]])

    def attr(self, path, name):
        obj = self.f[path] if path not in ("", "/") else self.f
        return _txt(obj.attrs.get(name))

    def field(self, path, name):
        ds = self.f[path]
        try:
            return np.asarray(ds[name])
        except Exception:
            return None

    def close(self):
        try:
            self.f.close()
        except Exception:
            pass


class _GdalMD(object):
    name = "GDAL multidimensional"

    def __init__(self, path):
        from osgeo import gdal
        if not hasattr(gdal, "OF_MULTIDIM_RASTER"):
            raise RasImportError("this GDAL has no multidimensional API (GDAL >= 3.1)")
        self.ds = gdal.OpenEx(path, gdal.OF_MULTIDIM_RASTER)
        if self.ds is None:
            raise RasImportError("GDAL cannot open {} as HDF5".format(path))
        self.root = self.ds.GetRootGroup()

    def _group(self, path):
        g = self.root
        for part in [p for p in path.strip("/").split("/") if p]:
            try:
                g = g.OpenGroup(part)
            except Exception:
                g = None
            if g is None:
                return None
        return g

    def _array(self, path):
        parent, name = path.rsplit("/", 1)
        g = self._group(parent)
        if g is None:
            return None
        try:
            return g.OpenMDArray(name)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def groups(self, path):
        g = self._group(path)
        return list(g.GetGroupNames() or []) if g is not None else []

    def has(self, path):
        return self._array(path) is not None or self._group(path) is not None

    def shape(self, path):
        a = self._array(path)
        return tuple(int(d.GetSize()) for d in a.GetDimensions())

    def read(self, path, cols=None):
        a = self._array(path)
        if a is None:
            raise KeyError(path)
        if cols is None:
            return np.asarray(a.ReadAsArray())
        dims = [int(d.GetSize()) for d in a.GetDimensions()]
        return np.asarray(a.ReadAsArray(array_start_idx=[0, int(cols[0])],
                                        count=[dims[0], int(cols[1] - cols[0])]))

    def attr(self, path, name):
        obj = self._group(path) if path in ("", "/") or self._array(path) is None \
            else self._array(path)
        if obj is None:
            return None
        try:
            at = obj.GetAttribute(name)
            return _txt(at.Read()) if at is not None else None
        except Exception:
            return None

    def field(self, path, name):
        return None                       # compound datasets: not needed with GDAL

    def close(self):
        self.root = None
        self.ds = None


def open_hdf(path):
    errors = []
    for cls in (_H5, _GdalMD):
        try:
            return cls(path)
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append("{}: {}".format(cls.name, e))
    raise RasImportError("the plan HDF cannot be read here ({})".format("; ".join(errors)))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ plan info --
def plan_info(h):
    """dict: areas, units ('US Customary' / 'SI Units' / ''), is_si,
    projection WKT, time steps, plan title."""
    areas = [a for a in h.groups(GEOM)]
    units = h.attr("/", "Units System") or ""
    proj = h.attr("/", "Projection") or ""
    t = TSERIES + "/Time"
    steps = h.shape(t)[0] if h.has(t) else 0
    title = h.attr("/Plan Data/Plan Information", "Plan Title") if h.has(
        "/Plan Data/Plan Information") else None
    with_results = [a for a in areas if h.has("{}/{}/Maximum Water Surface".format(SUMMARY, a))]
    return {"areas": areas, "with_results": with_results, "units": units or "",
            "is_si": "si" in (units or "").lower(), "projection": proj or "",
            "time_steps": int(steps), "title": title or "", "reader": h.name}


def _real_cells(h, area, n_all):
    """Number of real cells of an area (the arrays end with perimeter ghost
    cells): the 'Cell Count' of /Geometry/2D Flow Areas/Attributes when it
    can be read, else the cells with a finite minimum elevation."""
    names = h.field(GEOM + "/Attributes", "Name")
    counts = h.field(GEOM + "/Attributes", "Cell Count")
    if names is not None and counts is not None:
        for nm, c in zip(names, counts):
            if _txt(nm) == area:
                return min(int(c), n_all), None
    elev = h.read("{}/{}/Cells Minimum Elevation".format(GEOM, area))
    ok = np.isfinite(elev)
    if ok.all():
        return n_all, None
    # ghost cells are at the end; keep the leading finite block
    first_bad = int(np.argmin(ok)) if not ok[0] else 0
    return (first_bad if first_bad > 0 else int(ok.sum())), ok


def cell_velocity(face_vel, info, values, n):
    """Per-cell max |face velocity| (vectorised). info: (N, 2) start, count;
    values: (M, 2) face index, orientation."""
    face_vel = np.abs(np.asarray(face_vel, dtype=np.float64))
    starts = np.asarray(info[:n, 0], dtype=np.int64)
    counts = np.asarray(info[:n, 1], dtype=np.int64)
    faces = np.asarray(values[:, 0], dtype=np.int64)
    out = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float64)
    ok = counts > 0
    if not ok.any():
        return out
    idx = np.repeat(np.arange(n)[ok], counts[ok])
    pos = np.concatenate([np.arange(s, s + c) for s, c in zip(starts[ok], counts[ok])]) \
        if ok.sum() < 2000 else _ranges(starts[ok], counts[ok])
    fv = face_vel[np.clip(faces[pos], 0, face_vel.size - 1)]
    np.maximum.at(out, idx, fv)
    return out


def _ranges(starts, counts):
    """np.concatenate([arange(s, s + c) ...]) without a Python loop."""
    total = int(counts.sum())
    ends = np.cumsum(counts)
    out = np.ones(total, dtype=np.int64)
    out[0] = starts[0]
    out[ends[:-1]] = starts[1:] - (starts[:-1] + counts[:-1] - 1)
    return np.cumsum(out)


def arrival_days(ws_series, min_elev, threshold, chunk_rows=None):
    """First time index at which ws - min_elev > threshold, per cell (-1:
    never). ws_series: (T, n) array."""
    wet = (ws_series - min_elev[None, :]) > threshold
    anyw = wet.any(axis=0)
    first = np.argmax(wet, axis=0)
    return np.where(anyw, first, -1)


def read_area(h, area, is_si, breach_hr=0.0, arrival_ft=0.1, progress=None):
    """Cell arrays of one 2D flow area in ft / ft/s / h:
    {"x", "y", "zmin", "wse", "vel", "arr", "peak"} (NaN = no value)."""
    g = "{}/{}".format(GEOM, area)
    s = "{}/{}".format(SUMMARY, area)
    xy = h.read(g + "/Cells Center Coordinate")
    n_all = xy.shape[0]
    n, ok_mask = _real_cells(h, area, n_all)
    zmin = h.read(g + "/Cells Minimum Elevation").astype(np.float64)[:n]
    mws = h.read(s + "/Maximum Water Surface").astype(np.float64)
    if mws.ndim != 2 or mws.shape[1] < n:
        raise RasImportError("{}: Maximum Water Surface has shape {} for {} cells".format(
            area, mws.shape, n))
    wse, t_max = mws[0, :n], mws[1, :n]
    k = FT_PER_M if is_si else 1.0
    out = {"x": xy[:n, 0].astype(np.float64), "y": xy[:n, 1].astype(np.float64)}
    wet = np.isfinite(wse) & np.isfinite(zmin) & (wse - zmin > 1e-4)
    out["zmin"] = zmin * k
    out["wse"] = np.where(wet, wse * k, np.nan)
    out["peak"] = np.where(wet, np.maximum(t_max * 24.0 - breach_hr, 0.0), np.nan)
    # velocity
    vel = np.full(n, np.nan)
    fvp = s + "/Maximum Face Velocity"
    if h.has(fvp) and h.has(g + "/Cells Face and Orientation Info"):
        fv = h.read(fvp).astype(np.float64)
        fv = fv[0] if fv.ndim == 2 else fv
        info = h.read(g + "/Cells Face and Orientation Info")
        vals = h.read(g + "/Cells Face and Orientation Values")
        vel = cell_velocity(fv, info, vals, n) * k
        vel = np.where(wet, vel, np.nan)
    out["vel"] = vel
    # arrival from the time series
    arr = np.full(n, np.nan)
    tsp = "{}/2D Flow Areas/{}/Water Surface".format(TSERIES, area)
    if h.has(tsp) and h.has(TSERIES + "/Time"):
        times = h.read(TSERIES + "/Time").astype(np.float64).ravel()
        shp = h.shape(tsp)
        thr = arrival_ft / k                      # model units
        step = max(1, int(4.0e7 // max(1, shp[0])))
        first = np.full(n, -1, dtype=np.int64)
        for i0 in range(0, n, step):
            i1 = min(n, i0 + step)
            ws = h.read(tsp, cols=(i0, i1)).astype(np.float64)
            first[i0:i1] = arrival_days(ws, zmin[i0:i1], thr)
            if progress:
                progress(100.0 * i1 / n, "{}: arrival times {} of {} cells".format(
                    area, i1, n))
        got = first >= 0
        arr[got] = np.maximum(times[first[got]] * 24.0 - breach_hr, 0.0)
        arr = np.where(wet, arr, np.nan)
    out["arr"] = arr
    out["n"] = n
    return out


def _spacing(xs, ys, h=None, area=None, n=None):
    """Typical cell size (model units): sqrt of the median cell area when
    stored, else from the extent and the cell count."""
    if h is not None and area is not None:
        p = "{}/{}/Cells Surface Area".format(GEOM, area)
        if h.has(p):
            a = h.read(p).astype(np.float64)[:n]
            a = a[np.isfinite(a) & (a > 0)]
            if a.size:
                return float(np.sqrt(np.median(a))), float(np.sqrt(np.percentile(a, 95)))
    w = float(xs.max() - xs.min()) or 1.0
    ht = float(ys.max() - ys.min()) or 1.0
    s = float(np.sqrt(w * ht / max(1, xs.size)))
    return s, 2.0 * s


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ rasters --
def _write_csv(path, cells):
    """Cell centres and values as CSV (fast for millions of cells); GDAL
    reads it as points through the CSV driver's X / Y open options."""
    fields = ("wse", "zmin", "vel", "arr", "peak")
    cols = [cells["x"], cells["y"]] + [np.where(np.isfinite(cells[f]), cells[f], NODATA)
                                       for f in fields]
    np.savetxt(path, np.column_stack(cols), delimiter=",", fmt="%.6f", comments="",
               header="x,y," + ",".join(fields))


def _open_points(tmp_base, cells, srs_wkt):
    """(OGR dataset of the cell points for gdal.Grid, layer name, files to
    remove): a CSV read as points; a GeoPackage if this GDAL cannot."""
    from osgeo import gdal
    csv_path = tmp_base + ".csv"
    _write_csv(csv_path, cells)
    try:
        ds = gdal.OpenEx(csv_path, gdal.OF_VECTOR, open_options=[
            "X_POSSIBLE_NAMES=x", "Y_POSSIBLE_NAMES=y", "AUTODETECT_TYPE=YES",
            "KEEP_GEOM_COLUMNS=NO"])
        if ds is not None and ds.GetLayerCount() == 1:
            lyr = ds.GetLayer(0)
            if lyr.GetGeomType() != 0 and lyr.GetFeatureCount() == cells["x"].size:
                return ds, lyr.GetName(), [csv_path]
        ds = None
    except Exception:
        ds = None
    gpkg = tmp_base + ".gpkg"
    _write_points(gpkg, cells, srs_wkt)
    return gdal.OpenEx(gpkg, gdal.OF_VECTOR), "cells", [csv_path, gpkg]


def _write_points(path, cells, srs_wkt):
    from osgeo import ogr, osr
    drv = ogr.GetDriverByName("GPKG")
    if os.path.exists(path):
        drv.DeleteDataSource(path)
    ds = drv.CreateDataSource(path)
    srs = None
    if srs_wkt:
        srs = osr.SpatialReference()
        srs.ImportFromWkt(srs_wkt)
    lyr = ds.CreateLayer("cells", srs, ogr.wkbPoint)
    fields = ("wse", "zmin", "vel", "arr", "peak")
    for f in fields:
        lyr.CreateField(ogr.FieldDefn(f, ogr.OFTReal))
    defn = lyr.GetLayerDefn()
    lyr.StartTransaction()
    xs, ys = cells["x"], cells["y"]
    cols = {f: np.where(np.isfinite(cells[f]), cells[f], NODATA) for f in fields}
    for i in range(xs.size):
        ft = ogr.Feature(defn)
        for f in fields:
            ft.SetField(f, float(cols[f][i]))
        pt = ogr.Geometry(ogr.wkbPoint)
        pt.AddPoint_2D(float(xs[i]), float(ys[i]))
        ft.SetGeometry(pt)
        lyr.CreateFeature(ft)
    lyr.CommitTransaction()
    ds = None


def _grid(src, dst, field, bounds, width, height, radius, srs_wkt, layer="cells"):
    from osgeo import gdal
    opts = gdal.GridOptions(
        format="GTiff", outputType=gdal.GDT_Float32, width=int(width), height=int(height),
        outputBounds=list(bounds), outputSRS=srs_wkt or None, noData=NODATA,
        algorithm="nearest:radius1={r}:radius2={r}:angle=0.0:nodata={nd}".format(
            r=radius, nd=NODATA),
        layers=[layer], zfield=field, creationOptions=["TILED=YES", "COMPRESS=DEFLATE"])
    ds = gdal.Grid(dst, src, options=opts)
    if ds is None:
        raise RasImportError("gdal.Grid failed for {}".format(field))
    ds = None


def import_plan(hdf_path, out_folder, dem_path=None, cell_ft=0.0, breach_hr=0.0,
                arrival_ft=0.1, progress=None):
    """Convert a plan's 2D results. Returns {"paths": {key: tif}, "lines",
    "notes", "info"}."""
    from osgeo import gdal
    notes, lines = [], []
    h = open_hdf(hdf_path)
    try:
        info = plan_info(h)
        if not info["with_results"]:
            raise RasImportError("no 2D flow area results in {} (areas: {}) - run the plan "
                                 "with 2D output first".format(
                                     os.path.basename(hdf_path),
                                     ", ".join(info["areas"]) or "none"))
        is_si = info["is_si"]
        k = FT_PER_M if is_si else 1.0
        cells = {f: [] for f in ("x", "y", "zmin", "wse", "vel", "arr", "peak")}
        spacing = []
        for ai, area in enumerate(info["with_results"]):
            def sub(p, m="", ai=ai):
                if progress:
                    progress(40.0 * (ai + p / 100.0) / len(info["with_results"]), m)
            c = read_area(h, area, is_si, breach_hr, arrival_ft, sub)
            for f in cells:
                cells[f].append(c[f])
            spacing.append(_spacing(c["x"], c["y"], h, area, c["n"]))
            lines.append("{}: {:,} cells, {:,} wet, max depth {:.1f} ft".format(
                area, c["n"], int(np.isfinite(c["wse"]).sum()),
                float(np.nanmax(c["wse"] - c["zmin"])) if np.isfinite(c["wse"]).any()
                else 0.0))
            if not np.isfinite(c["arr"]).any():
                notes.append("{}: no time-series output - no arrival raster (turn on "
                             "'2D Flow Area' time-series output in the plan)".format(area))
            if not np.isfinite(c["vel"]).any():
                notes.append("{}: no face velocity output - no velocity raster".format(area))
        cells = {f: np.concatenate(v) for f, v in cells.items()}
    finally:
        h.close()
    wkt = info["projection"]
    dem = gdal.Open(dem_path) if dem_path else None
    if dem is not None and not wkt:
        wkt = dem.GetProjection()
        notes.append("the plan HDF has no projection - the terrain raster's is used")
    if dem is not None and info["projection"] and dem.GetProjection():
        try:
            from osgeo import osr
            a, b = osr.SpatialReference(), osr.SpatialReference()
            a.ImportFromWkt(info["projection"])
            b.ImportFromWkt(dem.GetProjection())
            if not a.IsSame(b):
                notes.append("the terrain raster's coordinate system differs from the plan's "
                             "- nothing is reprojected; check that they match")
        except Exception:
            pass
    if not wkt:
        raise RasImportError("the plan HDF has no projection (set it in RAS Mapper) - give "
                             "the terrain raster so its coordinate system can be used")
    med, p95 = (float(np.median([s[0] for s in spacing])), max(s[1] for s in spacing))
    radius = 1.5 * p95                          # model units (as the coordinates)
    xs, ys = cells["x"], cells["y"]
    xmin, xmax = float(xs.min()) - radius, float(xs.max()) + radius
    ymin, ymax = float(ys.min()) - radius, float(ys.max()) + radius
    if dem is not None:
        gt = dem.GetGeoTransform()
        if gt[2] != 0 or gt[4] != 0:
            raise RasImportError("rotated terrain rasters are not supported")
        c0 = max(0, int(np.floor((xmin - gt[0]) / gt[1])))
        c1 = min(dem.RasterXSize, int(np.ceil((xmax - gt[0]) / gt[1])))
        r0 = max(0, int(np.floor((ymax - gt[3]) / gt[5])))
        r1 = min(dem.RasterYSize, int(np.ceil((ymin - gt[3]) / gt[5])))
        if c1 <= c0 or r1 <= r0:
            raise RasImportError("the terrain raster does not cover the 2D flow areas (same "
                                 "coordinate system?)")
        width, height = c1 - c0, r1 - r0
        bounds = (gt[0] + c0 * gt[1], gt[3] + r0 * gt[5],
                  gt[0] + c1 * gt[1], gt[3] + r1 * gt[5])
        pix = abs(gt[1])
    else:
        pix = (cell_ft / k) if cell_ft and cell_ft > 0 else max(med / 2.0, 1e-6)
        width = int(np.ceil((xmax - xmin) / pix))
        height = int(np.ceil((ymax - ymin) / pix))
        bounds = (xmin, ymin + height * pix, xmin + width * pix, ymin)
        c0 = r0 = 0
        notes.append("no terrain raster: depth = max water surface - cell minimum elevation "
                     "(deepest point of each cell), {:.1f} ft pixels".format(pix * k))
    if width * height > 400e6:
        raise RasImportError("output grid of {:,} x {:,} pixels is too large - give a "
                             "coarser cell size".format(width, height))
    os.makedirs(out_folder, exist_ok=True)
    if progress:
        progress(45.0, "Writing {:,} cell centres...".format(xs.size))
    src, lname, tmp_files = _open_points(os.path.join(out_folder, "_cells"), cells, wkt)
    if src is None:
        raise RasImportError("the cell centres could not be written for gridding")
    grids = {}
    old = gdal.GetConfigOption("GDAL_NUM_THREADS")
    gdal.SetConfigOption("GDAL_NUM_THREADS", "ALL_CPUS")
    try:
        fields = ["wse", "vel", "arr", "peak"] + ([] if dem is not None else ["zmin"])
        for i, f in enumerate(fields):
            if f in ("vel", "arr", "peak") and not np.isfinite(cells[f]).any():
                continue
            if progress:
                progress(50.0 + 30.0 * i / len(fields), "Gridding {}...".format(f))
            dst = os.path.join(out_folder, "_grid_{}.tif".format(f))
            _grid(src, dst, f, bounds, width, height, radius, wkt, lname)
            grids[f] = dst
    finally:
        src = None
        gdal.SetConfigOption("GDAL_NUM_THREADS", old)
    paths = _finish(out_folder, grids, dem, (c0, r0, width, height), k, progress)
    for p in tmp_files + list(grids.values()):
        try:
            os.remove(p)
        except OSError:
            pass
    dem = None
    return {"paths": paths, "lines": lines, "notes": notes, "info": info,
            "pixel_ft": pix * k}


def _finish(folder, grids, dem, win, k, progress=None, rows=512):
    """Final rasters from the gridded cell values, strip by strip: depth,
    and velocity / arrival / peak only where depth > 0."""
    from osgeo import gdal
    c0, r0, w, h = win
    ref = gdal.Open(grids["wse"])
    gt, prj = ref.GetGeoTransform(), ref.GetProjection()
    drv = gdal.GetDriverByName("GTiff")
    outs = {}
    from .helpers import prepare_output_path
    for key in ("wse", "depth", "vel", "arr", "peak"):
        if key in ("vel", "arr", "peak") and key not in grids:
            continue
        # a copy loaded in QGIS is released first; a locked one (open in
        # another program) gets a time-stamped name instead of failing
        p = prepare_output_path(os.path.join(folder, OUT_NAMES[key]))
        ds = drv.Create(p, w, h, 1, gdal.GDT_Float32,
                        ["TILED=YES", "COMPRESS=DEFLATE", "BIGTIFF=IF_SAFER"])
        if ds is None:
            raise RasImportError("{} could not be created".format(p))
        ds.SetGeoTransform(gt)
        ds.SetProjection(prj)
        ds.GetRasterBand(1).SetNoDataValue(NODATA)
        outs[key] = ds
    ds = None
    src = {kk: gdal.Open(v) for kk, v in grids.items()}
    dband = dem.GetRasterBand(1) if dem is not None else None
    dnd = dband.GetNoDataValue() if dband is not None else None
    for y0 in range(0, h, rows):
        hh = min(rows, h - y0)
        wse = src["wse"].GetRasterBand(1).ReadAsArray(0, y0, w, hh).astype(np.float64)
        wse[wse == NODATA] = np.nan
        if dband is not None:
            z = dband.ReadAsArray(c0, r0 + y0, w, hh).astype(np.float64)
            if dnd is not None:
                z[z == dnd] = np.nan
            z = z * k                                  # terrain in the model's units
        else:
            z = src["zmin"].GetRasterBand(1).ReadAsArray(0, y0, w, hh).astype(np.float64)
            z[z == NODATA] = np.nan
        with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
            depth = wse - z
            wet = np.isfinite(depth) & (depth > 0)
        outs["wse"].GetRasterBand(1).WriteArray(np.where(np.isfinite(wse), wse, NODATA)
                                                .astype(np.float32), 0, y0)
        outs["depth"].GetRasterBand(1).WriteArray(np.where(wet, depth, NODATA)
                                                  .astype(np.float32), 0, y0)
        for key in ("vel", "arr", "peak"):
            if key not in outs:
                continue
            v = src[key].GetRasterBand(1).ReadAsArray(0, y0, w, hh).astype(np.float64)
            ok = wet & (v != NODATA) & np.isfinite(v)
            outs[key].GetRasterBand(1).WriteArray(np.where(ok, v, NODATA).astype(np.float32),
                                                  0, y0)
        if progress:
            progress(80.0 + 20.0 * (y0 + hh) / h, "Writing rasters...")
    paths = {}
    for key in list(outs):
        outs[key].FlushCache()
        paths[key] = outs[key].GetDescription()
        outs[key] = None                     # closes the file (Windows keeps it locked)
    src.clear()
    ref = None
    return paths


def slug(path):
    base = os.path.basename(path)
    base = re.sub(r"\.hdf$", "", base, flags=re.I)
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", base).strip("_")[:40] or "plan"


# ------------------------------------------ v2.9: plans read directly (cache) --
PLAN_RE = re.compile(r"\.p\d{2}\.hdf$", re.I)      # <project>.p01.hdf (not .p01.tmp.hdf)
HDF5_SIGNATURE = b"\x89HDF\r\n\x1a\n"
# Bump when import_plan() writes different rasters for the same input. The
# key also holds a digest of the conversion functions' source (_CODE_DIGEST),
# so a changed import invalidates old caches even if this is forgotten.
IMPORT_CODE_VERSION = "2.5.1"
CACHE_FORMAT = 1
CACHE_DIR_NAME = "HECRAS_plan_cache"
MANIFEST = "manifest.json"
CACHE_VERSIONS_KEPT = 3            # cache folders kept per plan (other settings / runs)
_TMP_PREFIX, _OLD_PREFIX = ".tmp_", ".old_"
_TMP_MAX_AGE_S = 12 * 3600         # a temporary folder this old is a crashed conversion
_HASH_BYTES = 1 << 20              # first and last MB of the plan / terrain file
RESULT_KEYS = ("depth", "vel", "arr", "dv", "wse", "peak")
# the import options (same defaults as the HEC-RAS plan tab and the
# 'hecrasplan' Processing algorithm):
#   dem         terrain raster (path or None: depth from each cell's lowest point)
#   breach_hr   breach start, hours after simulation start (arrival / peak are
#               hours after it)
#   arrival_ft  depth that counts as 'arrived' (ft)
#   cell_ft     pixel size without a terrain raster (ft, 0 = half the typical
#               cell size); ignored with a terrain raster (its grid is used)
PLAN_DEFAULTS = {"dem": None, "breach_hr": 0.0, "arrival_ft": 0.1, "cell_ft": 0.0}


def is_hdf5(path):
    """True when the file starts with the HDF5 signature (at 0 or after a
    user block of 512 * 2^n bytes). Reads a few bytes only."""
    try:
        size = os.path.getsize(path)
        with open(path, "rb") as fh:
            off = 0
            while off + 8 <= size and off <= 1 << 16:
                fh.seek(off)
                if fh.read(8) == HDF5_SIGNATURE:
                    return True
                off = 512 if off == 0 else off * 2
    except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    return False


def is_plan_hdf(path, deep=False):
    """A HEC-RAS plan results file? Cheap: the name <project>.p##.hdf and the
    HDF5 signature. deep=True: the HDF5 signature and the 2D summary results
    group (the file is opened, no array is read; the name does not matter)."""
    try:
        if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
            return False
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    if not deep:
        return bool(PLAN_RE.search(os.path.basename(path))) and is_hdf5(path)
    if not is_hdf5(path):
        return False
    try:
        h = open_hdf(path)
    except Exception:
        return False
    try:
        return bool(h.has(SUMMARY))
    except Exception:
        return False
    finally:
        h.close()


def default_cache_root(output_folder=None):
    """<outputs>/HECRAS_plan_cache (kept by release_outputs, skipped by the
    raster search); without an outputs folder a folder in the temp dir."""
    if output_folder:
        return os.path.join(output_folder, CACHE_DIR_NAME)
    return os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "ND_Dam_Hazard_Helper", CACHE_DIR_NAME)


def plan_settings(settings=None):
    """The import options as a complete dict (PLAN_DEFAULTS for what is not
    given; "dem_path" is accepted for "dem"; unknown keys are dropped)."""
    s = dict(PLAN_DEFAULTS)
    for k, v in (settings or {}).items():
        k = "dem" if k == "dem_path" else k
        if k in s and v is not None:
            s[k] = v
    dem = str(s["dem"] or "").strip()
    s["dem"] = os.path.abspath(dem) if dem else None
    try:
        for k in ("breach_hr", "arrival_ft", "cell_ft"):
            s[k] = float(s[k])
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise RasImportError("HEC-RAS plan import option {} = {!r} is not a number".format(
            k, s[k]))
    return s


def _content_sig(path):
    """[size, mtime (ns), md5 of the first and last MB]."""
    st = os.stat(path)
    h = hashlib.md5()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        h.update(fh.read(_HASH_BYTES))
        if st.st_size > 2 * _HASH_BYTES:
            fh.seek(-_HASH_BYTES, os.SEEK_END)
            h.update(fh.read(_HASH_BYTES))
        elif st.st_size > _HASH_BYTES:
            h.update(fh.read())
    return [int(st.st_size), int(getattr(st, "st_mtime_ns", int(st.st_mtime * 1e9))),
            h.hexdigest()]


def _vrt_sources_sig(path):
    """Size / mtime of the files a VRT terrain mosaic points at."""
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            text = fh.read(8 << 20)
    except OSError:
        return []
    out = []
    base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    for rel, name in re.findall(r'<SourceFilename[^>]*relativeToVRT="(\d)"[^>]*>([^<]+)<',
                                text)[:5000]:
        p = os.path.join(base, name) if rel == "1" else name
        try:
            st = os.stat(p)
            out.append([name, int(st.st_size), int(getattr(st, "st_mtime_ns", 0))])
        except OSError:
            out.append([name, "missing"])
    return out


def plan_key(path, settings=None):
    """Stable cache key (sha256 hex) of a plan conversion: the plan file's
    size, time stamp and first / last MB, the import options (the terrain
    raster by its content signature, not its path; the pixel size only
    without terrain) and the import code version. The plan's path is not
    part of it: a copied or moved plan keeps its cache."""
    s = plan_settings(settings)
    try:
        plan_sig = _content_sig(path)
    except OSError as e:
        raise RasImportError("HEC-RAS plan results file cannot be read: {} ({})".format(path, e))
    dem = None
    if s["dem"]:
        try:
            dem = _content_sig(s["dem"])
        except OSError:
            dem = ["missing", os.path.normcase(s["dem"])]
        if s["dem"].lower().endswith(".vrt"):
            dem.append(_vrt_sources_sig(s["dem"]))
    parts = {"format": CACHE_FORMAT, "code": [IMPORT_CODE_VERSION, _CODE_DIGEST],
             "plan": plan_sig, "dem": dem, "breach_hr": repr(s["breach_hr"]),
             "arrival_ft": repr(s["arrival_ft"]),
             "cell_ft": repr(0.0 if s["dem"] else s["cell_ft"])}
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(parts, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _folder_name(hdf_path, key):
    return "{}_{}".format(slug(hdf_path), key[:12])


def _read_manifest(folder):
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(folder, MANIFEST), "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            m = json.load(fh)
        return m if isinstance(m, dict) else None
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None


def _result(folder, manifest, cached):
    files = manifest.get("files") or {}
    out = {k: (os.path.join(folder, files[k]) if files.get(k) else None) for k in RESULT_KEYS}
    out.update({"cached": bool(cached), "folder": folder, "key": manifest.get("key"),
                "lines": list(manifest.get("lines") or []),
                "notes": list(manifest.get("notes") or []),
                "pixel_ft": manifest.get("pixel_ft"), "plan": manifest.get("plan")})
    return out


def plan_cache_lookup(hdf_path, cache_root, settings=None, key=None):
    """The cached conversion of this plan with these options, as
    plan_to_rasters_cached() returns it (cached=True), or None when there is
    none (or it is incomplete). Converts nothing; cheap enough for the main
    thread (reads 2 MB of the plan to make the key)."""
    if not cache_root or not hdf_path or not os.path.isfile(hdf_path):
        return None
    try:
        key = key or plan_key(hdf_path, settings)
    except RasImportError:
        return None
    folder = os.path.join(cache_root, _folder_name(hdf_path, key))
    m = _read_manifest(folder)
    if m is None or m.get("key") != key or not m.get("complete") or \
            m.get("format") != CACHE_FORMAT:
        return None
    files = m.get("files") or {}
    if not files.get("depth"):
        return None
    for name in files.values():
        if name and not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(folder, name)):
            return None
    return _result(folder, m, True)


_LOCKS = {}
_LOCKS_GUARD = threading.Lock()


def _key_lock(key):
    """One conversion of a key at a time in this QGIS (dialog run and a
    Processing batch could ask for the same plan)."""
    with _LOCKS_GUARD:
        return _LOCKS.setdefault(key, threading.Lock())


def _discard(folder):
    """Remove a cache folder: the manifest first, so what is left of a
    folder that cannot be removed completely (a raster open in QGIS on
    Windows) is never taken for a complete one. True when it is gone."""
    try:
        os.remove(os.path.join(folder, MANIFEST))
    except OSError:
        pass
    shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)
    if not os.path.exists(folder):
        return True
    aside = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(folder), "{}{}_{}".format(
        _OLD_PREFIX, os.path.basename(folder), int(time.time() * 1000)))
    try:
        os.rename(folder, aside)
        shutil.rmtree(aside, ignore_errors=True)
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False


def _clean_leftovers(cache_root):
    """Temporary folders of conversions that crashed (older than
    _TMP_MAX_AGE_S) and folders put aside for deletion. Best effort."""
    try:
        names = os.listdir(cache_root)
    except OSError:
        return
    now = time.time()
    for n in names:
        p = os.path.join(cache_root, n)
        try:
            if n.startswith(_OLD_PREFIX) or (n.startswith(_TMP_PREFIX) and
                                             now - os.path.getmtime(p) > _TMP_MAX_AGE_S):
                shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
        except OSError:
            pass


def _prune(cache_root, hdf_path, keep_folder, keep=CACHE_VERSIONS_KEPT):
    """Older conversions of the same plan (other options, an earlier plan
    run) beyond the newest `keep`. Best effort."""
    me = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(hdf_path))
    pat = re.compile(r"^{}_[0-9a-f]{{12}}$".format(re.escape(slug(hdf_path))))
    found = []
    try:
        names = os.listdir(cache_root)
    except OSError:
        return 0
    for n in names:
        p = os.path.join(cache_root, n)
        if not pat.match(n) or os.path.normcase(p) == os.path.normcase(keep_folder):
            continue
        m = _read_manifest(p)
        if m is None or os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(m.get("plan") or "")) != me:
            continue
        found.append((float(m.get("created_ts") or 0.0), p))
    found.sort(reverse=True)
    n = 0
    for _t, p in found[max(0, keep - 1):]:
        n += 1 if _discard(p) else 0
    return n


def _publish(tmp, final):
    """Rename the finished temporary folder to its cache name. False when
    another conversion put a folder there first. Retries: on Windows a
    virus scanner can hold a new file for a moment."""
    err = None
    for i in range(6):
        try:
            os.rename(tmp, final)
            return True
        except OSError as e:
            err = e
            if os.path.isdir(final):
                return False
            time.sleep(0.2 * (i + 1))
    raise RasImportError("the converted rasters could not be moved into the cache folder "
                         "{} ({})".format(final, err))


def plan_to_rasters_cached(hdf_path, cache_root, settings=None, progress=None, log=None):
    """A plan's rasters for the classification, converted with import_plan()
    into <cache_root>/<plan name>_<key[:12]>/ and re-used while plan_key()
    is unchanged. settings: see PLAN_DEFAULTS. progress(pct, msg) and
    log(msg) as the pipeline's; CancelledByUser raised by progress stops the
    conversion (nothing is left behind). Safe in a worker thread.
    Returns {"depth", "vel", "arr", "dv", "wse", "peak": path or None (dv:
    always None, the plan import has no D x V), "cached": re-used?, "folder",
    "key", "lines", "notes", "pixel_ft", "plan"}."""
    if not hdf_path or not os.path.isfile(hdf_path):
        raise RasImportError("HEC-RAS plan results file not found: {}".format(hdf_path))
    s = plan_settings(settings)
    if s["dem"] and not os.path.isfile(s["dem"]):
        raise RasImportError("Terrain raster for the HEC-RAS plan not found: {}".format(s["dem"]))
    cache_root = cache_root or default_cache_root(None)
    key = plan_key(hdf_path, s)
    final = os.path.join(cache_root, _folder_name(hdf_path, key))
    plan_name = os.path.basename(hdf_path)

    def say(msg):
        if log:
            log(msg)
    with _key_lock(key):
        hit = plan_cache_lookup(hdf_path, cache_root, s, key=key)
        if hit is not None:
            say(">>> HEC-RAS plan {}: rasters re-used from the cache (plan and import options "
                "unchanged) - {}".format(plan_name, final))
            if progress:
                progress(100.0, "HEC-RAS plan {}: cached rasters".format(plan_name))
            return hit
        os.makedirs(cache_root, exist_ok=True)
        _clean_leftovers(cache_root)
        if os.path.exists(final) and not _discard(final):
            raise RasImportError("the incomplete cache folder {} cannot be replaced - remove its "
                                 "rasters from the QGIS project or delete the folder".format(final))
        say(">>> HEC-RAS plan {}: converting its 2D results (breach start {:g} h, arrival "
            "depth {:g} ft, {}) ...".format(
                plan_name, s["breach_hr"], s["arrival_ft"],
                "terrain " + os.path.basename(s["dem"]) if s["dem"] else "no terrain raster"))
        tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=_TMP_PREFIX + os.path.basename(final) + "_", dir=cache_root)
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            res = import_plan(hdf_path, tmp, dem_path=s["dem"], cell_ft=s["cell_ft"],
                              breach_hr=s["breach_hr"], arrival_ft=s["arrival_ft"],
                              progress=progress)
            files = {k: os.path.basename(p) for k, p in (res.get("paths") or {}).items()
                     if p and k in RESULT_KEYS}
            if not files.get("depth"):
                raise RasImportError("the HEC-RAS plan import wrote no depth raster")
            manifest = {
                "format": CACHE_FORMAT, "key": key, "complete": True,
                "plan": os.path.abspath(hdf_path), "settings": s,
                "code": [IMPORT_CODE_VERSION, _CODE_DIGEST], "files": files,
                "lines": [str(x) for x in res.get("lines") or []],
                "notes": [str(x) for x in res.get("notes") or []],
                "pixel_ft": float(res.get("pixel_ft") or 0.0),
                "created": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "created_ts": time.time(),
                "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)}
            path = os.path.join(tmp, MANIFEST)
            with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:        # written last
                json.dump(manifest, fh, indent=1)
            won = _publish(tmp, final)
        except BaseException:
            shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
            raise
        if not won:                          # another conversion finished first
            shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
            hit = plan_cache_lookup(hdf_path, cache_root, s, key=key)
            if hit is None:
                raise RasImportError("the cache folder {} is in use and incomplete".format(final))
            return hit
    _prune(cache_root, hdf_path, final)
    say(">>> HEC-RAS plan {}: converted in {:.0f} s ({:.1f} ft pixels) - {}".format(
        plan_name, manifest["seconds"], manifest["pixel_ft"], final))
    for n in manifest["notes"]:
        say("    NOTE: " + n)
    return _result(final, manifest, False)


# the conversion code whose source is part of the cache key
_CODE_FUNCS = ("plan_info", "_real_cells", "cell_velocity", "_ranges", "arrival_days",
               "read_area", "_spacing", "_write_csv", "_open_points", "_write_points", "_grid",
               "import_plan", "_finish")


def _code_digest():
    import inspect
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for name in _CODE_FUNCS:
        try:
            h.update(inspect.getsource(globals()[name]).encode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:                    # no source (compiled install): the name
            h.update(name.encode("utf-8"))
    return h.hexdigest()[:16]


_CODE_DIGEST = _code_digest()
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.5: 'HEC-RAS plan' tab - read a HEC-RAS 6.x plan results file
(<project>.p##.hdf) and make the Setup rasters from its 2D flow areas
without the RAS Mapper export step (rasimport.py).

v2.9: "Use this plan for the classification" puts the plan itself in the
Setup tab's depth, velocity and arrival boxes (D x V cleared): the rasters
are made from it when the classification starts, in the background run,
with this tab's options (_ras_plan_settings) and cached
(rasimport.plan_to_rasters_cached in _ras_cache_root) - a re-run plan or
changed options are picked up by the next run, and nothing blocks QGIS now.
"Import" still writes rasters to look at first."""

import os
import traceback

from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import (
    QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QLabel, QWidget, QLineEdit, QCheckBox, QTextEdit,
    QFileDialog, QMessageBox, QFormLayout, QGroupBox, QDoubleSpinBox,
)
from qgis.core import QgsRasterLayer

from . import rasimport as RI
from .compat import MSG_CRITICAL
from .helpers import (
    log_message, add_layer_to_project, plugin_group, dam_display_name, CancelledByUser,
)
from .constants import GRP_HYDRAULICS
from .styles import style_depth


class RasImportTabMixin(object):
    def _build_ras_tab(self):
        tab = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(tab)
        info = QLabel(
            "<h3>HEC-RAS plan results</h3>Reads a HEC-RAS 6.x plan results file "
            "(<i>project.p01.hdf</i>) and makes the maximum depth, velocity, water surface, "
            "arrival-time and time-of-peak rasters from its 2D flow areas - no RAS Mapper "
            "export needed. Give the terrain raster for depths on the terrain grid (as RAS "
            "Mapper does); without it depth is measured from each cell's lowest point. "
            "Check the rasters against RAS Mapper for your first plans.")
        info.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(info)
        grp = QGroupBox("Plan")
        form = QFormLayout()
        self.ras_plan_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.ras_plan_edit.setPlaceholderText("<project>.p##.hdf (run with 2D output)")
        b1 = QPushButton("Browse...")
        b1.clicked.connect(self._ras_browse_plan)
        form.addRow("Plan results (.hdf):", self._ras_row(self.ras_plan_edit, b1))
        self.ras_dem_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.ras_dem_edit.setPlaceholderText("optional but recommended - the RAS terrain "
                                             "(GeoTIFF), same coordinate system and "
                                             "vertical units as the model")
        b2 = QPushButton("Browse...")
        b2.clicked.connect(self._ras_browse_dem)
        form.addRow("Terrain raster:", self._ras_row(self.ras_dem_edit, b2))
        self.ras_breach_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.ras_breach_spin.setRange(0.0, 10000.0)
        self.ras_breach_spin.setDecimals(2)
        self.ras_breach_spin.setSuffix(" h after simulation start")
        self.ras_breach_spin.setToolTip("Arrival and time of peak are given in hours after "
                                        "this moment (the breach start). 0 = simulation "
                                        "start.")
        form.addRow("Breach starts at:", self.ras_breach_spin)
        self.ras_arrival_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.ras_arrival_spin.setRange(0.01, 10.0)
        self.ras_arrival_spin.setDecimals(2)
        self.ras_arrival_spin.setValue(0.1)
        self.ras_arrival_spin.setSuffix(" ft")
        self.ras_arrival_spin.setToolTip("A cell has 'arrived' when its depth (water surface "
                                         "minus the cell's lowest point) first exceeds this.")
        form.addRow("Arrival depth:", self.ras_arrival_spin)
        self.ras_cell_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.ras_cell_spin.setRange(0.0, 1000.0)
        self.ras_cell_spin.setDecimals(1)
        self.ras_cell_spin.setSuffix(" ft (0 = half the typical cell size)")
        self.ras_cell_spin.setToolTip("Pixel size when no terrain raster is given (with one, "
                                      "its grid is used).")
        form.addRow("Pixel size without terrain:", self.ras_cell_spin)
        self.ras_scan_btn = QPushButton("Read plan")
        self.ras_scan_btn.clicked.connect(self._ras_scan)
        form.addRow("", self.ras_scan_btn)
        grp.setLayout(form)
        lay.addWidget(grp)
        opts = QHBoxLayout()
        self.ras_use_setup_check = QCheckBox("Use as the Setup tab rasters")
        self.ras_use_setup_check.setChecked(True)
        self.ras_load_check = QCheckBox("Load the rasters")
        self.ras_load_check.setChecked(True)
        for c in (self.ras_use_setup_check, self.ras_load_check):
            opts.addWidget(c)
        opts.addStretch()
        lay.addLayout(opts)
        self.ras_import_btn = QPushButton("Import")
        self.ras_import_btn.clicked.connect(self._ras_import)
        lay.addWidget(self.ras_import_btn)
        # v2.9: the plan itself as the classification input
        self.ras_use_plan_btn = QPushButton("Use this plan for the classification")
        self.ras_use_plan_btn.setToolTip(
            "Puts the plan file in the Setup tab's depth, velocity and arrival boxes: the "
            "rasters are made from it when the classification starts (in the background, "
            "with the options above) and re-used while the plan and the options are "
            "unchanged. Nothing is loaded now - use Import to look at the rasters first.")
        self.ras_use_plan_btn.clicked.connect(self._ras_use_plan)
        lay.addWidget(self.ras_use_plan_btn)
        self.ras_result_text = QTextEdit()
        self.ras_result_text.setReadOnly(True)
        lay.addWidget(self.ras_result_text)
        return tab

    def _ras_row(self, edit, btn):
        w = QWidget()
        h = QHBoxLayout(w)
        h.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        h.addWidget(edit, stretch=3)
        h.addWidget(btn)
        return w

    def _ras_browse_plan(self, *args):
        path, _f = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "HEC-RAS plan results", getattr(self, "config_dam_folder", "") or "",
            "HEC-RAS plan HDF (*.p??.hdf *.hdf);;All Files (*)")
        if path:
            self.ras_plan_edit.setText(path)

    def _ras_browse_dem(self, *args):
        start = os.path.dirname(self.ras_plan_edit.text().strip()) or \
            getattr(self, "config_dam_folder", "") or ""
        path, _f = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Terrain raster", start, "Rasters (*.tif *.tiff *.vrt *.img);;All Files (*)")
        if path:
            self.ras_dem_edit.setText(path)

    def _ras_plan_settings(self):
        """v2.9: this tab's import options (rasimport.PLAN_DEFAULTS keys) -
        the ones a plan in the Setup tab / scenario table is converted with."""
        return {"dem": self.ras_dem_edit.text().strip() or None,
                "breach_hr": float(self.ras_breach_spin.value()),
                "arrival_ft": float(self.ras_arrival_spin.value()),
                "cell_ft": float(self.ras_cell_spin.value())}

    def _ras_cache_root(self):
        """v2.9: <outputs>/HECRAS_plan_cache."""
        return RI.default_cache_root(getattr(self, "config_output_folder", "") or None)

    def _ras_use_plan(self, *args):
        """v2.9: the plan as the Setup tab's depth / velocity / arrival input
        (converted at run time). Checks what can be checked cheaply now."""
        if getattr(self, "_busy", False):
            return
        plan = self.ras_plan_edit.text().strip()
        if not plan or not os.path.isfile(plan):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan", "Select the plan results file (.hdf).")
            return
        if not RI.PLAN_RE.search(os.path.basename(plan)):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan",
                                "Only plan results files named <project>.p##.hdf (as HEC-RAS "
                                "writes them) can be used directly - use Import for this file.")
            return
        dem = self.ras_dem_edit.text().strip() or None
        if dem and not os.path.isfile(dem):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan", "Terrain raster not found: " + dem)
            return
        if not RI.is_hdf5(plan):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan", "{} is not an HDF5 file.".format(
                os.path.basename(plan)))
            return
        try:
            h = RI.open_hdf(plan)
            try:
                info = RI.plan_info(h)
            finally:
                h.close()
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "HEC-RAS plan", str(e) or repr(e))
            return
        if not info["with_results"]:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan",
                                "No 2D flow area results in {} (areas: {}) - run the plan with "
                                "2D output first.".format(os.path.basename(plan),
                                                          ", ".join(info["areas"]) or "none"))
            return
        if not info["projection"] and not dem:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan",
                                "The plan has no coordinate system (set it in RAS Mapper) - give "
                                "the terrain raster so its coordinate system can be used.")
            return
        # rasters of another model must not be mixed in (as Import does)
        self.depth_edit.setText(plan)
        self.vel_edit.setText(plan)
        self.arr_edit.setText(plan)
        self.dv_edit.setText("")
        i = self.model_combo.findData("2d")
        if i is not None and i >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(i)
        root = self._ras_cache_root()
        hit = RI.plan_cache_lookup(plan, root, self._ras_plan_settings())
        text = ["Setup tab: depth, velocity and arrival now come from this plan:", "  " + plan,
                "",
                "They are made when the classification starts - with the terrain raster, breach "
                "start, arrival depth and pixel size above - and re-used while the plan and "
                "these options are unchanged (a re-run plan is converted again).",
                "Cache: " + root, "",
                "Already converted with these options: {}".format(hit["folder"]) if hit else
                "Not converted yet: the first run converts it (large models take minutes).",
                "Time-series output steps: {}{}".format(
                    info["time_steps"], "" if info["time_steps"] else
                    " - no arrival raster without them"),
                "", "Use Import to look at the rasters in QGIS first."]
        self.ras_result_text.setPlainText("\n".join(text))
        self._log(">>> Setup tab: HEC-RAS plan {} as depth / velocity / arrival (converted at "
                  "run time{}, breach start {:g} h, arrival depth {:g} ft)".format(
                      os.path.basename(plan), ", terrain " + os.path.basename(dem) if dem
                      else ", no terrain raster", float(self.ras_breach_spin.value()),
                      float(self.ras_arrival_spin.value())))
        self._update_button_states()

    def _ras_out(self):
        plan = self.ras_plan_edit.text().strip()
        root = getattr(self, "config_output_folder", "") or os.path.dirname(plan)
        return os.path.join(root, "HECRAS_" + RI.slug(plan))

    def _ras_scan(self, *args):
        plan = self.ras_plan_edit.text().strip()
        if not plan or not os.path.isfile(plan):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan", "Select the plan results file (.hdf).")
            return
        try:
            h = RI.open_hdf(plan)
            try:
                info = RI.plan_info(h)
            finally:
                h.close()
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "HEC-RAS plan", str(e))
            return
        text = ["Plan: {}".format(info["title"] or os.path.basename(plan)),
                "Read with: {}".format(info["reader"]),
                "Units: {}".format(info["units"] or "not stated (US Customary assumed)"),
                "Coordinate system: {}".format("stored in the plan" if info["projection"]
                                               else "NOT stored - give the terrain raster"),
                "2D flow areas: {}".format(", ".join(info["areas"]) or "none"),
                "With results: {}".format(", ".join(info["with_results"]) or "none"),
                "Time-series output steps: {}{}".format(
                    info["time_steps"], "" if info["time_steps"] else
                    " - no arrival raster without them")]
        self.ras_result_text.setPlainText("\n".join(text))

    def _ras_import(self, *args):
        plan = self.ras_plan_edit.text().strip()
        if not plan or not os.path.isfile(plan):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan", "Select the plan results file (.hdf).")
            return
        dem = self.ras_dem_edit.text().strip() or None
        if dem and not os.path.isfile(dem):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "HEC-RAS plan", "Terrain raster not found: " + dem)
            return
        out = self._ras_out()
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._progress = self._make_progress("Importing HEC-RAS plan results...")
        try:
            res = RI.import_plan(plan, out, dem_path=dem,
                                 cell_ft=float(self.ras_cell_spin.value()),
                                 breach_hr=float(self.ras_breach_spin.value()),
                                 arrival_ft=float(self.ras_arrival_spin.value()),
                                 progress=self._progress_tick)
        except CancelledByUser:
            self._finish_progress()
            self._set_busy(False)
            self._update_status("HEC-RAS import cancelled", False)
            return
        except Exception as e:
            self._finish_progress()
            self._set_busy(False)
            log_message(traceback.format_exc(), MSG_CRITICAL)
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "HEC-RAS plan", str(e) or repr(e))
            return
        self._finish_progress()
        self._set_busy(False)
        p = res["paths"]
        name = "HEC-RAS " + RI.slug(plan)
        if self.ras_use_setup_check.isChecked():
            # rasters of another model must not be mixed in (see DSS-WISE import)
            self.depth_edit.setText(p["depth"])
            self.vel_edit.setText(p.get("vel") or "")
            self.arr_edit.setText(p.get("arr") or "")
            self.dv_edit.setText("")
            i = self.model_combo.findData("2d")
            if i is not None and i >= 0:
                self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(i)
        if self.ras_load_check.isChecked():
            grp = plugin_group(dam_display_name(self.config_dam_folder), GRP_HYDRAULICS)
            for key, label in (("depth", "max depth"), ("vel", "max velocity"),
                               ("arr", "arrival time"), ("peak", "time of peak"),
                               ("wse", "max water surface")):
                if p.get(key):
                    lyr = QgsRasterLayer(p[key], "{} - {}".format(name, label))
                    if lyr.isValid():
                        if key == "depth":
                            style_depth(lyr)
                        add_layer_to_project(lyr, visibility=key == "depth", group=grp)
        text = ["Imported to {} ({:.1f} ft pixels)".format(out, res.get("pixel_ft") or 0), ""] \
            + res["lines"] + [""] + ["NOTE: " + n for n in res["notes"]] + \
            ["", "Arrival and time of peak: hours after {:g} h of simulation time.".format(
                float(self.ras_breach_spin.value()))]
        self.ras_result_text.setPlainText("\n".join(text))
        self._log(">>> HEC-RAS plan {} imported ({})".format(os.path.basename(plan), ", ".join(
            os.path.basename(v) for v in p.values())))
        self._update_button_states()
```

## `report.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Submittal report: a QGIS print layout (kept in the project's Layout
Manager so it can be edited and re-exported) exported to PDF.

Pages (US Letter, landscape):
  1. classification summary: ND Dam Safety Standards REG_05.2026 Sec. 5.2
     criteria table, ACER TM 11 Table 1 (lives in jeopardy), scenarios,
     items requiring engineering judgment
  2. overview map of the study area with legend and scale bar
  3..n. zoom maps of the areas with the most habitable structures in the
     ACER high / judgment zones (up to `max_pages`)
  then: roads / railroads table, structures table (ND outcome and ACER
  zone of every flooded habitable structure)

The layout is rebuilt on every run (the previous one of the same name is
replaced), so the PDF and the layout always show the latest results.

v2.9: aerial imagery under every map (imagery=True): the imagery layer of
basemap.py is the LAST layer of each map item's explicit layer list (drawn
under everything) and an "Imagery: <service>" credit is printed under the
map. The depth raster is drawn semi-transparent in those map items only
(FLOOD_OPACITY_OVER_IMAGERY, a locked style of the map item - the layer and
the canvas are not changed). Offline (the "offline only" setting, or the
imagery service does not answer) the maps are made without imagery and the
map pages say so.
"""

import math
import os
import time

from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QFont
from qgis.core import (
    Qgis, QgsProject, QgsPrintLayout, QgsLayoutItemMap, QgsLayoutItemLabel, QgsLayoutItemLegend,
    QgsLayoutItemScaleBar, QgsLayoutItemPage, QgsLayoutPoint, QgsLayoutSize,
    QgsLayoutExporter, QgsRectangle, QgsUnitTypes, QgsRasterLayer,
)

from .compat import _first, enum_value, DIST_FEET, DIST_MILES
from .constants import (
    PLUGIN_NAME, PLUGIN_VERSION, CLASS_HIGH, CLASS_JUDGMENT, CLASS_LOW, ZONE_LABELS,
    ND_POLICY_REF, TM11_REF,
)
from .helpers import log_message, prepare_output_path, same_path, add_layer_to_project
from .styles import style_depth
from .structures import OUT_DRY
from . import basemap as BM

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 279.4, 215.9          # US Letter landscape, mm
MARGIN = 10.0
REPORT_FILE = "Hazard_Classification_Report.pdf"
_KEEP = []                              # layers referenced by open layouts
# raster flood layers (depth, arrival bands) over aerial imagery: this opacity
# in the map items (a more transparent style of the user's is kept)
FLOOD_OPACITY_OVER_IMAGERY = 0.65

STRUCT_HEAD = ["ID", "FEMA category", "ACER type", "ACER zone", "ND outcome (5.2.1.1)",
               "Depth ft", "Vel ft/s", "DxV ft2/s", "Arrival h", "Persons", "Est. LOL",
               "Reviewed"]
ROAD_HEAD = ["Road / railroad", "Class", "AADT or trains/day", "Flooded ft", "Depth ft",
             "Vel ft/s", "Vehicle zone", "ND class", "ND basis"]
ND_HEAD = ["Section", "Criterion", "Found", "Result"]
TM_HEAD = ["ACER TM 11 Table 1", "Value"]
SCEN_HEAD = ["Scenario", "ND class", "TM 11 class", "LIJ", "Zone method", "Baseline"]
# relative column widths (text wraps inside a column; see _fit_widths)
STRUCT_WIDTHS = [10, 30, 28, 18, 38, 14, 14, 16, 14, 14, 14, 22]
ROAD_WIDTHS = [58, 22, 30, 18, 14, 14, 20, 16, 64]
ND_WIDTHS = [14, 102, 32, 22]
TM_WIDTHS = [63, 18]
SCEN_WIDTHS = [24, 12, 12, 8, 14, 12]


def _fit_widths(table, weights, total):
    """Column widths (mm) from relative `weights` so that the WHOLE table -
    text columns plus QGIS's cell margins (both sides of every column) and
    grid lines - is `total` mm wide (QGIS sizes the frame to the table)."""
    n = len(weights)
    cm, gs = 1.0, 0.5                      # QGIS defaults
    try:
        cm = float(table.cellMargin())
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        gs = float(table.gridStrokeWidth()) if table.showGrid() else 0.0
    except Exception:
        pass
    avail = max(n * 4.0, total - n * 2.0 * cm - (n + 1) * gs - 0.5)
    s = float(sum(weights)) or 1.0
    return [w * avail / s for w in weights]


def _mm():
    return _first(lambda: Qgis.LayoutUnit.Millimeters,
                  lambda: QgsUnitTypes.LayoutUnit.LayoutMillimeters,
                  lambda: QgsUnitTypes.LayoutMillimeters)


def _landscape():
    return _first(lambda: QgsLayoutItemPage.Orientation.Landscape,
                  lambda: QgsLayoutItemPage.Landscape)


def _export_ok(res):
    ok = _first(lambda: QgsLayoutExporter.ExportResult.Success,
                lambda: QgsLayoutExporter.Success, default=0)
    return enum_value(res) == enum_value(ok)


def _place(item, x, y, w, h, page=0):
    mm = _mm()
    item.attemptResize(QgsLayoutSize(w, h, mm))
    item.attemptMove(QgsLayoutPoint(x, y, mm), True, False, page)


def _text_format(size, bold=False, mono=False):
    font = QFont("Courier New" if mono else "Arial")
    font.setBold(bold)
    try:
        from qgis.core import QgsTextFormat
        fmt = QgsTextFormat()
        fmt.setFont(font)
        fmt.setSize(size)
        return fmt, font
    except Exception:
        return None, font


def _label(layout, text, x, y, w, h, page=0, size=9, bold=False, mono=False):
    lab = QgsLayoutItemLabel(layout)
    lab.setText(text)
    fmt, font = _text_format(size, bold, mono)
    try:
        if fmt is None:
            raise AttributeError("no QgsTextFormat")
        lab.setTextFormat(fmt)
    except Exception:
        try:
            font.setPointSizeF(size)
            lab.setFont(font)
        except Exception:
            pass
    layout.addLayoutItem(lab)
    _place(lab, x, y, w, h, page)
    return lab


def _map(layout, crs, extent, layers, x, y, w, h, page=0, styles=None):
    """A map item with an explicit layer list (top first) and, with
    `styles` ({layer id: style XML}, see flood_style_overrides), those
    layers drawn with the given styles in this item only."""
    m = QgsLayoutItemMap(layout)
    m.setCrs(crs)
    m.setLayers(layers)
    try:
        m.setKeepLayerSet(True)
    except Exception:
        pass
    if styles:
        try:
            m.setLayerStyleOverrides(styles)
            m.setKeepLayerStyles(True)
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("Map layer styles not locked ({}); flood layers drawn with their "
                        "own opacity".format(e))
    m.setFrameEnabled(True)
    layout.addLayoutItem(m)
    _place(m, x, y, w, h, page)
    m.setExtent(_fit(extent, w / h))
    return m


def flood_style_overrides(layers, opacity=FLOOD_OPACITY_OVER_IMAGERY):
    """{layer id: style XML} that draws the raster layers of `layers` (depth,
    arrival bands - opaque colour ramps) at `opacity`, so aerial imagery shows
    through them. For QgsLayoutItemMap.setLayerStyleOverrides (the "lock
    styles for layers" of a map item): the layers themselves keep their
    style - the opacity is set only while the style is read, then put back.
    Vector layers (points, lines) are left alone. Never raises."""
    out = {}
    try:
        from qgis.core import QgsMapLayerStyle
    except ImportError:
        return out
    for lyr in layers or []:
        if not isinstance(lyr, QgsRasterLayer):
            continue
        try:
            r = lyr.renderer()
            if r is None:
                continue
            prev = float(r.opacity())
            if prev <= opacity + 1e-6:
                continue                     # already see-through enough
            r.setOpacity(float(opacity))
            try:
                st = QgsMapLayerStyle()
                st.readFromLayer(lyr)
                xml = st.xmlData()
            finally:
                r.setOpacity(prev)
            if xml:
                out[lyr.id()] = xml
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("Map opacity of {} not changed: {}".format(lyr.name(), e))
    return out


def imagery_label(layout, used, caption, note, x, y, w, page, size=6):
    """Under a map: the imagery credit, or why the map has no imagery
    (nothing when imagery was not asked for)."""
    if used and caption:
        text = caption
    elif note:
        text = "Aerial imagery not shown: {}".format(note)
    else:
        return None
    return _label(layout, text, x, y, w, 5, page, size=size)


def layout_imagery(imagery, layers, add_to_project, rect, crs):
    """(map layers with the imagery last, style overrides or None, used,
    caption, note) for the maps of a layout. imagery=False: the layers as
    they are, no note."""
    if not imagery:
        return list(layers), None, False, "", ""
    img, cap, note = BM.layout_imagery(add_to_project, rect, crs)
    map_layers = BM.with_imagery(layers, img)
    used = img is not None and bool(map_layers) and map_layers[-1] is img
    if img is not None and not used:
        note = "the maps have no layers"
    if not used:
        return list(layers), None, False, "", note
    _KEEP.append(img)
    return map_layers, flood_style_overrides(layers), True, cap or "", ""


def _fit(rect, aspect):
    """rect grown to the map item's aspect ratio (and never degenerate)."""
    w = max(rect.width(), 1e-9)
    h = max(rect.height(), 1e-9)
    cx = (rect.xMinimum() + rect.xMaximum()) / 2.0
    cy = (rect.yMinimum() + rect.yMaximum()) / 2.0
    if w / h > aspect:
        h = w / aspect
    else:
        w = h * aspect
    return QgsRectangle(cx - w / 2.0, cy - h / 2.0, cx + w / 2.0, cy + h / 2.0)


def _add_page(layout):
    page = QgsLayoutItemPage(layout)
    page.setPageSize("Letter", _landscape())
    layout.pageCollection().addPage(page)
    return layout.pageCollection().pageCount() - 1


def _decorations(layout, m, layers, page):
    try:
        leg = QgsLayoutItemLegend(layout)
        leg.setTitle("Legend")
        leg.setLinkedMap(m)
        try:
            leg.setAutoUpdateModel(False)
            root = leg.model().rootGroup()
            root.removeAllChildren()
            for lyr in layers:
                root.addLayer(lyr)
        except Exception:
            pass
        layout.addLayoutItem(leg)
        _place(leg, PAGE_W - MARGIN - 62, 30, 62, 100, page)
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("Report legend skipped: {}".format(e))
    try:
        sb = QgsLayoutItemScaleBar(layout)
        sb.setStyle("Single Box")
        sb.setLinkedMap(m)
        # US customary units for an ND submittal: miles for large maps
        wide = False
        try:
            from .helpers import buffer_distance_in_layer_units
            wide = m.extent().width() > buffer_distance_in_layer_units(3 * 5280.0, m.crs())
        except Exception:
            pass
        units = DIST_MILES if wide and DIST_MILES is not None else DIST_FEET
        sb.applyDefaultSize(units)
        try:
            sb.setUnitLabel("mi" if units is DIST_MILES else "ft")
        except Exception:
            pass
        layout.addLayoutItem(sb)
        _place(sb, MARGIN + 2, PAGE_H - MARGIN - 14, 80, 12, page)
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("Report scale bar skipped: {}".format(e))


def _clusters(structs, cell, max_n):
    """Groups of habitable high / judgment structures (grid cells), largest
    first: [(bbox, [recs])]."""
    groups = {}
    for s in structs:
        if s.get("habitable") != "Yes" or s.get("zone") not in (CLASS_HIGH, CLASS_JUDGMENT):
            continue
        if s.get("outcome") == OUT_DRY:
            continue
        try:
            p = s["geom"].centroid().asPoint()
        except Exception:
            continue
        key = (int(math.floor(p.x() / cell)), int(math.floor(p.y() / cell)))
        groups.setdefault(key, []).append((s, p))
    out = []
    for items in sorted(groups.values(), key=lambda g: -len(g))[:max_n]:
        xs = [p.x() for _s, p in items]
        ys = [p.y() for _s, p in items]
        pad = cell * 0.25
        out.append((QgsRectangle(min(xs) - pad, min(ys) - pad, max(xs) + pad, max(ys) + pad),
                    [s for s, _p in items]))
    return out


def _f(v, fmt="{:.1f}"):
    return "" if v is None else fmt.format(v)


def report_structures(structs):
    """Structures listed in the report: every flooded habitable structure
    (ND 5.2.2 counts them all) and unverified ones in the high / judgment
    zones; most severe first."""
    out = []
    for s in structs:
        if s.get("outcome") in (None, OUT_DRY):
            continue
        if s.get("habitable") == "Yes" or (
                s.get("habitable") == "Unverified" and
                s.get("zone") in (CLASS_HIGH, CLASS_JUDGMENT)):
            out.append(s)
    rank = {CLASS_HIGH: 0, CLASS_JUDGMENT: 1, CLASS_LOW: 2}
    return sorted(out, key=lambda r: (rank.get(r.get("zone"), 3),
                                      -(r.get("max_depth") or 0), r.get("id", 0)))


def _structure_rows(recs, incremental):
    rows = []
    for s in recs:
        row = [str(s["id"]), (s.get("fema_category") or "")[:40], s.get("acer_type") or "",
               ZONE_LABELS.get(s.get("zone"), "") if s.get("zone") else "",
               s.get("outcome") or "", _f(s.get("max_depth")), _f(s.get("max_vel")),
               _f(s.get("dv_max")), _f(s.get("arrival"), "{:.2f}"),
               str(int(s.get("persons") or 0)), _f(s.get("lol"), "{:.2f}"),
               "Yes" if s.get("reviewed") else ""]
        if incremental:
            row.append("Yes" if s.get("incremental") else "No")
        rows.append(row)
    return rows


def _line_rows(roads, rails):
    rows = []
    for r in roads:
        a = "{:,.0f}{}".format(r["aadt"], " ({})".format(r["aadt_year"])
                               if r.get("aadt_year") else "") if r.get("aadt") else "no AADT"
        rows.append([r.get("name") or "unnamed road", r.get("road_class") or "", a,
                     _f(r.get("length_ft"), "{:,.0f}"), _f(r.get("max_depth")),
                     _f(r.get("max_vel")), ZONE_LABELS.get(r.get("vehicle_zone"), "") or "",
                     r.get("nd_class") or "", (r.get("nd_basis") or "")[:60]])
    for r in rails:
        t = "{:.0f} trains/day".format(r["trains"]) if r.get("trains") is not None else "?"
        rows.append(["{} {}".format(r.get("railroad") or "railroad",
                                    r.get("subdivision") or "").strip(),
                     "passenger" if r.get("passenger") else "rail", t,
                     _f(r.get("length_ft"), "{:,.0f}"), _f(r.get("max_depth")),
                     _f(r.get("max_vel")), "", r.get("nd_class") or "",
                     (r.get("nd_basis") or "")[:60]])
    return rows


def _columns(head, widths):
    from qgis.core import QgsLayoutTableColumn
    cols = []
    for i, c in enumerate(head):
        col = QgsLayoutTableColumn(c)
        if widths and i < len(widths):
            try:
                col.setWidth(float(widths[i]))       # mm; 0 = automatic
            except Exception:
                pass
        cols.append(col)
    return cols


def _table_options(t):
    """Headers on every page of a table that flows over several pages, and
    long texts wrapped inside their column instead of widening the table."""
    from qgis.core import QgsLayoutTable
    try:
        t.setHeaderMode(_first(lambda: Qgis.LayoutTableHeaderMode.AllFrames,
                               lambda: QgsLayoutTable.HeaderMode.AllFrames,
                               lambda: QgsLayoutTable.AllFrames))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        t.setWrapBehavior(_first(lambda: QgsLayoutTable.WrapBehavior.WrapText,
                                 lambda: QgsLayoutTable.WrapText))
    except Exception:
        pass


def _table(layout, head, rows, page, x, y, w, h, size=7, repeat=True, title=None,
           widths=None):
    """A text table (flows onto extra pages when `repeat`, headers repeated),
    or a monospaced label if the table API is not available. `widths`:
    relative column widths; the table is made exactly `w` mm wide."""
    try:
        from qgis.core import QgsLayoutItemTextTable, QgsLayoutFrame, QgsLayoutMultiFrame
        t = QgsLayoutItemTextTable(layout)
        layout.addMultiFrame(t)
        t.setColumns(_columns(head, _fit_widths(t, widths, w) if widths else None))
        t.setContents(rows)
        _table_options(t)
        for setter, bold in (("setHeaderTextFormat", True), ("setContentTextFormat", False)):
            fmt, _font = _text_format(size, bold)
            try:
                if fmt is not None:
                    getattr(t, setter)(fmt)
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            mode = _first(lambda: QgsLayoutMultiFrame.ResizeMode.RepeatUntilFinished,
                          lambda: QgsLayoutMultiFrame.RepeatUntilFinished) if repeat else \
                _first(lambda: QgsLayoutMultiFrame.ResizeMode.UseExistingFrames,
                       lambda: QgsLayoutMultiFrame.UseExistingFrames)
            t.setResizeMode(mode)
        except Exception:
            pass
        fr = QgsLayoutFrame(layout, t)
        _place(fr, x, y, w, h, page)
        t.addFrame(fr)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("Report table{}: text fallback ({})".format(
            " '{}'".format(title) if title else "", e))
        width = max(8, int(w / (len(head) * 1.6)))
        text = "  ".join("{:<{w}}".format(c[:width], w=width) for c in head) + "\n" + \
            "\n".join("  ".join("{:<{w}}".format(str(c)[:width], w=width) for c in r)
                      for r in rows[:45])
        if len(rows) > 45:
            text += "\n... {} more rows (see the GeoPackage outputs)".format(len(rows) - 45)
        _label(layout, text, x, y, w, h, page, size=6, mono=True)
        return False


def _depth_layer(depth, scenario, add_to_project, group=None):
    """The depth raster for the maps. A layout kept in the project needs a
    layer that is IN the project (otherwise the saved layout loses it): an
    existing project layer of the same file is reused, else the raster is
    added (styled blue)."""
    if depth is None or not depth.isValid():
        return None
    if not add_to_project:
        return depth
    src = depth.source().split("|")[0]
    for lyr in QgsProject.instance().mapLayers().values():
        try:
            if isinstance(lyr, QgsRasterLayer) and same_path(lyr.source().split("|")[0], src):
                return lyr
        except Exception:
            continue
    depth.setName("Max depth ({})".format(scenario.name))
    style_depth(depth)
    add_layer_to_project(depth, group=group)
    return depth


def _summary_page(layout, dam_name, res, scenario, all_results):
    nd, tm11 = res["nd"], res["tm11"]
    _label(layout, "{} - dam hazard classification (screening)".format(dam_name),
           MARGIN, MARGIN, PAGE_W - 2 * MARGIN, 9, 0, size=14, bold=True)
    sub = "ND hazard: {}    ACER TM 11: {} (lives in jeopardy {:.1f})    governing " \
          "scenario: {}{}".format(nd["cls"].upper(), tm11["cls"].upper(), tm11["lij"],
                                 scenario.name,
                                 "    (incremental - consequences the breach adds)"
                                 if res.get("incremental") else "")
    _label(layout, sub, MARGIN, 20, PAGE_W - 2 * MARGIN, 6, 0, size=9, bold=True)
    left_w = 170.0
    _label(layout, "North Dakota Dam Safety Standards - " + ND_POLICY_REF, MARGIN, 28,
           left_w, 5, 0, size=8, bold=True)
    crit = nd.get("criteria") or []
    rows = [[c["section"], c["criterion"], c["found"], c["result"]] for c in crit]
    # v2.3.1: repeat=True so extra rows don't silently clip in PDF
    _table(layout, ND_HEAD, rows, 0, MARGIN, 34, left_w, 100, size=7, repeat=True,
           title="ND criteria", widths=ND_WIDTHS)
    rx = MARGIN + left_w + 6
    rw = PAGE_W - MARGIN - rx
    _label(layout, TM11_REF + " - Table 1", rx, 28, rw, 5, 0, size=8, bold=True)
    from .classification import tm11_rows
    _table(layout, TM_HEAD, [list(r) for r in tm11_rows(tm11)], 0, rx, 34, rw, 52, size=7,
           repeat=False, title="TM 11", widths=TM_WIDTHS)
    breaches = [(name, r) for name, r in (all_results or {}).items() if r.get("nd")]
    if len(breaches) > 1:
        _label(layout, "Scenarios (the most severe governs)", rx, 90, rw, 5, 0, size=8,
               bold=True)
        srows = [[name, r["nd"]["cls"], r["tm11"]["cls"], "{:.1f}".format(r["tm11"]["lij"]),
                  r.get("method") or "", (r.get("incremental") or {}).get("baseline", "")]
                 for name, r in breaches]
        if len(srows) > 8:
            log_message("Report: {} scenario rows exceed frame - table continues "
                        "on extra page".format(len(srows)))
```
