```python
        rid = str(r.get("railroad") or r.get("subdivision") or "rail fid {}".format(r.get("fid")))
        o = nh.Railroad(id=rid, max_depth_ft=depth if depth is not None else float("nan"),
                        trains_per_day=r.get("trains"), passenger=bool(r.get("passenger")))
        wet = depth is not None and depth >= wet_ft
        lvl, why, _gap = nh.rail_class(o, st) if wet else ("", "below {:g} ft".format(wet_ft), "")
        if wet:
            nh_rails.append(o)
        nd = r.get("nd_class") or ""
        rows.append({"Kind": "railroad", "ID": rid, "Depth_ft": _fmt(depth), "ND_Class": nd,
                     "ND_Basis": r.get("nd_basis") or "", "NH_Class": lvl, "NH_Reason": why,
                     "Differs": "Yes" if nd != lvl else "No",
                     "Cause": "" if nd == lvl else ("wet threshold" if not wet
                                                    else "railroad rule")})
    return rows, nh_roads, nh_rails


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ driver --
def _charts_for(nh, method, chart_file=None):
    if chart_file:
        cs = nh.load_charts(chart_file)
        if not cs.ready:
            raise ValueError("chart file {} is not digitized and checked (status '{}') - use "
                             "the default comparison with ND Dam Hazard's curves".format(
                                 chart_file, cs.status))
        return cs, "nd_hazard chart method with the chart file {} (status {}, digitized by {}, " \
                   "checked by {})".format(chart_file, cs.status, cs.digitized_by, cs.checked_by)
    if method == METHOD_CONSERVATIVE:
        return None, METHOD_LABELS[method]
    return _CurveCharts(nh, CS.charts_from_curves()), METHOD_LABELS[METHOD_CURVES]


def run_compare(recs, depth_path, vel_path, nd_class="", judge=True, method=METHOD_CURVES,
                chart_file=None, nh_path=None, wet_ft=0.1, roads=(), rails=(),
                out_folder=None, dam_name="", source="", one_d=False, use_nd_types=False,
                transform=None):
    """The comparison for structure records and the rasters; writes the CSV and
    HTML into out_folder (outputs/QA) when given. transform: optional function
    (x, y) -> (x, y) from the structures' CRS to the rasters' CRS."""
    if method not in METHODS:
        raise ValueError("method must be one of {}".format(", ".join(METHODS)))
    nh, info = CS.find_nd_hazard(nh_path)
    if nh is None:
        raise ValueError(info.get("problem") or "nd_hazard.py not found")
    if not depth_path or not os.path.isfile(depth_path):
        raise ValueError("depth raster not found: {}".format(depth_path))
    depth = Raster(depth_path)
    if not depth.square:
        raise ValueError("{}: nd_hazard's sampling needs square cells ({} x {})".format(
            os.path.basename(depth_path), depth.dx, depth.dy))
    vel = Raster(vel_path) if vel_path and os.path.isfile(vel_path) else None
    charts, method_text = _charts_for(nh, method, chart_file)
    if transform is not None:
        recs = [_moved(r, transform) for r in recs]
    rows, nh_structs, skipped = compare_records(nh, recs, depth, vel, judge, method, charts,
                                                wet_ft, use_nd_types)
    lin_rows, nh_roads, nh_rails = compare_linear(nh, roads, rails, wet_ft)
    st = nh.Settings(lethality=nh.LETHALITY_ALL_WET if method == METHOD_CONSERVATIVE and
                     not chart_file else nh.LETHALITY_CHARTS, wet_ft=wet_ft).validate()
    cls_s = nh.classify(structures=nh_structs, settings=st, charts=charts)
    cls_all = nh.classify(structures=nh_structs, roads=nh_roads, railroads=nh_rails, settings=st,
                          charts=charts) if (nh_roads or nh_rails) else cls_s
    nd_struct = max((r["ND_Level"] for r in rows if r["ND_Level"] != "dry"),
                    key=lambda x: _RANK.get(x, -1), default="Low")
    counts = {c: sum(1 for r in rows if c in r["_causes"]) for c in CAUSES + (CAUSE_OTHER,)}
    n_diff = sum(1 for r in rows if r["Differs"] == "Yes")
    verdict = _verdict(nd_class, cls_all.hazard_class, nd_struct, cls_s.hazard_class, n_diff,
                       len(rows), counts, rows, bool(roads or rails))
    notes = [
        "nd_hazard.py: {} (module {}, SHA-256 {}){}.".format(
            info["file"], info["module_version"], info["sha256"][:16],
            "" if info.get("identical_copies") in (None, True)
            else " - WARNING: the installed copies of nd_hazard.py are not identical"),
        "Method: " + method_text + ".",
        "ND Dam Hazard samples the outline grown by a {:g}-ft ring (a point structure: its "
        "assumed disc) and zones every cell with its own depth and velocity; nd_hazard samples "
        "the cells whose centre is inside the outline (a point: the cell under it) and pairs "
        "the maximum depth with the maximum velocity.".format(OSM_EDGE_BUFFER_FT),
        "nd_hazard habitability and mobile home type come from the occupancy text only "
        "(blank / unknown = habitable); ND Dam Hazard uses its inventory rules, review "
        "decisions and footprint size.",
        "ND Dam Hazard counted the judgment zone as probable loss of life: {}.".format(
            "yes" if judge else "no"),
        "'Any depth' for nd_hazard: {:g} ft or more.".format(wet_ft),
        "Structures dry for both: {}; flooded but uninhabited for both: {} (not listed).".format(
            skipped["dry_both"], skipped["uninhabited_both"]),
    ]
    if one_d:
        notes.append("The ND Dam Hazard run used the 1D (depth > 2 ft) criterion; this "
                     "comparison uses nd_hazard's 2D methods - expect differences.")
    if roads or rails:
        notes.append("Roads / railroads: ND Dam Hazard's overtopped stretches with its own "
                     "depths, AADT and train data, re-classified with nd_hazard.road_class / "
                     "rail_class (sole access not re-evaluated).")
    else:
        notes.append("Roads / railroads: none in the ND Dam Hazard result (or not available in "
                     "file mode) - structures only.")
    if nd_class:
        notes.append("ND Dam Hazard's dam class also covers criteria not re-evaluated here "
                     "(lifelines, dams in series, extra criteria).")
    out = {"rows": rows, "road_rows": lin_rows, "nd_class": nd_class,
           "nh_class": cls_all.hazard_class, "nh_class_structures": cls_s.hazard_class,
           "nd_class_structures": nd_struct, "verdict": verdict, "counts": counts,
           "differ": n_diff, "notes": notes, "method": method, "method_text": method_text,
           "nd_hazard": info, "skipped": skipped, "classification": cls_all,
           "dam_name": dam_name, "source": source, "csv": None, "html": None,
           "roads_csv": None}
    if out_folder:
        write_outputs(out, out_folder)
    return out


def _moved(rec, fn):
    """A shallow copy of rec whose geometry is replaced by parts in the raster CRS."""
    parts = []
    for kind, data in _parts_of(rec.get("geom")):
        if kind == "point":
            parts.append(("point", fn(*data)))
        else:
            parts.append(("polygon", [[fn(x, y) for x, y in ring] for ring in data]))
    r = dict(rec)
    r["geom"] = _Parts(parts)
    return r


def _verdict(nd_cls, nh_cls, nd_struct, nh_struct, n_diff, n, counts, rows, linear):
    why = ", ".join("{} {}".format(counts[c], c) for c in CAUSES + (CAUSE_OTHER,)
                    if counts.get(c))
    diff_txt = "{} of {} compared structure(s) differ ({})".format(n_diff, n, why) if n_diff \
        else "no structure differs"
    base = nd_cls or nd_struct
    if base and base == nh_cls:
        return "Same dam class from both rule sets ({}); {}.".format(base, diff_txt)
    if not base:
        return "nd_hazard rules give {}; ND Dam Hazard's class not available; {}.".format(
            nh_cls, diff_txt)
    gov = [r for r in rows if r["Differs"] == "Yes" and
           (r["ND_Level"] == max(nd_struct, nh_struct, key=lambda x: _RANK.get(x, -1)) or
            r["NH_Level"] == max(nd_struct, nh_struct, key=lambda x: _RANK.get(x, -1)))]
    gc = sorted({c for r in gov for c in r["_causes"]})
    tail = ""
    if nd_struct == nh_struct and nd_cls and nd_cls != nh_cls:
        tail = " The structures agree ({}); the difference comes from criteria outside the " \
               "structures{}.".format(nd_struct, " (roads / railroads)" if linear else "")
    return "Dam class differs: ND Dam Hazard {}, nd_hazard rules {}; {}{}.{}".format(
        base, nh_cls, diff_txt, "; governing cause(s): " + ", ".join(gc) if gc else "", tail)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ output --
def write_outputs(out, out_folder):
    """Rules_Comparison.csv (the structure table only, one header row, so it
    opens as a table in QGIS / Excel), Rules_Comparison_Roads.csv when roads /
    railroads were compared, and Rules_Comparison.html (verdict, classes,
    tables, notes)."""
    os.makedirs(out_folder, exist_ok=True)
    p_csv = os.path.join(out_folder, CSV_NAME)
    p_html = os.path.join(out_folder, HTML_NAME)
    p_roads = os.path.join(out_folder, ROADS_CSV_NAME)
    _write_csv(p_csv, COLUMNS, out["rows"])
    if out["road_rows"]:
        _write_csv(p_roads, ROAD_COLUMNS, out["road_rows"])
    elif os.path.isfile(p_roads):
        os.remove(p_roads)                     # never leave a previous run's table
        p_roads = None
    else:
        p_roads = None
    with open(p_html + ".tmp", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(render_html(out))
    os.replace(p_html + ".tmp", p_html)
    out["csv"], out["html"], out["roads_csv"] = p_csv, p_html, p_roads
    return p_csv, p_html


def _write_csv(path, columns, rows):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(columns)
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow([r.get(c, "") for c in columns])
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def _e(v):
    return html.escape("" if v is None else str(v), quote=True)


def render_html(out):
    t = ["<!doctype html>", '<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">',
         '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">',
         "<title>Rules comparison</title>",
         "<style>body{font-family:Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;margin:16px;"
         "color:#111;background:#fff}table{border-collapse:collapse;margin:8px 0 18px}"
         "th,td{border:1px solid #bbb;padding:3px 6px;vertical-align:top;text-align:left}"
         "th{background:#eee}tr.d td{background:#fff4e0}.v{font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;"
         "margin:10px 0}.wrap{overflow-x:auto}</style></head><body>",
         "<h1>Rules comparison: ND Dam Hazard vs nd_hazard (Breach Runner / Screening)</h1>",
         "<p>{}{} - written {} by {} {}.</p>".format(
             _e(out.get("dam_name") or ""), " (" + _e(out["source"]) + ")"
             if out.get("source") else "", _e(datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(
                 timespec="seconds")), _e(PLUGIN_NAME), _e(PLUGIN_VERSION)),
         '<p class="v">{}</p>'.format(_e(out["verdict"])),
         "<table><tr><th></th><th>ND Dam Hazard</th><th>nd_hazard rules</th></tr>",
         "<tr><td>Dam class</td><td>{}</td><td>{}</td></tr>".format(
             _e(out["nd_class"] or "-"), _e(out["nh_class"])),
         "<tr><td>From the compared structures</td><td>{}</td><td>{}</td></tr></table>".format(
             _e(out["nd_class_structures"]), _e(out["nh_class_structures"])),
         "<h2>Structures</h2>",
         "<p>Causes: {}.</p>".format(_e(", ".join("{} {}".format(k, v) for k, v in
                                                   out["counts"].items() if v) or "none")),
         '<div class="wrap"><table><tr>{}</tr>'.format(
             "".join("<th>{}</th>".format(_e(c)) for c in COLUMNS))]
    for r in out["rows"]:
        t.append('<tr{}>{}</tr>'.format(' class="d"' if r["Differs"] == "Yes" else "",
                                        "".join("<td>{}</td>".format(_e(r.get(c, "")))
                                                for c in COLUMNS)))
    t.append("</table></div>")
    if out["road_rows"]:
        t.append("<h2>Roads and railroads</h2>")
        t.append('<div class="wrap"><table><tr>{}</tr>'.format(
            "".join("<th>{}</th>".format(_e(c)) for c in ROAD_COLUMNS)))
        for r in out["road_rows"]:
            t.append('<tr{}>{}</tr>'.format(' class="d"' if r["Differs"] == "Yes" else "",
                                            "".join("<td>{}</td>".format(_e(r.get(c, "")))
                                                    for c in ROAD_COLUMNS)))
        t.append("</table></div>")
    t.append("<h2>Notes</h2><ul>")
    t += ["<li>{}</li>".format(_e(n)) for n in out["notes"]]
    t.append("<li>ND Dam Hazard is the classification authority; nd_hazard's results are "
             "screening previews. The official classification is made by the ND Department of "
             "Water Resources. Not yet run in a real QGIS.</li></ul></body></html>")
    return "\n".join(t) + "\n"


# ------------------------------------------------------ the two entry points --
def _raster_transform(struct_crs, raster_path):
    """(x, y) -> (x, y) from struct_crs to the raster's CRS, or None when they
    are the same or cannot be compared (QGIS needed)."""
    if struct_crs is None:
        return None
    try:
        from qgis.core import (QgsRasterLayer, QgsCoordinateTransform, QgsProject,
                               QgsPointXY)
        lyr = QgsRasterLayer(raster_path, "depth")
        rcrs = lyr.crs() if lyr is not None and lyr.isValid() else None
        if rcrs is None or not rcrs.isValid() or rcrs == struct_crs:
            return None
        ct = QgsCoordinateTransform(struct_crs, rcrs, QgsProject.instance().transformContext())

        def fn(x, y):
            p = ct.transform(QgsPointXY(x, y))
            return p.x(), p.y()
        return fn
    except Exception:
        return None


def compare_result(res, scenario=None, method=METHOD_CURVES, chart_file=None, nh_path=None,
                   wet_ft=0.1, out_folder=None, judgment_as_probable=None, write=True,
                   use_nd_types=False, depth_path=None, vel_path=None):
    """Comparison for a pipeline result dict (run_classification): structures of
    the governing breach scenario (or `scenario`), its depth / velocity
    rasters, ND's roads / railroads and dam class. Writes outputs/QA/
    Rules_Comparison.csv / .html unless write=False."""
    results = res.get("results") or {}
    name = scenario or res.get("governing") or (next(iter(results)) if results else None)
    sres = results.get(name) or {}
    sc = sres.get("scenario")
    depth_path = depth_path or (getattr(sc, "depth", None) if sc is not None else None)
    vel_path = vel_path or (getattr(sc, "velocity", None) if sc is not None else None)
    snap = sres.get("snap") or {}
    recs = []
    for rec in res.get("structs") or []:
        r = dict(rec)
        r.update(snap.get(rec.get("id"), {}))         # this scenario's values
        recs.append(r)
    run = res.get("run")
    cfg = getattr(run, "cfg", None) or {}
    judge = cfg.get("judgment_as_probable", True) if judgment_as_probable is None \
        else bool(judgment_as_probable)
    if out_folder is None and write:
        base = getattr(run, "out", None) or cfg.get("output_folder")
        out_folder = os.path.join(base, SUBDIR_QA) if base else None
    nd = sres.get("nd") or res.get("nd") or {}
    return run_compare(recs, depth_path, vel_path, nd_class=nd.get("cls", ""), judge=judge,
                       method=method, chart_file=chart_file, nh_path=nh_path, wet_ft=wet_ft,
                       roads=sres.get("roads") or (), rails=sres.get("rails") or (),
                       out_folder=out_folder if write else None,
                       dam_name=res.get("dam_name") or "", source="scenario '{}'".format(name),
                       one_d=bool(cfg.get("one_d")), use_nd_types=use_nd_types,
                       transform=_raster_transform(res.get("crs"), depth_path))


def _find_structures_file(out_folder, name=None):
    folder = os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION)
    if name:
        p = name if os.path.isabs(name) else os.path.join(folder, name)
        return p if os.path.isfile(p) else None
    p = os.path.join(folder, "Habitable_Structures.gpkg")
    if os.path.isfile(p):
        return p
    hits = sorted((os.path.join(folder, f) for f in os.listdir(folder)
                   if f.startswith("Habitable_Structures") and f.endswith(".gpkg")),
                  key=os.path.getmtime) if os.path.isdir(folder) else []
    return hits[-1] if hits else None


def _read_run_settings(out_folder):
    p = os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_QA, "Run_Settings.json")
    try:
        with open(p, encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
            return json.load(fh)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return {}


def _nd_class_from_summary(out_folder):
    try:
        from . import portfolio as PF
        p = PF.newest(out_folder, "Hazard_Classification_Summary*.txt")
        if not p:
            return ""
        return PF.summary_facts(PF.parse_summary(PF.read_text(p))).get("nd", "") or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


_ZONE_OF_LABEL = {"HIGH": CLASS_HIGH, "JUDGMENT": CLASS_JUDGMENT, "LOW": CLASS_LOW}


def read_structures_layer(path):
    """ND structure records from a Habitable_Structures GeoPackage (QGIS)."""
    from qgis.core import QgsVectorLayer
    lyr = QgsVectorLayer(path, "structures", "ogr")
    if lyr is None or not lyr.isValid():
        raise ValueError("structure layer could not be opened: {}".format(path))
    names = [f.name() for f in lyr.fields()]
    recs = []
    for feat in lyr.getFeatures():
        a = dict(zip(names, feat.attributes()))
        g = lambda k: _clean_attr(a.get(k))          # noqa: E731
        zone = g("ACER_Zone")
        try:
            zone = int(zone) if zone is not None else None
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            zone = _ZONE_OF_LABEL.get(str(g("ACER_Zone_Label") or "").upper())
        addr = ", ".join(str(x) for x in (g("Address"), g("City"), g("ZIP")) if x)
        recs.append({"id": g("Struct_ID"), "geom": feat.geometry(), "habitable": g("Habitable"),
                     "acer_type": g("ACER_Type"), "max_depth": _num(g("Max_Depth_ft")),
                     "max_vel": _num(g("Max_Vel_fps")), "zone": zone,
                     "outcome": g("ND_Outcome") or _OUT_DRY,
                     "occupancy": g("Occupancy") or "", "fema_category": g("FEMA_Category") or "",
                     "zone_note": "moved" if "zone moved" in str(g("Notes") or "") else "",
                     "address": addr})
    crs = lyr.crs()
    return recs, crs


def _clean_attr(v):
    if v is None:
        return None
    try:
        if v.isNull():                 # QVariant NULL
            return None
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    if type(v).__name__ in ("_Null", "QVariant", "NULL"):
        return None
    return v


def compare_folder(out_folder, depth_path=None, vel_path=None, method=METHOD_CURVES,
                   chart_file=None, nh_path=None, wet_ft=0.1, structures_file=None,
                   judgment_as_probable=None, write=True):
    """Comparison from the files a run wrote: <outputs>/Classification/
    Habitable_Structures.gpkg (fields Max_Depth_ft, Max_Vel_fps, ACER_Zone,
    Habitable, ACER_Type, ND_Outcome, Occupancy ...), the breach rasters named
    in QA/Run_Settings.json (or given), the ND class from the summary. Point
    structures are in that layer as their evaluation disc, so nd_hazard samples
    the disc (said in the notes)."""
    if not out_folder or not os.path.isdir(out_folder):
        raise ValueError("outputs folder not found: {}".format(out_folder))
    if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION)) and \
            os.path.isdir(os.path.join(out_folder, "outputs")):
        out_folder = os.path.join(out_folder, "outputs")
    sfile = _find_structures_file(out_folder, structures_file)
    if not sfile:
        raise ValueError("no Habitable_Structures GeoPackage in {} - run the classification "
                         "first".format(os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION)))
    rs = _read_run_settings(out_folder)
    if not depth_path:
        for sc in rs.get("scenarios") or []:
            if (sc.get("role") or "breach") == "breach" and sc.get("depth"):
                depth_path, vel_path = sc.get("depth"), vel_path or sc.get("velocity")
                break
    if not depth_path:
        raise ValueError("no depth raster given and none named in QA/Run_Settings.json")
    settings = rs.get("settings") or {}
    judge = settings.get("judgment_as_probable", True) if judgment_as_probable is None \
        else bool(judgment_as_probable)
    recs, crs = read_structures_layer(sfile)
    out = run_compare(recs, depth_path, vel_path, nd_class=_nd_class_from_summary(out_folder),
                      judge=judge, method=method, chart_file=chart_file, nh_path=nh_path,
                      wet_ft=wet_ft, out_folder=os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_QA)
                      if write else None, dam_name=rs.get("dam_name") or "",
                      source=os.path.basename(sfile), one_d=bool(settings.get("one_d")),
                      transform=_raster_transform(crs, depth_path))
    out["notes"].append("File mode: structures from {} (habitable / unverified structures "
                        "only; point structures appear as their evaluation disc and are "
                        "sampled as that disc by nd_hazard).".format(os.path.basename(sfile)))
    if write:
        write_outputs(out, os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_QA))
    return out
```

## `rulecompare_alg.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.10 Processing algorithm ndhazard:rulecompare - ND Dam Hazard's results
re-classified with the Breach Runner / Screening rules (rulecompare.py).
Register it in processing_provider.Provider.loadAlgorithms.

Self-contained on purpose (own base class, no import of processing_provider),
so processing_provider may import this module at any point without a cycle.
"""

import os
import traceback

from qgis.core import (
    Qgis, QgsProcessingAlgorithm, QgsProcessingException, QgsProcessingParameterFile,
    QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer, QgsProcessingParameterEnum, QgsProcessingParameterNumber,
    QgsProcessingOutputFile, QgsProcessingOutputString,
)

from .compat import _first
from .helpers import get_layer_path

FILE_FOLDER = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingFileParameterBehavior.Folder,
                     lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Behavior.Folder,
                     lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Folder)
FILE_FILE = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingFileParameterBehavior.File,
                   lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Behavior.File,
                   lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.File)
NUM_DOUBLE = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingNumberParameterType.Double,
                    lambda: QgsProcessingParameterNumber.Type.Double,
                    lambda: QgsProcessingParameterNumber.Double)
METHOD_OPTIONS = ["nd_hazard charts made from ND Dam Hazard's curves (only sampling / "
                  "habitability / rules differ)",
                  "nd_hazard conservative method (no chart)"]


class RuleCompareAlgorithm(QgsProcessingAlgorithm):
    def name(self):
        return "rulecompare"

    def displayName(self):
        return "Compare with the Breach Runner / Screening rules (nd_hazard)"

    def group(self):
        return "Dam hazard classification"

    def groupId(self):
        return "damhazard"

    def createInstance(self):
        return type(self)()

    def shortHelpString(self):
        return ("Re-classifies the structures of a finished ND Dam Hazard run with the rules of "
                "ND Dam Breach Runner / ND Dam Breach Screening (their core/nd_hazard.py, found "
                "in the installed plugins or given here): the depth / velocity rasters sampled "
                "their way (cells inside the outline, maximum depth with maximum velocity), "
                "habitability and mobile home from the occupancy text, and either ND Dam "
                "Hazard's own TM 11 curves as charts (so only sampling, habitability and the "
                "rules differ), the conservative no-chart method, or a signed-off chart file.\n\n"
                "Writes outputs/QA/Rules_Comparison.csv and .html: per structure both results, "
                "whether they differ and why (sampling area, habitability, mobile home type, "
                "chart / method, judgment zone rule), the dam class from each and a verdict. "
                "ND Dam Hazard remains the classification authority. Not yet run in a real "
                "QGIS.")

    def initAlgorithm(self, config=None):
        P = self.addParameter
        P(QgsProcessingParameterFile("OUTPUT_FOLDER", "The dam folder or its outputs folder",
                                     behavior=FILE_FOLDER))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("DEPTH", "Breach maximum depth (ft) - empty: the "
                                            "one in QA/Run_Settings.json", optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterRasterLayer("VELOCITY", "Breach maximum velocity (ft/s) - "
                                            "empty: from QA/Run_Settings.json", optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterEnum("METHOD", "nd_hazard lethality method",
                                     options=METHOD_OPTIONS, defaultValue=0))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterFile("CHART_FILE", "Or: a signed-off chart file (.json) - "
                                     "overrides the method", behavior=FILE_FILE,
                                     extension="json", optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterFile("ND_HAZARD_PY", "nd_hazard.py (empty: from the installed "
                                     "Breach Runner / Screening)", behavior=FILE_FILE,
                                     extension="py", optional=True))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterNumber("WET_FT", "nd_hazard 'any depth' (ft)", type=NUM_DOUBLE,
                                       defaultValue=0.1, minValue=0.01))
        self.addOutput(QgsProcessingOutputFile("CSV", "Rules_Comparison.csv"))
        self.addOutput(QgsProcessingOutputFile("HTML", "Rules_Comparison.html"))
        self.addOutput(QgsProcessingOutputString("VERDICT", "Verdict"))

    def _raster(self, parameters, name, context):
        v = parameters.get(name) if isinstance(parameters, dict) else None
        if isinstance(v, str) and v and os.path.isfile(v):
            return v
        lyr = self.parameterAsRasterLayer(parameters, name, context)
        return get_layer_path(lyr) if lyr is not None else None

    def processAlgorithm(self, parameters, context, feedback):
        from . import rulecompare as RC
        folder = self.parameterAsFile(parameters, "OUTPUT_FOLDER", context)
        if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
            raise QgsProcessingException("Folder not found: {}".format(folder))
        try:
            m = int(self.parameterAsEnum(parameters, "METHOD", context))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            m = 0
        method = RC.METHODS[m] if 0 <= m < len(RC.METHODS) else RC.METHOD_CURVES
        try:
            wet = float(self.parameterAsDouble(parameters, "WET_FT", context))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            wet = 0.1
        try:
            out = RC.compare_folder(
                folder, depth_path=self._raster(parameters, "DEPTH", context),
                vel_path=self._raster(parameters, "VELOCITY", context), method=method,
                chart_file=self.parameterAsFile(parameters, "CHART_FILE", context) or None,
                nh_path=self.parameterAsFile(parameters, "ND_HAZARD_PY", context) or None,
                wet_ft=wet)
        except (ValueError, OSError) as e:
            raise QgsProcessingException(str(e)) from e
        except Exception as e:                       # never an unhandled crash
            try:
                feedback.reportError(traceback.format_exc(), False)
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise QgsProcessingException("Unexpected error: {!r}".format(e)) from e
        feedback.pushInfo(out["verdict"])
        for n in out["notes"]:
            feedback.pushInfo(n)
        return {"CSV": out["csv"], "HTML": out["html"], "VERDICT": out["verdict"]}
```

## `runner.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.6: runs in the background.

The classification (and Download data now) run in a QgsTask so QGIS stays
usable while data are downloaded and rasters are sampled. The pipeline is
started with deferred=True: it writes its files in the worker thread and
leaves the project work (layers, map book, report, summary) to
pipeline.finish_run(), which the dialog calls on the main thread when the
task has finished. Progress and log lines cross to the main thread through
Qt signals.

Without a task manager (tests, headless scripts) start_task() runs the work
at once on the calling thread and calls the same callbacks - the dialog
code does not know the difference.
"""

import os
import traceback

from qgis.PyQt.QtCore import QObject, pyqtSignal

from .helpers import CancelledByUser, log_message, layer_file_path
from .compat import MSG_WARNING


class Bridge(QObject):
    """Signals a worker thread emits; the slots run on the main thread."""
    progressed = pyqtSignal(float, str)
    logged = pyqtSignal(str)
    done = pyqtSignal(object)


class Outcome(object):
    """What a task ended with."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.result = None
        self.error = None
        self.traceback = ""
        self.cancelled = False

    @property
    def ok(self):
        return self.error is None and not self.cancelled


def _task_class():
    try:
        from qgis.core import QgsTask
    except ImportError:
        return None

    try:
        from .compat import _first
        can_cancel = _first(lambda: QgsTask.Flag.CanCancel, lambda: QgsTask.CanCancel)
    except Exception:
        can_cancel = getattr(QgsTask, "CanCancel", 1)

    class PipelineTask(QgsTask):
        def __init__(self, description, work, bridge):
            super().__init__(description, can_cancel)
            self.work = work
            self.bridge = bridge
            self.outcome = Outcome()

        def _report_progress(self, pct, msg):
            if self.isCanceled():
                raise CancelledByUser()
            try:
                self.setProgress(max(0.0, min(100.0, float(pct))))
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.bridge.progressed.emit(float(pct), str(msg))

        def _report_log(self, msg):
            self.bridge.logged.emit(str(msg))

        def run(self):
            try:
                self.outcome.result = self.work(self._report_progress, self._report_log)
                return True
            except CancelledByUser:
                self.outcome.cancelled = True
                return False
            except Exception as e:                         # reported by the dialog
                self.outcome.error = e
                self.outcome.traceback = traceback.format_exc()
                return False

        def finished(self, result):
            # a Cancel that came after the last progress step changes nothing:
            # the work is complete and its files are written
            self.bridge.done.emit(self.outcome)

    return PipelineTask


def task_manager():
    try:
        from qgis.core import QgsApplication
        return QgsApplication.taskManager()
    except Exception:
        return None


def start_task(description, work, on_progress, on_log, on_done):
    """Run work(progress, log) in a QgsTask; on_progress(pct, msg),
    on_log(msg) and on_done(Outcome) are called on the main thread. Returns
    the task (cancel() stops it at the next progress call), or None when the
    work ran at once because no task manager is available (on_done was then
    already called)."""
    cls = _task_class()
    mgr = task_manager()
    if cls is None or mgr is None:
        out = Outcome()

        def progress(pct, msg):
            on_progress(float(pct), str(msg))

        try:
            out.result = work(progress, on_log)
        except CancelledByUser:
            out.cancelled = True
        except Exception as e:
            out.error = e
            out.traceback = traceback.format_exc()
        on_done(out)
        return None
    bridge = Bridge()
    bridge.progressed.connect(on_progress)
    bridge.logged.connect(on_log)
    bridge.done.connect(on_done)
    task = cls(description, work, bridge)
    task._bridge_ref = bridge                 # keep the QObject alive with the task
    mgr.addTask(task)
    return task


# --------------------------------------------------------- main-thread prep --
def detach_layers(cfg):
    """A copy of the configuration whose project layers are replaced by
    clones, so the worker thread never reads a layer the user could edit or
    remove from the project meanwhile. Layers without clone() are kept."""
    from .pipeline import _EVAL_LAYERS

    done = {}                                 # one clone per layer (road = AADT layer)

    def clone(lyr):
        if lyr is None:
            return None
        key = id(lyr)
        if key in done:
            return done[key]
        c = None
        try:
            # unsaved edits live in the edit buffer, which a clone does not
            # share: such a layer is copied feature by feature instead
            edited = bool(getattr(lyr, "isEditable", lambda: False)() and
                          getattr(lyr, "isModified", lambda: False)())
        except Exception:
            edited = False
        order = ("materialize", "clone") if edited else ("clone", "materialize")
        for meth in order:
            fn = getattr(lyr, meth, None)
            if fn is None:
                continue
            try:
                c = fn(_all_request()) if meth == "materialize" else fn()
                if c is not None and c.isValid():
                    try:
                        c.setName(lyr.name())
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    break
                c = None
            except Exception as e:
                log_message("Layer '{}' not copied for the background run ({}); read in "
                            "place".format(lyr.name(), e))
                c = None
        if edited and c is not None and order[0] == "materialize" and \
                getattr(c, "featureCount", lambda: -1)() != getattr(lyr, "featureCount",
                                                                    lambda: -2)():
            log_message("Layer '{}': unsaved edits may not be in the copy the run reads - "
                        "save the layer first".format(lyr.name()), MSG_WARNING)
        done[key] = c if c is not None else lyr
        return done[key]
    out = dict(cfg)
    for key in _EVAL_LAYERS + ("parcel_layer", "pop_source"):
        if out.get(key) is not None:
            out[key] = clone(out[key])
    if out.get("osm_layer") not in (None, "auto"):
        out["osm_layer"] = clone(out["osm_layer"])
    if isinstance(out.get("point_sources"), (list, tuple)):
        out["point_sources"] = [(fam, clone(lyr)) for fam, lyr in out["point_sources"]]
    return out


def _all_request():
    from qgis.core import QgsFeatureRequest
    return QgsFeatureRequest()


# result files the classification writes (also the flat layout before 2.3)
_RESULT_BASES = ("habitable_structures", "roads_inundated", "rail_inundated", "access_cut_off",
                 "dams_in_series", "lifeline_facilities", "bridges_culverts_crossings",
                 "model_boundary_check", "eap_", "structure_sample_points",
                 "structure_evaluation_areas", "structure_sampled_cells",
                 "future_development_parcels", "hazard_foundations", "hazard_mobilehomes",
                 "hazard_vehicles", "inventory_qa")


def release_outputs(output_folder, data_sets=False):
    """Remove from the project the plugin's result layers under
    output_folder (the run rewrites those files; a loaded layer would keep
    them locked on Windows): the files of the Classification / EAP / QA /
    Consolidation / ACER_* folders and result files left in outputs itself.
    With data_sets, the saved data sets in Data too (Download data now).
    Imports (HECRAS_* / DSSWISE_*), downloads, the outline file and the
    user's own layers stay. Main thread only. Returns the number removed."""
    from qgis.core import QgsProject
    from .constants import (SUBDIR_DATA, SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION, SUBDIR_EAP, SUBDIR_QA,
                            SUBDIR_CONSOLIDATION)
    if not output_folder:
        return 0
    root = os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(output_folder))
    result_dirs = {d.lower() for d in (SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION, SUBDIR_EAP, SUBDIR_QA,
                                       SUBDIR_CONSOLIDATION)}
    ids = []
    for lid, lyr in QgsProject.instance().mapLayers().items():
        p = layer_file_path(lyr)
        if not p:
            continue
        rp = os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(p))
        if not rp.startswith(root + os.sep):
            continue
        parts = rp[len(root) + 1:].split(os.sep)
        first = parts[0].lower()
        base = os.path.basename(rp).lower()
        if len(parts) > 1 and (first in result_dirs or first.startswith("acer_")):
            ids.append(lid)
        elif len(parts) > 1 and data_sets and first == SUBDIR_DATA.lower():
            ids.append(lid)
        elif len(parts) == 1 and base.startswith(_RESULT_BASES):
            ids.append(lid)
    if ids:
        try:
            QgsProject.instance().removeMapLayers(ids)
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("Result layers not released before the run: {}".format(e), MSG_WARNING)
            return 0
    return len(ids)
```

## `runnerculverts.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.10 (dam suite item 8): culvert / bridge lines for ND Dam Breach Runner.

Bare-earth LiDAR shows a road or rail embankment as a wall across the stream;
the Runner's "Culverts, bridges and notches" layer (lines, UPSTREAM END FIRST,
fields matched by name) opens it. This module writes that layer from the data
ND Dam Hazard already downloads:

  structures  National Bridge Inventory records (NBI_bridges: bridges and
              culverts with a span of 20 ft or more), OpenStreetMap crossings
              (OSM_crossings: culverts, fords / low-water crossings, railroad
              bridges) and, when given, an NDDOT bridge / culvert layer;
  streams     USGS NHD flowlines (digitised in the flow direction - the same
              assumption traveltime.trace makes) or the engineer's centerline;
  embankments road lines (ND GIS Hub NG9-1-1 centerlines ...) and rail lines.

Placement, per structure point P (all in EPSG:5070 metres):
 1. every place within SEARCH_M of P where a stream line crosses a road / rail
    line (segment intersection); the nearest wins, a line of the kind the
    record belongs to first (railroad bridge -> rail; NBI item 42A = 2 -> rail;
    other NBI / NDDOT records and culverts -> road, then the other kind);
 2. without one, and only when ALLOW_NO_EMBANKMENT is set: the stream point
    nearest to P (the embankment direction is then unknown: the line is not
    lengthened for skew);
 3. otherwise the structure is listed as not placed, with the reason.
The line follows the stream through that point, upstream end first: the
stream's digitised direction is taken as the flow direction (NHD), or the
reverse when STREAM_REVERSED is set. Its length along the stream is
(embankment top width + 2 x MARGIN_M) / sin(crossing angle), the angle
limited to 30 degrees (at most twice the square length); where the stream
line ends first, the line goes on straight along its end segment. The
embankment top width is the NBI deck width (item 52, or the roadway width,
item 51) when the record has one and USE_NBI_WIDTH is set, else the
engineer's ROAD_WIDTH_M / RAIL_WIDTH_M. MARGIN_M stands for the side slopes.
All of these are SCREENING PARAMETERS chosen by the engineer; the defaults
are placeholders, not standards.

Fields (the names ND Dam Breach Runner matches: core/structures.py and
algorithms.STRUCT_FIELD_SYNONYMS - kind, span_ft, rise_ft, barrels, shape,
invert_up, invert_dn, name; units feet):
  kind       culvert / bridge / notch (NBI item 43B = 19 is a culvert - the same
             rule as facilities.read_crossings; a ford or low-water crossing is
             written as a notch: the road dips to the stream, there is no opening
             to model)
  span_ft    NBI item 48, maximum span length (metres in the NBI, converted); empty
             when unknown (the Runner then uses its own default span)
  rise_ft    always EMPTY: neither the NBI nor the OSM crossings carry a culvert rise
  barrels    culvert: NBI item 45 (main-unit spans; the NBI coding guide counts a
             culvert's cells there - verify); bridge: items 45 + 46, all spans, so the
             Runner's cut (span x barrels x 1.1) is about the bridge opening; empty
             when unknown
  shape      EMPTY (the NBI does not say box or pipe; the Runner assumes box)
  invert_up, invert_dn  always EMPTY (no source has inverts; the Runner reads the DEM)
  name       source, number and "carried over crosses"
plus information fields the Runner ignores: source, src_id, carried, crosses,
nbi_kind (43A), nbi_design (43B), n_spans, struct_len_ft (49), deck_w_ft (52 / 51),
emb_width_ft and emb_width_src, line_len_ft, match_m (distance from the structure's
point to the placed crossing), angle_deg, embankment (road / rail / none), emb_name,
stream, stream_dir, also_in (other records merged into this line), notes.
No field name is one the Runner would misread ("width", "height", "type", "id" ...
are not used). Values that are not known are left EMPTY - never guessed.

Output: a GeoPackage (EPSG:5070) with layer "runner_culverts" (lines, give it
to the Runner as "Culverts, bridges and notches"), layer
"culverts_not_placed" (the structure points that could not be placed, with
the reason) and table "runner_culverts_info"; plus a CSV of the structures
not placed. Pure Python (suitegpkg); nothing has run in a real QGIS.
"""

import csv
import datetime
import json
import math
import os

from . import suitegpkg as G
from . import constants as C

M_FT = 1.0 / 0.3048
LAYER = "runner_culverts"
NOT_PLACED = "culverts_not_placed"
INFO_TABLE = "runner_culverts_info"

# engineer-chosen screening parameters (defaults are placeholders, not standards)
DEFAULTS = {"search_m": 150.0,          # structure point to the stream / road crossing
            "road_width_m": 10.0,       # embankment top width of a road (about 33 ft)
            "rail_width_m": 6.0,        # embankment top width of a railroad (about 20 ft)
            "margin_m": 10.0,           # added on EACH side for the side slopes
            "use_nbi_width": True,      # NBI deck / roadway width instead of road_width_m
            "allow_no_embankment": False,
            "stream_reversed": False,   # streams digitised upstream (not NHD)
            "dedupe_m": 30.0,           # records placed this close together = one crossing
            "min_angle_deg": 30.0}

FIELDS = [("name", "text"), ("kind", "text"), ("span_ft", "real"), ("rise_ft", "real"),
          ("barrels", "int"), ("shape", "text"), ("invert_up", "real"), ("invert_dn", "real"),
          ("source", "text"), ("src_id", "text"), ("carried", "text"), ("crosses", "text"),
          ("nbi_kind", "text"), ("nbi_design", "text"), ("n_spans", "int"),
          ("struct_len_ft", "real"), ("deck_w_ft", "real"), ("emb_width_ft", "real"),
          ("emb_width_src", "text"), ("line_len_ft", "real"), ("match_m", "real"),
          ("angle_deg", "real"), ("embankment", "text"), ("emb_name", "text"),
          ("stream", "text"), ("stream_dir", "text"), ("also_in", "text"), ("notes", "text")]
NOT_PLACED_FIELDS = [("name", "text"), ("kind", "text"), ("source", "text"), ("src_id", "text"),
                     ("reason", "text")]
# the Runner's own field synonyms (nd_breach_runner/algorithms.py, STRUCT_FIELD_SYNONYMS);
# kept here so a test can check that no information field is taken for one of them
RUNNER_FIELDS = {"S_KIND": "kind", "S_WIDTH": "span_ft", "S_HEIGHT": "rise_ft",
                 "S_BARRELS": "barrels", "S_SHAPE": "shape", "S_INV_UP": "invert_up",
                 "S_INV_DN": "invert_dn", "S_NAME": "name"}

KIND_CULVERT, KIND_BRIDGE, KIND_NOTCH = "culvert", "bridge", "notch"
SOURCE_RANK = {"NBI": 0, "NDDOT": 1, "OSM": 2}
# NBI item 42B (service under): waterway codes
NBI_WATERWAY = ("5", "6", "7", "8")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ records --
def _low(props):
    return {str(k).lower(): v for k, v in (props or {}).items()}


def _txt(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    s = str(v).strip().strip("'").strip()
    return "" if s.upper() == "NULL" else s


def _num(v):
    try:
        x = float(str(v).strip()) if isinstance(v, str) else float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return x if math.isfinite(x) else None


def _pos(v):
    x = _num(v)
    return x if x is not None and x > 0 else None


def nbi_record(props, xy, source="NBI"):
    """A structure record from National Bridge Inventory fields (NTAD names such as
    STRUCTURE_TYPE_043B, MAX_SPAN_LEN_MT_048 - metres), or (None, reason)."""
    p = _low(props)
    no = _txt(p.get("structure_number_008"))
    design = _txt(p.get("structure_type_043b")).lstrip("0")
    kind43a = _txt(p.get("structure_kind_043a"))
    under = _txt(p.get("service_und_042b"))
    on = _txt(p.get("service_on_042a"))
    carried = _txt(p.get("facility_carried_007"))
    crosses = _txt(p.get("features_desc_006a"))
    kind = KIND_CULVERT if design == "19" else KIND_BRIDGE
    rec = {"x": xy[0], "y": xy[1], "source": source, "src_id": no, "kind": kind,
           "carried": carried, "crosses": crosses, "nbi_kind": kind43a, "nbi_design": design,
           "prefer": "rail" if on == "2" else "road", "notes": []}
    rec["name"] = "{} {}{}".format(source, no or "?", " ({} over {})".format(
        carried or "?", crosses or "?") if (carried or crosses) else "")
    if under and under not in NBI_WATERWAY:
        return None, "{}: not over a waterway (NBI item 42B = {})".format(rec["name"], under)
    span = _pos(p.get("max_span_len_mt_048"))
    main, appr = _pos(p.get("main_unit_spans_045")), _pos(p.get("appr_spans_046"))
    n_spans = int(round((main or 0) + (appr or 0))) or None
    rec["span_ft"] = round(span * M_FT, 2) if span else None
    rec["n_spans"] = n_spans
    if kind == KIND_CULVERT:
        rec["barrels"] = int(round(main)) if main else None
    else:
        rec["barrels"] = n_spans
    ln = _pos(p.get("structure_len_mt_049"))
    rec["struct_len_ft"] = round(ln * M_FT, 2) if ln else None
    deck = _pos(p.get("deck_width_mt_052"))
    road = _pos(p.get("roadway_width_mt_051"))
    rec["deck_w_ft"] = round((deck or road) * M_FT, 2) if (deck or road) else None
    rec["deck_w_src"] = "NBI item 52 (deck width)" if deck else \
        "NBI item 51 (roadway width)" if road else ""
    return rec, ""


def osm_record(props, xy):
    """A structure record from an OpenStreetMap crossing (osm_parse.crossing_features)."""
    p = _low(props)
    cat = _txt(p.get("category"))
    c = cat.lower()
    if c.startswith("culvert"):
        kind, prefer = KIND_CULVERT, "road"
    elif "ford" in c or "low-water" in c or "low water" in c:
        kind, prefer = KIND_NOTCH, "road"
    elif "bridge" in c:
        kind, prefer = KIND_BRIDGE, "rail" if "rail" in c else "road"
    else:
        return None, "OSM {}: category '{}' is not a culvert, ford or bridge".format(
            _txt(p.get("osm_id")) or "?", cat)
    oid = _txt(p.get("osm_id"))
    nm = _txt(p.get("name"))
    rec = {"x": xy[0], "y": xy[1], "source": "OSM", "src_id": oid, "kind": kind,
           "name": "OSM {} {}{}".format(oid or "?", cat.lower(), " ({})".format(nm) if nm else ""),
           "carried": _txt(p.get("railway")), "crosses": _txt(p.get("waterway")),
           "nbi_kind": "", "nbi_design": "", "prefer": prefer, "span_ft": None,
           "n_spans": None, "barrels": None, "struct_len_ft": None, "deck_w_ft": None,
           "deck_w_src": "", "notes": []}
    if kind == KIND_NOTCH:
        rec["notes"].append("ford / low-water crossing: written as a notch (no opening "
                            "through an embankment is expected)")
    return rec, ""


_UNIT_SUFFIX = (("_ft", 1.0), ("_feet", 1.0), ("_mt", M_FT), ("_m", M_FT))


def _dimension(p, stems):
    """A dimension in feet from a field whose name states its unit (span_ft, span_m ...)."""
    for stem in stems:
        for suf, k in _UNIT_SUFFIX:
            v = _pos(p.get(stem + suf))
            if v is not None:
                return round(v * k, 2), stem + suf
    return None, ""


def nddot_record(props, xy):
    """An NDDOT bridge / culvert record: NBI item fields when the layer has them, else a
    kind from a type / kind / description text and dimensions only from fields whose name
    gives the unit (span_ft, span_m ...)."""
    p = _low(props)
    if "structure_number_008" in p or "structure_type_043b" in p:
        return nbi_record(props, xy, source="NDDOT")
    text = " ".join(_txt(p.get(k)) for k in ("type", "kind", "structure_type", "struct_type",
                                             "category", "description", "descr", "str_type")
                    ).lower()
    sid = _txt(p.get("structure_number") or p.get("bridge_no") or p.get("bridge_number") or
               p.get("str_num") or p.get("id") or p.get("objectid"))
    if "culvert" in text or "pipe" in text or "box" in text:
        kind = KIND_CULVERT
    elif "bridge" in text:
        kind = KIND_BRIDGE
    else:
        return None, "NDDOT {}: kind (culvert / bridge) not found in the attributes".format(
            sid or "?")
    span, _s = _dimension(p, ("span", "max_span", "opening_width"))
    barrels = _pos(p.get("barrels") or p.get("cells") or p.get("num_barrels"))
    deck, dsrc = _dimension(p, ("deck_width", "roadway_width", "road_width"))
    nm = _txt(p.get("name") or p.get("route") or p.get("facility_carried"))
    return {"x": xy[0], "y": xy[1], "source": "NDDOT", "src_id": sid, "kind": kind,
            "name": "NDDOT {}{}".format(sid or "?", " ({})".format(nm) if nm else ""),
            "carried": nm, "crosses": _txt(p.get("crosses") or p.get("feature_crossed")),
            "nbi_kind": "", "nbi_design": "", "prefer": "road", "span_ft": span,
            "n_spans": None, "barrels": int(round(barrels)) if barrels else None,
            "struct_len_ft": None, "deck_w_ft": deck, "deck_w_src": "NDDOT " + dsrc if deck else "",
            "notes": []}, ""


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ placement --
class _Lines(object):
    """Polylines in metres with a segment grid: [{"parts", "name", "kind"}]."""

    def __init__(self, items, cell):
        self.items = [it for it in items if it.get("parts")]
        self.grid = G.SegmentGrid(cell)
        for k, it in enumerate(self.items):
            self.grid.add_line(k, it["parts"])

    def segments_near(self, x, y, radius):
        for k, pi, si in self.grid.near(x, y, radius):
            pts = self.items[k]["parts"][pi]
            a, b = pts[si], pts[si + 1]
            if G.seg_distance(x, y, a, b) <= radius:
                yield k, pi, si, a, b


def _chainage(pts, si, t):
    ch = G.line_length(pts[:si + 1])
    return ch + t * math.hypot(pts[si + 1][0] - pts[si][0], pts[si + 1][1] - pts[si][1])


def _cut(pts, ch0, ch1):
    """The polyline between chainages ch0 < ch1, continued straight along the end segments
    where it is too short. Returns (points, extended?)."""
    total = G.line_length(pts)
    ext = ch0 < 0 or ch1 > total
    out = []
    if ch0 < 0:
        (xa, ya), (xb, yb) = pts[0], pts[1]
        n = math.hypot(xb - xa, yb - ya) or 1.0
        out.append((xa - (xb - xa) / n * -ch0, ya - (yb - ya) / n * -ch0))
    out.append(G.point_at(pts, max(ch0, 0.0)))
    run = 0.0
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        run += math.hypot(pts[i + 1][0] - pts[i][0], pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i][1])
        if max(ch0, 0.0) < run < min(ch1, total):
            out.append(tuple(pts[i + 1]))
    out.append(G.point_at(pts, min(ch1, total)))
    if ch1 > total:
        (xa, ya), (xb, yb) = pts[-2], pts[-1]
        n = math.hypot(xb - xa, yb - ya) or 1.0
        out.append((xb + (xb - xa) / n * (ch1 - total), yb + (yb - ya) / n * (ch1 - total)))
    clean = [out[0]]
    for p in out[1:]:
        if math.hypot(p[0] - clean[-1][0], p[1] - clean[-1][1]) > 1e-6:
            clean.append(p)
    return clean, ext


def _angle(a, b, c, d):
    """Angle in degrees (0-90) between segments a-b and c-d."""
    ux, uy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    vx, vy = d[0] - c[0], d[1] - c[1]
    n = math.hypot(ux, uy) * math.hypot(vx, vy)
    if n <= 0:
        return 90.0
    cs = abs(ux * vx + uy * vy) / n
    return math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, cs))))


def place(records, streams, roads=(), rails=(), params=None):
    """Place structure records on the streams. streams / roads / rails:
    [{"parts": [[(x, y), ...]], "name": str}] in metres (EPSG:5070).
    Returns (placed rows [(line geometry, attrs)], not placed [(point geometry, attrs)])."""
    P = dict(DEFAULTS)
    P.update(params or {})
    search = float(P["search_m"])
    cell = max(search, 50.0)
    S = _Lines(streams, cell)
    E = {"road": _Lines(roads or (), cell), "rail": _Lines(rails or (), cell)}
    placed, not_placed = [], []

    def fail(rec, reason):
        not_placed.append(({"type": "Point", "coordinates": (rec["x"], rec["y"])},
                           {"name": rec["name"], "kind": rec["kind"], "source": rec["source"],
                            "src_id": rec["src_id"], "reason": reason}))
    for rec in records:
        x, y = rec["x"], rec["y"]
        segs = list(S.segments_near(x, y, search))
        if not segs:
            fail(rec, "no stream line within {:g} m".format(search))
            continue
        hits = []
        for ek, lines in E.items():
            esegs = list(lines.segments_near(x, y, search))
            if not esegs:
                continue
            for k, pi, si, a, b in segs:
                for ek2, epi, esi, c, d in esegs:
                    hit = G.segment_intersection(a, b, c, d)
                    if hit is None:
                        continue
                    t, _u, (ix, iy) = hit
                    dd = math.hypot(ix - x, iy - y)
                    if dd <= search:
                        hits.append((0 if ek == rec["prefer"] else 1, dd, ek, k, pi, si, t,
                                     (ix, iy), _angle(a, b, c, d), lines.items[ek2]["name"]))
        rec_notes = list(rec.get("notes") or [])
        if hits:
            hits.sort(key=lambda h: (h[0], h[1]))
            pref, dd, ek, k, pi, si, t, xy, ang, ename = hits[0]
            if pref:
                rec_notes.append("no {} line crosses a stream here: placed at a {} "
                                 "crossing".format(rec["prefer"], ek))
        elif P["allow_no_embankment"]:
            best = None
            for k, pi, si, a, b in segs:
                ch, d, pxy, _i = G.project_on_line([a, b], x, y)
                seglen = math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) or 1.0
                if best is None or d < best[1]:
                    best = (k, d, pi, si, ch / seglen, pxy)
            k, dd, pi, si, t, xy = best
            ek, ang, ename = "none", None, ""
            rec_notes.append("no road / rail line crosses a stream within {:g} m: placed on the "
                             "stream point nearest the structure (embankment not seen)".format(search))
        else:
            fail(rec, "no road / rail line crosses a stream within {:g} m".format(search))
            continue
        # embankment top width
        if P["use_nbi_width"] and rec.get("deck_w_ft"):
            width_m, wsrc = rec["deck_w_ft"] / M_FT, rec.get("deck_w_src") or "record"
        elif ek == "rail":
            width_m, wsrc = float(P["rail_width_m"]), "rail default (engineer parameter)"
        else:
            width_m, wsrc = float(P["road_width_m"]), "road default (engineer parameter)"
        length = width_m + 2.0 * float(P["margin_m"])
        if ang is not None:
            length /= math.sin(math.radians(max(float(P["min_angle_deg"]), ang)))
        stream = S.items[k]
        pts = [tuple(p) for p in stream["parts"][pi]]
        ch = _chainage(pts, si, t)
        direction = "as digitised (NHD: downstream)"
        if P["stream_reversed"]:
            total = G.line_length(pts)
            pts = pts[::-1]
            ch = total - ch
            direction = "reversed (streams digitised upstream)"
        line, ext = _cut(pts, ch - length / 2.0, ch + length / 2.0)
        if ext:
            rec_notes.append("the stream line ends within the embankment: extended straight")
        attrs = {"name": rec["name"], "kind": rec["kind"], "span_ft": rec.get("span_ft"),
                 "rise_ft": None, "barrels": rec.get("barrels"), "shape": None,
                 "invert_up": None, "invert_dn": None, "source": rec["source"],
                 "src_id": rec["src_id"], "carried": rec.get("carried"),
                 "crosses": rec.get("crosses"), "nbi_kind": rec.get("nbi_kind"),
                 "nbi_design": rec.get("nbi_design"), "n_spans": rec.get("n_spans"),
                 "struct_len_ft": rec.get("struct_len_ft"), "deck_w_ft": rec.get("deck_w_ft"),
                 "emb_width_ft": round(width_m * M_FT, 1), "emb_width_src": wsrc,
                 "line_len_ft": round(G.line_length(line) * M_FT, 1),
                 "match_m": round(dd, 1), "angle_deg": round(ang, 1) if ang is not None else None,
                 "embankment": ek, "emb_name": ename, "stream": stream.get("name") or "",
                 "stream_dir": direction, "also_in": "", "notes": "; ".join(rec_notes)}
        placed.append(({"type": "LineString", "coordinates": line}, attrs,
                       {"xy": xy, "rank": _rank(rec), "point": (x, y)}))
    placed, dups = _dedupe(placed, float(P["dedupe_m"]))
    for pt, a, why in dups:
        not_placed.append(({"type": "Point", "coordinates": pt},
                           {"name": a["name"], "kind": a["kind"], "source": a["source"],
                            "src_id": a["src_id"], "reason": why}))
    return placed, not_placed


def _rank(rec):
    """Lower is better: more known dimensions, then NBI, NDDOT, OSM."""
    known = sum(1 for k in ("span_ft", "barrels", "deck_w_ft") if rec.get(k))
    return (-known, SOURCE_RANK.get(rec["source"], 9))


def _dedupe(placed, tol):
    """One line per crossing: records whose placed crossing points lie within `tol` of each
    other on the same embankment kind are one structure (the best-described record is kept;
    the others are named in also_in and listed as not placed)."""
    order = sorted(range(len(placed)), key=lambda i: (placed[i][2]["rank"], i))
    hosts, merged, dups = [], {}, []
    for i in order:
        g, a, meta = placed[i]
        host = next((h for h in hosts if placed[h][1]["embankment"] == a["embankment"] and
                     math.hypot(placed[h][2]["xy"][0] - meta["xy"][0],
                                placed[h][2]["xy"][1] - meta["xy"][1]) <= tol), None)
        if host is None:
            hosts.append(i)
            continue
        merged.setdefault(host, []).append(i)
        dups.append((meta["point"], a, "same crossing as {} (merged into its line)".format(
            placed[host][1]["name"])))
    for h, others in merged.items():
        ha = placed[h][1]
        ha["also_in"] = "; ".join(placed[i][1]["name"] for i in others)
        same = 1 + sum(1 for i in others if placed[i][1]["source"] == ha["source"])
        if same > 1:
            note = "{} {} records at this crossing (twin structures? verify the barrels)".format(
                same, ha["source"])
            ha["notes"] = "; ".join(x for x in (ha["notes"], note) if x)
    return [(placed[i][0], placed[i][1]) for i in sorted(hosts)], dups


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ inputs --
def structure_records(nbi=(), osm=(), nddot=()):
    """Records from [(feature, geometry in EPSG:5070)] lists; returns (records, rejected)
    where rejected = [(point geometry, attrs)] of the ones that are not structures over a
    stream."""
    recs, rejected = [], []
    for maker, feats, src in ((nbi_record, nbi, "NBI"), (osm_record, osm, "OSM"),
                              (nddot_record, nddot, "NDDOT")):
        for f, g in feats or ():
            xy = G.point_on_surface(g)
            if xy is None:
                continue
            rec, why = maker(f.get("properties") or {}, xy)
            if rec is None:
                rejected.append(({"type": "Point", "coordinates": xy},
                                 {"name": why.split(":")[0], "kind": "", "source": src,
                                  "src_id": "", "reason": why}))
            else:
                recs.append(rec)
    return recs, rejected


def line_items(feats, name_fields=("gnis_name", "name", "fullname", "full_name", "routename",
                                   "rrowner1", "subdiv"), skip=None):
    """[{"parts", "name"}] of line features [(feature, geometry)]; skip(props) -> True leaves
    a feature out."""
    out = []
    for f, g in feats or ():
        props = f.get("properties") or {}
        if skip is not None and skip(props):
            continue
        parts = [p for p in G.lines_of(g) if len(p) >= 2]
        if not parts:
            continue
        low = _low(props)
        name = next((_txt(low.get(n)) for n in name_fields if _txt(low.get(n))), "")
        out.append({"parts": parts, "name": name})
    return out


def abandoned_rail(props):
    """NARN lines that carry no trains (linear.NARN_NO_TRAFFIC) are no embankment to open."""
    from .linear import NARN_NO_TRAFFIC
    return _txt(_low(props).get("net")).upper() in NARN_NO_TRAFFIC


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ output --
def write(out_path, placed, not_placed, params=None, sources=None):
    """Write the GeoPackage (+ <name>_not_placed.csv). Returns (gpkg path, csv path)."""
    if not out_path.lower().endswith(".gpkg"):
        out_path += ".gpkg"
    w = G.GpkgWriter(out_path)
    try:
        lyr = w.layer(LAYER, "LINESTRING", FIELDS,
                      description="Culverts, bridges and notches for ND Dam Breach Runner "
                                  "(lines, upstream end first)")
        for g, a in placed:
            lyr.add(g, a)
        np_ = w.layer(NOT_PLACED, "POINT", NOT_PLACED_FIELDS,
                      description="structures that could not be placed, with the reason")
        for g, a in not_placed:
            np_.add(g, a)
        info = w.table(INFO_TABLE, [("key", "text"), ("value", "text")])
        P = dict(DEFAULTS)
        P.update(params or {})
        for k, v in (("created", datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")),
                     ("created_by", "ND Dam Hazard {} (runnerculverts.py)".format(
                         C.PLUGIN_VERSION)),
                     ("crs", "EPSG:5070"), ("placed", str(len(placed))),
                     ("not_placed", str(len(not_placed))),
                     ("parameters", json.dumps(P, sort_keys=True)),
                     ("sources", json.dumps(sources or {}, sort_keys=True)),
                     ("for", "ND Dam Breach Runner: 'Culverts, bridges and notches' (lines, "
                             "upstream end first); fields kind, span_ft, rise_ft, barrels, shape, "
                             "invert_up, invert_dn, name are matched by name")):
            info.add(None, {"key": k, "value": v})
        w.close()
    except BaseException:
        w.abort()
        raise
    csv_path = os.path.splitext(out_path)[0] + "_not_placed.csv"
    with open(csv_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        wr = csv.writer(fh)
        wr.writerow(["name", "kind", "source", "src_id", "reason", "x_5070", "y_5070", "lon",
                     "lat"])
        for g, a in not_placed:
            x, y = g["coordinates"][:2]
            lon, lat = G.from_5070(x, y)
            wr.writerow([a["name"], a["kind"], a["source"], a["src_id"], a["reason"],
                         "{:.1f}".format(x), "{:.1f}".format(y), "{:.6f}".format(lon),
                         "{:.6f}".format(lat)])
    return out_path, csv_path


def run(out_path, nbi=(), osm=(), nddot=(), streams=(), roads=(), rails=(), params=None,
        sources=None, log=None):
    """The whole job on [(feature, geometry in EPSG:5070)] lists. Returns a report dict."""
    log = log or (lambda m: None)
    recs, rejected = structure_records(nbi, osm, nddot)
    s_items = line_items(streams)
    r_items = line_items(roads)
    t_items = line_items(rails, skip=abandoned_rail)
    if not s_items:
        raise ValueError("no stream lines: give NHD flowlines or a centerline layer")
    if not r_items and not t_items and not (params or {}).get("allow_no_embankment"):
        raise ValueError("no road or rail lines: give them, or allow placement on the stream "
                         "alone")
    placed, not_placed = place(recs, s_items, r_items, t_items, params)
    not_placed = rejected + not_placed
    gpkg, csv_path = write(out_path, placed, not_placed, params, sources)
    by_kind = {}
    for _g, a in placed:
        by_kind[a["kind"]] = by_kind.get(a["kind"], 0) + 1
    lines = ["Runner culverts: {} line(s) placed ({}), {} structure(s) not placed (see {})".format(
        len(placed), ", ".join("{} {}".format(v, k) for k, v in sorted(by_kind.items())) or "-",
        len(not_placed), os.path.basename(csv_path)),
        "Structures read: {} NBI, {} OSM, {} NDDOT; streams {}, roads {}, rail lines {}".format(
            len(nbi or ()), len(osm or ()), len(nddot or ()), len(s_items), len(r_items),
            len(t_items))]
    reasons = {}
    for _g, a in not_placed:
        key = a["reason"].split(":")[-1].strip() if a["reason"].startswith(("NBI", "NDDOT", "OSM")) \
            else a["reason"]
        key = key if len(key) < 90 else key[:87] + "..."
        reasons[key] = reasons.get(key, 0) + 1
    lines += ["  not placed: {} x {}".format(v, k) for k, v in sorted(reasons.items(),
                                                                      key=lambda t: -t[1])]
    for ln in lines:
        log(ln)
    return {"path": gpkg, "csv": csv_path, "placed": len(placed), "not_placed": len(not_placed),
            "by_kind": by_kind, "lines": lines}


def from_source(out_path, source, extent=None, params=None, log=None, nddot=()):
    """The job on an offline data pack / downloads folder (suiteexport.open_source):
    NBI_bridges, OSM_crossings, NHD_flowlines, ND_roads_NG911 (else the newest HPMS year),
    NARN_rail_lines. nddot: [(feature, geometry)] of an NDDOT layer, when given."""
    from .suiteexport import projected, HPMS_SETS
    from .offline_pack import ND_BBOX
    extent = tuple(extent or ND_BBOX)
    got, sources = {}, {}
    for key, names in (("nbi", ("NBI_bridges",)), ("osm", ("OSM_crossings",)),
                       ("streams", ("NHD_flowlines",)),
                       ("roads", ("ND_roads_NG911",) + HPMS_SETS),
                       ("rails", ("NARN_rail_lines",))):
        name = next((n for n in names if source.has(n)), None)
        if name is None:
            got[key] = []
            sources[key] = "not in the source"
            continue
        feats = source.features(name, extent) or []
        got[key] = projected(feats)
        sources[key] = "{} ({} features, {})".format(name, len(feats), source.note(name, extent))
    return run(out_path, got["nbi"], got["osm"], nddot, got["streams"], got["roads"],
               got["rails"], params, sources, log)
```

## `scenarios.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Breach scenarios and the no-breach baseline for incremental analysis.

FEMA P-333 bases hazard potential on INCREMENTAL consequences: "under the
same conditions (e.g., flood ...), the difference in impacts that would
occur due to failure or mis-operation of the dam over those that would
have occurred without failure". A breach scenario may name a baseline
(the same flood without failure); consequences present without the breach
are then not charged to the dam. Several breach scenarios (sunny-day,
PMF, ...) are classified separately and the most severe one governs.

v2.9: a scenario can come from a HEC-RAS plan results file (.p##.hdf) in
place of rasters (Scenario.from_plan, or a plan path in the depth column of
the Setup tab / the scenario table). resolve() - called by
resolve_scenarios() before the run, or by load_layers() at the latest -
converts it through the plan cache (rasimport.plan_to_rasters_cached; worker
thread safe) and the scenario then is a raster scenario like any other:
depth, and velocity / arrival unless the user gave rasters for them.
"""

import os
import re

import numpy as np
from qgis.core import QgsRasterLayer, QgsCoordinateTransform

from .constants import (CLASS_HIGH, CLASS_JUDGMENT, DEFAULT_INCREMENTAL_DEPTH_FT,
                        vehicle_curve_available)
from .helpers import transform_xy, classify_values, curve_pair

ROLE_BREACH, ROLE_BASELINE = "breach", "baseline"


def _is_plan_path(path):
    """A HEC-RAS plan results file name (<project>.p##.hdf)? Name only."""
    from .rasimport import PLAN_RE
    return bool(path) and isinstance(path, str) and bool(PLAN_RE.search(os.path.basename(
        path.strip())))


def _same_file(a, b):
    if not a or not b:
        return False
    return os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(a.strip())) == \
        os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(b.strip()))


class Scenario(object):
    """One set of hydraulic results. Paths only - rasters are opened when
    the scenario is run."""

    # v2.9: HEC-RAS plan the rasters are made from (class defaults: scenarios
    # saved by earlier versions - evaluation cache - load unchanged)
    plan = None                 # the .p##.hdf
    plan_settings = None        # rasimport.plan_settings() dict
    cache_root = None           # where the conversion is cached
    plan_fields = ()            # of "velocity", "arrival": taken from the plan
    plan_rasters = None         # after resolve(): what the conversion gave

    def __init__(self, name, depth, velocity, arrival, dv=None,
                 role=ROLE_BREACH, baseline=None, source="", velocity_units_note="",
                 plan=None, plan_settings=None, cache_root=None):
        self.name = (name or "Scenario").strip()
        self.depth, self.velocity, self.arrival = depth, velocity, arrival
        self.dv = dv or None
        self.role = role if role in (ROLE_BREACH, ROLE_BASELINE) else ROLE_BREACH
        self.baseline = baseline or None
        self.source = source or ""
        self.velocity_units_note = velocity_units_note
        # v2.9: a plan named here or a plan file in the depth column
        if not plan and _is_plan_path(depth):
            plan = depth.strip()
        if plan:
            self._set_plan(plan, plan_settings, cache_root)

    def _set_plan(self, plan, settings, cache_root):
        from .rasimport import plan_settings as normalise, RasImportError
        self.plan = plan
        try:
            self.plan_settings = normalise(settings)
        except RasImportError:
            self.plan_settings = dict(settings or {})        # reported by missing()
        self.cache_root = cache_root or None
        self.depth = plan                      # until resolve(): the plan file
        # velocity / arrival from the plan unless the user gave other rasters
        self.plan_fields = [f for f in ("velocity", "arrival")
                            if not getattr(self, f) or _same_file(getattr(self, f), plan)]
        for f in self.plan_fields:
            setattr(self, f, None)
        if self.dv and _same_file(self.dv, plan):
            self.dv = None                     # the plan import has no D x V

    @classmethod
    def from_plan(cls, name, hdf_path, settings=None, cache_root=None, velocity=None,
                  arrival=None, dv=None, role=ROLE_BREACH, baseline=None):
        """v2.9: a scenario made from a HEC-RAS plan results file. settings:
        rasimport.PLAN_DEFAULTS keys (dem, breach_hr, arrival_ft, cell_ft);
        velocity / arrival rasters given here are used instead of the plan's."""
        return cls(name, hdf_path, velocity, arrival, dv=dv, role=role, baseline=baseline,
                   plan=hdf_path, plan_settings=settings, cache_root=cache_root)

    @property
    def plan_pending(self):
        """True while a plan scenario's rasters are not made yet."""
        return bool(self.plan) and not self.plan_rasters

    def resolve(self, progress=None, log=None, cache_root=None):
        """v2.9: a plan scenario's rasters, converted through the plan cache
        (re-used when the plan and the options are unchanged). No project or
        widget access - call it in the worker thread. Nothing to do for a
        raster scenario or when done already. cache_root: used when the
        scenario has none (else a temp folder). Returns the conversion
        result (rasimport.plan_to_rasters_cached) or None."""
        if not self.plan_pending:
            return None
        from . import rasimport as RI
        for f in ("velocity", "arrival"):
            v = getattr(self, f)
            if v and _is_plan_path(v) and not _same_file(v, self.plan):
                raise RI.RasImportError("{}: the {} column holds another HEC-RAS plan ({}) - "
                                        "one plan per scenario".format(self.name, f,
                                                                        os.path.basename(v)))
        root = self.cache_root or cache_root or RI.default_cache_root(None)
        res = RI.plan_to_rasters_cached(self.plan, root, self.plan_settings, progress=progress,
                                        log=log)
        self.depth = res["depth"]
        if "velocity" in self.plan_fields:
            self.velocity = res.get("vel")
        if "arrival" in self.plan_fields:
            self.arrival = res.get("arr")
        # JSON-safe (the evaluation cache keeps scenarios as JSON)
        self.plan_rasters = {k: res.get(k) for k in ("depth", "vel", "arr", "wse", "peak",
                                                     "folder", "key", "cached")}
        self.plan_rasters["notes"] = list(res.get("notes") or [])
        return res

    @property
    def slug(self):
        return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", self.name).strip("_")[:40] or "Scenario"

    def to_dict(self):
        d = {"name": self.name, "depth": self.depth, "velocity": self.velocity,
             "arrival": self.arrival, "dv": self.dv, "role": self.role, "baseline": self.baseline, "source": self.source}
        if self.plan:
            d.update({"plan": self.plan, "plan_settings": self.plan_settings,
                      "cache_root": self.cache_root, "plan_fields": list(self.plan_fields)})
        return d

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d):
        if d.get("plan"):
            # the columns the plan fills are filled again when it is resolved
            fields = d.get("plan_fields")
            fields = ("velocity", "arrival") if fields is None else fields
            return cls(d.get("name"), d["plan"],
                       None if "velocity" in fields else d.get("velocity"),
                       None if "arrival" in fields else d.get("arrival"),
                       d.get("dv"), d.get("role", ROLE_BREACH), d.get("baseline"),
                       d.get("source", ""), plan=d["plan"], plan_settings=d.get("plan_settings"),
                       cache_root=d.get("cache_root"))
        return cls(d.get("name"), d.get("depth"), d.get("velocity"), d.get("arrival"),
                   d.get("dv"), d.get("role", ROLE_BREACH), d.get("baseline"),
                   d.get("source", ""))

    def _plan_problems(self):
        from . import rasimport as RI
        name = os.path.basename(self.plan)
        if not os.path.isfile(self.plan):
            return ["{}: HEC-RAS plan results file not found ({})".format(self.name, self.plan)]
        if not RI.is_hdf5(self.plan):
            return ["{}: {} is not a HEC-RAS plan results file (HDF5)".format(self.name, name)]
        out = []
        try:
            s = RI.plan_settings(self.plan_settings)
            if s["dem"] and not os.path.isfile(s["dem"]):
                out.append("{}: terrain raster for plan {} not found ({})".format(
                    self.name, name, s["dem"]))
        except RI.RasImportError as e:
            out.append("{}: {}".format(self.name, e))
        for f in ("velocity", "arrival"):
            v = getattr(self, f)
            if v and _is_plan_path(v) and not _same_file(v, self.plan):
                out.append("{}: the {} column holds another HEC-RAS plan ({}) - one plan per "
                           "scenario".format(self.name, f, os.path.basename(v)))
        return out

    def missing(self):
        """Human-readable problems (empty list = usable)."""
        out = []
        if self.plan_pending:
            out.extend(self._plan_problems())
        elif not self.depth or not os.path.isfile(self.depth):
            out.append("{}: depth raster missing".format(self.name))
        if self.velocity and not os.path.isfile(self.velocity):
            out.append("{}: velocity raster not found".format(self.name))
        if self.arrival and not os.path.isfile(self.arrival):
            out.append("{}: arrival raster not found".format(self.name))
        if self.dv and not os.path.isfile(self.dv):
            out.append("{}: D x V raster not found".format(self.name))
        return out

    def load_layers(self):
        if self.plan_pending:
            self.resolve()             # v2.9: normally done by resolve_scenarios() already
        names = {"depth": "Depth", "vel": "Velocity", "arr": "Arrival", "dv": "DxV"}
        out = {}
        for key, path in (("depth", self.depth), ("vel", self.velocity),
                          ("arr", self.arrival), ("dv", self.dv)):
            out[key] = QgsRasterLayer(path, "{} {}".format(names[key], self.name)) \
                if path else None
        return out


def order_for_run(scenarios):
    """Baselines first (they are needed by the breaches), then breaches;
    a breach whose baseline name does not exist loses the link."""
    names = {s.name for s in scenarios if s.role == ROLE_BASELINE}
    for s in scenarios:
        if s.role == ROLE_BREACH and s.baseline and s.baseline not in names:
            s.baseline = None
    return [s for s in scenarios if s.role == ROLE_BASELINE] + \
        [s for s in scenarios if s.role == ROLE_BREACH]


def resolve_scenarios(scenarios, progress=None, log=None, cache_root=None):
    """v2.9: make the rasters of every plan scenario (through the plan cache)
```
