```python
    return bool(mask[r0:r1 + 1, c0:c1 + 1].any())


def _colour_classes(items):
    """Split (sid, bbox) items into lists whose bboxes do not overlap within
    a list, so one rasterisation per list gives every region its own cells
    (a cell holds one id). Greedy, in bbox order."""
    if not items:
        return []
    widths = [max(bb.xMaximum() - bb.xMinimum(), bb.yMaximum() - bb.yMinimum(), 1e-9)
              for _s, bb in items]
    cell = max(1e-6, float(np.median(widths)) * 4.0)
    classes, grids = [], []
    for sid, bb in sorted(items, key=lambda it: (it[1].yMinimum(), it[1].xMinimum())):
        placed = False
        for k, grid in enumerate(grids):
            clash = False
            k0, k1 = grid._key(bb.xMinimum(), bb.yMinimum()), grid._key(bb.xMaximum(),
                                                                          bb.yMaximum())
            for i in range(k0[0], k1[0] + 1):
                for j in range(k0[1], k1[1] + 1):
                    for other in grid.cells.get((i, j), ()):
                        if other.intersects(bb):
                            clash = True
                            break
                    if clash:
                        break
                if clash:
                    break
            if not clash:
                classes[k].append(sid)
                grid.insert_rect(bb, bb)
                placed = True
                break
        if not placed:
            g = _Grid(cell)
            g.insert_rect(bb, bb)
            grids.append(g)
            classes.append([sid])
    return classes


def _onepass_cells(regions, sampler, progress=None):
    """{sid: (xs, ys, values)} of the valid depth cells whose centre lies in
    each region (regions: {sid: QgsGeometry in the raster CRS}), from one
    rasterisation per colour class over the rows the regions cover, instead
    of one window read and one rasterisation per structure. Raises when the
    GDAL / OGR path is unavailable (the caller falls back)."""
    from osgeo import gdal, ogr
    from .helpers import _wkb_bytes
    if sampler.backend != "gdal" or not regions:
        raise RuntimeError("one-pass sampling needs the GDAL reader")
    items = [(sid, g.boundingBox()) for sid, g in regions.items()]
    classes = _colour_classes(items)
    # pixel window covering every region
    xs = [v for _s, bb in items for v in (bb.xMinimum(), bb.xMaximum())]
    ys = [v for _s, bb in items for v in (bb.yMinimum(), bb.yMaximum())]
    win = sampler._window_for_bbox(min(xs), min(ys), max(xs), max(ys))
    out = {}
    if win is None:
        return out
    c0, r0, w, h = win
    rows = max(1, min(h, int(4000000 // max(1, w))))
    drv_mem = gdal.GetDriverByName("MEM")
    drv_ogr = ogr.GetDriverByName("Memory")
    if drv_mem is None or drv_ogr is None:
        raise RuntimeError("GDAL MEM / OGR Memory drivers unavailable")
    ds_v = drv_ogr.CreateDataSource("regions")
    layers = []
    for k, sids in enumerate(classes):
        lyr = ds_v.CreateLayer("c{}".format(k), None, ogr.wkbPolygon)
        lyr.CreateField(ogr.FieldDefn("sid", ogr.OFTInteger))
        defn = lyr.GetLayerDefn()
        for sid in sids:
            og = ogr.CreateGeometryFromWkb(_wkb_bytes(regions[sid]))
            if og is None:
                continue
            if og.HasCurveGeometry():
                og = og.GetLinearGeometry()
            og.FlattenTo2D()
            f = ogr.Feature(defn)
            f.SetGeometry(og)
            f.SetField("sid", int(sid))
            lyr.CreateFeature(f)
        layers.append(lyr)
    gt = sampler.gt
    n_strips = int(math.ceil(h / float(rows)))
    for si, y0 in enumerate(range(r0, r0 + h, rows)):
        if progress and si % 4 == 0:
            progress(100.0 * si / max(1, n_strips), "Sampling structures: strip {} of {}".format(
                si + 1, n_strips))
        hh = min(rows, r0 + h - y0)
        depth = sampler.window_values(c0, y0, w, hh)
        if depth is None:
            continue
        wet_any = np.isfinite(depth)
        if not wet_any.any():
            continue
        wgt = sampler._window_gt(c0, y0)
        # strip bbox in raster CRS for the spatial filter
        bx = [wgt[0] + cc * wgt[1] + rr * wgt[2] for cc in (0, w) for rr in (0, hh)]
        by = [wgt[3] + cc * wgt[4] + rr * wgt[5] for cc in (0, w) for rr in (0, hh)]
        for lyr in layers:
            try:
                lyr.SetSpatialFilterRect(min(bx), min(by), max(bx), max(by))
                if lyr.GetFeatureCount() == 0:
                    continue
            except Exception:
                pass
            mem = drv_mem.Create("", int(w), int(hh), 1, gdal.GDT_Int32)
            mem.SetGeoTransform(wgt)
            band = mem.GetRasterBand(1)
            band.Fill(0)
            err = gdal.RasterizeLayer(mem, [1], lyr, options=["ATTRIBUTE=sid"])
            if err not in (0, None):
                raise RuntimeError("GDAL RasterizeLayer returned error {}".format(err))
            ids = np.asarray(band.ReadAsArray())
            mem = band = None
            sel = (ids > 0) & wet_any
            if not sel.any():
                continue
            rr, cc = np.nonzero(sel)
            sids = ids[rr, cc]
            vals = depth[rr, cc]
            colc = cc + (c0 + 0.5)
            rowc = rr + (y0 + 0.5)
            px = gt[0] + colc * gt[1] + rowc * gt[2]
            py = gt[3] + colc * gt[4] + rowc * gt[5]
            order = np.argsort(sids, kind="stable")
            sids, px, py, vals = sids[order], px[order], py[order], vals[order]
            uniq, starts = np.unique(sids, return_index=True)
            ends = list(starts[1:]) + [sids.size]
            for sid, a, b in zip(uniq.tolist(), starts.tolist(), ends):
                prev = out.get(sid)
                part = (px[a:b], py[a:b], vals[a:b])
                out[sid] = part if prev is None else tuple(
                    np.concatenate((p, q)) for p, q in zip(prev, part))
        for lyr in layers:
            try:
                lyr.SetSpatialFilter(None)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return out


def apply_type(rec, one_d=False, near_ft=DEFAULT_NEAR_THRESHOLD_FT, borderline_higher=False):
    """Set the structure's zone, margins, borderline flag, sample locations
    and ND outcome from its ACER type (house-on-foundation or mobile-home
    curve) and the per-type results kept by evaluate_structures - so a
    changed type (engineer review), 1D / 2D choice or borderline setting is
    applied without reading the rasters again."""
    types = rec.get("_types")
    rec.update({"near": "", "zone_note": "", "near_raised": False})
    if not types or rec.get("max_depth") is None:
        rec["zone"] = rec["zone_mm"] = rec["margin_high"] = rec["margin_judg"] = None
        rec["loc"] = None
        rec["outcome"] = structure_outcome(rec, one_d)
        return
    typ = curve_type(rec["acer_type"])
    t = types.get(typ) or types[TYPE_HOUSE]
    rec["zone"], rec["loc"] = t["zone"], t["loc"]
    rec["zone_mm"] = t["zone"] if t.get("has_vel") else None
    rec["margin_high"], rec["margin_judg"] = t.get("margin_high"), t.get("margin_judg")
    if one_d:
        # 1D model (ND 5.2.1.1): probable loss of life above 2 ft of depth;
        # borderline = within near_ft below that (ND 5.3(f))
        m1 = ND_1D_DEPTH_FT - rec["max_depth"]
        rec["margin_high"] = rec["margin_judg"] = None   # ACER margins do not decide 1D
        if near_ft and near_ft > 0 and 0 <= m1 <= near_ft:
            rec["near"], rec["margin_high"] = "High", float(m1)
            if borderline_higher:
                rec["near_raised"] = True
                rec["zone_note"] = ("counted as probable loss of life ({:.2f} ft below "
                                    "the 1D 2-ft rule, ND 5.3(f))".format(m1))
    elif t.get("has_vel") and near_ft and near_ft > 0:
        if rec["zone"] == CLASS_JUDGMENT and 0 < rec["margin_high"] <= near_ft:
            rec["near"] = "High"
        elif rec["zone"] == CLASS_LOW and 0 < rec["margin_judg"] <= near_ft:
            rec["near"] = "Judgment"
        if rec["near"] and borderline_higher:
            rec["zone_note"] = "moved from {} ({:.2f} ft below the boundary, " \
                "ND 5.3(f))".format(zone_label(rec["zone"]), rec["margin_high"]
                                    if rec["near"] == "High" else rec["margin_judg"])
            rec["zone"] = CLASS_HIGH if rec["near"] == "High" else CLASS_JUDGMENT
    rec["outcome"] = structure_outcome(rec, one_d)


_RESET = {"max_depth": None, "max_vel": None, "arrival": None, "zone_found": None,
          "zone_mobile": None, "zone": None, "zone_mm": None, "vel_missing": False,
          "dv_max": None, "margin_high": None, "margin_judg": None, "near": "",
          "zone_note": "", "loc": None, "near_raised": False, "region": None,
          "reach_ft": None, "region_kind": "", "n_cells": 0, "sampling": "",
          "cells_xy": None, "_types": None}


# v2.7.1: which cells around a structure are read for its maximum depth / velocity
SAMPLE_AREA, SAMPLE_RING, SAMPLE_BAND = "area", "ring", "band"
SAMPLE_AREAS = ((SAMPLE_AREA, "Whole area: outline + 5-ft buffer (default)"),
                (SAMPLE_RING, "Buffer ring only: outside the wall, no cells inside"),
                (SAMPLE_BAND, "Band along the outline: 5 ft either side of the wall"))


def _sample_region(rec, full, r_disc, edge, mode):
    """The area the cells are read from for `mode` (SAMPLE_RING / SAMPLE_BAND),
    cut from `full` (the outline or point disc grown by the edge ring), or
    None when nothing sensible is left (the whole area is then used).
    r_disc: the assumed radius of a point structure (None with an outline)."""
    geom = rec["geom"]
    if r_disc is None:                                  # building outline
        cut = geom if mode == SAMPLE_RING else geom.buffer(-edge, 8)
    else:                                               # a point: its assumed disc
        inner = r_disc if mode == SAMPLE_RING else r_disc - edge
        if inner <= 0:
            return None
        cut = geom.buffer(inner, 8)
    if cut is None or cut.isNull() or cut.isEmpty():
        return None                                     # a wall thinner than the band
    out = full.difference(cut)
    if out is None or out.isNull() or out.isEmpty():
        return None
    return out


def evaluate_structures(structs, samplers, analysis_crs, transform_ctx, one_d=False,
                        edge_ft=OSM_EDGE_BUFFER_FT, point_radius_ft=DEFAULT_POINT_RADIUS_FT,
                        progress_cb=None, lat=None, near_ft=DEFAULT_NEAR_THRESHOLD_FT,
                        borderline_higher=False, keep_cells=False, sample_area=SAMPLE_AREA,
                        keep_dv=False, fast_sampling=False):
    """Depth/velocity/arrival and ACER zone for each structure (in place).

    samplers: {"depth", "vel", "arr"} RasterSamplers (depth in analysis_crs)
    and optionally "dv" (depth x velocity max raster, flood severity). Also
    records the depth margin to the next more severe boundary (from
    Dmax/Vmax) and flags structures within `near_ft` of it; with
    borderline_higher they are moved to that zone (ND 5.3(f)).

    v2.6: one pass instead of one read per structure - a coarse wet mask
    finds the structures near the flood, every evaluation area is rasterised
    at once (per colour class of non-overlapping areas) and the velocity /
    arrival / D x V rasters are read for all cells together. Results are
    identical to the per-structure reads (same cells: centres inside the
    area). Each evaluated structure records the evaluation area
    (rec["region"]: the outline grown by the edge ring, or the point's
    disc), its reach in feet, the number of wet cells read and, with
    keep_cells, the centres of those cells (Structure_Evaluation_Areas /
    Structure_Sampled_Cells layers). Per-type results (both curves) are kept
    in rec["_types"] so apply_type() can re-apply a changed type or setting
    without the rasters.

    v2.7.1 sample_area: SAMPLE_AREA (default, as before) reads every cell
    whose centre is in the outline grown by the edge ring; SAMPLE_RING only
    the ring outside the wall; SAMPLE_BAND a band of the edge width on both
    sides of the wall - so the maximum points lie along the buffer / outline.
    A structure with no cell centre in the ring / band (grid coarser than the
    ring) is read over the whole area instead, and says so in "sampling".

    v2.8 keep_dv (default False - nothing changes): keep the wet cells the
    maximum came from, compactly, as rec["_dv"] = (depth, velocity) float32
    arrays (velocity None without a velocity raster; NaN velocities as used,
    i.e. 0). Only wet structures get them. sensitivity.py re-classifies from
    these arrays with scaled depth / velocity, without reading the rasters.

    v2.9 fast_sampling (default False - nothing changes): select the cells
    with fastsample.py (numpy, exact distances) instead of GEOS regions +
    GDAL rasterisation; GEOS regions are then built only for the wet
    structures (rec["region"], display) and for the coarse-grid fallback.
    Same cells except in the arc/chord gap of GEOS buffers (see fastsample);
    any error, a rotated raster or an unsupported geometry uses the GEOS path."""
    if sample_area not in (SAMPLE_AREA, SAMPLE_RING, SAMPLE_BAND):
        sample_area = SAMPLE_AREA
    if lat is None and samplers["depth"].layer is not None:
        try:
            lat = center_latitude(samplers["depth"].layer.extent(), analysis_crs, transform_ctx)
        except Exception:
            lat = None
    edge = _ft_units(edge_ft, analysis_crs, lat)
    dep = samplers["depth"]
    to_vel = QgsCoordinateTransform(analysis_crs, samplers["vel"].crs, transform_ctx) \
        if samplers["vel"].crs is not None else None
    to_arr = QgsCoordinateTransform(analysis_crs, samplers["arr"].crs, transform_ctx) \
        if samplers["arr"].crs is not None else None
    dvs = samplers.get("dv")
    to_dv = QgsCoordinateTransform(analysis_crs, dvs.crs, transform_ctx) \
        if dvs is not None and dvs.crs is not None else None
    curves = {TYPE_HOUSE: curve_pair("found"), TYPE_MOBILE: curve_pair("mobile")}
    problems = LimitedLogger("Structure evaluation")
    total = len(structs) or 1

    def tick(p, m):
        if progress_cb:
            progress_cb(p, m)

    # ---- 1. reset, evaluation areas of the structures near the flood --------
    tick(0, "Finding structures near the flood...")
    # (the provider reader has no fast whole-raster pass: every structure is
    # then a candidate, as before)
    mask_f = _coarse_wet_mask(dep) if dep.ok and dep.backend == "gdal" else None
    regions = {}
    fulls = {}                       # ring / band mode: the whole area, as a fallback
    fast = {}                        # v2.9 fast_sampling: id -> (Shape, reach, r_disc)

    def _geos_region(rec, reach, r_disc):
        """(region, full): the GEOS evaluation region of `rec` for sample_area
        and, for ring / band, the whole area (else None); labels region_kind."""
        region = rec["geom"].buffer(reach, 8)
        full = None
        if sample_area != SAMPLE_AREA:
            part = _sample_region(rec, region, r_disc, edge, sample_area)
            if part is not None:
                full, region = region, part
                rec["region_kind"] += ("; buffer ring only (outside the wall)"
                                       if sample_area == SAMPLE_RING else
                                       "; band {:g} ft either side of the wall".format(
                                           edge_ft))
        return region, full

    use_fast = bool(fast_sampling) and dep.ok and FS.grid_ok(dep.gt)
    for i, rec in enumerate(structs):
        rec.update(_RESET)
        rec.pop("_dv", None)                 # v2.8: never stale from an earlier evaluation
        try:
            r_disc = None
            if rec["footprint"]:
                reach = edge
                rec["reach_ft"] = float(edge_ft)
                rec["region_kind"] = "footprint + {:g} ft edge ring".format(edge_ft)
            else:
                r_ft = point_radius_ft
                if rec.get("sqft"):
                    r_ft = max(5.0, math.sqrt(float(rec["sqft"]) / math.pi))
                r_disc = _ft_units(r_ft, analysis_crs, lat)
                reach = r_disc + edge
                rec["reach_ft"] = float(r_ft + edge_ft)
                rec["region_kind"] = "point: {:g} ft radius{} + {:g} ft edge ring".format(
                    r_ft, " (from the floor area)" if rec.get("sqft") else "", edge_ft)
            bb = rec["geom"].boundingBox()
            # dry structures (most of them in a large study area) are dropped
            # by the coarse wet mask before any GEOS work
            if not _near_flood(mask_f, dep, bb.xMinimum() - reach, bb.yMinimum() - reach,
                               bb.xMaximum() + reach, bb.yMaximum() + reach):
                continue
            if use_fast:
                shp = FS.shape_from_geometry(rec["geom"], r_disc)
                if shp is not None:
                    fast[rec["id"]] = (shp, reach, r_disc)
                    continue
            region, full = _geos_region(rec, reach, r_disc)
            if full is not None:
                fulls[rec["id"]] = full
            rec["region"] = region
            regions[rec["id"]] = region
        except Exception as e:
            problems.log("structure {}: {}".format(rec["id"], e))
    by_id = {rec["id"]: rec for rec in structs}

    # ---- 1b. v2.9 fast sampling: the cells of the fast structures -------------
    fast_cells, fast_fb, fast_wet = {}, set(), []
    if fast:
        got = None
        try:
            got = FS.sample_cells({s: (v[0], v[1]) for s, v in fast.items()}, dep,
                                  sample_area, edge, progress=lambda p, m: tick(5 + 0.45 * p, m))
        except CancelledByUser:
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("Fast sampling not used ({}); using GEOS regions".format(e))
        if got is None:                              # rotated raster / error: GEOS path
            for sid, (_shp, reach, r_disc) in fast.items():
                rec = by_id[sid]
                try:
                    region, full = _geos_region(rec, reach, r_disc)
                    if full is not None:
                        fulls[sid] = full
                    rec["region"] = regions[sid] = region
                except Exception as e:
                    problems.log("structure {}: {}".format(sid, e))
            fast = {}
        else:
            fast_cells, fast_fb, _whole = got
            for sid, (_shp, reach, r_disc) in fast.items():
                if sid in fast_cells:
                    fast_wet.append(sid)
                    continue
                # no valid cell in the (whole) area: the GEOS region only serves the
                # "cell under the centre" fallback below
                rec = by_id[sid]
                try:
                    region, full = _geos_region(rec, reach, r_disc)
                    if full is not None:
                        rec["region_kind"] += " (no cell centre in it - whole area used)"
                        region = full
                    regions[sid] = region
                except Exception as e:
                    problems.log("structure {}: {}".format(sid, e))

    # ---- 2. depth cells of every area: one pass, else per structure ----------
    cells = None
    if len(regions) >= ONEPASS_MIN:
        try:
            cells = _onepass_cells(regions, dep, progress=lambda p, m: tick(5 + 0.45 * p, m))
        except CancelledByUser:
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            log_message("One-pass sampling not used ({}); reading structure by structure"
                        .format(e))
            cells = None
    if cells is None:
        cells = {}
        n = len(regions) or 1
        for i, (sid, region) in enumerate(regions.items()):
            if i % PROGRESS_INTERVAL == 0:
                tick(5 + 45.0 * i / n, "Evaluating structures: {} of {}".format(i, n))
            xs, ys, d = dep.cells_in_geometry(region)
            if d.size:
                cells[sid] = (xs, ys, d)
    cells.update(fast_cells)
    # ring / band without a cell centre inside (grid coarser than the ring):
    # the whole area is read instead
    for sid in [s_ for s_ in fulls if s_ not in cells]:
        by_id[sid]["region"] = regions[sid] = fulls[sid]
        by_id[sid]["region_kind"] += " (no cell centre in it - whole area used)"
        xs, ys, d = dep.cells_in_geometry(regions[sid])
        if d.size:
            cells[sid] = (xs, ys, d)
    # areas without a cell centre inside (grid coarser than the building):
    # the cell under the area's centre
    coarse_ids = [sid for sid in regions if sid not in cells]
    if coarse_ids:
        cx = np.array([regions[s].centroid().asPoint().x() for s in coarse_ids])
        cy = np.array([regions[s].centroid().asPoint().y() for s in coarse_ids])
        cd = dep.values_at(cx, cy)
        for sid, x, y, d in zip(coarse_ids, cx, cy, cd):
            by_id[sid]["sampling"] = "grid coarser than the area: the cell under its centre"
            if np.isfinite(d):
                cells[sid] = (np.array([x]), np.array([y]), np.array([d]))
    # wet cells only; a structure without one is dry and, as before 2.6,
    # keeps no evaluation area
    wet_ids = []
    for sid in list(cells):
        xs, ys, d = cells[sid]
        wet = np.isfinite(d) & (d > 0)
        if not wet.any():
            del cells[sid]
            continue
        cells[sid] = (xs[wet], ys[wet], d[wet])
        wet_ids.append(sid)
        rec = by_id[sid]
        if not rec["sampling"]:
            rec["sampling"] = "cells whose centre lies in the area"
        rec["n_cells"] = int(cells[sid][2].size)

    wet_set = set(wet_ids)
    for sid in regions:
        if sid not in wet_set:
            by_id[sid]["region"] = None
    for sid in fast_wet:                 # v2.9: the evaluation area shown for a wet structure
        if sid not in wet_set:
            continue
        rec = by_id[sid]
        try:
            region, full = _geos_region(rec, fast[sid][1], fast[sid][2])
            if full is not None and sid in fast_fb:
                rec["region_kind"] += " (no cell centre in it - whole area used)"
                region = full
            rec["region"] = region
        except Exception as e:
            problems.log("structure {} evaluation area: {}".format(sid, e))
    # ---- 3. velocity, arrival, D x V for all wet cells at once ---------------
    tick(55, "Reading velocity and arrival at {} structure(s)...".format(len(wet_ids)))
    if wet_ids:
        counts = [cells[s][2].size for s in wet_ids]
        offs = np.concatenate(([0], np.cumsum(counts)))
        ax_all = np.concatenate([cells[s][0] for s in wet_ids])
        ay_all = np.concatenate([cells[s][1] for s in wet_ids])
        vx, vy = transform_xy(ax_all, ay_all, to_vel)
        v_all = samplers["vel"].values_at(vx, vy)
        rx, ry = transform_xy(ax_all, ay_all, to_arr)
        a_all = samplers["arr"].values_at(rx, ry)
        dv_all = None
        if dvs is not None and dvs.ok:
            px, py = transform_xy(ax_all, ay_all, to_dv)
            dv_all = dvs.values_at(px, py)
    vel_ok = samplers["vel"].ok

    # ---- 4. per structure: maxima, zones for both curves, margins -----------
    n = len(wet_ids) or 1
    for i, sid in enumerate(wet_ids):
        if i % PROGRESS_INTERVAL == 0:
            tick(60 + 35.0 * i / n, "Evaluating structures: {} of {}".format(i, n))
        rec = by_id[sid]
        try:
            xs, ys, d = cells[sid]
            a0, a1 = int(offs[i]), int(offs[i + 1])
            v = v_all[a0:a1]
            a = a_all[a0:a1]
            if np.isnan(v).any() and vel_ok:
                rec["vel_missing"] = True
                v = np.where(np.isnan(v), 0.0, v)
            if keep_cells:
                rec["cells_xy"] = (np.array(xs, dtype=np.float64), np.array(ys, dtype=np.float64))
            if keep_dv:
                rec["_dv"] = (np.asarray(d, dtype=np.float32).copy(),
                              np.asarray(v, dtype=np.float32).copy() if vel_ok else None)
            rec["max_depth"] = float(d.max())
            rec["max_vel"] = float(v.max()) if vel_ok else None
            rec["arrival"] = float(np.nanmin(a)) if np.isfinite(a).any() else None
            dvv = None
            if dv_all is not None:
                dvv = dv_all[a0:a1]
                rec["dv_max"] = float(np.nanmax(dvv)) if np.isfinite(dvv).any() else None
            elif vel_ok and (not rec["vel_missing"] or v.any()):
                dvv = d * v
                rec["dv_max"] = float(dvv.max())
            types = {}
            for typ in (TYPE_HOUSE, TYPE_MOBILE):
                zcls = classify_values(d, v, *curves[typ])
                t = {"zone": int(zcls.min()), "has_vel": vel_ok, "margin_high": None,
                     "margin_judg": None, "loc": None}
                try:
                    t["loc"] = _locations(xs, ys, d, v, a, dvv, vel_ok, zcls)
                except Exception as e:                       # never fails the structure
                    problems.log("structure {} sample locations: {}".format(rec["id"], e))
                if vel_ok:
                    mh, mj = zone_margins(d, v, *curves[typ])
                    t["margin_high"], t["margin_judg"] = float(mh.min()), float(mj.min())
                types[typ] = t
            rec["zone_found"], rec["zone_mobile"] = types[TYPE_HOUSE]["zone"], \
                types[TYPE_MOBILE]["zone"]
            rec["_types"] = types
        except Exception as e:
            problems.log("structure {}: {}".format(rec["id"], e))
    for rec in structs:
        apply_type(rec, one_d, near_ft, borderline_higher)
    tick(100, "Structures evaluated")
    problems.summary()
    return structs


def structure_outcome(rec, one_d=False):
    """ND 5.2.1.1 outcome for one structure."""
    if rec.get("max_depth") is None or rec["max_depth"] <= 0:
        return OUT_DRY
    if one_d:
        return OUT_PROBABLE if rec["max_depth"] > ND_1D_DEPTH_FT or rec.get("near_raised") \
            else OUT_ECONOMIC
    if rec.get("zone") == CLASS_HIGH:
        return OUT_PROBABLE
    if rec.get("zone") == CLASS_JUDGMENT:
        return OUT_JUDGMENT
    return OUT_ECONOMIC


# v2.9: the address columns (Address / City / ZIP from address_of - the ND GIS
# Hub address first) and the ND GIS Hub (NENA NG9-1-1) site / structure
# address points joined to the structure. Every reader of this layer and of
# its CSV / XLSX copies uses field NAMES, so they sit after NSI_fd_id.
ND_ADDRESS_FIELDS = [
    ("Address", FT_STRING), ("City", FT_STRING), ("ZIP", FT_STRING),
    ("ND_Site_NGUID", FT_STRING), ("ND_Place_Type", FT_STRING),
    ("ND_Address_Points", FT_INT),
]
ND_FAMILY = "NDGISHUB"
TEXT_LIMIT = 250              # longest text written to a list column (Shapefile-safe)

STRUCTURE_FIELDS = [
    ("Struct_ID", FT_INT), ("Sources", FT_STRING), ("NSI_fd_id", FT_STRING),
] + ND_ADDRESS_FIELDS + [
    ("Occupancy", FT_STRING), ("FEMA_Category", FT_STRING),
    ("Habitable", FT_STRING), ("ACER_Type", FT_STRING),
    ("Type_Basis", FT_STRING), ("Type_Conflict", FT_STRING),
    ("Lifeline", FT_STRING), ("Persons", FT_INT),
    ("Persons_Basis", FT_STRING), ("Area_ft2", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Max_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("Max_Vel_fps", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("First_Arrival_hr", FT_DOUBLE), ("Zone_Found", FT_INT),
    ("Zone_Mobile", FT_INT), ("ACER_Zone", FT_INT),
    ("ACER_Zone_Label", FT_STRING), ("ND_Outcome", FT_STRING),
    ("DV_Max_ft2s", FT_DOUBLE), ("Margin_High_ft", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Margin_Judg_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("Near_Threshold", FT_STRING),
    ("Pop_Night", FT_DOUBLE), ("Pop_Day", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Val_Struct_USD", FT_DOUBLE), ("Val_Cont_USD", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("FirstFloor_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("Damage_USD", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Damage_NonRes_USD", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Damage_Basis", FT_STRING), ("Warning_hr", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Flood_Severity", FT_STRING), ("Fatality_Rate", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Est_Life_Loss", FT_DOUBLE), ("PAR_Night", FT_DOUBLE), ("PAR_Day", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Access_Cut_Off", FT_STRING),
    ("Incremental", FT_STRING), ("Base_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("Base_Zone", FT_INT), ("Reviewed", FT_STRING), ("Notes", FT_STRING),
]


def _nz(v):
    return NULL if v is None else v


def _yes_no(v):
    return NULL if v is None else ("Yes" if v else "No")


def join_capped(values, limit=TEXT_LIMIT, sep="; "):
    """Distinct non-empty values joined with `sep`, at most `limit`
    characters: whole values only, then "(+N more)"."""
    vals = []
    for v in values:
        t = _text(v)
        if t and t not in vals:
            vals.append(t)
    out = sep.join(vals)
    if len(out) <= limit:
        return out
    for k in range(len(vals) - 1, 0, -1):
        s = "{} (+{} more)".format(sep.join(vals[:k]), len(vals) - k)
        if len(s) <= limit:
            return s
    more = " (+{} more)".format(len(vals) - 1) if len(vals) > 1 else ""
    return vals[0][:max(0, limit - len(more) - 3)] + "..." + more


def nd_address_points(rec):
    """The ND GIS Hub (NENA) address point sources joined to a structure,
    one per point (by Site_NGUID, else by source reference)."""
    out, seen = [], set()
    for s in rec.get("sources", ()):
        if s.get("family") != ND_FAMILY:
            continue
        key = s.get("nguid") or s.get("ref") or id(s)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append(s)
    return out


def address_fields(rec):
    """v2.9: {field: value} of the ND_ADDRESS_FIELDS for one structure -
    Address / City / ZIP from address_of (ND GIS Hub first), the Site_NGUID(s)
    and Place_Type(s) of the joined ND GIS Hub address points ("; "-joined,
    at most TEXT_LIMIT characters) and how many there are. Empty text is
    NULL; the count is 0 without an ND address point."""
    addr, city, zp = address_of(rec)
    pts = nd_address_points(rec)

    def txt(v):
        v = _text(v)[:TEXT_LIMIT]
        return v if v else NULL
    return {"Address": txt(addr), "City": txt(city), "ZIP": txt(zp),
            "ND_Site_NGUID": join_capped(s.get("nguid") for s in pts) or NULL,
            "ND_Place_Type": join_capped(s.get("place_type") for s in pts) or NULL,
            "ND_Address_Points": len(pts)}


def structure_notes(rec):
    notes = []
    if rec.get("type_conflict"):
        notes.append("sources disagree on structure type - verify")
    if rec.get("mobile_rule") == "shape":
        notes.append("ACER type from the footprint shape (possible single-wide manufactured "
                     "home) - verify")
    elif rec.get("mobile_rule") == "park_lot":
        notes.append("ACER type from a mobile-home park / lot address - verify")
    if rec.get("mobile_occupied"):
        notes.append("mobile-home evidence on a building read as occupied non-residential "
                     "- verify")
    if rec.get("vel_missing"):
        notes.append("velocity missing on some wet cells (used 0)")
    if rec["category"] == CAT_UNVERIFIED:
        notes.append("habitability not confirmed by any source - verify")
    if rec.get("address_note"):
        notes.append(rec["address_note"])
    if rec["category"] == CAT_OCCUPIED and not rec["persons"]:
        notes.append("occupied building without occupancy data")
    moved = [x["snapped"] for x in rec["sources"] if x.get("snapped") is not None]
    if moved:
        notes.append("{} point(s) moved onto this outline".format(len(moved)))
    if rec.get("near"):
        notes.append("within the near-threshold distance of the {} boundary".format(
            rec["near"]))
    if rec.get("zone_note"):
        notes.append("zone " + rec["zone_note"])
    if rec.get("camp"):
        notes.append("campground / RV park ({}) - seasonal overnight occupancy; verify the "
                     "number of sites and when it is open".format(rec["camp"].get("shape")
                                                                  or "OSM"))
    return notes


def structures_to_layer(structs, crs, include_dry=False, name="Habitable_Structures"):
    fields = [QgsField(n, t) for n, t in STRUCTURE_FIELDS]
    lyr = create_memory_layer(name, WKB_MULTIPOLYGON, crs, fields)
    out_fields = lyr.fields()
    feats = []
    for rec in structs:
        if rec["category"] == CAT_NOT_HABITABLE:
            continue
        if not include_dry and rec.get("outcome", OUT_DRY) == OUT_DRY:
            continue
        geom = rec["geom"] if rec["footprint"] else rec.get("region") or rec["geom"].buffer(
            _ft_units(DEFAULT_POINT_RADIUS_FT, crs), 8)
        try:
            if not geom.isMultipart():
                geom = QgsGeometry(geom)
                geom.convertToMultiType()
        except Exception:
            pass
        vals = {
            "Struct_ID": rec["id"], "Sources": ";".join(sorted(rec["families"])),
            "NSI_fd_id": rec.get("fd_id") or NULL,
            "Occupancy": (rec.get("occupancy") or "")[:250],
            "FEMA_Category": (rec.get("fema_category") or "")[:250] or NULL,
            "Habitable": rec["habitable"], "ACER_Type": rec["acer_type"],
            "Type_Basis": rec["type_basis"], "Type_Conflict": _yes_no(rec["type_conflict"]),
            "Lifeline": _yes_no(rec["lifeline"]), "Persons": int(rec["persons"]),
            "Persons_Basis": rec["persons_basis"], "Area_ft2": _nz(rec.get("area_ft2")),
            "Max_Depth_ft": _nz(rec.get("max_depth")), "Max_Vel_fps": _nz(rec.get("max_vel")),
            "First_Arrival_hr": _nz(rec.get("arrival")),
            "Zone_Found": _nz(rec.get("zone_found")), "Zone_Mobile": _nz(rec.get("zone_mobile")),
            "ACER_Zone": _nz(rec.get("zone")),
            "ACER_Zone_Label": ZONE_LABELS.get(rec.get("zone"), "DRY"),
            "ND_Outcome": rec.get("outcome", OUT_DRY),
            "DV_Max_ft2s": _nz(rec.get("dv_max")), "Margin_High_ft": _nz(rec.get("margin_high")),
            "Margin_Judg_ft": _nz(rec.get("margin_judg")),
            "Near_Threshold": rec.get("near") or NULL,
            "Pop_Night": _nz(rec.get("pop_night")),
            "Pop_Day": _nz(rec.get("pop_day")),
            "Val_Struct_USD": _nz(rec.get("val_struct")), "Val_Cont_USD": _nz(rec.get("val_cont")),
            "FirstFloor_Depth_ft": _nz(rec.get("ff_depth")),
            "Damage_USD": _nz(rec.get("damage_usd")),
            "Damage_NonRes_USD": _nz(rec.get("damage_nonres_usd")),
            "Damage_Basis": rec.get("damage_basis") or NULL,
            "Warning_hr": _nz(rec.get("warning_hr")),
            "Flood_Severity": rec.get("severity") or NULL,
            "Fatality_Rate": _nz(rec.get("fatality_rate")), "Est_Life_Loss": _nz(rec.get("lol")),
            "PAR_Night": _nz(rec.get("par_night")), "PAR_Day": _nz(rec.get("par_day")),
            "Access_Cut_Off": _yes_no(rec.get("cut_off")),
            "Incremental": _yes_no(rec.get("incremental")),
            "Base_Depth_ft": _nz(rec.get("base_depth")), "Base_Zone": _nz(rec.get("base_zone")),
            "Reviewed": rec.get("reviewed") or NULL,
            "Notes": "; ".join(structure_notes(rec)),
        }
        vals.update(address_fields(rec))
        f = QgsFeature(out_fields)
        f.setGeometry(geom)
        f.setAttributes([vals[n] for n, _t in STRUCTURE_FIELDS])
        feats.append(f)
    add_features_batched(lyr.dataProvider(), feats, FEATURE_BATCH_SIZE)
    lyr.updateExtents()
    return lyr


SAMPLE_TYPES = (("depth", "Max depth", "ft"), ("vel", "Max velocity", "ft/s"),
                ("dv", "Max depth x velocity", "ft2/s"), ("arr", "Earliest arrival", "h"),
                ("zone", "Controlling ACER zone", "zone"))


def structure_sample_points_layer(structs, crs, name="Structure_Sample_Points"):
    """Where each flooded structure's governing values were read (the cells
    behind Max_Depth_ft, Max_Vel_fps, DV_Max_ft2s, First_Arrival_hr and the
    ACER zone), for checking the automatic result on the map. None if
    nothing to show."""
    fields = [QgsField("Struct_ID", FT_INT), QgsField("FEMA_Category", FT_STRING),
              QgsField("ACER_Type", FT_STRING), QgsField("Value_Type", FT_STRING),
              QgsField("Value", FT_DOUBLE), QgsField("Units", FT_STRING),
              QgsField("Label", FT_STRING)]
    lyr = create_memory_layer(name, WKB_POINT, crs, fields)
    feats = []
    for rec in structs:
        loc = rec.get("loc")
        if not loc or rec.get("outcome", OUT_DRY) == OUT_DRY:
            continue
        for key, vtype, units in SAMPLE_TYPES:
            if key not in loc:
                continue
            x, y, val = loc[key]
            label = ZONE_LABELS.get(int(val), "") if key == "zone" else \
                "{:.2f} {}".format(val, units)
            f = QgsFeature(lyr.fields())
            f.setGeometry(QgsGeometry.fromPointXY(QgsPointXY(x, y)))
            f.setAttributes([int(rec["id"]), rec.get("fema_category") or NULL,
                             rec["acer_type"], vtype,
                             float(val), units, label])
            feats.append(f)
    if not feats:
        return None
    add_features_batched(lyr.dataProvider(), feats, FEATURE_BATCH_SIZE)
    lyr.updateExtents()
    return lyr


EVAL_AREA_FIELDS = [
    ("Struct_ID", FT_INT), ("Sources", FT_STRING), ("FEMA_Category", FT_STRING),
    ("Habitable", FT_STRING), ("ACER_Type", FT_STRING), ("Area_Type", FT_STRING),
    ("Reach_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("Sampling", FT_STRING), ("Wet_Cells", FT_INT),
    ("Max_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE), ("Max_Vel_fps", FT_DOUBLE), ("First_Arrival_hr", FT_DOUBLE),
    ("ACER_Zone", FT_INT), ("ACER_Zone_Label", FT_STRING), ("ND_Outcome", FT_STRING),
    ("Persons", FT_INT),
]


def _multi(geom):
    """A copy of `geom` as a multi-polygon (GeoPackage layers hold one type)."""
    try:
        g = QgsGeometry(geom)
        if not g.isMultipart():
            g.convertToMultiType()
        return g
    except Exception:
        return geom


def evaluation_areas_layer(structs, crs, name="Structure_Evaluation_Areas", include_dry=False):
    """v2.6: the exact area each structure's maximum depth and velocity were
    searched in - the building outline grown by the 5-ft edge ring (ACER TM
    11 practice: water against the wall counts), or the disc around a point
    without an outline - with the values found there. Structures whose
    surroundings were dry have no area (their region was never built) and
    are left out unless include_dry. None when there is nothing to show."""
    lyr = create_memory_layer(name, WKB_MULTIPOLYGON, crs,
                              [QgsField(n, t) for n, t in EVAL_AREA_FIELDS])
    feats = []
    for rec in structs:
        region = rec.get("region")
        if region is None or region.isNull() or region.isEmpty():
            continue
        if not include_dry and rec.get("outcome", OUT_DRY) == OUT_DRY:
            continue
        z = rec.get("zone")
        f = QgsFeature(lyr.fields())
        f.setGeometry(_multi(region))
        f.setAttributes([int(rec["id"]), ", ".join(sorted(rec.get("families") or [])),
                         rec.get("fema_category") or NULL, rec.get("habitable") or NULL,
                         rec.get("acer_type") or NULL, rec.get("region_kind") or NULL,
                         _nz(rec.get("reach_ft")), rec.get("sampling") or NULL,
                         int(rec.get("n_cells") or 0), _nz(rec.get("max_depth")),
                         _nz(rec.get("max_vel")), _nz(rec.get("arrival")),
                         NULL if z is None else int(z), ZONE_LABELS.get(z, "") or NULL,
                         rec.get("outcome") or NULL, int(rec.get("persons") or 0)])
        feats.append(f)
    if not feats:
        return None
    add_features_batched(lyr.dataProvider(), feats, FEATURE_BATCH_SIZE)
    lyr.updateExtents()
    return lyr


def sampled_cells_layer(structs, crs, cell_w, cell_h, name="Structure_Sampled_Cells",
                        max_cells=400000):
    """v2.6: the raster cells that were read for each evaluated structure
    (one multi-polygon of cell squares per structure), from the cell centres
    kept by evaluate_structures(keep_cells=True). None when the centres were
    not kept, nothing is wet, or there are more than `max_cells` cells."""
    if not cell_w or not cell_h:
        return None
    total = sum(int(r.get("n_cells") or 0) for r in structs if r.get("cells_xy") is not None)
    if total == 0 or total > max_cells:
        return None
    lyr = create_memory_layer(name, WKB_MULTIPOLYGON, crs, [
        QgsField("Struct_ID", FT_INT), QgsField("Wet_Cells", FT_INT),
        QgsField("Max_Depth_ft", FT_DOUBLE), QgsField("Max_Vel_fps", FT_DOUBLE),
        QgsField("ACER_Zone_Label", FT_STRING)])
    hw, hh = abs(float(cell_w)) / 2.0, abs(float(cell_h)) / 2.0
    feats = []
    for rec in structs:
        cells = rec.get("cells_xy")
        if cells is None or rec.get("outcome", OUT_DRY) == OUT_DRY:
            continue
        xs, ys = cells
        polys = [[[QgsPointXY(x - hw, y - hh), QgsPointXY(x + hw, y - hh),
                   QgsPointXY(x + hw, y + hh), QgsPointXY(x - hw, y + hh),
                   QgsPointXY(x - hw, y - hh)]] for x, y in zip(xs.tolist(), ys.tolist())]
        if not polys:
            continue
        f = QgsFeature(lyr.fields())
        f.setGeometry(QgsGeometry.fromMultiPolygonXY(polys))
        z = rec.get("zone")
        f.setAttributes([int(rec["id"]), len(polys), _nz(rec.get("max_depth")),
                         _nz(rec.get("max_vel")), ZONE_LABELS.get(z, "") or NULL])
        feats.append(f)
    if not feats:
        return None
    add_features_batched(lyr.dataProvider(), feats, FEATURE_BATCH_SIZE)
    lyr.updateExtents()
    return lyr


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- QA --
QA_FIELDS = ["Struct_ID", "Issue", "FEMA_Category", "Habitable", "Sources", "X", "Y", "CRS"]


def address_of(rec):
    """(address, city, zip) of a structure for notification lists: the ND GIS
    Hub (NENA) address first, then any other source with a street address."""
    best = None
    for src in rec.get("sources", ()):
        if not src.get("addr_text"):
            continue
        rank = 0 if src.get("nena") else 1
        if best is None or rank < best[0]:
            best = (rank, src)
    if best is None:
        return "", "", ""
    s = best[1]
    return s.get("addr_text", ""), s.get("city", ""), s.get("zip", "")


def inventory_qa(structs, outline_families=(STRUCTURES_FAMILY, "OSM", "USA_STRUCTURES",
                                            "OUTLINES")):
    """(record, issue) pairs for the completeness check: outlines that no
    point source describes (possible unmapped dwelling or outbuilding) and
    points without an outline (possible missing footprint)."""
    fams = set(outline_families)
    rows = []
    for rec in structs:
        if rec["footprint"]:
            if not (rec["families"] - fams) and rec["category"] != CAT_NOT_HABITABLE:
                rows.append((rec, "outline without NSI / address point"))
        else:
            rows.append((rec, "point without building outline"))
    return rows


def write_qa_csv(rows, path, crs):
    """Inventory_QA.csv (UTF-8 with BOM so Excel shows accents). A copy
    open in Excel is not overwritten: this run's table gets a new name
    (returned)."""
    import csv
    from .helpers import prepare_output_path
    path = prepare_output_path(path)
    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(QA_FIELDS)
        for rec, issue in rows:
            try:
                p = rec["geom"].centroid().asPoint()
                x, y = round(p.x(), 3), round(p.y(), 3)
            except Exception:
                x = y = ""
            w.writerow([rec["id"], issue, rec.get("fema_category") or "", rec["habitable"],
                        ";".join(sorted(rec["families"])), x, y, crs.authid() or "custom"])
    return path
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Simple categorized styles for the classification outputs."""

from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QColor
from qgis.core import QgsSymbol, QgsRendererCategory, QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer

from .compat import GEOM_LINE, MSG_INFO
from .helpers import log_message

COLORS = {
    "HIGH": "#F44336", "JUDGMENT": "#FFEB3B", "LOW": "#4CAF50", "DRY": "#9E9E9E",
    "High": "#F44336", "Medium": "#FF9800", "Low": "#4CAF50",
    # sample locations (where the values were read)
    "Hmax_ft": "#08519C", "Vmax_ftps": "#D94801", "Arrival_hr": "#238B45",
    "EdgeBuf_Hmax_ft": "#6BAED6", "EdgeBuf_Vmax_ftps": "#FD8D3C",
    "Max depth": "#08519C", "Max velocity": "#D94801", "Max depth x velocity": "#7B3294",
    "Earliest arrival": "#238B45", "Controlling ACER zone": "#E7298A",
}


def style_by_field(layer, field):
    """Categorized renderer on `field` using the ACER / ND colours. Never
    raises - a styling problem must not fail the run."""
    try:
        idx = layer.fields().indexOf(field)
        if idx < 0:
            return False
        cats = []
        for v in sorted(layer.uniqueValues(idx), key=str):
            sym = QgsSymbol.defaultSymbol(layer.geometryType())
            if sym is None:
                continue
            sym.setColor(QColor(COLORS.get(str(v), "#607D8B")))
            if layer.geometryType() == GEOM_LINE and hasattr(sym, "setWidth"):
                sym.setWidth(1.2)
            cats.append(QgsRendererCategory(v, sym, str(v)))
        if not cats:
            return False
        layer.setRenderer(QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer(field, cats))
        layer.triggerRepaint()
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("Could not style {}: {}".format(layer.name(), e), MSG_INFO)
        return False


def style_depth(layer, max_ft=None):
    """Light-to-dark blue ramp for a depth raster (for maps and the report).
    Never raises."""
    try:
        from qgis.core import (QgsColorRampShader, QgsRasterShader,
                               QgsSingleBandPseudoColorRenderer)
        from .compat import SHADER_LINEAR
        top = float(max_ft) if max_ft else 10.0
        items = [QgsColorRampShader.ColorRampItem(0.0, QColor("#c6dbef"), "0 ft"),
                 QgsColorRampShader.ColorRampItem(top / 2.0, QColor("#4292c6"),
                                                  "{:g} ft".format(top / 2.0)),
                 QgsColorRampShader.ColorRampItem(top, QColor("#08306b"),
                                                  ">= {:g} ft".format(top))]
        ramp = QgsColorRampShader()
        if SHADER_LINEAR is not None:
            ramp.setColorRampType(SHADER_LINEAR)
        ramp.setColorRampItemList(items)
        shader = QgsRasterShader()
        shader.setRasterShaderFunction(ramp)
        layer.setRenderer(QgsSingleBandPseudoColorRenderer(layer.dataProvider(), 1, shader))
        layer.triggerRepaint()
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("Could not style {}: {}".format(layer.name(), e), MSG_INFO)
        return False


def style_outline(layer, color="#E7298A", width_mm=0.6, fill_alpha=0):
    """Hollow outline for an area layer (evaluation areas, sampled cells):
    coloured border, no or faint fill. Never raises."""
    try:
        from qgis.core import QgsFillSymbol, QgsSingleSymbolRenderer
        c = QColor(color)
        fill = QColor(c)
        fill.setAlpha(int(fill_alpha))
        sym = QgsFillSymbol.createSimple({
            "color": "{},{},{},{}".format(fill.red(), fill.green(), fill.blue(), fill.alpha()),
            "outline_color": "{},{},{},255".format(c.red(), c.green(), c.blue()),
            "outline_width": "{:.2f}".format(width_mm), "outline_style": "solid",
            "style": "solid" if fill_alpha else "no"})
        if sym is None:
            return False
        layer.setRenderer(QgsSingleSymbolRenderer(sym))
        layer.triggerRepaint()
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("Could not style {}: {}".format(layer.name(), e), MSG_INFO)
        return False


MAP_TIPS = {
    "Habitable_Structures": (
        '"Struct_ID"',
        '<b>Structure [% "Struct_ID" %]</b> ([% "Sources" %])<br>'
        'Habitable: [% "Habitable" %] - ACER type: [% "ACER_Type" %]<br>'
        'FEMA category: [% "FEMA_Category" %]<br>'
        'ACER zone: <b>[% "ACER_Zone_Label" %]</b> - ND outcome: <b>[% "ND_Outcome" %]</b><br>'
        'Depth [% round("Max_Depth_ft", 1) %] ft, velocity [% round("Max_Vel_fps", 1) %] '
        'ft/s, arrival [% round("First_Arrival_hr", 2) %] h<br>'
        'Persons [% "Persons" %] ([% "Persons_Basis" %])<br>[% "Reviewed" %]'),
    "Roads_Inundated": (
        '"Road_Name"',
        '<b>[% "Road_Name" %]</b> ([% "Road_Class" %])<br>ND class <b>[% "ND_Class" %]</b>: '
        '[% "ND_Basis" %]<br>Overtopped [% round("Length_ft", 0) %] ft, depth '
        '[% round("Max_Depth_ft", 1) %] ft'),
    "Structure_Sample_Points": (
        '"Struct_ID"',
        '<b>Structure [% "Struct_ID" %]</b><br>[% "Value_Type" %]: [% "Label" %]'),
    "Structure_Evaluation_Areas": (
        '"Struct_ID"',
        '<b>Structure [% "Struct_ID" %]</b> - area searched for max depth / velocity<br>'
        '[% "Area_Type" %] (reach [% round("Reach_ft", 1) %] ft)<br>'
        '[% "Wet_Cells" %] wet cell(s): [% "Sampling" %]<br>'
        'Depth [% round("Max_Depth_ft", 2) %] ft, velocity [% round("Max_Vel_fps", 2) %] '
        'ft/s - ACER zone <b>[% "ACER_Zone_Label" %]</b>, ND outcome [% "ND_Outcome" %]'),
    "Structure_Sampled_Cells": (
        '"Struct_ID"',
        '<b>Structure [% "Struct_ID" %]</b>: [% "Wet_Cells" %] wet cell(s) read<br>'
        'Depth [% round("Max_Depth_ft", 2) %] ft, velocity [% round("Max_Vel_fps", 2) %] '
        'ft/s - [% "ACER_Zone_Label" %]'),
    "Dams_In_Series": (
        '"Dam_Name"',
        '<b>[% "Dam_Name" %]</b> [% "NID_ID" %]<br>Hazard potential: [% "Hazard_Potential" %]'
        '<br>Flooded: [% "Flooded" %], depth [% round("Max_Depth_ft", 1) %] ft'),
    "Lifeline_Facilities": (
        '"Facility"',
        '<b>[% "Facility" %]</b> ([% "Category" %])<br>Flooded: [% "Flooded" %], depth '
        '[% round("Max_Depth_ft", 1) %] ft<br>[% "Source" %]'),
    "EAP_Notification": (
        '"Address"',
        '<b>#[% "Order" %] [% "Address" %]</b><br>[% "Type" %] - [% "Category" %]<br>'
        'Arrival [% "Arrival_hhmm" %], depth [% round("Max_Depth_ft", 1) %] ft'),
    "Model_Boundary_Check": (

        '[% round("Depth_ft", 1) %] ft, incremental [% round("Incr_ft", 1) %] ft'),
    "FEMA_Structures_Sample_Points": (
        '"Outline_FID"',
        '<b>[% "Value_Type" %]</b> = [% round("Value", 2) %]<br>[% "Method" %]'
        '<br>offset [% round("Offset_ft", 1) %] ft'),
}


def set_map_tip(layer, kind):
    """Identify / map-tip text for a plugin layer (View > Show Map Tips).
    Fields the layer does not have are simply left empty. Never raises."""
    try:
        key = next((k for k in MAP_TIPS if k in kind), None)
        if key is None:
            return False
        display, tip = MAP_TIPS[key]
        layer.setDisplayExpression(display)
        layer.setMapTipTemplate(tip)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log_message("Map tip not set on {}: {}".format(kind, e), MSG_INFO)
        return False
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Submittal package: the files of the last classification run that go to
the reviewer, gathered into one dated folder (optionally also one zip) with
a manifest and a cover-letter template.

    outputs/Submittal/<Dam>_<date>/
        README.txt                     what is in the package
        MANIFEST.csv                   every file, what it is, size, SHA-256
        Cover_Letter_TEMPLATE.txt      filled with the result; the engineer edits it
        01_Report/                     PDF report, summary
        02_Method_and_record/          run log, review decisions, change log, QA
        03_Results_tables/             structures, roads, rail ... (CSV / XLSX)
        04_EAP/                        map book, notification list, travel-time
        05_GIS/                        (optional) GeoPackages and zone rasters
        data/                          (v2.9, optional "include data") the files the
                                       run read: inputs/<role>/, layers/<cfg key>/,
                                       files/<key>/ (review decisions, curves ...),
                                       rasters/<scenario>/ (optional, they are big)
        Run_Settings_package.json      (with data) QA/Run_Settings.json with every
                                       packaged path relative to the package - what
                                       reproduce.py re-runs the classification from

Nothing is recalculated: the package holds the files the last run wrote, so
what is submitted is what was run. It works from the files on disk (and the
run's Last_Run_Snapshot.json for the result), so it can be made from QGIS,
a script or the hazard-creep watch alike.
"""

import csv
import glob
import hashlib
import os
import re
import shutil
import time
import zipfile

from .constants import PLUGIN_NAME, PLUGIN_VERSION, ND_POLICY_REF, SUBDIR_QA, \
    SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION, SUBDIR_EAP

SUBMITTAL_DIR = "Submittal"
COVER_NAME = "Cover_Letter_TEMPLATE.txt"
MANIFEST_NAME = "MANIFEST.csv"
README_NAME = "README.txt"

# (folder, [(pattern relative to outputs, description, newest only?)])
_TABLE_BASES = ("Habitable_Structures", "Roads_Inundated", "Rail_Inundated", "Access_Cut_Off",
                "Dams_In_Series", "Lifeline_Facilities", "Bridges_Culverts_Crossings",
                "Future_Development_Parcels")
GROUPS = [
    ("01_Report", [
        ("Hazard_Classification_Report*.pdf", "Hazard classification report (PDF)", True),
        ("Hazard_Classification_Summary.txt", "Classification summary (text)", False),
        ("Hazard_Classification_Summary.xlsx", "Classification summary (table)", False),
    ]),
    ("02_Method_and_record", [
        ("Hazard_Classification_Run_Log.txt",
         "Run log: settings, data sources, warnings, timings", False),
        ("Structure_Review_Decisions.csv", "Engineer's structure review decisions", False),
        ("Facility_Review_Decisions.csv",
         "Engineer's road / rail / crossing / lifeline review decisions (v2.9)", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Changes_Since_Last_Run.csv", "What changed since the previous run", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Last_Run_Snapshot.json", "Snapshot of this run's result", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Inventory_QA.csv", "Structure inventory completeness check", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/DSSWISE_HCOM_CrossCheck.csv",
         "Population at risk against the DSS-WISE HCOM table", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Model_Boundary_Check.csv", "Model extent check (flood at the raster edge)",
         False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Model_Gate.csv", "Model gate: checks of the flood model before the "
         "classification (v2.10)", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Class_Probability.csv", "Class probability over a model ensemble "
         "(v2.10)", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Class_Probability.html", "Class probability over a model ensemble "
         "(v2.10, page)", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Class_Probability_Runs.csv", "Class of every ensemble run (v2.10)",
         False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Rules_Comparison.csv", "This plugin's rules against the ND Dam Breach "
         "Runner / Screening rules, per structure (v2.10)", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Run_Settings.json",
         "Run settings: every setting, the rasters and the data sets the run read (v2.9)", False),
        (SUBDIR_QA + "/Data_Vintage.csv", "Data vintage: what the results rest on, with dates",
         False),
    ]),
    ("03_Results_tables", [
        ("{}/{}.csv".format(SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION, b), "{} (CSV)".format(b.replace("_", " ")),
         False) for b in _TABLE_BASES] + [
        ("{}/{}.xlsx".format(SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION, b), "{} (Excel)".format(b.replace("_", " ")),
         False) for b in _TABLE_BASES]),
    ("04_EAP", [
        (SUBDIR_EAP + "/EAP_Map_Book*.pdf", "Inundation map book (PDF)", True),
        (SUBDIR_EAP + "/EAP_Notification_List.csv", "Notification list (CSV)", False),
        (SUBDIR_EAP + "/EAP_Notification_List.xlsx", "Notification list (Excel)", False),
        (SUBDIR_EAP + "/EAP_Travel_Time.csv", "Travel-time table (CSV)", False),
        (SUBDIR_EAP + "/EAP_Travel_Time.xlsx", "Travel-time table (Excel)", False),
    ]),
]
GIS_GROUP = ("05_GIS", [
    (SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION + "/*.gpkg", "Result layer (GeoPackage)", False),
    (SUBDIR_CLASSIFICATION + "/Hazard_*.tif", "ACER zone raster", False),
    (SUBDIR_EAP + "/*.gpkg", "EAP layer (GeoPackage)", False),
    (SUBDIR_QA + "/Structure_Evaluation_Areas.gpkg", "Area evaluated around each structure",
     False),
])


def _safe(name):
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", str(name or "").strip()).strip("_")[:60] or "Dam"


def _sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def _find(out_folder, pattern, newest):
    hits = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(out_folder, pattern.replace("/", os.sep))))
    hits = [h for h in hits if os.path.isfile(h)]
    if newest and hits:
        hits = [max(hits, key=os.path.getmtime)]
    return hits


def collect(out_folder, include_gis=False):
    """[(group folder, source path, description)] of the files a package
    holds, in order; files that do not exist are left out."""
    groups = list(GROUPS) + ([GIS_GROUP] if include_gis else [])
    items, seen = [], set()
    for folder, specs in groups:
        for pattern, desc, newest in specs:
            for path in _find(out_folder, pattern, newest):
                key = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(path))
                if key in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(key)
                items.append((folder, path, desc))
    # v2.10 (item 13): the ND Dam Breach Runner manifest the classification was checked
    # against (QA/run_manifest.json, else the dam folder's current one - described so),
    # QA/Model_Chain_Check.csv / .txt and the dam's dam.json -> 02_Method_and_record
    try:
        from . import modelchain as MC
        extra = MC.package_files(out_folder)
    except Exception:
        extra = []
    for rel, path, desc in extra:
        key = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(path))
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        items.append((rel.split("/")[0], path, desc))
    return items


def read_result(out_folder):
    """The last run's result (dam, ND class, TM 11 class, lives in
    jeopardy, governing scenario, time) from its snapshot, or {}."""
    from . import history as HIS
    snap = HIS.read_snapshot(os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_QA)) or {}
    return {k: snap.get(k) for k in ("dam", "nd", "tm11", "lij", "governing", "time")
            if snap.get(k) is not None}


def cover_letter(result, dam_name, enclosures, when=None):
    """Text of the cover-letter template, filled with the run's result. The
    engineer completes and signs it; the classification stated is the
    plugin's screening result until the engineer confirms it."""
    when = when or time.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    nd = str(result.get("nd") or "[ND hazard class]").upper()
    tm = str(result.get("tm11") or "[TM 11 class]").upper()
    lij = result.get("lij")
    lines = [
        "[Engineering firm letterhead]",
        "",
        when,
        "",
        "North Dakota Department of Water Resources - Dam Safety Program",
        "[address]",
        "",
        "RE: Hazard potential classification - {}".format(dam_name or "[dam name]"),
        "    NID ID: [NID ID]      State file no.: [file number]",
        "",
        "Dear [reviewer]:",
        "",
        "Enclosed is the hazard potential classification submittal for {}, prepared under "
        "{}.".format(dam_name or "[dam name]", ND_POLICY_REF),
        "",
        "Result of the analysis run on {}:".format(result.get("time") or "[date]"),
        "  ND hazard potential classification (screening): {}".format(nd),
        "  USBR ACER TM 11 classification (screening):     {}{}".format(
            tm, "  (lives in jeopardy {:.1f})".format(lij) if lij is not None else ""),
        "  Governing breach scenario: {}".format(result.get("governing") or "[scenario]"),
        "",
        "[State the classification proposed, the engineering judgment applied to the items "
        "listed in the report, and any structures reviewed in the field.]",
        "",
        "Enclosures:",
    ] + ["  - {}".format(e) for e in enclosures] + [
        "",
        "Please contact me with any questions.",
        "",
        "Sincerely,",
        "",
        "[Name, P.E.]",
        "[License no. / state]",
        "[Telephone / e-mail]",
        "",
        "-- The screening results above were produced by {} v{}. They are not the "
        "classification until the engineer of record adopts them. --".format(
            PLUGIN_NAME, PLUGIN_VERSION),
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def readme(dam_name, result, rows, when, profile=None, data=None, chain=""):
    lines = ["Hazard classification submittal package - {}".format(dam_name or "dam"),
             "Made {} by {} v{} from the files of the last classification run".format(
                 when, PLUGIN_NAME, PLUGIN_VERSION), ""]
    if result:
        lines += ["Run of {}: ND {} / TM 11 {} (governing scenario {})".format(
            result.get("time") or "?", result.get("nd") or "?", result.get("tm11") or "?",
            result.get("governing") or "?"), ""]
    if profile:
        lines += ["Settings profile: '{}' (profile hash sha256 {}){}".format(
            profile.get("name") or "?", profile.get("sha256") or "?",
            " - the settings were changed after the profile was loaded: {}".format(
                ", ".join(profile.get("changed_keys") or [])) if profile.get("modified")
            else ""), ""]
    if chain:
        lines += [chain, ""]
    if data is not None:
        lines += ["Data for reproducing the run: {} file(s) in data/, settings in {}{}.".format(
            data.get("files", 0), data.get("settings_file") or "-",
            "" if data.get("rasters") else " (flood rasters NOT included - the reviewer needs "
            "them separately)"),
            "  To re-run the classification and check that the same result comes out: "
            "reproduce.reproduce(<this folder>, <work folder>[, rasters_folder=...]) - it "
            "writes Reproduction_Check.csv."]
        for n in data.get("not_packaged") or []:
            lines.append("  NOT packaged: {} ({}) - {}".format(n.get("what"), n.get("path"),
                                                             n.get("why")))
        for c in data.get("changed") or []:
            lines.append("  CHANGED since the run: {} ({}) - the package holds the file as it "
                         "is now, not as the run read it".format(c.get("what"), c.get("path")))
        lines.append("")
    lines += ["Files (also in {}, with SHA-256):".format(MANIFEST_NAME)]
    lines += ["  {}  -  {}".format(r["Path"], r["Description"]) for r in rows]
    lines += ["", "Cover_Letter_TEMPLATE.txt is a template: complete and sign it. Nothing here "
              "was recalculated for the package - it is what the last run wrote."]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def _chain_line(out_folder):
    """v2.10: the README line of the model chain check the run recorded, or ""."""
    try:
        from .modelchain import readme_line
        return readme_line(out_folder)
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _profile_info(out_folder, profile):
    """(record, source file or None) of the settings profile to name in the
    package: `profile` = a profile file path or its meta / status dict (with
    "name", "sha256", optional "path"); None: the one the run recorded in
    QA/Run_Settings.json ("settings_profile"), if any."""
    if profile is None:
        try:
            from .reproduce import read_run_settings, RUN_SETTINGS_FILE
            rs = read_run_settings(os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_QA, RUN_SETTINGS_FILE))
            profile = rs.get("settings_profile") or None
        except (ValueError, OSError):
            profile = None
        if not isinstance(profile, dict):
            return None, None
    if isinstance(profile, str):
        from .settings import load_profile
        _state, meta = load_profile(profile)
        return ({"name": meta["name"], "sha256": meta["sha256"], "note": meta.get("note", ""),
                 "created": meta.get("created", ""), "path": meta["path"]}, meta["path"])
    rec = {k: profile.get(k) for k in ("name", "sha256", "note", "created", "modified",
                                       "changed_keys", "path") if profile.get(k) is not None}
    src = rec.get("path") if rec.get("path") and os.path.isfile(rec["path"]) else None
    return rec, src


def build(out_folder, dam_name=None, zip_it=True, include_gis=False, dest_root=None,
          when_ts=None, profile=None, include_data=False, include_rasters=False):
    """Make the package. Returns {"folder", "zip", "files", "missing", "result",
    "profile", "data", "warnings"} where "missing" lists what a submittal
    normally holds and this run did not write (e.g. no report because
    report_pdf was off). Raises ValueError when the outputs folder holds no
    classification run at all.

    v2.9: `profile` (a settings-profile path, or its meta / status dict; None =
    the one QA/Run_Settings.json records) is named in the README and the
    manifest (its file is copied to 02_Method_and_record when it exists).
    `include_data`: the files the run read (QA/Run_Settings.json "inputs",
    project layers, review decisions ...) are copied to data/ with
    Run_Settings_package.json (reproduce.py); `include_rasters` adds the flood
    rasters (they are big). Without QA/Run_Settings.json (a run of an older
    version) nothing can be packaged: listed in "missing"."""
    if not out_folder or not os.path.isdir(out_folder):
        raise ValueError("Outputs folder not found: {}".format(out_folder))
    items = collect(out_folder, include_gis=include_gis)
    if not any(os.path.basename(p).startswith("Hazard_Classification_") for _g, p, _d in items):
        raise ValueError("No classification run in {} - run the Hazard Classification "
                         "first".format(out_folder))
    result = read_result(out_folder)
    dam = dam_name or result.get("dam") or "Dam"
    prof, prof_src = _profile_info(out_folder, profile)
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(when_ts)) if when_ts else \
        time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    root = dest_root or os.path.join(out_folder, SUBMITTAL_DIR)
    base = "{}_{}".format(_safe(dam), stamp)
    folder = os.path.join(root, base)
    n = 1
    while os.path.exists(folder) or os.path.exists(folder + ".zip"):
        n += 1
        folder = os.path.join(root, "{}_{}".format(base, n))
    os.makedirs(folder)
    rows = []
    data_missing, warnings = [], []
    data = None

    def add_row(rel, src, desc):
        dest = os.path.join(folder, *rel.split("/"))
        rows.append({"Path": rel, "Description": desc, "Size_bytes": os.path.getsize(dest),
                     "SHA256": _sha256(dest),
                     "Source_modified": time.strftime(
                         "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(os.path.getmtime(src)))
                     if src and os.path.exists(src) else ""})
    try:
        for group, src, desc in items:
            dest_dir = os.path.join(folder, group)
            os.makedirs(dest_dir, exist_ok=True)
            dest = os.path.join(dest_dir, os.path.basename(src))
            shutil.copy2(src, dest)
            add_row("{}/{}".format(group, os.path.basename(src)), src, desc)
        if prof:
            if prof_src:
                name = "Settings_Profile_{}.json".format(_safe(prof.get("name")))
                dest_dir = os.path.join(folder, "02_Method_and_record")
                os.makedirs(dest_dir, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copy2(prof_src, os.path.join(dest_dir, name))
                add_row("02_Method_and_record/" + name, prof_src,
                        "Settings profile '{}' used for the run (profile hash {})".format(
                            prof.get("name"), prof.get("sha256")))
            else:
                warnings.append("settings profile '{}' (hash {}) recorded, its file is not "
                                "at hand".format(prof.get("name"), prof.get("sha256")))
        if include_data:
            data = _package_data(out_folder, folder, include_rasters, data_missing, warnings,
                                 add_row)
        enclosures = [r["Description"] for r in rows if r["Path"].startswith(
            ("01_Report", "04_EAP")) or "Review_Decisions" in r["Path"]
            or "Run_Log" in r["Path"]]
        with open(os.path.join(folder, COVER_NAME), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(cover_letter(result, dam, enclosures))
        with open(os.path.join(folder, MANIFEST_NAME), "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=["Path", "Description", "Size_bytes", "SHA256",
                                               "Source_modified"])
            w.writeheader()
            w.writerows(rows)
        with open(os.path.join(folder, README_NAME), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(readme(dam, result, rows, time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), prof, data,
                            chain=_chain_line(out_folder)))
        zpath = None
        if zip_it:
            zpath = folder + ".zip"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, allowZip64=True) as zf:
                for dirpath, _d, files in os.walk(folder):
                    for f in sorted(files):
                        full = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
                        zf.write(full, os.path.join(os.path.basename(folder),
                                                    os.path.relpath(full, folder)))
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)         # never leave half a package
        if zip_it and os.path.exists(folder + ".zip"):
            try:
                os.remove(folder + ".zip")
            except OSError:
                pass
        raise
    have = {r["Path"].split("/")[0] + "/" + os.path.basename(r["Path"]) for r in rows}
    missing = []
    if not any(p.endswith(".pdf") and p.startswith("01_Report") for p in have):
        missing.append("PDF report (the run had 'PDF report' off, or it failed - see the run "
                       "log)")
    if not any(p.startswith("02_Method_and_record/Structure_Review") for p in have):
        missing.append("engineer review decisions (none saved yet)")
    if not any(p.startswith("04_EAP/EAP_Map_Book") for p in have):
        missing.append("EAP inundation map book (off, or no arrival raster)")
    missing.extend(data_missing)
    return {"folder": folder, "zip": zpath, "files": rows, "missing": missing,
            "result": result, "profile": prof, "data": data, "warnings": warnings}


def _package_data(out_folder, folder, include_rasters, missing, warnings, add_row):
    """Copy the run's inputs into the package (reproduce.package_inputs) and add
    their manifest rows. Returns the summary for the README / the caller."""
    from . import reproduce as RP
    spath = os.path.join(out_folder, SUBDIR_QA, RP.RUN_SETTINGS_FILE)
    try:
        rs = RP.read_run_settings(spath)
    except ValueError as e:
        missing.append("data for reproducing the run: no usable QA/{} ({}) - run the "
                       "classification again with this version".format(
                           RP.RUN_SETTINGS_FILE, e))
        return None
    got = RP.package_inputs(rs, folder, include_rasters=include_rasters)
    for rel, src, desc in got["rows"]:
        add_row(rel, src, desc)
    add_row(got["settings_file"], None,
            "Run settings with the packaged paths (for reproduce.py)")
    for n in got["not_packaged"]:
        if "rasters not included" not in n.get("why", ""):
            warnings.append("not packaged: {} ({}) - {}".format(n["what"], n["path"],
                                                                 n["why"]))
    for c in got["changed"]:
        warnings.append("changed since the run: {} ({}) - the package holds the file as it "
                        "is now".format(c["what"], c["path"]))
    return {"files": len(got["rows"]), "settings_file": got["settings_file"],
            "rasters": bool(include_rasters), "not_packaged": got["not_packaged"],
            "changed": got["changed"]}
```

## `suite_algorithms.py`

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""v2.10: Processing algorithms of the dam-suite exports (for the "ndhazard"
provider; the lead registers them in processing_provider.Provider.loadAlgorithms):

  ndhazard:runnerculverts  culvert / bridge lines for ND Dam Breach Runner
                           (runnerculverts.py, dam suite item 8)
  ndhazard:suiteexport     one GeoPackage in ND Dam Breach Screening's data
                           package schema (suiteexport.py, dam suite item 12)

This file does not import processing_provider (so the provider may import it at
module level without a circular import); the few enum spellings it needs are
resolved here the same way (compat._first). Nothing here has been run inside a
real QGIS.
"""

import os

from qgis.core import (
    Qgis, QgsProcessingAlgorithm, QgsProcessingException, QgsProcessing,
    QgsProcessingParameterVectorLayer, QgsProcessingParameterFile,
    QgsProcessingParameterBoolean, QgsProcessingParameterNumber, QgsProcessingParameterEnum,
    QgsProcessingParameterString, QgsProcessingOutputFile, QgsProcessingOutputString,
    QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem, QgsCoordinateTransform, QgsProject,
)

from .compat import _first

try:                                    # not in every test double
    from qgis.core import QgsProcessingParameterFileDestination as _FileDest
except ImportError:                     # pragma: no cover - depends on the build
    _FileDest = None
try:
    from qgis.core import QgsProcessingParameterExtent as _Extent
except ImportError:                     # pragma: no cover
    _Extent = None

NUM_DOUBLE = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingNumberParameterType.Double,
                    lambda: QgsProcessingParameterNumber.Type.Double,
                    lambda: QgsProcessingParameterNumber.Double)
FILE_FILE = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingFileParameterBehavior.File,
                   lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Behavior.File,
                   lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.File)
FILE_FOLDER = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingFileParameterBehavior.Folder,
                     lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Behavior.Folder,
                     lambda: QgsProcessingParameterFile.Folder)
SRC_LINE = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingSourceType.VectorLine,
                  lambda: QgsProcessing.SourceType.TypeVectorLine,
                  lambda: QgsProcessing.TypeVectorLine)
SRC_POINT = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingSourceType.VectorPoint,
                   lambda: QgsProcessing.SourceType.TypeVectorPoint,
                   lambda: QgsProcessing.TypeVectorPoint)
SRC_POLYGON = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingSourceType.VectorPolygon,
                     lambda: QgsProcessing.SourceType.TypeVectorPolygon,
                     lambda: QgsProcessing.TypeVectorPolygon)
NO_THREADING = _first(lambda: Qgis.ProcessingAlgorithmFlag.NoThreading,
                      lambda: QgsProcessingAlgorithm.Flag.FlagNoThreading,
                      lambda: QgsProcessingAlgorithm.FlagNoThreading, default=0)


def layer_features(layer, extent=None, feedback=None):
    """[(GeoJSON-like feature, geometry in EPSG:5070)] of a QGIS vector layer: each geometry
    is transformed to EPSG:4326 by QGIS, then projected with suitegpkg (the same path as
    the pack's features). extent: lon / lat box - features outside are skipped."""
    from . import suitegpkg as G
    from .helpers import transform_geometry, _wkb_bytes, is_null
    from .offline_pack import intersects_rect
    from .suiteexport import projected
    if layer is None:
        return []
    xf = QgsCoordinateTransform(layer.crs(), QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem("EPSG:4326"),
                                QgsProject.instance().transformContext())
    names = [f.name() for f in layer.fields()]
    out, bad = [], 0
    for feat in layer.getFeatures():
        if feedback is not None and feedback.isCanceled():
            raise QgsProcessingException("cancelled")
        g = transform_geometry(feat.geometry(), xf)
        if g is None or g.isNull() or g.isEmpty():
            continue
        try:
            try:
                from qgis.core import QgsWkbTypes, QgsGeometry
                if QgsWkbTypes.isCurvedType(g.wkbType()):
                    g = QgsGeometry(g.constGet().segmentize())
            except Exception:
                pass
            geom = G._read_wkb(_wkb_bytes(g))[0]
        except Exception:
            bad += 1
            continue
        if extent is not None and not intersects_rect(geom, extent):
            continue
        props = {n: (None if is_null(v) else v) for n, v in zip(names, feat.attributes())}
        out.append({"type": "Feature", "geometry": geom, "properties": props})
    if bad and feedback is not None:
        feedback.pushInfo("{}: {} geometr{} could not be read and were skipped".format(
            layer.name(), bad, "y" if bad == 1 else "ies"))
    return projected(out)


class _SuiteBase(QgsProcessingAlgorithm):
    def group(self):
        return "Dam suite exports"

    def groupId(self):
        return "damsuite"

    def createInstance(self):
        return type(self)()

    def flags(self):
        return super().flags() | NO_THREADING

    # ---- shared parameters
    def _add_source_params(self):
        P = self.addParameter
        P(QgsProcessingParameterFile(
            "PACK", "ND Dam Hazard offline data pack (.zip / .sqlite; empty = the pack chosen "
            "on the Data tab, if any)", behavior=FILE_FILE, optional=True,
            fileFilter="ND Dam Hazard offline data pack (*.zip *.sqlite);;All files (*.*)"))
        P(QgsProcessingParameterFile(
            "DOWNLOADS", "or: a folder of ND Dam Hazard downloads (a dam output folder, its "
            "_downloads folder or a folder of dams)", behavior=FILE_FOLDER, optional=True))
        if _Extent is not None:
            P(_Extent("EXTENT", "Area (empty = North Dakota)", optional=True))
        else:
            P(QgsProcessingParameterString(
                "EXTENT", "Area 'xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax [EPSG:4326]' (empty = North Dakota)",
                defaultValue="", optional=True))

    def _add_output(self, name, desc):
        if _FileDest is not None:
            self.addParameter(_FileDest(name, desc, "GeoPackage (*.gpkg)"))
        else:
            self.addParameter(QgsProcessingParameterString(name, desc, defaultValue=""))

    def _output_path(self, parameters, name, context, default_name):
        if _FileDest is not None:
            path = self.parameterAsFileOutput(parameters, name, context)
        else:
```
